jobs.title: Corporate Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
Job title: Corporate Affairs Lead

Location: Barangaroo, AUS

Position Type: Full time, Permanent

About the Job:

• A senior member of Sanofi Australia & New Zealand’s Corporate Affairs team, the Corporate Affairs Lead oversees all disciples including government relations, policy development, stakeholder management, patient group engagement, media relations, market readiness / launch campaigning, issues management and leadership voice for the ANZ organisation.

• This is a senior role requiring the ability to provide well rounded counsel to executive leaders and the ability to craft holistic Corporate Affairs strategy to meet the broad needs of the business.

• Reporting directly to the Head of Corporate Affairs, Sanofi Australia & New Zealand, this role will also provide cross functional counsel across the broader Corporate Affairs team. It will contribute to corporate policy, insights programs and more as required.

Main Responsibilities:

• Responsible for overarching delivery of all government, policy, media, social, and GM communication activities for specified Business Units and/or therapeutic areas.
• Ensure strategies and activities, for each Corporate Affairs discipline, are crafted with clear objectives and KPIs.
• Ensure product market readiness and launch campaigns are delivered to a high standard with clear objectives and KPIs.
• Lead policy development and advocacy activities specific to those Business Units and/or therapeutic areas. Contribute to One Sanofi policy positions.
• Lead and oversee all government, industry, patient group / HCO and community relationships related to those Business Units and/or therapeutic areas. Ensure all Sanofi policies and procedures are followed while managing those relationships.
• Protect reputation –support leaders to exercise good judgement in business decisions and stakeholder engagement.
• Manage relevant issues and lead crisis management support
• Manage external agency partners as their work applies to those Business Units and/or therapeutic areas corporate affairs activities.
• Responsible for developing and reporting key impact measures

About you:

Essential Qualifications

• 10+ years, in senior Corporate Communications, Public Affairs or Corporate Affairs roles in large organisations.
• Experience managing complex stakeholder relationships to deliver outstanding results.
• Experience providing Corporate Affairs counsel to senior leaders on complex matters of potential public interest.
• Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, politics or similar.
• Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• Corporate Affairs experience in the healthcare industry.
• Issues Management of complex corporate issues.

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

jobs.title: Associate Producer, MS NOW Podcasts
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
MS NOW is looking for an Associate Producer to join our Podcast Unit. This role will work across multiple podcasts and projects, with a focus on news and politics. The AP’s primary roles will be to support the unit with a combination of administrative duties (such as organizing tape, booking studios, and maintaining calendars), and editorial roles (like fact checking, cutting tape, and researching). The AP will work closely with podcast Producers and Coordinating Producers on assignments, typically working under tight deadlines. We’re eager to bring in someone who knows how to move fast, think critically, and stay extremely organized while doing it.

The exact assignment(s) may change over time as unit needs evolve. The role will work across podcasts and projects within the unit, supporting a range of editorial and production needs. Responsibilities include pitching, booking, pulling tape, researching stories, editing tape and producing social clips. We also hope to loop this person into some development projects and task them with occasionally taking the lead in junior-level assignments. It’s an exciting early-career role for someone with editorial promise who has already mastered being a logistical powerhouse.

The strongest candidates will have newsroom experience, as well as know how to edit audio and video. Adherence to journalistic best practices is a must.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Support the production process end-to-end, occasionally taking the lead on junior-level assignments
• Manage the logistics of setting up a recording, such as shipping mic kits and maintaining calendars
• Organize incoming tape, as well as find & isolate file tape
• Prepare research materials
• Edit audio and video
• Draft scripts and metadata
• Review episode mixes and provide feedback to audio engineer and video editor
• Order graphics for YouTube
• Pull social media materials
• Manage listener mail where applicable
• Manage show websites where applicable
• Organize show folders and unit documents
• Post TV special coverage as audio-only offerings
• Backfill for lead show producers when needed
• Produce bonus content (such as Premium and DTC offerings)
• Additional duties as assigned
• Subject to change as role and company needs are expected to evolve over time

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
• Minimum 3 years of audio production experience, preferably in podcasting
• Minimum 1 year of video editing experience, preferably for YouTube podcasting
• Technical expertise in Pro Tools, Descript, and Premiere
• Demonstrated ability to handle multiple projects under deadline
• Follows current video and podcasting trends
• Strong understanding of news & politics
• Understanding of journalism ethics

Desired Qualifications:

• Collaborative attitude and strong communication skills
• Fast learner
• Self-motivated to continually grow their skillset
• Adaptable to the needs of an evolving team
• Able to take accountability
• Enjoys solving problems, and does so pro-actively
• Highly organized
• Works well within a large organization
• Comfortable working on shared projects

Additional Requirements:

• Must be willing to work in New York, NY
• Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
• Must be willing to work varied shifts as news & production needs change

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.

Salary range: $75,000 - $80,000

jobs.title: Coordinating Politics Video Producer/Editor, MS NOW Digital
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
The MS NOW Politics Video Coordinating Producer/Editor will play a key role in shaping our social and digital video coverage of the 2028 election cycle. Working closely with campaign embeds, field producers and reporters across the country, this producer will identify the biggest stories and most compelling moments from the campaign trail and turn them into sharp, distinctive video for digital platforms.

We are looking for someone who lives and breathes politics, has exceptional editorial judgment and is an expert video editor. This person knows how to look at a complicated political story, candidate event or interview and quickly distill it down to the key headline and the most compelling video. They understand what matters, why it matters and how to make it resonate with a broad audience.

This role also requires a strong editorial leader who can work closely with reporters and producers in the field—helping them sharpen their ideas, identify the best moments, and deliver videos that are punchy, informative, authoritative, and built for digital audiences. This producer/editor is constantly on the pulse of what is happening across the country and ready to react when the political story changes.

This position is represented by the Writers Guild of America East.

Responsibilities:

• Work closely with 2028 campaign embeds, field producers and reporters to produce compelling original video daily.
• Write, edit, and produce multiple vertical videos daily, either by yourself or assigned to a teammate.
• Serve as a key editorial partner to political desk, political director and DC Bureau executives.
• Shape video reports by identifying the most compelling angles and video.
• Oversee and sharpen scripts.
• Monitor the campaign coverage notes and candidate schedules throughout the day and identify the moments, interviews, exchanges that are most compelling.
• React quickly to breaking political news, turning video that is fast, accurate, distinctive, and competitive.
• Distill complicated political stories and campaign developments into clear, compelling storytelling for a broad audience.
• Generate daily and long-term original video pitches responsive to the political news cycle and developments across campaign.
• Edit longer form video for YouTube and OTT platforms.
• Identify opportunities for campaign reporting to break through with new franchises.
• Write compelling headlines, scripts, and social copy.
• Develop new social franchises and formats around the 2028 election.
• Innovate with new ideas and storytelling approaches to grow the audience and the MS NOW brand.

• Minimum 7 years of digital or social video editing, producing, and writing experience.
• Deep expertise in politics, campaigns, and elections, with a strong understanding of the candidates, issues and forces shaping the 2028 election cycle.
• Adobe Premiere expert who can edit quickly and confidently when speed is the priority.
• Proven experience editing and producing original digital video.
• Exceptional editorial judgment and an instinct for identifying the strongest and most compelling element of a political story.
• Strong scriptwriting and headline-writing skills, with the ability to distill complex stories into clear, accessible, and engaging video.
• Ability to work closely with reporters and producers and provide strong editorial direction on framing and scripting.
• Ability to recognize the moment from the campaign trail that audiences need to see and quickly turn it into compelling video.
• Strong commitment to accuracy, fairness, context, and nuance.
• Ability to manage multiple stories and original projects simultaneously in an extremely fast-moving news environment.
• Ability to delegate work to staff working with you.
• Strong knowledge of TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and other social and digital platforms and their audiences.
• Comply with the Standards and Practices of MS NOW.

Desired Qualifications:

• Previous experience covering presidential campaigns, elections, Congress or Washington politics.
• A demonstrated ability to spot emerging political stories and narratives before they become the dominant story of the day.
• Ability to develop original story ideas, research and plan coverage with reporters and producers in the field.
• Strong coaching and communication skills, with the ability to help reporters sharpen their storytelling and on-camera delivery.
• Work well both independently (must be a self-starter) and collaboratively as part of an integrated political and digital team.
• Strong follow-through and attention to detail.
• Ability to work calmly and decisively under intense deadline pressure.
• Understanding of digital gear, including camera operations and microphones.
• A genuine enthusiasm for political reporting and the unpredictability and pace of a presidential campaign.

Additional Requirements:

• Must be willing to work in Washington, D.C.
• Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
• Must be willing and able to work flexible hours under tight deadline pressure, including nights, weekends, breaking news, debates, election events, and special projects.
• Must have a valid U.S. driver’s license and be willing to drive.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.

Salary Range: $115,000 - $150,000

As a Diesel Technician, you play a crucial role in our Service department, helping keep our customers on the road by delivering top-notch repairs and maintenance.

We are pleased to offer a sign-on bonus of up to $7,500 based on experience!

• Tackle general and major repairs across various truck systems, including engines, transmissions, suspensions, brakes, HVAC, electronics, and more.

jobs.title: Enterprise Engineer (U-SIEM)
jobs.description:
Link Solutions is seeking an Enterprise Engineer (U-SIEM) to join our team in Fort Huachuca, AZ.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen
• Active DoD Secret Clearance
• IAT Level III certification required
• Non-remote (relocation incentive available)

The Enterprise Engineer (U-SIEM) will support the Army Department of Defense Information Network (DoDIN) Cybersecurity and Network Operations Mission Support (ADCNOMS) program, providing enterprise engineering expertise to the U.S. Army Network Enterprise Technology Command (NETCOM).

You will be responsible for engineering, integrating, and sustaining enterprise SIEM solutions that enable proactive cyber defense, strengthen situational awareness, and protect critical network infrastructure supporting Army missions worldwide. As a key member of a multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate with Government and contractor personnel to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity capabilities.

This highly visible role offers the opportunity to influence enterprise cyber operations and make a meaningful impact on the Army's security posture and mission success.

Job Responsibilities:

• Develop, maintain, and deliver provisioning documentation and technical implementation packages for fielding activities.
• Conduct technical research and analysis to address emerging technology challenges and mission requirements.
• Utilize Linux operating systems, VMware virtualization technologies, and SIEM platforms to support daily engineering and operational activities.
• Support the U-SIEM Engineering Team and Government stakeholders to ensure mission objectives and deliverables are achieved.
• Collaborate with engineering teams and coordinate with customers as directed by project and technical leadership.
• Drive timely completion of assigned projects and tasks while adapting to evolving mission priorities and requirements.
• Analyze and resolve complex technical issues across enterprise cybersecurity and infrastructure environments.
• Support enterprise planning, design, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment activities for U-SIEM capabilities.
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering artifacts, system designs, implementation plans, and configuration records.
• Support cybersecurity operations through security monitoring, event management, log aggregation, and threat detection activities.
• Assist with enterprise architecture planning and capability modernization efforts supporting NETCOM requirements.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams within a distributed enterprise environment.
• Participate in systems testing, validation, troubleshooting, and performance optimization activities.
• Support virtualization infrastructure, systems integration, and enterprise platform management initiatives.
• Provide technical recommendations and engineering solutions that improve system security, scalability, reliability, and operational effectiveness.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

• U.S. Citizen
• Active DoD Secret Clearance.
• IAT Level III certification (SecurityX/CASP+, CISSP, CCNP Security, CISA, or equivalent).
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline.
• Eight (8+) years of relevant technical experience supporting enterprise information technology, cybersecurity, systems engineering, or network operations environments.
• Demonstrated experience working with Internet, web, application, and network security technologies.
• Working knowledge of Enterprise Linux operating systems.
• Working knowledge of Elastic and enterprise SIEM technologies.
• Experience supporting virtualization platforms and enterprise infrastructure environments.
• Experience developing technical reports, engineering documentation, system design plans, functional requirements documentation, information system security plans, or related technical guidance.
• Demonstrated proficiency with Linux, virtualization technologies, and security information and event management platforms.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred:

• Computing Environment (CE) Certification such as RHCSA, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), CCNA Cybersecurity, or equivalent/higher-level certification.
• Experience supporting U.S. Army, NETCOM, DoD Cyber, or Federal cybersecurity operations environments.
• Experience supporting enterprise SIEM implementations, security monitoring, and log management platforms.
• Experience with Elastic Stack, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, or related technologies.
• Experience supporting Kubernetes, containerized environments, and cloud-native technologies.
• Experience supporting VMware virtualization infrastructure and enterprise architecture initiatives.
• Knowledge of RMF, NIST 800-53, STIGs, ACAS, and cybersecurity compliance requirements.
• Experience supporting large-scale distributed enterprise networks and cybersecurity programs.
• Experience developing technical design documentation and implementation plans.
• Ability to work effectively within geographically dispersed engineering teams.
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Experience supporting mission-critical systems and enterprise-scale cybersecurity operations.

Link Solutions Inc. offers a competitive compensation and benefits package to include paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, company-paid long and short-term disability, life insurance, referral bonuses, relocation reimbursement incentive, certification reimbursement program, retirement, and more.

Link Solutions, Inc. is an EOE. AA/M/F/D/V. We participate in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: CPM Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

This position will initially be based in Tampa, Florida, supporting several local design and construction initiatives. The role will typically oversee projects from design through final completion, ensuring they are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with design, regulatory, and contract requirements, while achieving a high level of client satisfaction. Future assignments may vary.

The CPM Construction Project Manager is responsible for oversight of Veolia construction projects, engineering subcontractors, construction subcontractors and subordinate personnel assigned to those projects. Primary objectives of the role include:

• Lead project team with respect to field engineering support for construction activities.
• Manage and coordinate the efforts of subcontractors.
• Lead coordination of both design and construction activities at the site.
• Work with existing operation teams and on site contractors to ensure that work is properly coordinated and done safely.
• Ensure financial commitments and obligations of assigned projects are being met and create/execute mitigation efforts when they are not.
• Works to create a collaborative work environment.
• Ensure designated project tools (e.g. Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Masterworks) are being used in accordance with company protocols and contract/project requirements.
• Direct and lead subordinates in efforts to properly execute design and construction projects in accordance with company policies, project contracts and appropriate industry practice.
• Interact with client to ensure that the client agency maintains a high level of confidence and satisfaction with Veolia and projects managed by Veolia.
• Be knowledgeable of project contracts.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Project Planning and Execution:Develop and maintain the overall project management plan.Establish project objectives and delivery strategies.Coordinate construction activities.Plan site logistics, temporary facilities, access and laydown areas.Ensure constructability is considered during design development and construction planning.
• Schedule Management:Monitor project progressive in accordance with the master construction schedule.Track progress against milestones and production targets.Analyze delays, disruptions, and schedule risks.Lead or participate in recovery efforts.Coordinate shutdowns, tie-ins, testing, startup, and commissioning activities.
• Cost and Financial Control:Monitor the construction budget and cost forecasts.Review commitments, expenditures, invoices, change orders, and payment applications.Evaluate the cost and schedule impacts of proposed changes.Implement cost-control measures and report variances to project leadership.
• Contract and Commercial Management:Administer prime contracts, construction management agreements, and subcontractor contracts.Ensure contractors comply with contract terms, specifications, drawings, and approved schedules.Manage requests for information, submittals, notices, claims, disputes, and changes.Review and negotiate change orders, extensions of time, and additional-cost requests.Maintain complete project records in accordance with company requirements.
• Safety and Health Management:Promote a strong site safety culture and enforce the project safety plan.Ensure compliance with applicable occupational safety regulations and owner requirements.Review contractor safety plans, permits, job hazard analyses, and emergency response procedures.Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions and ensure corrective actions are completed.
• Quality Assurance and Quality Control:Implement and enforce the project quality management plan.Verify that construction complies with approved drawings, specifications, codes, standards, and manufacturer requirements.Ensure deficiencies are documented, corrected, and closed before acceptance.
• Design and Technical Coordination:Coordinate design teams, engineers, contractors, vendors, client/owner and field personnel.Review drawings, specifications, technical submittals, shop drawings, and equipment data.Resolve design conflicts, field conditions, constructability issues, and interface problems.Manage the request-for-information process and ensure timely technical decisions.
• Procurement and Materials Management:Coordinate procurement of long-lead equipment and critical materials.Monitor vendor engineering, fabrication, inspections, shipping, and delivery.Track material status and ensure materials are available when required by the schedule.Verify receiving inspections, storage conditions, preservation, and inventory control.
• Regulatory and Environmental Compliance:Ensure compliance with permits, environmental requirements, water-quality regulations, building codes, and utility standards.Maintain required records, reports, and compliance documentation.Support permit modifications and regulatory reviews when project conditions change.
• Stakeholder and Communication Management:Serve as a primary point of contact among the owner, designer, contractors, operators, regulators, utilities, and community representatives.Lead progress meetings, coordination meetings, design reviews, and risk workshops.Prepare regular reports covering schedule, cost, safety, quality, risks, changes, and key decisions.Communicate impacts of construction activities to plant operations and surrounding stakeholders.Escalate critical issues promptly and provide recommendations for resolution.
• Interface and Operations Coordination:Coordinate construction with existing plant operations and ongoing treatment activities.Lead or participate in Maintenance of Plant Operations efforts.Ensure operator training, operating procedures, maintenance requirements, and asset handover are performed in accordance with contract requirements.
• Risk and Issue Management:Maintain the project risk register and mitigation plans.Identify risks related to geotechnical conditions, buried utilities, permitting, procurement, constructability, startup, and operations.Lead or participate in the dispute resolution process as defined by the contract.Monitor emerging risks and assess their cost, schedule, safety, quality, and operational impacts.Ensure lessons learned are captured and applied.
• Testing, Commissioning, and Startup:Review and coordinate the commissioning and startup plans with the owner, design team, contractors, and operators.Ensure activities are performed in accordance with the contract and applicable plans, including systems are mechanically complete before testing and commissioning, and the following are performed appropriately: prefunctional checks, pressure testing, flushing, cleaning, electrical testing, controls verification, and performance testing, process validation and demonstration of treatment performance.Track commissioning deficiencies and ensure they are resolved.Ensure regulatory acceptance, operational readiness, and proper transition to operations.
• Closeout and Handover:Confirm completion of punch-list work and contractual obligations.Collect as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, spare parts, test records, certificates, and training documentation.Verify final inspections, approvals, permits, and acceptance documentation.Support final account settlement and contract closeout.Complete lessons learned and ensure a smooth transition to plant operations and maintenance.
• Ultimately, the construction project manager is accountable for integrating all project functions and ensuring that the project is:Safely constructed.Compliant with permits, codes, and specifications.Delivered within the approved budget and schedule.Properly tested and commissioned.Capable of meeting its required treatment performance.Fully documented and ready for reliable operation.

Work Environment:

• This job operates in an office, water treatment plant process settings, and both indoor and outdoor construction settings.
• This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers.

Education/Experience/Background:

• Four year college degree.
• Experience in a project management role.
• Experience with managing direct reports.
• Experience with direct client communications.
• Experience with working on Maintenance of Plant Operations efforts.
• Master’s Degree is preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Strong analytical skills and process focus.
• Tenacity and energy in leading change toward a high performing work environment.
• Analytical skills as normally attained through education and field experience.
• Ability to influence and coach others for results.
• Problem-solving skills and follow-up ability.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Demonstrated effective communication, presentation and interpersonal skills in order to interface with and motivate all levels of personnel.
• Ability to understand and use reference materials (manuals, schematics, etc.).
• Demonstrated ability to prepare accurate, effective, complete and easily understood written communications and reports.
• Demonstrated commitment to compliance with applicable laws and regulations, the Company’s Code of Business Conduct and other Company policies and procedures.
• Understanding of construction site safety practices, design drawings, cost estimating, construction schedules and cost and quality management.
• Understanding of water and wastewater plant environments and processes.
• Ability to travel throughout the United States.
• Strong problem solving and project management skills.
• Strong PC skills with proficiency in word processing, project scheduling, spreadsheet and database software and the ability to optimize the use of technology and systems to communicate, manage budget and to streamline processes and increase efficiency.
• Proficiency in the care and use of all site specific, facility required PPE (Personal Protection Equipment).

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Valid Driver’s license and safe driving record.
• Desirable professional licenses/certifications include Professional Engineer License, Contractor’s License and Water/Wastewater Operations Certification(s).

Physical Requirements:

• This role also routinely utilizes personal protective equipment.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

Customer Sales & Profit

Team & Development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

Who You Are

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $17.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to join us at a pivotal moment in our growth journey. You’ll own the full sales cycle: generating pipeline, moving deals through the funnel, and landing new logos that become long-term customers.


ABOUT STRELLA

Strella is reimagining market research with AI. Our platform conducts in-depth, AI-moderated interviews and transforms customer conversations into actionable insights in a fraction of the time of traditional research.

We’re building a new model for market research that combines the speed and scale of AI with the strategic expertise of world-class researchers. Our mission is to make high-quality customer understanding faster, more accessible, and more impactful for every business.

 - Explosive Growth: We’ve more than quadrupled our annual recurring revenue over the past year, demonstrating strong demand for a fundamentally better way to conduct research.

 - Enterprise Traction: Trusted by leading brands including J.Crew, Chobani, DraftKings, and to uncover customer insights and inform critical business decisions.

 - Strong Investor Backing: Raised capital from Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate our mission of transforming the market research industry.

 - Massive Market Opportunity: We’re bringing AI-native technology to a $100B+ global insights industry, replacing slow, expensive research processes with a faster, more scalable approach.

 - Building the Future of Research: We’re expanding beyond software into a new model of full-service insights, combining AI-powered research with expert-led strategy. You’ll be among the earliest hires helping shape this offering.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


GENERATE PIPELINE AND BUILD RELATIONSHIPS

 - Run outbound: Develop creative campaigns, test messaging and run multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls)

 - Own your pipeline: Build, maintain, and nurture your pipeline and target account list

 - Qualify rigorously: Qualify inbound and outbound leads so your time goes to the highest-value deals

 - Build genuine relationships: Be a trusted advisor to prospects navigating a fast-changing research landscape, someone they turn to for guidance and honest advice


MANAGE THE FULL SALES CYCLE

 - Lead discovery and demos: Uncover the prospect’s goals, pain points, and decision process; Tailor demos to each prospect’s use cases and team

 - Move deals with urgency: Manage a high volume of opportunities at once and keep each one moving toward a decision

 - Run successful pilots: Define clear success criteria upfront and partner with Customer Success to drive each pilot to a confident buying decision

 - Make the business case: Build ROI cases tied to the buyer’s key KPIs and goals

 - Forecast accurately: Call deal likelihood, contract value, and close dates with accuracy

 - Negotiate and close: Structure contracts that are fair, scalable, and set accounts up for long-term growth

 - Set customers up to succeed: Partner with Customer Success on smooth handoffs and scope upgrades that set accounts up to expand


BUILD THE MID-MARKET PLAYBOOK

 - Partner with leadership: Work closely with the Head of Growth on strategy, messaging, pricing, and sales ops

 - Close the loop with product: Bring back customer learnings to keep improving our product and offering

 - Shape the playbook: Help define what great looks like, how we scale, and how we improve funnel conversion

 - Know the market: Stay on top of competitor moves and market trends to sharpen messaging and objection handling


WHO YOU ARE

 - You’ve consistently hit or exceeded quota selling to Enterprises, ideally to insights or marketing teams

 - You’ve sold SaaS, martech, or market research

 - You’ve self-sourced deals and built your own pipeline

 - You thrive juggling many deals at once without letting details slip

 - You’re naturally curious, great at discovery, and deeply customer-centric

 - You’re hungry to own a number and for hunting new business and deals

 - You’re a good listener who builds genuine relationships

 - You’re a creative problem solver who thinks on your feet


WHY STRELLA

 - Huge greenfield market and early traction with top logos

 - An AI-native product that customers rave about

 - Massive impact: join early and help shape the company

 - Competitive salary, early equity, healthcare, flexible PTO, and a 401(k)

 - Hybrid culture with high trust and low ego

 - Opportunities to travel to conferences and meet key customers

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - A passion for service and the drive to achieve personal and team sales goals

 - Willingness to support operational tasks as part of the team

 - Availability to work at least 16 hours/week, either 3 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) OR 2 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) + 2 Non-Peak Days (Mondays - Thursdays)

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift




OUR BENEFITS:

 - Wellness and Commuter Programs

 - PTO and Wellbeing Time

PAY RANGE:

$16.90 per hour

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.  This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Base pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

jobs.title: ZZ Test - Field Operator - Mechanicsburg, PA
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Field Operator, you will serve as Traba's in-market operational hands — focused on recruiting, onboarding, and preparing workers for placement across the market. Rather than being anchored to a single customer, you'll support the broader market and may interact with multiple customer sites as volume and coverage needs dictate.

You'll be the local face of Traba to our workforce: building community partnerships, running onboarding sessions, and making sure every worker is vetted, prepared, and ready to succeed on their first shift. This role requires professionalism, bilingual communication, strong recruiting instincts, and the flexibility to flex across worker funnel needs in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

 - Worker Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with workers across the market — owning the experience from recruiting through placement and providing timely updates, feedback, and support.

 - Community & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with workforce centers, community organizations, and local partners to drive worker pipeline and brand presence in the market.

 - Worker Vetting & Onboarding: Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end, including running large group onboarding sessions when volume calls for it.

 - Worker Funnel Management: Manage the full worker funnel — sourcing, screening, scheduling, and converting applicants into placement-ready workers.

 - New Start Scheduling: Coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires across customer sites, ensuring workers are matched to the right opportunities at the right time.

 - PPE & On-Site Support: Distribute and manage PPE, and provide on-site presence at customer facilities as needed to support new starts, escalations, or peak coverage.

 - Communication & Reporting: Maintain consistent, proactive feedback loops with Traba HQ — flagging market trends, funnel issues, or coverage risks early.

Requirements

 - High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

 - Bilingual (English & Spanish) preferred.

 - 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

 - Strong recruiting instincts and the ability to source, screen, and convert candidates.

 - Comfortable running large group onboarding sessions and presenting in front of workers.

 - Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

 - Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with workers, partners, and client stakeholders.

 - Flexible and adaptable — able to shift priorities and locations as market needs evolve.

 - Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

 - Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse and field environments.

What success looks like

 - 10 workers sourced a week

Where and when

Crescent, Harrisburg, PA. Full time, 40 hrs/week. Bilingual (Spanish) preferred.

Compensation

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to worker onboarding and successful placements.

$23.5/hr, overtime at 1.5× over 40 hours, plus $100 per worker you source who completes 10 shifts.

jobs.title: Dining Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Operations Manager oversees the daily operations of dining services, ensuring high-quality food service and resident satisfaction while maintaining financial and operational efficiency. This role manages the dining manager, including chefs and hourly team members, and ensures compliance with safety, sanitation, and regulatory standards. The Operations Manager fosters a collaborative environment, supports professional development, and works to enhance the overall dining experience.

1. Daily Operations and Service Excellence

• Manage multiple food service operations to maintain high standards in food preparation, presentation, and service.
• Oversee daily front of house and back of house operations across assigned dining venues.
• Ensure consistent food quality, presentation, temperature, and timely service.
• Address resident concerns promptly and professionally, documenting resolutions and follow-up.
• Coordinate with culinary leadership to ensure menu execution and service consistency.

2. Leadership and Associate Development

• Provide direct supervision, coaching, and performance management for dining room managers, supervisors, and associates.
• Conduct regular leadership meetings, associate check-ins, and performance evaluations.
• Ensure new associates receive appropriate onboarding, orientation, and job-specific training.
• Oversee scheduling, payroll functions, and staffing to ensure appropriate coverage and efficient operation.

3. Financial Management and Budget Accountability

• Manage operational expenses in accordance with approved budgets.
• Monitor labor productivity, scheduling efficiency, overtime, and staffing levels.
• Partner with culinary leadership to control food costs, waste, and inventory.
• Review financial reports, identify unfavorable variances, and implement corrective action plans.

4. Food Safety, Sanitation, and Compliance

• Ensure compliance with food safety regulations, sanitation requirements, and organizational policies.
• Complete required weekly safety inspections, observations, and operational audits.
• Ensure corrective actions are documented and completed within established deadlines.
• Maintain readiness for regulatory inspections and internal audits.

6. Resident Engagement and Continuous Improvement

• Plan and coordinate catering services, special events, and other dining-related activities.
• Actively engage with residents to understand their dining preferences and address concerns promptly.
• Participate in resident meetings and service improvement initiatives.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• Minimum 5 years of progressive food service, hospitality, or dining operations management experience.
• Experience overseeing multiple dining venues or complex food service operations preferred.

You will build the tools, systems, and platforms that free up other engineers’ time and context windows, making it effortless for them to build and ship software quickly while making it hard to break production.

ID.me is evolving as an API-first platform company, and everything we build on the Developer Experience and AI Platform team is superpowered by modern AI and Agentic AI tools and systems. As an SDE3 on this team, you will design and evolve programming-language-specific paved paths ("golden paths") that standardize service creation, CI/CD, observability, and security out of the box. Furthermore, you will build and integrate autonomous AI agents and agentic workflows (such as MCP integrations, RAG-powered developer context, and automated remediation pipelines) that progressively automate ongoing service ownership, upgrades, and maintenance tasks across ID.me’s codebase.

This role is based out of our McLean, VA office and requires full-time in-office attendance.

Responsibilities

• Build Self-Service Platforms & Intelligent Guardrails: Design, build, and maintain internal developer tools, CLI utilities, Internal Developer Portal (IDP) workflows, and reusable GitHub Actions that make building and deploying services fast and intuitive—while embedding automated guardrails that make it hard for engineers to introduce breaking changes, security gaps, or compliance regressions.

• Develop & Evolve Language-Specific Paved Paths: Create and maintain opinionated, programming-language-specific "golden paths" (including project scaffolding, SDKs, shared libraries, container base images, and standardized CI/CD templates) that bake in production readiness, observability, and security best practices by default.

• Superpower Developer Workflows with AI & Agentic Systems: Build and operate AI-native developer platform capabilities—including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/registries, context-engineering and RAG pipelines, and AI coding assistant integrations—that optimize both human developer cognitive load and AI context windows.

• Automate Ownership & Maintenance with Autonomous AI Agents: Design and deploy autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI agents that automate recurring engineering ownership and maintenance toil—such as dependency and framework upgrades, vulnerability remediation, configuration migrations, automated test generation, and standards enforcement.

• Eliminate Toil & Manual Ticket Queues: Partner with product, infrastructure, SRE, and security teams to identify high-friction bottlenecks in the software development lifecycle and replace manual processes or ticket queues with 100% self-service automation.

• Own End-to-End Platform Features: Drive medium-to-large Developer Experience and AI Platform initiatives from technical design through rollout, adoption, and operational support, measuring impact via DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Time to Restore) and developer satisfaction.

• Champion Enablement & Mentorship: Evangelize modern AI-augmented engineering workflows, write clear documentation, and mentor fellow engineers through code reviews, pairing, and enablement workshops.

• Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Go, Python, Ruby, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java) and ability to work across multiple language ecosystems to build language-specific tooling and paved paths.

• Demonstrated track record of using and building with modern AI and Agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, LLM APIs, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks) to accelerate software delivery and automate engineering workflows.

• Deep passion for automation, self-service system design, and reducing cognitive load for other engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience designing or building autonomous AI agents, custom MCP tools/servers, RAG systems, or LLM-powered CI/CD and code-maintenance workflows.

• Strong familiarity with modern CI/CD platforms (especially GitHub Actions reusable workflows), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Internal Developer Portals (e.g., Backstage).

• Understanding of production observability (metrics, logs, traces) and embedding security/compliance guardrails (e.g., FedRAMP, SOC2, NIST) directly into developer pipelines.

• Systems-level thinking with strong written and verbal communication skills—able to champion standards through enablement and intuitive tooling rather than manual mandates.

• Demonstrated ownership of at least one significant platform tool, automation pipeline, or AI-enabled workflow from design through organization-wide adoption.

As a Staff Engineer on the Core Platform Data team, you will serve as the organization’s foremost technical authority on PostgreSQL internals, performance engineering, and safe database evolution at scale. Beyond tuning queries and managing high-scale database infrastructure, you will act as a force multiplier for the entire engineering organization by designing and maintaining automated schema change pipelines, migration linters, and self-service guardrails that enable product engineers to ship database changes safely, rapidly, and without production disruption. You will also lead high-stakes database engine upgrades, large-scale data migrations, and Change Data Capture (CDC) initiatives in partnership with Product Engineering, SRE, Security, and Compliance teams. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that combines deep mastery of PostgreSQL internals with strong software engineering skills to build resilient systems and developer-facing database automation.

This role is based out of our Mountain View, CA or McLean, VA offices and requires full-time in-office attendance.

Responsibilities

• Master & Optimize PostgreSQL Internals at Scale: Serve as the primary technical escalation point and subject-matter expert on PostgreSQL internals—including MVCC, vacuum/autovacuum tuning, transaction ID wraparound prevention, lock management, WAL/checkpoint behavior, buffer management, query planner/optimizer internals, and table/index bloat remediation.

• Build Safe Change Deployment Pipelines & Developer Guardrails: Design, build, and maintain automated database schema change management pipelines (e.g., Liquibase/CI-CD workflows, automated DDL validation, lock/timeout guardrails, and pre-flight migration checks) that empower engineers across ID.me to deploy schema and data changes safely with zero downtime.

• Lead Zero-Downtime Migrations & Engine Upgrades: Architect and execute complex, large-scale data migrations (accounting for data skew, batching, and index performance) as well as major version upgrades and platform transitions across PostgreSQL, GCP CloudSQL, AlloyDB, and AWS RDS.

• Drive Query Performance & Schema Hygiene: Partner with engineering teams to review and optimize high-throughput queries, indexing strategies, partitioning/sharding designs, connection management, and role/permission models across operational and graph-adjacent relational workloads.

• Engineer Database Observability & Diagnostics Tooling: Build and enhance custom PostgreSQL telemetry, statistics collection, query performance monitoring, and alerting to proactively detect lock contention, replication lag, slow queries, and capacity bottlenecks before they impact production SLAs.

• Enable Event-Driven & CDC Architectures: Design and maintain reliable Change Data Capture (CDC), logical replication, and outbox/streaming integrations that bridge transactional PostgreSQL databases with ID.me’s broader event-driven and analytical data ecosystem.

• Automate Governance, Security & Compliance: Build automated workflows and enforcement mechanisms for database access controls, cross-schema permissions, secret rotation, data retention/pruning, and regulatory compliance (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST 800-63, GDPR).

• Act as Production Stability Guardian & Multiplier: Establish and codify PostgreSQL best practices, conduct architectural and high-risk migration reviews, and mentor engineers across the company to decentralize database expertise and elevate the organization’s database engineering bar.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Graduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

• 8+ years of professional software development and data infrastructure experience, including 5+ years working deeply with PostgreSQL in high-volume production environments.

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of PostgreSQL internals (e.g., MVCC, vacuuming, locking semantics, query execution plans, indexing structures, WAL, and replication).

• Strong programming proficiency in one or more backend languages such as Go, Python, Ruby, or Java, alongside expert-level SQL and PL/pgSQL.

Preferred Qualifications

• Proven track record of building software, automation, and CI/CD pipelines for safe database schema changes, migrations, and developer guardrails.Demonstrated experience designing and operating automated database change management and schema migration frameworks (e.g., Liquibase, Flyway, custom DDL linters, or zero-downtime migration tooling) across a large engineering organization.

• Extensive hands-on experience managing and upgrading managed cloud PostgreSQL platforms at scale, particularly GCP CloudSQL, Google AlloyDB, AWS RDS, or Aurora PostgreSQL.

• Proven success planning and executing near-zero-downtime major PostgreSQL version upgrades and multi-terabyte table migrations or normalizations under strict availability SLAs.

• Deep experience with PostgreSQL extensions, custom statistics/diagnostics tooling, logical replication, and Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Debezium, pglogical, Airbyte, or Pub/Sub/Kafka integrations).

• Experience automating database infrastructure and lifecycle management using Terraform, Kubernetes, or Helm.

• Strong understanding of data security, encryption, role-based access control, and compliance requirements in regulated environments (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST, GDPR).

• Fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to accelerate tooling development, query analysis, and migration validation.

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

 - Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

 - Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance

 


YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older

 


YOU HAVE:

 - Previous retail or customer service experience preferred

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine customer connections

 - A passion for service and the drive to achieve personal and team sales goals

 - Willingness to support operational tasks as part of the team

 - Availability to work at least 16 hours/week, either 3 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) OR 2 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) + 2 Non-Peak Days (Mondays - Thursdays)

The Specialist receives EquipmentShare training and a market brief for each assigned market, then works the market in person with brokers, owners, Operations, and Construction Project Managers (CPMs). The role has full agency for sourcing, similar to a CPM, without preparing formal construction budgets or detailed scopes of work. The Real Estate Manager provides training and quality-control review on every deal before escalation, and performance is measured against defined 12-month targets. This is a strong opportunity for a high-agency professional who wants to build a long-term career with EquipmentShare.

Primary Responsibilities

• Learn EquipmentShare’s property requirements and criteria for all ES verticals: Core, Advanced, Tooling, and Site Solutions

• Walk into off-market properties and businesses, ask for the owner, and open conversations about sale, lease, or relocation

• Check the Real Estate & Construction board in Monday.com for duplicates and enter complete property information

• Propose pricing and deal structure for each site, supported by comps, for Real Estate Manager approval

• Submit sites for pre-qualification in Slack with Operations introductions and CPM engagement, and coordinate site visits

• Complete Real Estate Manager quality-control review on every deal, then escalate approved sites with a complete executive summary

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Onboarding
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

As the Manager, Onboarding, you will lead and mentor a team who serve as the crucial initial point of contact for post-sales customers transitioning onto a new Justworks product. You will leverage your expertise to oversee the entire onboarding lifecycle, ensuring a standardized, seamless, and service-first experience for customers that sets the foundation for long-term success.

You think strategically but operate hands-on. You use data to guide decisions, proactively remove obstacles, and continuously improve how work gets done. You are energized by change and skilled at leading teams through it. You care deeply about developing people, building scalable systems, and shaping the future of onboarding.

You will be responsible for the overall effectiveness and efficiency of the onboarding function, focusing on optimizing processes, and maintaining high customer satisfaction during the pivotal implementation phase. This is a highly visible leadership role, requiring strong relationship management skills not just with customers, but also as the primary bridge between Sales, Operations, and Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs and alignment on the customer journey. You will guide your team to become trusted partners and product experts, directly contributing to Justworks' mission of enabling entrepreneurs to focus on building their businesses.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

• Work closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless new customer onboarding

• Obsess over key metrics such as onboarding success and customer satisfaction

• Coach your team members in reinforcing Onboarding best practices, our CSO identity, and the Justworks brand

• Work closely with team members and internal teams to advocate for customer needs and that the voice of the customer is heard, understood, and prioritized

• Handle general management responsibilities, such as conducting 1:1s, leading regular team meetings, generating reports, and conducting annual performance reviews

• Support hiring and expansion of our Onboarding Team

• Focus on continuous process and quality improvement in partnership with cross-functional teams

• Other duties as needed based on department and/or organizational needs

How You Will Do Your Work

As a Manager, Onboarding, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:

• Consultative - takes an approach that focuses on building relationships with others, understanding their problems, and developing solutions to their challenges through open-ended questions and active listening.

• Taking responsibility - being accountable, being committed, and accepting ownership for one's decisions, actions, and behavior.

• Adaptability - the ability to adjust your approach or actions in response to changes in your external environment.

• Solution-oriented - identifies the source of a question or challenge and provides the right, or a better, way of doing things.

• Curious - the innate desire to learn, grow and understand.

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

• Camaraderie - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

• Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

• Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

• Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

• Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

Qualifications

• 5 or more years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or service operations

• 3 or more years of people and team management experience

• Proven track record of coaching and developing high-performing teams

• Demonstrated success achieving team KPIs and operational targets

• Experience building or improving processes in a scaling environment

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills

• Impeccable organizational, written, and verbal communication skills

• Experience in HR Tech or SaaS preferred

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $109,000.00 to $136,000.00 per year.

#LI-Hybrid #LI-AM2

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks.

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. jobs.title: Operations Site Lead
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Job Description

The Site Lead owns all on-site activities and all personnel at their assigned location, serving as the single point of accountability for site operations, facilities coordination, and personnel administration. The Site Lead ensures the site is staffed, secure, and operating smoothly, and is the primary point of contact for site-level personnel matters from onboarding through roll-off. They oversee the Supervisor and SME Supervisor roles at the site, ensuring shift operations and workstream execution run effectively, while owning the administrative and personnel functions that sit above day-to-day shift management. The Site Lead reports directly to the Program Lead and is the escalation point for site-level issues that cannot be resolved by the Supervisor or SME Supervisor. The Site Lead is distinct from the Supervisor and SME Supervisor roles in scope: those roles own shift-level and workstream-level execution, while the Site Lead owns the site itself; its personnel lifecycle, facilities/access, and overall operational posture. The SME provides Site Lead coverage as needed during absences or gaps.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the single point of accountability for all on-site activities and personnel at the assigned site

• Own the personnel lifecycle for site staff: onboarding, in-processing, badging/access coordination, and roll-off/out-processing

• Assist incoming personnel with badge requests, facility access, and required site in-processing steps

• Serve as the primary point of contact for personnel issues arising at the site (conduct, attendance, conflicts) and coordinate resolution with leadership/HR as needed

• Support the Supervisor and SME Supervisor roles at the site, ensuring shift operations and workstream execution are running effectively

• Serve as the site-level escalation point for issues that exceed Supervisor or SME Supervisor authority

• Coordinate site facilities, physical security, and access management with relevant site/facility points of contact

• Maintain overall situational awareness of site staffing levels, coverage, and readiness; coordinate with Supervisors on coverage gaps

• Report site status, staffing, risks, and personnel matters to the Program Lead

• Coordinate with the customer site POCs on site-level administrative and operational matters

• Ensure site compliance with program, customer, and facility security requirements

• Maintain site documentation: rosters, access logs, onboarding/roll-off records, and site-specific procedures

Here's What You Need

• Demonstrated experience owning site-level operations and personnel administration in a government/customer-facing environment

• Experience with personnel onboarding/off-boarding processes, including facility access and badging coordination

• Experience handling personnel issues and coordinating with HR/leadership on resolution

• Strong organizational skills to manage staffing, coverage, and compliance across a full site

• Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with Program Lead, customer POCs, and site staff

Bonus Points If You Have

• Prior experience as a site or facility lead on a similar cleared government program

• Familiarity with facility security/access control processes for cleared environments

• Experience directly managing or overseeing operational personnel

• Relevant certifications in security management, facility operations, or personnel administration

Work Schedule

• Monday–Friday, 8-hour shift. Participation in on-call rotation, which spans weekends and holidays. After-hours coverage for site-level emergencies. Work is performed onsite with access to specified workspace

Security Requirements

• TS/SCI with polygraph level clearance required

• Valid US Passport Required

jobs.title: Associate Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
The role / impact

This role centres on establishing and expanding commercial relationships with the regional offices of defined Enterprise Accounting and Bookkeeping Partners. Working alongside national Enterprise Account owners, you will execute strategies that encourage partner practices to adopt Xero, unlocking total addressable market potential and contributing to sustained subscription and revenue growth.

By guiding accounting practices through consultative conversations, you help firms modernise their workflows and harness cloud technology. In doing so, you contribute to Xero's overarching purpose of making running a business beautiful, enabling small business clients across the country to operate more efficiently.

The team / how they connect

You will join our Enterprise Sales team, who oversee relationships with our largest accounting and bookkeeping partner organisations nationally The team collaborates with national account owners, partner consulting specialists, and local practice stakeholders to deliver seamless customer journeys By sharing market insights and sales resources across departments, the team ensures our partners gain long-term value from Xero.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

 - Utilising Salesforce CRM and modern sales tools to coordinate outbound prospecting, maintain accurate pipeline records, and monitor engagement metrics.

 - Consulting with regional partner offices to identify addressable client portfolios and facilitate their transition to Xero.

 - Partnering with national Enterprise Account owners to design and lead tailored practice presentations, educational sessions, and workshops.

Where and how you can work

 - You have a proven ability to build genuine rapport and establish strong commercial relationships with professional services or accounting practices.

 - Your background demonstrates clear communication and presentation skills, whether facilitating partner workshops or presenting virtually.

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation:
