jobs.title: Sr. Client Partner, CPG Food
jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Role Summary

As a Client Partner at Pinterest, you will serve as a strategic visionary, cultivating trusted relationships with top-tier clients through your deep expertise in full-funnel sales. By leveraging your nuanced understanding of client businesses, you will independently engage assigned customer accounts to promote Pinterest products effectively. Your primary responsibilities include meeting performance targets, developing new business, maintaining and expanding customer relationships, and resolving specific customer issues. By guiding clients’ efforts, you'll drive value for millions of Pinners seeking inspiration and action, forming strategic alliances both internally and externally. Success in this role depends on your ability to drive substantial revenue growth and spearhead a vision for long-term client success in a collaborative, dynamic environment.

What you'll do:

Strategic Vision and Partnership Building

• Develop and execute full-funnel sales strategies that encompass awareness, consideration, conversion, and retention for top-tier clients, driving measurable business results.

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships across client and agency stakeholders, including C-suite, Investment, Strategy, and Activation teams, organizing key educational summits, strategy sessions, and QBRs.

• Build and execute a strategic business plan to drive revenue growth on Pinterest. Get buy-in from key stakeholders (internally and externally) to your strategic approach and drive accountability through influence. Drive y/y growth and spearhead annual deal conversations.

• Demonstrate executive presence, leadership and influence with clients by understanding the ins and outs of their business that includes but is not limited to macro trends (headwinds, tailwinds), business goals & media KPIs, opportunities, etc to think critically, the status quo and not take client directives at face value.

Product Expertise and Market Influence

• Serve as a product expert, delivering guidance on digital ecosystem and Pinterest's ad offerings, focusing on both upper and lower funnel formats, and staying at the forefront of industry trends to address partner needs.

• Develop tailored media strategies leveraging industry insights to achieve business goals, driving adoption and scaling Pinterest’s performance media solutions (search, Shopping, feed-based ads).

Internal and External Collaboration

• Spearhead negotiations and develop joint business plans to foster an understanding of partner goals, maximizing impact while mobilizing cross-functional teams to address complex challenges.

• Drive business growth by analyzing partner goals, delivering data-driven insights, and crafting compelling narratives to guide successful media strategies.

Champion Pinterest’s Value

• Champion Pinterest's value proposition by showcasing impactful ad metrics and positioning Pinterest as a key player in advertisers’ media mix.

• Proactively identify and communicate opportunities for incremental growth, working closely with clients to expand partnerships.

What we are looking for:

• Ad Tech and Digital Advertising Expertise: Deep understanding of full funnel advertising solutions that includes media and measurement solutions for brand, consideration and conversion. Nice to have specialized knowledge/expertise in search, shopping, display and/or social.

• Strong Consultative and Negotiation Skills: Proven track record of developing long-term partnerships and effectively negotiating annual partnership agreements, ensuring mutual satisfaction and driving high-value client engagements.

• Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to think critically and analytically by leveraging insights, macro trends and micro performance trends to translate learnings into actionable insights to propel revenue growth.

• Goal and Result-Oriented Approach: Demonstrated ability to consistently achieve revenue goals while balancing both short and long-term growth objectives to foster continued partnership development. This includes a strategic, results-oriented approach to client and media management, ensuring sustainable success and mutually beneficial outcomes.

• Excellent Communication and Collaboration Skills: Able to thrive in fast-paced environments, maintaining high standards of operational excellence, strategic thinking, and fostering a collaborative team atmosphere.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as digital media or SAAS sales, or equivalent experience.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1 times per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from our New York office.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

jobs.title: General Manager - Delivery Operations
jobs.description:
About Us

Odeko is the all-in-one operations and technology partner to more than 20,000 independent coffee shops, cafes and other food establishments.

Through the Odeko web portal and mobile app, customers can purchase supplies from hundreds of national and local brands, track ordering trends, finance equipment, and access insurance. Customers that use Odeko can increase their revenue, reduce their environmental footprint, and save significantly on their cost of goods and time spent on vendor management.

Odeko is on a mission to continuously develop technology to champion your neighborhood cafes, coffee shops, and other independent F&B establishments.

Local coffee shops and cafes are the backbone of any given community, and we’re here to help manage the day-to-day tasks with a platform so intuitive, it’s kinda like magic.

The Odeko team is diverse, passionate, and innovative. Our 400+ employees are spread across numerous departments and business lines, but are single-minded in our mission to develop technology to support the many needs of our customers. We believe that small businesses need support now more than ever, and that Odeko is uniquely positioned to provide that support.

The General Manager, Delivery Operations owns the complete delivery outcome for our flagship Moonachie, NJ warehouse — Fleet, Personal and Food Safety; delivery success, on-time performance, dispatch reliability, driver productivity, and the customer delivery experience — across both Day and Night shifts under the site's single threaded owner  (STO) model. The General Manager, Delivery Operations drives results through the Day and Night Delivery AGMs, owns site-wide Driver Safety and Training strategy, leads major delivery initiatives, and represents EWR1 in network-level delivery conversations — while modeling servant leadership that enables AGMs to own their shifts.  The GM, Delivery Ops must be able to support and back-up the Sr GM in his/her absence.  Additionally, the GM must share P&L ownership  - to deliver OPEX and EBITDA targets. Our delivery operation is primarily at night and the work schedule for this role will also be primarily working at night.

Reports to: Senior General Manager

Direct reports: AGM, Day Delivery Operations; AGM, Night Delivery Operations; Trainers

Travel requirement: As required

Essential Responsibilities:

• Safety & Training Ownership: Directly owns EWR1's driver safety and training function, with Trainers reporting into this role. Liaise with HR, Safety, and Training partners on process improvements to training design and delivery. Evolves the use of Trainers beyond the first two weeks of onboarding into a comprehensive training strategy that incorporates ongoing observation and retraining. The project manages key safety initiatives (e.g., safety stand-up sign-offs, major safety trainings) and owns the site strategy to reduce total recordable incident rate (TRIR) and vehicle incident rate (VIR) within the delivery teams. Owns telematics and violations compliance in close partnership with Fleet Lead.

• Delivery Performance & Metric Ownership: Own the full delivery scorecard across Day and Night operations, translating the Senior General Manager's annual objectives into concrete strategy executed through the Day and Night AGMs. Propose improvement strategies, secure AGM buy-in, and hold both shifts accountable for delivery success, on-time dispatch, and productivity results.

• Capital Expenditures: Reviews with Fleet Lead and Senior General Manager any proposals for capital requests including fleet and equipment.

• Staffing Management: Works with Delivery AGMs to ensure shift level staffing plans are sufficient and manage OT within pre-defined budgets and escalates any proposed staffing level changes (increase or decreases) to Senior GM for approval.

• Food Safety Program: Own the development and implementation of EWR1's Food Safety program, including flawless MSS execution and a cold-chain improvement strategy, partnering with ICQA/Inbound leadership on execution, compliance and auditing standards.

• Strategic & Cross-Functional Project Management: Lead major delivery-focused initiatives (e.g., scan-at-delivery, Burq pilot) from planning through execution at EWR1, and represent EWR1 in network-level delivery strategy and technology direction.

• Routing Management: Owns routing standards, configuration/parameter governance, the scenario-testing and optimization roadmap, and vendor/tool relationship and driving key improvements in all routing processes at EWR1.

• Leadership Model & Shift Coverage: Models servant leadership toward the AGMs for Delivery Operations — enabling them to own objectives rather than exercising direct floor oversight during overlap shifts.Take a mentoring and modeling approach to after-action review rather than real-time direct correction — with the exception of safety, compliance, and food safety where direct, in-the-moment coaching is always expected to prevent injury or accident.

• Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Own continuous improvement for delivery operations — identify and diagnose upstream issues affecting delivery performance (e.g., mispicks), develop proposals to resolve root causes, and assemble and lead cross-functional project teams (e.g., Pick/Pack, ICQA, Fleet) to troubleshoot and drive issues to resolution. Escalates to Sr. General manager proposed changes to the STO model, anything affecting another function's SLAs, network-facing commitments.

• Backup Coverage: Identifies critical must dos with lack of scheduled coverage and acts as coverage for the Delivery AGM team for all tasks including but not limited to leadership coverage, routing, audits, training, etc…

• Team Communication and Escalation: Hold recurring delivery-specific staff meetings to review current performance against metrics and align the team on what they can deliver or what the incumbent can unlock or enable to drive meaningful improvement. Communicate effectively cross-functionally on key initiatives, escalations and operational issues. Immediately escalates OSHA recordables, major customer service failures, cold-chain excursions above threshold, any safety incidents.

Core Competencies:

• Industry Experience: 6-8 years of operations management experience in warehousing, logistics, distribution, including an emphasis on final-mile delivery, including experience owning outcomes across multiple shifts or functions rather than a single shift.

• Leadership Through Leaders: 3+ years managing through other leaders rather than direct floor supervision — demonstrated ability to drive results and gain buy-in without direct authority over every execution detail.

• Performance Driven: Demonstrated ability to deliver metrics across Safety, People, Quality, Productivity, and Costs across multiple shifts. Must have an intense bias for action and results.

• Subject Matter Expertise: Strong working knowledge of routing/dispatch operations, food safety and cold-chain compliance, and safety/training program management. OSHA, DOT, or other relevant safety certifications preferred.

• Project & Change Management: Proven experience leading cross-functional projects with measurable outcomes, ideally including exposure to network-level or multi-site initiatives.

• Collaboration & Influence: Ability to deliver results by working with matrix teams (Pick/Pack, ICQA, Fleet, HR, Safety) and to build trust with AGMs to enable ownership rather than direct oversight.

• Communications: Must be adept with instant messenger (slack) style software. Presents formal and informal recommendations using a variety of tools, including spreadsheets, presentations and other related data systems.

• Financial Acumen: Experience owning labor budgets, overtime, and P&L-adjacent delivery metrics.

What you’ll love about Odeko:

• Fast-paced environment and growth opportunities - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and enhance your career!

• Competitive compensation, healthcare benefits, and opportunity for equity

• Other great perks - Full lists of benefits available upon request

Odeko is proud to be a diverse, equitable, and inclusive employer. We encourage all to apply regardless of educational background, race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Manager
jobs.description:

Konrad is a global leader in AI and digital innovation consulting. We help the world’s top businesses and brands succeed in the AI era. We are dedicated to solving complex business problems for our global clients with creative, forward-thinking solutions and AI-enabled products. Our employees enjoy a culture built on innovation and a commitment to creating best-in-class, AI-driven digital products used by hundreds of millions of consumers around the world. We hire exceptionally smart, analytical, and hardworking people who are lifelong learners.

As a Senior Manager on our Strategy team, you have a successful career in digital consulting and will lead large-scale, cross-functional programs with global organizations as they embrace digital transformation and innovate for the AI era. Driving collaboration across our Strategy, Design, and Technology teams, you will solve complex business problems by directing the creation of smart, intuitive, and human-centered experiences. You will act as a primary trusted advisor to C-suite and executive client leaders, ensuring that our engagements consistently deliver transformative business impact.

Defining how emerging technologies like AI can be leveraged to build best-in-class digital products, you will shape long-term client strategy, oversee executive-level engagements, and ensure seamless end-to-end program delivery. Partnering closely with Konrad’s executive leadership, you will take ownership of program growth, client satisfaction, and practice development. As a leader on the team, you excel at translating complex market shifts into clear strategic direction, expanding our impact across global client relationships, and mentoring managers and consultants across our practice.

What You'll Do

• Responsible for program governance including budget, scope, timelines, organization, resourcing, implementation, and risk management for flagship enterprise initiatives

All qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status will receive consideration for employment. jobs.title: Principal Data Architect
jobs.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?
Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
 
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.
 
Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?
We’re looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, high-performance data solutions for our clients. You’ll lead data engineering initiatives, build and optimise data pipelines and models, and connect complex data sources to power analytics, customer engagement, and business decisions.
Working closely with Data, CRM, and CDP teams, you’ll bring strong technical expertise across modern data platforms, with a focus on Snowflake, SQL, Python, and dbt. You’ll also guide engineering best practices, explore new technologies and AI tools, and help clients get more value from their data infrastructure.
What Will You Do?
Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines across batch and real-time data architectures.
Develop and optimise data models, transformations, and workflows using SQL, Python, and dbt.
Build and maintain integrations across cloud data platforms, warehouses, and external data sources
Improve database performance, data reliability, and cost efficiency through monitoring and optimisation.

jobs.title: Senior Influencer & Creator Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
We are ARB Interactive, the team behind Modo Casino, one of the top Social+ platforms in the US. Founded in 2022, we've grown to nearly 200 team members and were named one of LinkedIn's 2025 Top 50 Startups in the United States. We move fast, think big, and love bold ideas that push boundaries (and buttons). From new rewards to fresh game mechanics, every challenge is a chance to innovate and have fun doing it. Our culture is collaborative, curious, and full of laughter because great ideas grow best between coffee, code, and a few epic high-fives.


ABOUT US

We are ARB Interactive, the team behind Modo Casino, one of the top Social+ platforms in the US. Founded in 2022, we've grown to nearly 200 team members and were named one of LinkedIn's 2025 Top 50 Startups in the United States. We move fast, think big, and love bold ideas that push boundaries (and buttons). From new rewards to fresh game mechanics, every challenge is a chance to innovate and have fun doing it. Our culture is collaborative, curious, and full of laughter because great ideas grow best between coffee, code, and a few epic high-fives.




POSITION OVERVIEW

Today we have a brand people want to talk about, a category full of creators looking for a partner who actually gets them, and no formal creator program. You will create one, and you will do it yourself. You'll report to the Director of Growth Strategy, with the room to define how this function runs.

You own it end to end: sourcing, outreach, negotiation, briefing, deal structure, content, and the program architecture that makes all of it repeatable. Not a roster of one-off posts. A network you can activate on short notice, where the creators we find early and help grow become our loudest advocates and pull the next wave of talent toward us.

You'll partner closely with the Director of Growth Strategy and cross-functionally with Marketing, Brand and Product as the creator channel scales.

This is a founding role: expect to set the systems, tools and cadence yourself in year one, with the scope to grow into leading the function as the program proves out.




THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

Creator is the next big unlock. We're hiring the person who will build it. This is a hands-on, zero to one build.

We're looking for someone with natural grit. Someone who will send 200 DMs on a Tuesday, get 12 replies, close 3, and treat that as a great day. Someone who would rather build the machine than inherit one.

If you do your best work with a system already built for you, this role will feel like a stretch. If you want to point at something in 18 months and say you built every piece of it, keep reading.




THE ROLE

Build the program

 - Design and launch our creator program: tiers, incentives, content expectations, deal and code structures, onboarding, and a real path from emerging talent to flagship partner.

 - Build the scouting engine that finds creators before anyone else does. Set the criteria, watch the signals, and get there early while partnerships are still affordable and relationships still matter.

 - Create the development side of the program: coaching, content feedback, early access, co-created formats, and support that makes creators better at their craft. We want creators to grow with us, not just post for us.

Build a network, not a roster

 - Grow an owned community of creators, streamers, editors and clippers who work with us on an ongoing basis rather than campaign to campaign.

 - Run always-on programs and recurring briefs that keep the community producing, competing and improving between formal activations.

 - Make participation worth it. Design the incentives, recognition and progression that turn one-time contributors into regulars, and regulars into partners.

Run the outreach engine

 - Own high-volume, high-quality prospecting across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Twitch, Kick, X, and wherever the audience moves next.

 - Negotiate and close across the full spectrum: performance-based, flat fee, hybrid, affiliate, ambassador and always-on retainers. Land rights and usage terms that work for both sides.

 - Build the CRM and tracking discipline that turns outreach into a forecastable channel, and that tells us which creators actually perform rather than which ones simply posted.

Make it perform

 - Treat this as a growth channel with real economics behind it, not a brand line item. You will shape how creators are rewarded against performance, and you will be accountable for what the channel returns.

 - Define the KPIs and report on them without being asked: creators activated, cost per activation, cost per new registration, content volume and quality, code redemption, and the retention and value of the players creators bring in.

 - Kill what doesn't work fast. Double down on what does, faster.




QUALIFICATIONS

Required

 - 5+ years in influencer, creator, talent or community marketing, including at least one program you built or scaled meaningfully yourself.

 - A real network. You can open a laptop and start sending messages to people who will actually reply.

 - Natural grit. You are motivated by the opportunity to build the machine rather than inherit it.

 - Proven closing ability. You've negotiated deals from a few hundred dollars to six figures and know when each makes sense.

 - Fluency in creator economics: rate benchmarks, CPM and CPA math, affiliate and rev share structures, whitelisting, usage rights, and how to build a deal that works for both sides.

 - Experience running something always-on. A community, a contributor program, an ambassador network, anything where the job was keeping a lot of people engaged and producing over time, not just booking deals one at a time.

 - Strong content instincts. You can tell in five seconds whether a creator's audience is real and whether their style will convert.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action. You build the spreadsheet, write the contract template and set up the tracking yourself.

 - Sharp written communication. Most of your closing happens in DMs and email.

Preferred

 - Background in talent management, or you've been a creator yourself.

 - Live streaming know-how, especially Twitch and Kick.

 - Experience with clipping or edit-driven content programs.

 - Familiarity with influencer platforms, affiliate tooling and attribution setups.

 - You've worked in a regulated or age-gated category and know how to operate cleanly inside one.


HOW WE'LL KNOW IT'S WORKING

 - A program that runs on a documented process and doesn't depend on you being online.

 - A pipeline of emerging talent we reached first.

 - Creator-sourced players who stick around and play, not just click.

 - Creators who talk about working with us the way we'd want them to, publicly and unprompted.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
About Decimal

Decimal is a franchise network of operator-owned accounting firms. We built the technology, processes, and infrastructure we had when we were running a firm, then made it available to independent accountants who want to grow without giving up ownership.





Job Summary

We are seeking an Accounting Manager to own the client relationship and accounting delivery for this Decimal franchise location. You'll be the client's primary point of contact, delighting them with expert guidance while directing the analyst team's work. Using Decimal's established technology stack and processes, you'll bring a technology-first mindset to client delivery and process improvement.

As a member of our client services team, and working closely with the Firm Principal/Franchise Owner, you would have the following responsibilities:

 - This role may be assigned to corporate and deployed to a franchisee, or work directly with a franchisee, depending on business needs.

 - Serve as the operational lead on accounting delivery, partnering with the Firm Principal/Franchise Owner to ensure client needs are met

 - Oversee accounting operations for multiple clients

 - Problem-solve with a technology-first mindset

 - Direct and review the analyst team's work across A/P, A/R, payroll, bank reconciliations, and adjusting journal entries

 - Proactively identify opportunities for automation, delegation, and process improvement, and flag strategic items to the Firm Principal/Franchise Owner

 - Prepare and review general ledger entries and supporting documentation

 - Perform, analyze, and review balance sheet reconciliations

 - Research and resolve questions related to general ledger items, escalating client-relationship matters to the Firm Principal/Franchise Owner as needed

 - Ensure all daily, weekly, and monthly deadlines are met

Qualifications:

 - Minimum of 5+ years of public accounting or full-cycle accounting experience

 - Minimum of 2+ years of client relationship management experience

 - Minimum of 2+ years of Quickbooks Online (QBO) experience required

 - Experience with cloud accounting tools like Bill.com http://Bill.com, Ramp, etc. is a plus

 - Prior experience working with multiple clients

 - Ability to communicate with clients and team members clearly and effectively

 - Strong analytical skills

 - Your Google-it problem-solving skills are top-notch.

 - You love working with the latest technology.

 - You hate the statement: "This is the way we've always done it."



 

Interview Process

 

At Decimal, we know the hiring process can be overwhelming and confusing, but we don't want you to feel that way! We want to be transparent with you so that you don't have to guess and you can focus on being your best self! As part of the interview process, we will dive into your career and past projects and get to know you a bit more. The interview process for the Accounting Manager role consists of 5 rounds:

 1. 30-minute interview with one of our Recruiters

 2. A take-home technical accounting assessment

 3. A 45-minute interview with one of our Directors

 4. A 45-minute interview with our team members

 5. A final 45-minute interview with our COO

 

Your recruiter will be your main point of contact and will keep you informed at every step of the process. If we decide to move to the final round of the process, we will also ask for references at that time. If you have any questions during the process, don't be shy about leaning on your recruiter for help!



Our Values

👍 Do the right thing

🙌 Default to transparency

🤗 Move fast, make things better

🤝 Win together

Benefits

💪 Competitive salary

💰 401K retirement savings plan

🚑 Health, dental and vision insurance

🚀 Flexibility to travel and work anywhere that suits you best



Decimal is full of passionate people who are driven in a variety of disciplines—and each of them brings their unique perspective to everything they do. We hope you’re feeling excited about the role and our team! Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in Decimal’s mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways—not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay and do their best work here.



Creating a safe and inclusive workplace is critical to the success of our company and of our employees, so it’s our aim to recruit, hire and promote without bias against race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. As we learn and as we grow, we’re committed to ensuring that these ideals are at the forefront of everything we do.

jobs.title: Engineering Test Technician
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Advanced Infrared Solutions (AIRS), formerly American Infrared Solutions, was acquired by Anduril Industries in 2025 and now operates as part of the Imaging Business Line. For more than 10 years, AIRS has designed and built world-class, high-performance cooled infrared cameras and subsystems, including critical components such as Integrated Dewar Cooler Assemblies (IDCAs). From its site in Hudson, NH, AIRS is expanding to supply these critical components both internally, to Anduril's Imaging products, and externally, to serve as a merchant supplier to the broader defense, space, and commercial industrial base. Growing the external merchant supplier business alongside internal production is a core strategic priority for the Business Line.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Engineering Test Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring our optical systems meet stringent quality standards before shipment to customers. In this position, you’ll be responsible for testing optical equipment, running validation and system-level testing, and troubleshooting complex issues. A successful candidate will have a strong background in both production and R&D environments, with the ability to collaborate effectively across interdisciplinary teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Perform testing of optical equipment according to procedures and specifications.

• Run validation and system-level testing to ensure optimal performance.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues with optical systems during testing, identifying problems in electrical systems and the associated programs.

• Follow detailed test work instructions and document results accurately in the system.

• Utilize MATLAB for data collection, coding, and analysis to support testing activities.

• Maintain test equipment and tools, ensuring they are calibrated and functioning correctly.

• Participate in root cause analysis of product failures, providing input based on testing experiences.

• Work autonomously while closely collaborating with the test engineering team to identify and report opportunities for improving testing processes and efficiencies.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Associates degree in Physics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years of relevant industry experience in production or R&D testing

• Experience with cryogenics and vacuum systems in a testing environment.

• Proficiency in MATLAB for data acquisition, processing, and coding.

• Strong troubleshooting skills for non-conforming hardware and software, with the ability to identify electrical issues and program failures.

• Experience working with interdisciplinary teams in fast-paced settings.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of infrared systems or optical systems including performance requirements and verification methodologies.

• Familiarity with test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, thermal chambers, and data acquisition sensors.

• Understanding of computer hardware communication protocols (USB, Ethernet, RS232, etc.).

US Hourly Range

$37—$50 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

jobs.title: Catalysis Scientist Specialist
jobs.description:
With a strategy centered on people and sustainability, Braskem is engaged in contributing to the value chain to strengthen the Circular Economy. Braskem’s 9,000 team members dedicate themselves every day to improving people's lives through sustainable solutions in chemicals and plastics. With its corporate DNA rooted in innovation, Braskem offers a comprehensive portfolio of plastic resins and chemical products for diverse industries, such as food packaging, construction, manufacturing, automotive, agribusiness, health and hygiene, and more. With 40 industrial units in Brazil, the United States, Mexico, and Germany, Braskem exports its products to clients in over 70 countries.

Braskem America is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Braskem S.A. headquartered in Philadelphia. The company is the leading producer of polypropylene in the United States, with six production plants located in Texas, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia, as well as an Innovation and Technology Center in Pittsburgh and a New Renewable Innovation Center in Lexington, which focuses on leveraging groundbreaking developments in biotechnology and chemical catalysis. For more information, visit www.braskem.com/usa.

Department: Innovation & Technology

Location: Pittsburgh, PA

Travel Involved: Less than 25%

Job Type: Hybrid

Description:

Braskem is seeking a motivated scientist to support research and development activities within the Global Catalysis organization. The Global Catalysis organization discovers and develops catalytic solutions to support Braskem's strategic goals in bio-based chemicals, specialty products, and polyolefins catalysis.

The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in heterogeneous catalysis and catalyst development, with experience gained through doctoral research and/or early industrial practice. The scientist will contribute to catalyst synthesis, characterization, testing, and technology development projects while working closely with multidisciplinary teams across research, engineering, analytical sciences, and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities Include:

• Contribute to catalysis research projects focused on developing new catalysts and processes to improve process performance and enable new product development.

• Design and execute experimental programs for the synthesis, characterization, and performance evaluation of heterogeneous catalysts.

• Analyze experimental data and correlate catalyst properties with catalytic performance.

• Support the development of zeolite-based and metal-supported catalyst systems through laboratory-scale research activities.

• Contribute to catalyst preparation activities including synthesis, modification, shaping, and metal deposition.

• Assist in catalyst scale-up and technology transfer activities by collaborating with internal teams and external partners.

• Prepare technical reports, presentations, and documentation to communicate project results and recommendations.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including process engineering, analytical sciences, manufacturing, and business stakeholders.

• Contribute ideas for new catalyst concepts, experimental approaches, and research methodologies.

• Participate in technology exchanges and knowledge-sharing activities across the Global Catalysis organization.

• Support intellectual property development through invention disclosures, patent support, and documentation of technical advances.

• Maintain a strong commitment to safety, laboratory excellence, and continuous learning.

Requirements:

The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical foundation in heterogeneous catalysis, catalyst synthesis, and characterization. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to independently plan and execute experimental work, analyze complex datasets, and effectively communicate technical findings. Success in this role requires curiosity, initiative, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary research teams.

Hands-on experience gained through doctoral research, postdoctoral work, or early industrial experience in catalyst development is preferred. Experience with catalyst synthesis, characterization, and reactor testing is highly desirable

Preferred Skills, Education, and Experience:

• Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.

• Zero to five (0-5) years of industrial and/or postdoctoral experience in catalysis research and development.

• Fundamental understanding of heterogeneous catalysis principles and catalyst structure-performance relationships.

• Experience in catalyst synthesis, catalyst characterization, and catalyst performance evaluation through graduate research, postdoctoral work, or industrial experience.

• Hands-on experience with zeolite synthesis or other porous material synthesis techniques.

• Familiarity with post-synthesis modification methods for zeolites and porous materials, including ion exchange, steaming, dealumination, desilication, or related approaches.

• Experience with catalyst preparation and metal deposition methods such as incipient wetness impregnation, wet impregnation, ion exchange, deposition-precipitation, or related techniques.

• Familiarity with catalyst characterization techniques such as XRD, BET surface area analysis, TPD, TPR, chemisorption, SEM, TEM, ICP, XRF, Raman spectroscopy, FTIR, solid-state NMR, or similar analytical methods.

• Experience designing and conducting laboratory experiments, including catalyst screening and reactor testing.

• Knowledge of reaction engineering, kinetics, reactor design, or process development is desirable.

• Exposure to scale-up, manufacturing support, or technology transfer activities is a plus but not required.

• Strong data analysis and technical problem-solving skills.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical results clearly.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong safety mindset and commitment to laboratory excellence.

• Enthusiasm for learning, innovation, and continuous professional development

What we offer

At Braskem, we offer more than just a competitive pay package. Our total rewards package includes a wide range of benefits you need for every stage of your life. Our benefits include:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Retirement Benefits

Candidates must be currently eligible to work in the United States without the need for any type of sponsorship now or in the future. Braskem is committed to equal employment opportunity and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified candidates and employees according to applicable law. jobs.title: Senior Space Build Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Build Reliability Engineer partners closely with the design and manufacturing teams to right-size processes and controls to enable scaling the production of spacecraft hardware. Build Reliability Engineers ensure production processes yield verified, reliable hardware at rate. You will flex beyond Build Reliability to support Quality, Flight Reliability, and Mission Assurance. The ideal candidate is a responsible, collaborative, process-oriented engineer with hands-on hardware design/test/manufacturing/troubleshooting experience.

Responsibilities

• Partner with design engineering and manufacturing teams to create test, manufacturability, and inspection plans for all vehicle hardware.

• Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors, and engineers.

• Lead failure investigations in production, test, and operation; identifying and mitigating immediate and underlying root causes to reduce risk and improve the reliability of designs and processes.

• Provide critical peer review of hardware during design reviews and acceptance and qualification test campaigns.

• Perform failure modes and effects analyses, build requirements compliance matrix tools, and ensure adequate test coverage, change management, and manufacturability of flight hardware.

• Own vehicle level deliverables for regulatory bodies including requirements compliance, functional or flight hazard analyses, and verification evidence.

• Support Mission Assurance's vehicle level risk management and identification/tracking/execution of mitigations.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in aerospace, computer science, electrical, manufacturing, mechanical, or material sciences engineering.

• 5+ years professional experience in aerospace, design, quality, or related engineering role.

• Hands-on hardware test, qualification, troubleshooting, or failure analysis experience.

• Commitment to lean quality principles without compromising safety or reliability.

• Demonstrated application of process controls in high volume manufacturing, test, and quality environments.

• Experience generating, processing, and/or analyzing data for production insight.

• Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, with a drive to innovate and improve reliability in cutting-edge technology.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Full project lifecycle ownership experience (cradle-to-grave).

• Proficiency with quality tools such as measurement systems analysis, design of experiments, statistical process control, root cause analysis and corrective action, advanced product quality planning (APQP), metrology, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and various problem-solving approaches.

• Hands-on knowledge of CNC machining, additive manufacturing, casting, welding, fastening, or other special manufacturing processes.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $179,314/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

jobs.title: Senior Integrations Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

Role Summary:

We’re looking for a Senior Integrations Software Engineer to help build and evolve our next-generation Censys Platform. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams building, deploying and maintaining scalable integrations between our Censys platform and third-party systems such as SIEMs, SOARs, and Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs). These integrations connect Censys Platform with critical security platforms, enriching attack surface data and delivering actionable insights directly into the tools practitioners and CISOs depend on for visibility, threat hunting and incident response. You will play a critical part in helping organizations and critical security providers of all shapes and sizes truly understand everything on the Internet and help make it a safer place.

What You’ll Do:

• Set the technical direction for Censys's integrations portfolio: decide what we build and how we build it, across a dozen-plus integrations.

• Lead integration delivery across internal engineers and external vendor partners, setting standards, reviewing work, and ensuring long-term maintainability.

• Build and maintain integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and security operations platforms (SIEM, SOAR, TIP).

• Partner directly with third-party engineering teams, and with our Alliances and Marketing teams, to launch and certify integrations.

• Design, implement, and maintain robust integrations between the Censys Platform and external SOAR, SIEM, and TIP solutions.

• Develop and operate highly available, scalable API connectors.

• Contribute to and maintain existing Censys open-source APIs and SDKs.

• Advance the next generation of integrations by developing AI Agent skills and plugins to support Agentic workflows.

• Create instructions for AI Agents to build new integrations and maintain existing ones.

• Design and implement automated solutions for continuous integration, covering the building, testing, monitoring, and deployment of integrations.

• Act as a strong advocate for the customer, prioritizing requests, and actively shaping the integrations roadmap.

• Keep current with emerging SOAR, SIEM, and TIP technologies to inform and guide the overall integration strategy.

What You’ll Bring:

• Own it! Independently drive and implement integrations, working closely with PM, customer success, and partners.

• Technical leadership: you've set direction for a multi-integration or platform effort and grown the engineers around you.

• 5+ years in software engineering, with 2+ years focused on integrations or robust backend systems.

• Python or Golang Pro (3+ years experience).

• API: Deep expertise in API-first development and seamless service integration.

• Master Integrator: Proven ability to unify multiple APIs into a coherent platform with solid service contracts.

• CI/CD Champion: Always pushing to improve deployment and developer workflows.

• Code Craftsmanship: Passionate about writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code.

• Action-Oriented: Bias for action and an iterative approach to solving problems.

• Data-Driven Thinker: Contribute insightful ideas to technical discussions, making fast, informed decisions.

• Communication Powerhouse: Excellent communication and documentation skills — able to clearly explain technical concepts across engineering and non-engineering teams

What Sets You Apart:

• Hands-on experience integrating with security platforms (e.g., Splunk, Cortex XSOAR, Anomali, Recorded Future).

• A cyber security engineering background

• Proven success integrating with vendor marketplaces (e.g., AWS, Splunk)

• Expertise with expanding REST/gRPC micro-service architecture

• Strong interest in harnessing AI and LLM tools as a force multiplier - using it to code smarter, iterate faster boosting productivity

• Experience with cloud providers, (especially Google Cloud)

• Skilled in building, deploying, and maintaining containerized services in Kubernetes environments

• You understand the value of building maintainable software, while building new services you are ensuring test coverage is enforced by strong CI practices, adding linters and code complexity checks. You value clean abstraction, and promote established design patterns, but also know when to innovate beyond conventions

jobs.title: Assistant Principal
jobs.description:
At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential. We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.


Assistant Principals (APs) at Rocketship are charged with driving academic achievement for students and building a rigorous college preparatory school culture. Every AP at Rocketship works closely with their Principal to lead and implement the instructional vision with a group of educators. Assistant Principals typically support several grade levels directly, which includes direct management of the teachers on that grade level as well as instructional support staff.  APs lead their grade levels by driving data analysis cycles, regularly observing classrooms, providing continuous feedback, and co-planning units of study and lesson plans aimed at increasing educator effectiveness and leadership. APs also serve as cultural and community leaders by building teacher capacity in culture, behavior, and parent engagement. 
 
Rocketship campuses are supported by a school leadership team that includes the Principal, Assistant Principals, as well as operations team members.   APs share responsibility across the school leadership team for professional development, culture and behavior in common spaces, and special events. Together, they lead a team of teachers, tutors, enrichment coordinators, and support staff who collectively deliver gap-closing, personalized instruction to students from pre-K to fifth grade. 
 
Rocketship attracts school leaders with ambitious aspirations. Just as we are committing to propelling student growth we are dedicated to advancing the careers of our exceptional talent. As an AP, you will receive ongoing professional development in conducting rigorous observations, providing meaningful feedback, and executing useful planning and analysis. Additionally, Rocketship is a rapidly growing network which provides APs with a number of career paths both within our schools and on the Network Support Team. 
 
Reports to the Principal and direct reports may include teachers, enrichment center coordinators and tutors.
 
The starting compensation scale for this role is $77,500.
 
Our Ideal Candidate
Believes that adult preparation is essential to student success.
Has a desire to become an elementary content expert and is eager to use that knowledge to develop teachers who demonstrate excellence in their planning and execution of lessons.
Understands that eliminating the achievement gap is hard work but deeply rewarding and within their control.

jobs.title: Senior Communications Associate
jobs.description:
The American Flood Coalition (AFC) is a nonpartisan group that drives transformational adaptation to higher seas, stronger storms, and more frequent flooding. AFC comprises more than 500 elected officials, local leaders, military groups, and businesses that work together to advance resilient and equitable flood solutions at the local, state, and federal levels. As the only organization that focuses on flooding and sea level rise across all levels of government, AFC is uniquely positioned to help advance solutions that keep communities safe.

Position Summary

We are seeking a driven problem-solver Senior Communications Associate who can turn complex flood policy into clear, compelling content. The Senior Communications Associate will assist with writing and editing across channels, ranging from policy explainers and op-eds to social campaigns. This position will also help grow AFC's reach on social media among members, policymakers, partners, and the public.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer who understands flood policy and the broader resilience space, thinks strategically about digital audiences, and keeps multiple projects on track in a fast-paced environment. The Senior Communications Associate will join a small, collaborative team.  If you want to work alongside immensely passionate and talented people who are intent on helping flood-affected communities adapt and thrive, we want to talk to you. This is a full-time position reporting to our Marketing and Communications Director, and will be located in our headquarters in Washington, DC.

Responsibilities

• Policy writing and content: Translate technical, scientific, and policy information into clear content for elected officials, residents, partners, and the public. Write and edit policy explainers, web pages, newsletters, reports, press releases, op-eds, and executive communications. Track state and federal legislative developments, summarize their impact, and prepare talking points and briefing materials for leadership. Develop messaging toolkits and narrative frameworks that equip members and local elected leaders to communicate about flood resilience.

• Campaigns and collaboration: Partner with the policy, government relations, and state teams to implement communications campaigns that advance legislative and policy goals. Support media relations by drafting statements and pitching stories. Craft compelling narratives for members, partners, and donors in coordination with the Programs team. Help refine editorial processes and standard operating procedures.

• Social media strategy and content: Collaborate on platform-specific content that makes flood policy and resilience relevant and shareable. Assist in implementing AFC's social media strategy across its channels, including LinkedIn, X, and Facebook. As a part of the communications team, monitor the flood resilience policy and media landscape and identify moments for AFC to engage quickly with timely commentary. Track social and digital analytics, report on performance, and use the findings to refine strategy.

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years of experience in policy communications, public relations, editorial strategy, or journalism

• Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a track record of translating complex policy into clear, compelling language

• Significant experience taking scientific or technically complex topics and communicating them to a variety of audiences

• Sound judgment and comfort operating in fast-moving environments

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

• Bachelor's degree required

Preferred

• Experience in flood resilience, infrastructure, disaster recovery, or related public policy areas

• Demonstrated success developing and executing social media strategies to grow audience engagement

• Experience creating social content and using analytics tools to measure and improve performance

• Skills in visual content and short-form video, using tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative

Location

Washington, DC

Benefits

• Base salary range: $77,000–$92,000

• Generous and flexible paid time off.

• Health, dental, and vision insurance, including a $0 monthly premium health insurance option for employees.

• 401k plan with 4% employer match.

• Company-paid short-term and long-term disability, as well as basic life insurance and other voluntary benefits.

• Up to $4,000 in relocation assistance for new employees living outside of the D.C. metropolitan area.

We also offer:

• A hybrid work schedule: All D.C.-based employees are in-person in our D.C. office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the option to work from home on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

• Company-sponsored outings, such as happy hours, after-work activities, a holiday party, an annual retreat, and more.

• Office closure the week between Christmas and New Year's Day.

• A modern office with amenities, including gym access, snacks and drinks, a business casual dress code, and a collaborative floor plan with options to suit every workstyle.

We encourage you to apply for this position even if you do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed here. The American Flood Coalition is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse staff, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite applications from candidates with unique backgrounds and strive to create and maintain an environment that is inclusive, equitable, and welcoming.

jobs.title: Director, Security Operations & Intelligence - White Plains, NY
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We’ve done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they are empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

We’re rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That’s where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we find a way to say YES—and this role brings that mentality to keeping our VEGgies safe and our hospitals ready for the unexpected. .

As Director, Security Operations and Intelligence, you’ll build and lead the security operations, strategic intelligence, and crisis management capabilities that protect our VEGgies, pet parents, patients, facilities, and operations as we grow. You’ll set the enterprise-wide strategy, standards, and operating model, partnering with leaders across VEGquarters (VQ) and our hospitals to turn complex risk signals into clear action.

You’ll build the systems and partnerships that help our teams anticipate threats and respond with confidence. That means developing others, strengthening readiness, and bringing calm, sound judgment to the moments when the stakes are high.

This job requires 5 days in office at our HQ in White Plains.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Security Strategy and Standards: Develop and maintain operating standards, playbooks, standard operating procedures, escalation protocols, and governance frameworks for VEG’s Global Security Operations Center (GSOC). Establish clear practices for incident management, alarms and alerts, global threats, executive protection suppoort, facility security, and emergency response.

• Security Operations: Lead VEG’s 24/7/365 GSOC, overseeing daily operations and ensuring rapid detection, assessment, triage, escalation, and response to security incidents and operational disruptions across VEG facilities.

• Critical-Incident Response: Serve as a primary escalation point during significant events, coordinating response with HR, Legal, IT/Cyber, Facilities, Communications, Real Estate, Business Continuity, and field leadership. Lead after-action reviews and remediation efforts to strengthen future readiness.

• Monitoring and Executive Security: Oversee enterprise monitoring and executive security support, including physical security systems, access control, environmental alerts, executive travel and threat monitoring, residential alarm support, contractor guard activity, and site-level security events.

• Partnership and Readiness: Build trusted relationships across VEG and with law enforcement and external security partners. Provide hands-on leadership and coaching to VQ and field leaders, ensure policy and privacy compliance, and develop training that strengthens threat assessment, incident response, customer service, and alarm-monitoring standards.

WHAT YOU NEED

• 7+ years of progressive experience in security operations, a GSOC/operations center, crisis management, emergency management, intelligence, law enforcement, or a related field, including experience leading managers and teams in a complex, multi-site or 24/7 environment.

• Demonstrated experience developing policies, procedures, escalation protocols, and governance standards, with working knowledge of legal and regulatory considerations affecting security, investigations, incident response, and information sharing. Investigative, law-enforcement, or fusion-center experience is a plus.

• Strong knowledge of open-source intelligence (OSINT) methodologies, threat assessment, predictive threat modeling, and risk forecasting, with the ability to independently research, produce, and edit high-quality reports and executive summaries.

• Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, and networking skills, with the ability to build trust across internal teams and external partners and translate complex security requirements into practical strategies and program objectives.

• Proven judgment and composure in high-pressure, time-sensitive incidents, with the ability to lead through change and manage competing priorities.

• Experience using security and crisis-management technologies effectively.

• Bachelor’s degree in intelligence studies, national security, criminal justice, emergency management, political science, international studies, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Availability to support critical incidents outside standard business hours and travel as needed.

• Five days in office required at VEGquarters in White Plains, NY.

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive Compensation Including base salary $170,000 - 220,000 (based on experience) + bonus + benefits.

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary, and offering inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Unlimited PTO to use for vacation or sick days—however you need it!

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people.

• And the little (big) things, like casual office attire, ability to bring your fur baby to work, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry and free lunches twice a week!!

• Company laptop and a monthly cell phone reimbursement

BETTER TOGETHER: WHY IN-PERSON MATTERS AT VEG HQ

Our hospitals thrive on in-person collaboration, and VQ is no different. Time in the office sparks stronger connections, meaningful conversations, and better results—all bringing our core values to life. We prioritize being present because our values are best achieved side by side. Plus, we make getting here easy with free parking and a shuttle from the White Plains Metro-North station.

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.
