Centria Healthcare – Now Hiring CNAs & HHAs

Are you a compassionate and dependable Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) or Home Health Aide (HHA) looking for a rewarding opportunity? Centria Healthcare is hiring caregivers to provide in-home support

Whether you're experienced in home care or just beginning your journey in the healthcare field, this is your chance to join a mission-driven organization that values care, compassion, and community.

💵 Pay Range: $16–$18 per hour, based on experience and case needs
🕒 Flexible schedules and weekly pay

🏡 About the Role

Centria caregivers provide essential in-home support to help individuals remain safe, comfortable, and independent. You’ll work one-on-one with clients in a private home setting, supporting their unique care needs.

✅ Responsibilities

• Assist with mobility and transfers to prevent falls

• Provide basic personal care, including hygiene, toileting, and dressing

• Monitor and assist with oxygen therapy as needed

• Prepare light snacks or drinks upon request

• Offer companionship and emotional reassurance throughout the shift

• Assist in positioning and turning to prevent discomfort

• Document and report changes in client condition promptly

• Respond to emergencies following proper procedures

• Perform duties as outlined in the patient’s plan of care

• Monitor client’s physical and mental condition, intake/output, and exercise

• Maintain a safe, clean, and healthy care environment

• Follow professional standards, care policies, and local/state/federal requirements

📝 Qualifications

• CNA, HHA, or equivalent experience in home care preferred

• Experience working with fall-risk and mobility-impaired clients strongly desired

• Must be comfortable assisting with personal care tasks

• Reliable, patient, and attentive to individual needs

• Comfortable working in a private home setting

• Ability to work independently and follow a care plan

• Strong oral and written communication skills

• Ability to follow verbal and written instructions

• Comfortable using tablets/computers for documentation

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow all care protocols

• Ability to address minor medical concerns as they arise

✅ Documentation Requirements

To be eligible for employment, all caregivers must provide the following:

• Valid Driver’s License

• Current CPR Certification

• Clear Background Check

• Negative TB Test Results

• Proof of Auto Insurance (with your name listed on the policy)

We’re looking for caregivers who are patient, reliable, and genuinely passionate about helping others.

Why Caregivers Love Working at Centria

We believe that when we care for you, you can care best for others.

🌟 Comprehensive Benefits Package

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Paid Sick Time

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental wellness and family support

🕒 Flexibility & Balance

• Flexible Scheduling to fit your lifestyle

• Weekly and Daily Pay

• Virtual Orientation – convenient and efficient onboarding

• Electronic Charting – streamline your workday

🚀 Support & Growth Opportunities

• Paid Training and ongoing education

• 24/7 Clinical Support

• Career Advancement within a growing organization

Be Part of Something Meaningful

Centria Healthcare, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Farmington Hills, is one of Michigan’s leading providers of catastrophic injury care, private duty nursing, and rehabilitative home support. We serve clients of all ages with a deep commitment to quality, compassion, and respect.

📣 Apply today and start making a difference in your community—one home at a time.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the CTO
jobs.description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

This role is a force multiplier for the CTO and the Product, Engineering, and Implementation leadership team. You operate as an extension of the CTO, absorbing context across every workstream, making real prioritization calls, wielding real authority, and running the operating system of a technical org that ships to both commercial and government customers around the world.

Beyond execution, you hold the business of the Product/Eng org: its operating cadence, its budget, and its people planning, in partnership with Finance and the People team. You also build and lead the org’s Program Management Office: a team of technical program managers who run the portfolio of cross-functional programs and customer deliveries.

This is a position of operational ownership and trusted judgment; ensuring the technical functions are aligned with Altana’s business strategy and corporate governance. Where the role touches comp, leveling, org design, and budget, you apply the frameworks the People CoE and Finance own. You are the CTO's embedded counterpart to those functions, not a parallel authority.

You Will

In this role, you will own:

• Strategic projects. Lead or staff high-priority critical organizational initiatives identified by EPD leadership.

• Operating cadence. Staff meetings, roadmap planning and portfolio reviews, metrics reviews, and leadership offsites — set agendas, drive follow-through, document and distribute decisions.

• PMO leadership. Build and lead a team of technical program managers. Hire, develop, and set the bar for the function, and decide where TPMs are embedded versus centrally deployed.

• Portfolio and delivery. Own the portfolio view of in-flight programs and customer deliveries, intake and prioritization, and delivery standards (planning, status, risk and dependency tracking, launch readiness, government contract reporting), plus the tooling that makes delivery health visible.

• Cross-functional integration. Across the various sub-teams within Product, Engineering, Implementation and our public and private sector delivery motions — surface where priorities collide and force resolution.

• Decision and information flow. What reaches the CTO, in what form, and what gets escalated versus resolved below.

• Executive communications. Board and all-hands material and internal updates for the Product/Eng org, grounded in its real state.

• People partnership. With the People CoE, run headcount planning, org design, and leveling/comp inside Product/Eng — applying central frameworks, owning the org's read on where it's over- or under-built, and serving as the CTO's single counterpart to the People team.

• Finance partnership. Own the Product/Eng budget and spend against the plan Finance sets — track burn, flag variance, model headcount and vendor trade-offs, and act as the CTO's counterpart to FP&A. Own the success metrics in partnership with FP&A to ensure tight alignment on business levers to drive growth and deployment of capital.

You Have

• ~10 years in product management, technical program or portfolio management, strategy, business operations, or a role with genuine operational ownership — not coordination.

• A record of holding multiple parallel workstreams, competing stakeholders, and ambiguous ownership, and keeping all of it moving.

• Experience building or running a PMO or program portfolio. You’ve designed intake, prioritization, and delivery-tracking processes that teams use rather than work around.

• Experience managing and growing a team, ideally program or project managers. You’ve hired, coached, and given hard feedback, and built a function others want to join.

• Enough technical fluency to hold a real conversation with a platform engineer — APIs, infrastructure, deployment, architecture at a conceptual level — and to read a design doc and push on it. Not a coder.

• Financial and operational fluency: managing a budget, speaking to variance, tackling headcount and spend trade-offs.

• Comfort with org design and workforce planning as a partner to a People function — fluent enough to be a real thought partner, without running it.

• Influence beyond your own team: moving engineers, PMs, and GTM leads through trust, framing, and timing, not by invoking the CTO's name.

• Extreme organizational precision — systems legible to others, clean first drafts, async updates that need minimal editing.

• Nice-to-have: experience delivering programs under government contracts (milestones, deliverables, compliance reporting.

Nice to have, but not required

• Experience building production systems with LLMs, agents, evals, or retrieval.

• Experience using engineering metrics such as DORA or SPACE to improve how a team works.

• Background in trade, supply chain, compliance, or working with government customers.

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, USA with hybrid work flexibility and candidates must be within commuting distance from our Williamsburg, Brooklyn office

US Salary and Benefits

The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position.  The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Altana's total compensation package. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Oﬀ (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your work-life balance.

• Parental Leave: We oﬀer industry leading Paid Parental Leave (PPL), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.

• Health Benefits: We have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. Our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA). There is also a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option.

• Supplemental Benefits: Altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and AD&D insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.

• 401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Fidelity 401(k) retirement savings program.

• Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre-tax funds for public transit or parking!

• Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness.

• Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan.

• Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support.

• Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre-tax funds for childcare expenses

The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Our Values

Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

• Trust: Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.

• Resilience: In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.

• Stewardship: We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.

• Courage: Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. Our employment opportunities and decisions are based on business needs and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, family care or medical leave status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations in the areas in which we operate. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, in any situation.

Offers related to employment at Altana will come from an Altana.ai email address. We will never ask for payment as part of the interview or onboarding process.

jobs.title: VP of Client Relationships
jobs.description:
The exciting world of scientific research is fueled by people with a passion for solving complex problems. At Cayuse, we are committed to our customers’ success by empowering organizations to conduct globally connected research that advances their impact on science, discovery and society. We build on that commitment with proven, integrated and easy-to-use technology that delivers exceptional value, and world class service and support that accelerates outcomes.

But we are more than just an empowering platform powered by advanced technologies. We are a collaboration of exceptional, highly skilled people with multi-disciplinary expertise, and are building our team to support our ambitious growth plans. Cayuse’s foundational strength comes from our customer and employee focused values and commitment to industry-leading solutions. It’s an exciting time to become a key member of our growing team.

Cayuse is seeking a Vice President, Client Relationships to lead our strategic account organization and own the renewals, account planning, and revenue we retain and grow from our existing customer base. This high-impact leadership role leads a team made up of Customer Success Managers and Strategic Account Managers, carries an expansion quota, and is accountable for Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR). The VP is the customer's ultimate advocate and strategic advisor, guiding clients through platform optimization, expansion, and multi-year adoption lifecycles.

The ideal candidate is an executive-level relationship builder who can influence C-suite stakeholders, orchestrate a broad internal matrix, and lead and develop a team to deliver measurable client outcomes. This role requires equal parts strategic thinking, commercial discipline, and hands-on leadership.

Core Responsibilities

• Team Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers and Strategic Account Managers, setting clear portfolio, coverage, and performance expectations.

• Build the hiring, onboarding, and career-development plan for the team, and retain top talent.

• Establish a consistent operating rhythm for account planning, forecast reviews, customer health reviews, and business-at-risk reviews.

• Oversee tool and process development to optimize team reach and performance.

• Strategic Account & Relationship Governance

• Serve as executive sponsor for our largest enterprise accounts, building trusted relationships with executive sponsors in Enterprise Research Administration.

• Lead high-profile Customer Business Reviews (CBRs), Steering Committees, and multi-year technology roadmap sessions focused on business outcomes and ROI.

• Guide enterprise customers through platform and landscape updates, ensuring their corporate strategy maps to Cayuse's product roadmap.

• Commercial Growth, Renewals & Risk Mitigation

• Own GRR and NRR for the strategic account portfolio, and carry an expansion quota covering cross-sell, upsell, and renewal growth.

• Own contract renewals, including renewal forecasting, timing, pricing and terms, and negotiation, working with Finance and Legal.

• Build and manage the expansion pipeline with Revenue Operations, including accurate forecasting to leadership and CRM hygiene.

• Lead escalations and recovery plans for Business-at-Risk (BAR) accounts.

• Account Planning & Customer Health Management

• Own account planning: ensure every strategic account has a documented plan covering goals, stakeholders, adoption, risks, and expansion opportunities, and review plans with the team on a regular basis.

• Own customer health management across the portfolio: define health scoring and early-warning signals (adoption, engagement, support trends, sentiment), and make sure the team acts on them with clear playbooks for at-risk and expanding accounts.

• Use account health reviews to drive renewal, risk, and expansion plans.

• Value Realization & Platform Adoption

• Partner with client business units post-implementation to maximize feature adoption and subscription value.

• Advise clients on operational readiness, change management, and governance best practices to sustain high user engagement.

• Establish, track, and interpret adoption and engagement metrics to address customer friction points proactively.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Mobilize and orchestrate teams across Product Management, Delivery Consultants, and Elite Support to resolve escalations.

• Capture client feedback, telemetry, and capability gaps and surface them to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.

• Contribute to company go-to-market planning, including retention and expansion targets, coverage models, and pricing and packaging input.

Qualifications

• 12+ years of experience in enterprise software sales, customer success, strategic client delivery, or key account management.

• 5+ years leading managers or multi-level, highly matrixed enterprise account teams, including hiring, coaching, and developing Customer Success Managers and Strategic or Key Account Managers.

• Proven experience steering Tier 1 SaaS/cloud deployments (e.g., enterprise research administration, ERP, HCM, SCM, or financial suites).

• Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding retention (GRR/NRR) and expansion quota targets, and of building customer health management programs.

• Advanced executive presence, with masterful negotiation, critical thinking, and communication skills and a record of influencing C-suite decisions under pressure.

• Understanding of global IT ecosystems, implementation lifecycles, global system integrators (SIs), and enterprise governance models.

• Financial data literacy: comfort with SaaS financial metrics, forecasting, data analytics, and performance KPIs.

• Experience selling into higher education, healthcare, research organizations, or similarly complex enterprise environments strongly preferred.

• Willingness to travel 30–50% for customer on-sites and executive reviews.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, opportunities, and resource needs can shift.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and familiarity with modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger, GAP Selling).

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline; MBA or equivalent advanced degree highly preferred.

• Certifications such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, GAP Selling, PMP, or Workday Deployment Methodologies are a major asset.

How You'll Be Measured

• Gross and net revenue retention: GRR and NRR across the strategic account portfolio, against quarterly and annual targets.

• Expansion: attainment of the team's expansion quota, and the size, quality, and velocity of the cross-sell and upsell pipeline, including forecast accuracy.

• Renewals: on-time renewal rate and renewal forecast accuracy.

• Customer health and risk management: health coverage and outcomes, and early identification and resolution of Business-at-Risk accounts.

• Account planning: coverage and quality of account plans across strategic accounts.

• Value realization: adoption and engagement KPIs, plus client satisfaction (NPS and CSAT).

• Executive engagement: depth of C-suite relationship coverage and quality of CBRs and Steering Committees.

• Team leadership: performance, development, engagement, and retention of the Customer Success Managers and Strategic Account Managers.

• Cross-functional impact: effectiveness in resolving escalations and the quality of client feedback surfaced to Product.

Benefits

• Competitive Medical Benefits (PPO + HSA available)

• Vision, Dental, Short-Term Disability fully covered by Cayuse

• Unlimited PTO + Holidays + Flexible Work Schedule

• Remote Work Stipend

• Equal Paid Parental Leave

• 401k with Employer Matching

• Quarterly Wellness Reimbursement

• Remote Work Environment, supporting the Ultimate Employee Experience

Cayuse does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or any Cayuse employees. Cayuse is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Our culture is one of inclusion and belonging where everyone feels respected, treated justly, supported and nourished. We all share responsibility for creating and sustaining a work environment where differences are celebrated and we are empowered to strive for excellence. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively seek to recruit, develop, and retain a diverse and talented workforce.

jobs.title: Leader in Training, RISE on The Strip
jobs.description:
The Role

The Leader in Training (LIT) is an adaptable and essential part of the RISE Dispensary leadership team that prioritizes delivering memorable, positive consumer experiences. As part of the leadership team, you have a key role in actively supervising the dispensary’s daily operations, communicating priorities to team members, and optimizing the customer journey. As a Leader in Training, you will gain subject matter expertise as you rotate through critical dispensary functions supporting operations, experience, and people. The Leader in Training role puts you on a fast track to growth and is a developmental step to becoming Assistant General Manager.

Responsibilities

Operations

• Support management in overseeing the execution of all dispensary operations to ensure compliance with security, inventory, and local and state regulations.

• Monitor and maintain inventory levels, ensuring an assortment of products and communicating inventory action items with management.

• Oversee the intake and verification of deliveries, transfers, and inventory management, ensuring accuracy within the vault.

• Actively participate in leading team members to effectively execute programs, initiatives, and regionalized in-store promotions.

• Demonstrate proper cash handling, including accurately processing payments, discount application, and cash maintenance, and oversee team member execution.

Experience

• Lead by example and motivate team members to consistently deliver memorable, positive in-store customer experiences.

• Participate in “Leader On Duty” shifts to provide active supervision, team member recognition, and redirect behaviors to support the customer journey.

• Facilitate a seamless omni-channel customer experience and provide oversite to deliver consistency across in-store, drive-thru, curbside & delivery.

• Lead by example and motivate team members to deliver Loyalty goals.

• Complete and appropriately delegate assigned tasks during scheduled shifts. Ensure adequate sales floor coverage and zoning during shifts.

People

• In partnership with the General Manager or Assistant General Manager, build and retain a high-performing team by participating in selecting the best talent and leading the onboarding and training of new team members.

• Provide coaching and feedback to help team members exceed performance and behavioral expectations. Partner with management to issue accountability.

• Help facilitate the store’s team member badging process with local and state agencies.

• Maintain and coordinate scheduling of team members' shifts, meal breaks, and rest periods.

• Perform other duties as needed.

Qualifications

• At least three years of customer service or retail experience, with at least one year in a supervisory role.

• Cannabis experience preferred

• Inventory control experience preferred

• Meet the scheduling and availability requirements (i.e., ability to work a schedule inclusive of varying shifts such as mornings, days, nights, and weekends) to meet business needs

• Must have reliable, responsible and dependable attendance.

• Must be 21 years or older.

• Must pass any and all required background checks.

• Must possess a valid driver’s license or state ID.

• Must understand and comply with the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of Green Thumb

• Must have a solid understanding of the Cannabis laws, rules and regulations, and a passion to further their understanding and knowledge of the industry and the laws.

• Prior cannabis experience not required

Skills

• Must be proactive, with a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and strong communication and leadership skills.

• Meet timelines consistently and be able to work under pressure effectively.

• Continuously open to constructive, developmental feedback, and maintaining composure even in difficult situations.

• High level of interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment, often working cross-functionally.

• Ability to use standard office equipment and computer software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications, and email

• Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative, and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgment, common sense, and resourcefulness.

• Adapts and thrives in a demanding, fast-paced environment

• Possesses a high level of critical thinking

• Operates with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information

• Ability to resolve conflict, handle employee and customer complaints, and settle disputes

Additional Requirements

Must have the ability to perform the following tasks for prolonged periods of time (i.e., up to the duration of a scheduled shift or workday)

• Move about the dispensary in order to fulfill work assignments and assist employees and patients and/or customers in various locations of the dispensary

• Remain in a stationary position, if required, to meet the needs of the business

• Converse and communicate with individuals and groups of people directly

• Operate point of sale system, computer, and other office productivity machinery in order to use online programming and software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications and email

• Prepare patient and customer orders by moving and placing products

• Inspect and receive detailed information, such as patients' and/or customers' dates of birth, in-store or online orders, or inquiries

• Move inventory and materials weighing up to 30 pounds independently

• Position self to move inventory and materials in storage areas

Working Conditions

• Patient and/or customer-facing environment

• Ability to work outdoors in varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions

• Exposure to cannabis and/or allergens that might be present in an environment where cannabis is present and prevalent

jobs.title: Property Accountant
jobs.location: HRP Corporate - 804 Green Valley Road - #300 - Greensboro, NC - 27408
jobs.description:
Property Accountant

PURPOSE OF THE JOB:

The Property Accountant is responsible for overseeing the complete financial cycle for a portfolio of multifamily communities. Our Property Accounting Department offers a unique blend of full-cycle accounting, treasury, and financial analysis, creating an environment that fosters growth and development.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

General Accounting and Portfolio Management:

• Oversee the accounting, treasury and reporting of a portfolio of multi-family properties

• Review of the monthly financial package (GL, budget comparison, and 12 months rolling P&L) for required reclasses, accruals, and explanations in close collaboration with Community Managers and according to published guidelines.

• Confirm accuracy and upload petty cash transactions

• Review G/L and re-class to ensure operating/major expenses and capital expenditures are recorded accurately

• Calculate accruals for mortgage interest, property taxes, and insurance

• Calculate and pay management fees to HRP, ensuring the monthly true up is within established materiality thresholds of the actual fee.

• Review of the Balance Sheet for monthly submissions, focusing on the accuracy of accruals, escrows, and loan amortizations

• Develop deep understanding of ownership specific reporting requirements and accounting treatments

• Perform monthly Balance Sheet reconciliations

Treasury and Cash Management Functions:

• Review and process payables weekly, ensuring timely payments to vendors

• Process utility payments timely to avoid late fees and disconnects

• Review the daily cash position and forecast for all properties in the portfolio, ensuring timely communication of cash surpluses or deficits to HRP management.

• Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations

• Ensure mortgages are recorded and paid timely

• Review and track all bank and self-escrows related to tax, insurance, and reserves

• Post Security Deposit payments and reconcile bank accounts

• Ensure all lender financial statements are submitted as required.

• Complete and submit quarterly Lender Replacement Reserve Draw Requests by the end of the month following quarter end. Ensure Replacement Reserve submissions and receipts are tracked according to policy.

Owner and Investor Servicing:

• Distribute monthly financial reporting to owners per the management fee agreement

• Review and initiate ownership disbursements as necessary

• Prepare quarterly reporting as needed (Reserve Reimbursement Requests, Financial Statements, etc.)

Operations and Community Manager Support:

• Distribute variance reports and financial reviews to Community and Regional Managers

• Maintain clear and consistent lines of communication with site and regional teams

• Provide Accounting support for site teams

• Build positive working relationships with site and regional teams

Other Responsibilities:

• Review all necessary agreements for assigned properties and utilize organizational tools to document critical information for future reference

• Support the annual audit process and assist with year-end tax procedures

• Foster a team-oriented environment, working professionally with internal and external customers

• Attend and participate in periodic training sessions

• Promote the Live It Culture within the Department, leading by example to the other team members

• Perform all other duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Must possess strong attention to detail to be able to accurately process financial data, identify discrepancies, and ensure all accounting entries are correct.

• Must possess strong analytical skills to review financial reports, identify trends, and offer insights to management for decision-making.

• Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with property managers, auditors, and other stakeholders.

• Must possess the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple property portfolios simultaneously.

• Must be able to maintain confidentiality.

• Knowledge of property management accounting is preferred.

FLSA STATUS:

Salaried, Exempt

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:

Reports directly to the Accounting Team Leader. Works with team members including Community Managers, Regional Managers, corporate team members, and outside vendors.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

None

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

Hours of Work: 7:45am/9:00am to 4:45pm/6:00pm Monday through Friday. Schedule may vary. Extended hours may be required during peak periods to meet business needs.

EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, or equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Prior experience in property management is preferred, but not required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Must be able to perform the physical functions of the position, which may include but are not limited to: ability to effectively communicate with team members, supervisors, vendors and service providers. Must be able to see, hear, talk, sit, stand, walk, reach, climb, stoop, kneel and crouch. Must be able to moderately lift or move up to 5 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 10 pounds as needed.

COMMUNICATION:

Must be able to communicate effectively both verbally and in written form with Team Leader, Accounting Manager, Director of Property Accounting, VP of Property Accounting, Community Managers, Regional Managers, corporate team members, and outside vendors.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

Must be able to work in a general office environment.  The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

TRAVEL:

Some overnight travel may be required to attend company sponsored events such as conferences, training events, road shows etc.

PRE-EMPLOYMENT:

Drug testing and background screening required. Must complete online pre-employment assessment.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

Ability to read, write and verbally communicate in English.

REASONING ABILITY:

Has the ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out basic written or oral instructions.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

Advanced knowledge of mathematics required. Ability to apply mathematical concepts to practical situations. Ability to calculate interest, fractions, percentages, and ratios. The ability to add and subtract two-digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10’s and 100’s. Ability to perform the operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume and distance.

COMPUTER SKILLS:

Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Excel required. Yardi Voyager knowledge and General Ledger experience is preferred

PERSONAL APPEARANCE:

Dress, grooming and personal cleanliness standards contribute to the business image of Hawthorne Residential Partners.  During business hours or when representing the company, employees are expected to present a clean, neat and tasteful appearance.

Hawthorne is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Consultor de Vendas - Sabará/MG
Assistant General Counsel, Transactions
jobs.location: Remote (w/ preference for DC or NYC)
jobs.description:
Assistant General Counsel, Transactions

Location: Remote (U.S.), with preference for New York or Washington, DC

Travel: 5-10% (team offsites, transaction meetings, industry conferences, and in-person legal events)

Reports to: General Counsel, working closely with the Associate General Counsel and the Managing Director, Investments

We’re financing the future of energy

Crux is the capital platform for clean and critical infrastructure. We combine advisory, investments, markets, and research with proprietary intelligence and technology to modernize capital raising and deployment.

Our team is composed of experts in energy, tax, finance, government, and technology. We have raised $77 million in capital from some of the best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Lowercarbon Capital, New System Ventures, Overture, Ardent Venture Partners, QED, Canapi, and others. These funds are joined by strategic investors including Pattern Energy, Clearway Energy, EDF Renewables, Intersect Power, LS Power, Orsted, Hartree Partners, Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures, MassMutual Ventures, and OMERS Ventures.


AN INFLECTION POINT IN AMERICAN ENERGY AND MANUFACTURING

Energy demand is growing for the first time in decades, driving an urgent need for more affordable and reliable electricity. More electricity requires new clean energy infrastructure and strong domestic supply chains for minerals and components — as well as large amounts of capital.

Traditional project financing is opaque, fragmented, and analog. At Crux, we’re changing that. Through unmatched insights and expertise, white-glove service, purpose-built tools, and risk underwriting, we power a more prosperous, clean, and secure energy future.

We are scaling quickly and looking for team members who are eager to combine deep expertise with an AI- and tech-forward mindset.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Crux is seeking an Assistant General Counsel, Transactions — a mid-level project finance lawyer who will serve as the day-to-day transactional attorney across Crux’s investment and financing activity. The role covers the full range of transactions Crux originates, structures, and executes: tax equity and preferred equity investments, transferable tax credit purchases and forward commitments, and debt facilities, as well as Crux’s own corporate-level financings and strategic transactions.

You will manage transactions from term sheet through closing and post-closing administration, working with Crux’s Investments, Coverage, Debt Advisory, and Portfolio Management teams and managing outside counsel where appropriate. You will also support the General Counsel and Associate General Counsel on corporate-level matters, so the role offers significant breadth.

Crux Legal approaches each transaction as an opportunity to improve the next one: standardizing documents, developing playbooks and checklists, and building and using AI tools for diligence, drafting, closing, and portfolio management. We are looking for a lawyer who already works this way and wants to do a lot more of it.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Execute Crux’s investment transactions. Lead the legal workstream on tax equity (partnership flip, T-flip, and hybrid structures), preferred equity, and transferable tax credit transactions: term sheets, LLC agreements, equity capital contribution agreements, tax credit transfer and forward purchase agreements, guaranties, and closing deliverables. Drive checklists, manage timelines, and close deals.

 - Support debt financings. Work on the debt that sits alongside Crux’s investments and on Crux’s own facilities: construction, bridge, back-leverage, and warehouse financings, including credit agreements, intercreditor and forbearance arrangements, borrowing base and draw mechanics, and lender consents.

 - Lead legal diligence and issue-spotting. Review project documents (offtake, EPC and supply, interconnection, real estate, permits), tax credit qualification items (beginning of construction, prevailing wage and apprenticeship, domestic content, energy community, recapture), insurance, and sponsor/counterparty matters. Distill findings into clear risks and mitigants for investment committee materials.

 - Own the post-closing legal workstream. Handle funding conditions, amendments, consents, waivers, and reporting obligations across the portfolio with Portfolio Management.

 - Manage outside counsel efficiently. Decide what gets done in-house versus by outside counsel, scope and supervise their work, and keep fees proportional to the transaction.

 - Support corporate-level matters. Assist the General Counsel and Associate General Counsel on a range of corporate matters as needed, including corporate financings, strategic transactions and joint ventures, entity formation and maintenance, corporate governance, regulatory matters, intellectual property, and commercial agreements.

 - Standardize documents and processes. Maintain and improve Crux’s forms, playbooks, checklists, and closing sets, and identify and address inefficiencies in deal processes.

 - Develop and apply AI tools. Work with Crux’s legal innovation, operations, product, and engineering teams to develop and deploy AI tools for diligence review, document drafting and comparison, and closing workflows. Apply them on live transactions, assess their effectiveness, and refine them over time.

 - Partner with the business. Participate in deal discussions with Investments, Coverage, Debt Advisory, and Portfolio Management teams, translate legal issues into commercial terms, and help the business make well-informed decisions. Identify regulatory considerations where transactions involve Crux’s broker-dealer and investment adviser affiliates, and escalate to the General Counsel and Compliance as appropriate.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3-6 years of transactional experience, with a significant portion in the projects, energy, or infrastructure finance practice of a leading law firm. In-house experience at a developer, investor, or lender is a plus but not required.

 - Hands-on experience with tax equity, transferable tax credit transactions, and debt financings for renewable energy and infrastructure projects. You should be able to draft from a term sheet, negotiate a full document set, and drive to closing with limited supervision.

 - Working fluency in the federal energy tax credit framework (Sections 45, 48, 45Y, 48E, 45X, and 6418), including qualification, bonus adders, and recapture risk, and the judgment to know when to bring in tax counsel.

 - Practical experience using AI in legal practice. You have adopted or built tools and workflows, can describe concretely what worked and what did not, and are interested in redesigning how transactions are done, not simply doing them faster. This role requires demonstrated experience rather than general openness to learning AI tools.

 - Ownership and judgment. You take responsibility for outcomes, make pragmatic risk-weighted calls informed by business needs, and know when to escalate.

 - Clear communication with lawyers and non-lawyers, in writing and in real time. You can explain a complicated structure to an investment principal in plain terms and hold your own with counterparty counsel.

 - Comfort with pace and ambiguity. You work effectively on several transactions at once, build process where none exists, and are comfortable fielding questions from across the business.

 - JD and admission in good standing to the bar of at least one U.S. state (New York or DC preferred), with eligibility for in-house registration where required.


WHO THRIVES HERE

Crux is highly cross-functional. Legal works alongside Investments, Coverage, Finance, Product, and Compliance, and this role suits someone who wants to be involved when deals are shaped, not only when documents are drafted. Decisions are often made collaboratively, which can take longer than a top-down process but generally produces better and more durable outcomes.





WHAT WE BRING

 - Backing, traction & brand:
   
   - We have raised $77 million in capital from some of the best venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Lowercarbon Capital, New System Ventures, Ardent Venture Partners, Pattern, Clearway, EDFR, Intersect, LS Power, Orsted, Hartree Partners, Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures, MassMutual Ventures, and OMERS Ventures.
   
   - $500m warehouse facility from Nuveen to invest in clean energy.
   
   - Have been profitable and are growing exponentially
   
   - We have closed over 180+ transactions in just the last 2 years, facilitating billions of dollars of capital flowing into renewables projects

 - Culture & working dynamic
   
   - Remote-first operating model: Work from anywhere in the US and Canada, or work from one of our optional offices in DC, NYC, Denver, & SF. Co-working pod in Seattle.
   
   - High growth & high ownership culture: We grow quickly by giving extremely talented people a lot of responsibility.
   
   - Best of financial services & technology: We have brought together a team that are experts in clean energy finance, and the best technologies. Use your expertise while getting to be on the cutting edge of applying AI to your day and your clients’ experience.
   
   - Regular team offsites: We sustain culture by bringing the entire company together 2 times a year. Individual teams may also meet up more frequently.

 - Benefits
   
   - Healthcare: We cover 100% of premiums for employees with a variety of plans on Aetna (nationwide) and Kaiser (WA and California) and subsidize 80% for dependents (total as a group), if relevant.
   
   - Dental & vision: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and 80% for dependents (each), if relevant.
   
   - Family forming & fertility support
   
   - Parental leave: 16 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents.
   
   - Holidays: 10 company holidays per year.
   
   - Paid time off: 20 days per year.
   
   - 401k: account fees supported by Crux.
   
   - 

Compensation

 - Base salary: $220,000-$270,000, based on experience.

 - Bonus: Discretionary annual performance bonus.

 - Stock options in a rapidly growing company, in an amount to be agreed.

Our values

 - Care for each other: We want to work on a team where people support each other — in their growth, in their work, and towards our shared mission. When we do that, we have fun.

 - Build and improve rapidly: We move quickly. To do that, we focus, consistently ask ourselves if we are prioritizing the right things, and execute them as best as possible.

 - Focus unremittingly on customers: Our first obligation is to our customers and partners, and we keep their needs front and center in everything we do.

 - Demonstrate ownership: We are all owners of Crux. This is our team, our company, our product and we show that to each other.

 - Convene a team that reflects the breadth of experiences in the country: We’re building a team with a wide range of backgrounds and a culture where everyone can thrive.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Web Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Polymarket is looking for a Senior Web Engineer to own complex frontend features, improve reliability, and help us ship faster with confidence. You'll own major web surfaces end-to-end: from scoping and implementation through launch, monitoring, and production support. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of frontend product development, backend systems, performance, and reliability. You should have experience in crypto and be comfortable shipping complicated React/Next.js features, debugging ambiguous production issues, and working across teams without needing hand-holding. We want someone who can move fast, make strong technical decisions, and help raise the quality bar for our frontend systems.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own and ship complex features end-to-end. Build and launch web features across Polymarket's core product surfaces, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, architecture, and long-term maintainability.

 - Collaborate across the stack. Work closely with backend engineers to design APIs, reason through data flows, and build reliable user experiences on top of complex systems. Partner with QA, TPM, product, and design to clarify requirements, manage launches, and improve product quality.

 - Own reliability and incident response for your domain. Monitor dashboards, alerts, and user reports to identify and respond to issues quickly. Work with backend and infrastructure teams during incidents to isolate root causes, ship mitigations, and follow through with fixes and prevention work.

 - Improve frontend observability. Build and improve the logs, metrics, alerts, dashboards, and error reporting that give the team visibility into how our frontend systems are performing.

 - Raise the engineering bar. Identify meaningful technical debt, propose pragmatic refactors, and contribute to system design discussions that evolve our frontend architecture as the product scales. Lead by example through strong code reviews, clear communication, and high-quality execution.

 - Tie technical work to outcomes. Connect your work to measurable results – performance, reliability, product quality, and conversion – and help break down ambiguous product requirements into shippable engineering work.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of frontend web engineering experience with experience in crypto, Web3, or adjacent financial infrastructure

 - Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend development

 - Strong frontend system design instincts across state management, data fetching, caching, performance, reliability, and maintainability

 - Experience owning complex features from scoping through launch

 - Strong debugging skills and experience responding to production issues

 - Comfortable working with backend engineers on APIs, data contracts, failure modes, and system behavior

 - High agency: you notice problems, propose solutions, and drive work to completion

 - Product-minded: you care about user experience, not just implementation

 - Able to operate independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

 - Clear communicator during planning, launches, bugs, and incidents

 - (Plus) Frontend performance specialization

 - (Plus) Experience with high-traffic, real-time, marketplace, trading, or financial products

 - (Plus) Experience building for WebViews or shared web/mobile surfaces

 - (Plus) Experience improving frontend observability, alerting, or reliability practices

 - (Plus) Strong practical use of AI tools to improve engineering productivity



BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

 - 401k match

 - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories




PAY TRANSPARENCY 

Base salary range: $230,000 to $330,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Smartcat

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

You’ll join a newly formed Technical Account Management team built to make sure every Smartcat customer, at every tier, can reach a human technical expert 24/7. AI already resolves a growing share of customer issues, so you’ll own the escalations beyond what AI can handle: technical troubleshooting, integrations, and workflow questions, solved in an AI-forward way. You’ll be assigned a portfolio of accounts, and on our largest accounts you’ll be the named technical resource and work directly with the account executive.

MISSION

Be the trusted technical expert behind Smartcat’s customers: meet their needs with passion and approachability, resolve complex escalations with AI-first problem solving, keep integrations and workflows healthy, and give customers around the world fast, expert technical support at any hour.

OUTCOMES

• Act as the technical point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts within your tier (Strategic, Enterprise, or Corporate), partnering with the account team on each

• Take ownership of customer escalations that go beyond what Smartcat’s AI capabilities can resolve, using technical troubleshooting and AI tools to reach resolution quickly

• Resolve customer inquiries and requests in modern ticketing systems such as Zendesk and YouTrack, maintaining a consistently high customer satisfaction rate

• Provide 24/7 coverage as part of a globally distributed team, so every customer can reach a human regardless of tier

• Own technical onboarding and implementation: API and connector integrations (CMS, TMS, DAM, dev tools), SSO/SAML setup, workspace architecture, and workflow configuration

• Escalate feature requests, bugs, and issues that need engineering to Support, Product, and Engineering with clear reproduction steps, and own root-cause communication through resolution

• Advise customers on best-practice use of Smartcat’s platform (CAT tools, AI Coworkers, Marketplace, PDF pipeline, custom workflows) to maximize adoption and ROI

• Monitor technical health signals (integration failures, API error rates, usage drop-offs) and flag risk to the account team before it becomes churn

• Collaborate with engineers, analysts, testers, success managers, and product managers, and relay customer technical feedback to influence the roadmap

• Develop and maintain help center content, internal documentation, runbooks, and reusable integration patterns, using AI to keep them current

• Support renewal and expansion conversations with technical proof points: performance data, integration health, and use-case expansion opportunities

How the tiers differ: On Strategic accounts (our largest named customers), you’ll be the go-to technical resource and work directly with the assigned account executive. On Enterprise and Corporate accounts, you’ll cover a larger number of accounts, with less day-to-day customer-facing time and more emphasis on efficient, AI-powered issue resolution.

HOW YOU’LL RAMP

By Day 30:

• Learn Smartcat’s platform end to end: CAT tools, AI Coworkers, Marketplace, PDF pipeline, custom workflows, and the integration and API landscape

• Learn how AI handles first-line customer issues today, where human escalation takes over, and how tickets flow through Zendesk and YouTrack

• Meet your account team, Support, Product, and Engineering counterparts, and get oriented on your assigned accounts: architecture, integrations, open issues, and health signals

By Day 60:

• Resolve customer escalations independently, using AI tools to diagnose and solve, and escalating to Engineering with clear reproduction steps when needed

• Lead technical onboarding or integration work for at least one account

• Monitor health signals across your accounts and flag at least one emerging risk to the account team

By Day 90:

• Carry your full account portfolio, including your share of 24/7 coverage

• Run a technical workshop with a customer’s team and summarize it cleanly for their business stakeholders

• Contribute help center content, a runbook, or a reusable integration pattern to the team’s library, and relay customer feedback that informs Product and Engineering

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED

• Background in the localization or translation industry, for example as a localization engineer at a translation agency or language service provider, with a strong understanding of languages and international customers

• An AI-first approach to problem solving: you already use AI tools to troubleshoot, diagnose, and work faster

• Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a track record of owning issues through resolution

• A genuine love of helping and teaching people, and excellent written communication skills in English

• Working knowledge of REST APIs and webhooks, and comfort reading logs and debugging integration failures; scripting experience (Python or JavaScript) is a plus

• Experience with ticketing systems such as Zendesk and YouTrack

• The ability to explain technical root cause to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and to run a technical workshop with a customer’s team and then summarize it cleanly for their VP

• Comfort owning multiple accounts at once and prioritizing under pressure, including during crisis de-escalation

• Experience working on remote, globally distributed teams

• Openness to feedback and to others’ opinions and ideas, and eagerness to grow

• Bonus: technical support or quality assurance experience, and experience with CMS/TMS integrations or content supply chain tooling

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

• A global, connected team We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.

• Be part of an AI Native Organization We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.

• Innovating a $100 Billion industry Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.

• Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.

• Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High Performance At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: Contract Principal Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company:

Stable Kernel is a technology services firm and custom software developer building scalable software solutions for cutting-edge, innovative enterprises to move their business forward. We are headquartered in Atlanta, GA.

We’re a privately held, Great Place to Work Certified Company™ with a multi-award-winning culture and impressive 10+ year trajectory of sustainable growth. At Stable Kernel, we support our employees in ways that help them do some of the best work of their lives.

About the Role:

As a Stable Kernel Contract Principal Project Manager, you play an essential role in setting our portfolio of world-class clients up for success through the on-time and on-budget development and delivery of their most innovative, transformational initiatives. You are equal parts delivery expert and trusted advisor to internal and external project stakeholders. Your positivity, candor, and effectiveness make you the Project Manager that clients request to have assigned to their projects time and again.

You are a true partner to our sales, strategy, technical, and client services professionals and collaborate with them throughout the client life cycle to ensure outstanding work, documentation, and customer experiences.

Principal Project Managers report directly to our Director of Project Management. You may be classified as individual contributors or as people managers with individual contributor responsibilities.

Core Responsibilities Include:

• Technical Impact:

• Establishes scalable delivery solutions and defines the approach, phasing, and sequencing across complex, multi-project programs, making strategic trade-offs that account for cross-functional dependencies and evolving client needs.

• Establishes scope governance and change control discipline across the program, coaching project managers on managing scope creep and change requests.

• Sets standards for engagement health and quality benchmarks across multiple project teams; mentors project managers on interpreting delivery health indicators.

• Evaluates tool effectiveness at program scale, identifying gaps and making recommendations for procurement, integration, or retirement.

• Designs AI-enabled delivery workflows and leads responsible AI adoption across program teams.

• Serves as the bridge between technical, design, product, and business teams across enterprise-level programs, establishing cross-departmental coordination norms.

• Business Alignment: Identifies and pursues opportunities to expand service offerings within existing programs.

• Clarifies strategic outcomes and defines integrated roadmaps across multiple projects; translates high-level client goals into actionable program-level objectives and anticipates shifts in client priorities.

• Establishes project planning standards across the program, coaching project managers on plan development, baselining, and tracking discipline.

• Supports statement of work (SOW) development and RFP and paid discovery engagements.

• Helps lead estimation and financial calibration across the program; oversees burn tracking and forecasting and works with finance and account leadership to translate estimates into business forecasts.

• Interacting with Others: Mentors junior project managers on handling difficult stakeholder situations and advancing their delivery practice.

• Leads coordination across the full program, orchestrating collaboration between multiple project teams, account leadership, technical leads, and senior business stakeholders.

• Leads program-level status reporting with governance cadences tailored to different stakeholder audiences.

• Influences the program and broader organization to drive adoption of new methodologies, tools, or practices across multiple teams through demonstration and consensus-building.

• Advises teams across the company, including executive leadership, on complex program challenges and strategic decisions.

• Leads communication during critical situations, including escalations, major milestones, and strategic decisions.

• Consulting: Coaches project managers on stakeholder mapping, dependency management, and navigating political complexity.

• Partners with leadership to shape delivery approaches; coaches project managers on large-scale initiatives and complex stakeholder dynamics.

• Leads stakeholder navigation across the full program, managing relationships with senior client stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and delivery teams across multiple interconnected projects.

• Operates comfortably in ambiguous, high-stakes environments, helping program teams establish clarity when strategic direction is still evolving.

• Coaches project managers on developing an advisory mindset, moving from reactive execution to proactive strategic partnership with clients.

• Poses probing questions and challenges proposed solutions to drive teams toward the best possible outcome.

• Problem-Solving: Coaches project managers to think critically and analytically when problem-solving. Helps clients and colleagues understand and respond to risk.

• Leads program-level problem solving and serves as the escalation point for assigned project managers, applying structured methodologies to diagnose root causes.

• Establishes risk management and escalation frameworks across multiple project teams and coaches project managers on early warning signals.

• Escalates business-impactful issues with context, impact assessment, and recommended solutions while solving in parallel; establishes escalation pathways across the program.

• Analyzes patterns across multiple projects to identify systemic issues; establishes metrics and measurement frameworks for tracking program health.

• Leadership: Exhibits strong capabilities in stakeholder management, negotiating, and problem-solving in complex situations. Identifies and nurtures potential in others, providing strategic guidance and supporting career path development for team members.

• Sets the strategic direction for how projects are managed within the program; leads multiple project teams or large programs.

• Proposes and leads process improvements across key program areas, such as team throughput, delivery quality, and engagement management, establishing standards that serve as models for broader adoption.

• Advocates for the iteration of practices and delivery philosophy across the program and organization; evaluates industry standards for applicability to program contexts.

• Helps lead resource management across the program, maintaining staffing plans, forecasting resourcing needs, and partnering with account and delivery leadership.

• Exhibits exceptional mentoring abilities, developing other leaders within the program team.

• Takes initiative in leading department-level activities, including facilitating team meetings, driving internal PMO initiatives, and contributing to hiring, onboarding, and team culture.

Intimate, Working Familiarity With:

• JIRA, Notion, Slack Claude, Github, Miro, and any budget tracking tools.

• Fluent in Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall and other project management methodologies, but willing to adapt as the SDLC evolves.

General Requirements:

• 8-10 years of experience in project management for consulting, professional services, or similar services-based organizations.

• Has PMP, CSM (Certified Scrum Master), CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner), or similar Project Management certifications.

• Proven track record of successful delivery of projects of all sizes and complexities.

• Exceptional communication skills, including client and stakeholder management.

• Experience crafting deliverable components of SOWs and writing business requirements documents.

A Bit More Info:

Base Compensation Range: $135,000

This is a 4-6 month contract position.

Stable Kernel operates a People Before Place Hybrid model, allowing most employees to choose where they can do their best work most days.

Minimal travel is associated with this role.

*Note – We are not sponsoring employment visas at this time. If you are currently in possession of an employment visa, it will need to be effective for at least 3 years from the date of your application for your candidacy for employment to be considered.

Stable Kernel’s culture is inclusive and expansive. We celebrate diversity in its many glorious forms and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender role orientation, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

However, we will discriminate against those unwilling to comply with the practice of our company values:

• we work with integrity always

• we respect our work and each other

• we are dedicated to life-long learning and sharing

• we stay hungry for new challenges

If you are like-minded in this regard, we hope you will apply. We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager (Public)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company’s long-term success.

Job Summary

The Assistant Project Manager supports the Project Manager in all daily responsibilities, including managing the financial lifecycle (change order management, billing, receivables, subcontractor payments) and document control. This fast-paced role requires strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively under pressure.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Execute all administrative and financial tasks related to project management, including insurance coordination, billing, change order management, profitability tracking, and project closeouts

• Manage the complete change order process, from scope review and pricing solicitation to packaging and presenting accurate change order requests

• Oversee billing activities, including setup, issuance, tracking receivables, and coordinating subcontractor payments

• Support the Project Manager in understanding and communicating project impacts, including delays and scope changes

• Have the general ability to process submittals, RFIs, and other essential construction administration documents with proficiency

• Assist with the administrative aspects of the monthly requisition process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness

• Utilize JRM’s ERP and construction management software to maintain project documentation and financial records

• Work independently with minimal direction on small to medium projects or collaborate with Senior Project Managers on larger, complex projects

• Demonstrate general aptitude in reading and interpreting construction documents and supporting field operations

• Maintain effective communication with project teams and stakeholders regarding project status, changes, and financial impacts

Qualifications and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management or a related field

• Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, ideally including 1-2 years in a field-based role

• Resourceful, driven, and self-motivated with strong financial and organizational skills

• Proven ability to multitask and manage detailed financial responsibilities

• Excellent time management and ability to work effectively under deadline pressure

• Proficient in reading and interpreting commercial construction plans and specifications

Computer Systems

• Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook), Timberline (preferred but not required), On-Screen Takeoff (preferred but not required)

Salary Information

• To the extent this position is performed in New York City, the annual salary range for this role is $100,000 - $125,000.

#LI-OnSite

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at JRM without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

The salary range listed in job postings reflects the Company’s good-faith estimate at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as position tier, geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training, and skills.

For more information on how JRM Construction Management collects and uses your personal information, reference our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Leasing Consultant - Olympus Corsair
jobs.description:
* National Apartment Association's Top Employer of 2023 - 2024 - 2025 *

The Olympus Property Difference

Compassion plays a part in everything we do, in every interaction, at every level. Kind acts for our residents. Respect for our employees. Courtesy for our partners.

We pride ourselves on being #OlympusProud, and to us, culture is everything. Each of our team members contributes to continued success and is dedicated to ensuring we surpass every expectation so that we can commit to providing opportunities for growth, rewards, and recognition.

The Leasing Consultant is the "face of the property" and an initial point of contact for all guests, prospects, residents, and vendors.

Your role's driving success is enthusiastically caring about helping others and securing residents in homes they'll love. You are an integral part of establishing your team's success by meeting sales goals and orchestrating successful resident events and community functions.

Your Purpose & General Responsibilities:

• Embody the Olympus Property Core Values: Customer Care Teamwork Trust Family Fun

• Showing and leasing apartment homes to prospective residents

• Explaining details of the different apartment unit options and variations

• Providing exemplary customer service to both current and prospective residents

• Greet visitors in a warm, courteous, professional and welcoming manner

• Maintain thorough knowledge of the property

• Close “the sale” of new apartment homes to prospective residents

• Prepare lease paperwork, obtain move-in keys, and additional duties prior to new resident arrival

jobs.title: Manager, Test Operations

Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

Role Overview

Apptronik is building advanced humanoid robots at scale, and manufacturing test is a critical part of ensuring reliability, quality, and production readiness across all robot subsystems.

We are seeking a Manager, Test Operations to be a hands-on technical leader to drive development, maintainability, and scalable hardware and software integrated solutions used for manufacturing and validation testing of robotic systems. This role will work closely with test and validation engineers, systems engineers, firmware developers, manufacturing, and operations teams to implement robust and maintainable test infrastructure supporting products from early NPI through production ramp.

This is a highly hands-on role focused on test automation, systems integration and manufacturing support in a fast-paced robotics environment.

• Own the testing process reliability, maintainability, and deployment consistency across manufacturing environments

• Champion flawless integration of: Embedded systems Firmware interfaces Sensors and actuators Motion control systems Data acquisition hardware

• Establish technical direction for hardware bring-up, debug activities, troubleshooting and communication issues in manufacturing environments

• Collaborate with test and validation engineering teams to ensure products are designed with testability and manufacturability in mind

• Drive best practices and process improvements within the test organization

• Ensure test documentation, procedures, and architecture diagrams are maintained

Manufacturing Operations Support

• Ensuring internal manufacturing operations and contract manufacturers are fully supported for deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting of manufacturing test stations

• Supporting rapidly changing production ramps and resolving manufacturing test issues to minimize downtime

• Proposing manufacturing test requirements and workflows for future products

Required Qualifications

• Serial communication protocols

• Networked systems

• Familiarity with modern software development practices:

• Git

• Code reviews

• CI/CD workflows

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer

Working closely with Data, CRM, and CDP teams, you’ll bring strong technical expertise across modern data platforms, with a focus on Snowflake, SQL, Python, and dbt.
