Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines across batch and real-time data architectures.
Develop and optimise data models, transformations, and workflows using SQL, Python, and dbt.
Build and maintain integrations across cloud data platforms, warehouses, and external data sources
Improve database performance, data reliability, and cost efficiency through monitoring and optimisation.
Implement data quality checks, unit tests, and validation processes to maintain data integrity.
Translate customer engagement and CRM data requirements into actionable data models and pipelines that power Braze and other platforms.
Work with customer events, user attributes, identity resolution, and data synchronisation to support personalised customer experiences.
Collaborate with Data, Analytics, CRM, and CDP teams to align technical solutions with client requirements and business goals.
Provide technical leadership, guidance, and best practices to engineers and help drive continuous improvement.
Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, and emerging technologies to improve engineering productivity and data workflows.
Support multiple client engagements, communicate technical recommendations clearly, and adapt to changing priorities.
What Makes You a Great Fit
5+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or a similar technical role, with strong ownership of architecture, implementation, and optimisation.
4+ years of hands-on experience with SQL, data modelling, and ETL/ELT processes.
2+ years of experience using Python to build data applications and transformations.
Practical experience with dbt and modular data transformation.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and modern data integration tools.
Strong understanding of data architecture, pipeline design, database performance, testing, and data quality.
Experience translating business and customer engagement requirements into reliable data solutions.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working in an agency or consulting environment, managing multiple clients and adapting to changing priorities.
A proactive approach to problem-solving, continuous learning, and using AI tools to improve day-to-day productivity.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills (C1 level or equivalent).
Desirable
Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Hightouch, mParticle, or Databricks.
Snowflake SnowPro Advanced: Architect or Data Engineer certification.
Experience with customer data platforms (CDPs), identity resolution, audience activation, and real-time data synchronisation.
Familiarity with Braze, CRM platforms, and customer engagement data models.
Experience with other cloud data warehouses, such as BigQuery or Redshift.
Knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and access controls.
Exposure to AI/ML architectures, cloud-native AI services, or agentic workflows.
Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable
 
A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required
 
A Quick Note on Applications
We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

jobs.title: Senior IT Support Analyst
jobs.description:
We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior IT Support Analyst to join our Boston office. This role is built for a technically well-rounded professional who can own complex, multi-system problems independently, serve as the escalation point for challenging support issues, and apply AI and automation to improve how the team operates and supports end users. You will be the primary IT presence in the Boston office—resolving advanced end-user issues, contributing to infrastructure and cloud initiatives, and actively driving tool improvements and AI integrations alongside the global IT team.

Must be aware of and comply with all aspects of the RxSense Information Security Program and the policies contained therein. Must always understand the importance of maintaining Information Security.

Key Responsibilities

End-User & Office Support

• Serve as the primary on-site IT resource for Boston office staff, delivering prompt, high-quality technical assistance in person and remotely.

• Provide dedicated on-site and remote technical support to executives and office staff, ensuring responsive, and high-quality assistance for time-sensitive needs.

• Manage and own the IT support ticket queue, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with SLA targets; serve as the escalation point for complex and non-standard issues, engaging senior engineers or specialized teams only where scope requires it.

• Provision, configure, and support Windows and macOS endpoints, including laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, and mobile devices.

• Support A/V and conferencing equipment, including video conferencing systems, microphones, and display technology for meetings and presentations.

• Assist with user account management, including password resets, MFA configuration, and access provisioning.

• Manage hardware and software inventory, ensuring accurate and up-to-date asset records.

• Recover and validate assets upon employee separations.

• Assist with physical office equipment moves and workspace setup as needed.

• Administer physical access control systems, including badge provisioning, door reader troubleshooting, and coordination with facilities for access changes.

Cloud & Systems Support

• Support day-to-day administration tasks across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, partnering with the systems engineering team on complex changes.

• Perform day-to-day administration of Windows 365 and Google Workspace.

• Support identity and access management tasks across Okta, Entra ID, and Active Directory, including account lifecycle, group membership, and SSO troubleshooting.

• Write, own, and maintain automation scripts in PowerShell and Python; manage and version all scripts and tools via GitHub.

• Maintain clear and accurate documentation for all systems, configurations, and procedures.

• Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate automation scripting, documentation generation, and workflow improvements across IT operations.

• Conduct deep-dive evaluations of current and prospective IT tools; document findings and present integration and improvement recommendations to the team.

• Develop and deliver internal training sessions and reference materials to improve team proficiency with key platforms and AI-powered capabilities.

Networking & Connectivity

• Support and perform basic configuration of office network hardware including switches, firewalls, and wireless access points; escalate complex network engineering tasks to senior network staff.

• Troubleshoot common connectivity issues across wired LAN, Wi-Fi, and VPN; identify root cause and escalate infrastructure-level problems appropriately.

• Perform cabling, patching, and physical network infrastructure tasks as required.

Compliance & Security

• Ensure compliance with SOC1, SOC2, HIPAA, HITRUST, and ISO 27001 standards in all IT activities.

• Enforce Information Security policies and IT procedures; report suspected policy violations promptly.

• Protect all information in any form and assist with end-user security awareness and training.

• Maintain confidentiality and use sound judgment when handling technical or sensitive matters.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Document all support interactions and resolutions in the IT ticketing system.

• Create and maintain end-user guides, runbooks, and process documentation.

• Apply AI tools to accelerate the creation and maintenance of documentation, runbooks, and self-service knowledge base content; continuously assess output quality and accuracy.

• Identify gaps in process or documentation and take initiative to close them.

• Stay current with technology trends through ongoing training and self-development.

• Contribute actively to team projects and initiatives by sharing technical knowledge, providing hands-on assistance, and helping to raise the collective capability of the IT team.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 3+ years of IT experience centered on end-user support, with hands-on exposure to systems administration and networking.

• Proficient with Windows and macOS operating systems and enterprise endpoint management tools (Intune, JAMF).

• Hands-on experience with Google Workspace, Okta, Windows 365, and Active Directory.

• Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, and GCP for systems administration tasks; foundational understanding of cloud networking concepts (DNS, VPNs, TCP/IP, RBAC, SAML, OIDC) sufficient for troubleshooting and cross-team collaboration.

• Basic familiarity with network hardware (firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points) including routine support tasks such as port configuration, AP troubleshooting, and firmware updates.

• Demonstrated scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Python; ability to independently build, maintain, and document automation solutions for IT administration tasks.

• Hands-on experience using AI productivity and coding tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot) in a professional IT context; comfort applying AI to real workflows, not just experimentation.

• Excellent communication skills with a strong customer-service orientation.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple responsibilities and projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for ticket management, documentation, and internal knowledge management.

• Familiarity with physical access control platforms (e.g., Brivo), including badge provisioning and basic troubleshooting.

Nice to Have

• IT certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, AWS, Cisco, or Azure.

• ITIL certification or familiarity with ITIL practices.

• Experience in regulated industries such as health tech or finance.

• Familiarity with prompt engineering or LLM-powered workflow automation; experience building or integrating AI agents or assistants into IT processes.

• Experience with unified communications or telephony systems.

Work Environment

• Occasional physical tasks such as moving equipment, running cables, or configuring hardware in server/network closets.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. We provide thought leadership for complex issues through independent analysis, and we deliver practical, useful solutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Summary

ANSER is seeking an Exercise Planner (senior or mid-level) to support Headquarters Marine Forces Pacific’s (MARFORPAC’s) role in Joint and Combined training exercises and events in the US Pacific Command (PACOM) Area of Responsibility (AOR) and beyond. You will support Joint Chiefs of Staff, Combatant Command, or Headquarters and Subordinate/Component exercises, engagements and assigned operations.

Day to Day Responsibilities

• Plan and coordinate Field Training Exercises (FTXs), Command Post Exercises (CPXs), Tabletop Exercises (TTX), Senior Leader Seminars (SLS) and training events that prepare tactical, operational, and strategic forces for possible future contingencies.

• Plan exercise operations and logistics using an analysis of exercise objectives and tasks, MARFORPAC unit capabilities, deployment requirements, forward operating location assessments, and resource constraints.

• Support exercise planning across the Joint Event Life Cycle.

• Participate in planning meetings and develop and present plans documentation.

• Assist in observer/controller activities and document lessons learned for after action reporting.

• Support exercise database management and updates via JTIMS and other DOW applications.

• Provide JOPES, DCAPES and TPFDD support as needed.

• Support training plans and program development.

• Support Theater Security Cooperation plans and activities.

Required Qualifications

• Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

• Bachelor’s degree will consider associates degree with an additional three (3) years of practical experience.

• 4+ years of relevant experience within a three or four-star general officer/flag officer level operational or strategic command.

• Experience as a staff-level exercise planner, and experience planning/executing CPXs/FTXs within the PACOM AOR (preferred).

• Possess a working knowledge of the Pacific theater, and an understanding of the relationships and general interactions between each nation within.

• Operational and/or logistical experience in the PACOM AOR and supporting Theater Security Cooperation efforts (preferred).

• Knowledge of the operational and logistical support required for exercises, deployments, and mobilizations and familiar with TPFDD nomenclature.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong interpersonal/social skills; proven staff officer/contractor support excellence.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

· Travel and relocation opportunities across the US

· Push boundaries and deliver cutting-edge technology that is going to change the construction industry forever

· Professional development opportunities



If you'd like to see the products and technology we have created so far on our journey you can view it in action through our YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@XYZReality/videos and Website http://www.xyzreality.com/

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations, Payer Partnerships
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

About the Role

As our Strategy & Operations Lead, Commercial and Payer Partnerships, you’ll work with our Head of Commercial and Payer Partnerships to own that opportunity end-to-end. You’ll build and run our strategy for contracting with regional health plans, prioritizing which plans to target, , communicating Prosper's value proposition, and negotiating agreements. You'll also own key areas of our overall commercial strategy from how we market Prosper to payers to how we think about entering new lines of business. You'll be involved in every step of building out the commercial function for one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare services.

You’ll thrive here if you’re a structured thinker who loves building relationships and wants to own outcomes, and is excited to help build new processes not just manage processes that someone else designed. You likely bring a mix of consulting and healthcare services experience, and you’re excited to apply that toolkit to expand access to care and drive better healthcare outcomes.

Success in this role means:

• Prosper is in-network with a growing set of regional and state health plans, opening care to millions more members

• Prosper is building deeper and more strategic relationships with health plans that drive greater value for both sides

• Payers know who Prosper is and why our care model matters for their members

• Our commercial engine is becoming more scalable, with processes that efficiently support go-to-market and partner success as Prosper scales to 50 states:

Key Responsibilities

• Win new payer contracts. Build and execute our strategy for regional health plans. Prioritize targets by size of opportunity, partner with Prosper leadership to identify contracts, run outreach, lead partnership discussions and negotiate agreements at competitive rates.

• Strengthen our value proposition. Work with our clinical and clinical operations teams to execute and build on our clinical quality strategy Build payer awareness. Work with Prosper leadership to identify efficient high-ROI strategies for raising awareness, including by borrowing best practices from peer companies

• Deepen existing partnerships. Stand up a lightweight partner success model (reporting, regular check-ins, joint operating committees) and help scale across partners

• Make new payers work operationally. Partner with Product and Operations to build processes for seamlessly launching new payer partnerships

• Scope what’s next. Evaluate new growth channels, such as Medicaid and direct-to-employer, as Prosper expands

About You

• 3–6 years of experience, ideally a mix of management consulting and a healthcare services or health tech company. Partner-facing experience (BD, partnerships, partner success or growth) is a plus. Payer experience is helpful but not required.

• Extreme ownership. You build your own plans, set your own deadlines and follow up without reminders. You measure yourself on contracts signed, not activity.

• First-principles thinker. You break problems into the parts that matter, use data and clear reasoning to prioritize, and don’t copy a playbook just because it worked elsewhere.

• Resilient and resourceful. You use ingenuity, scrappiness and persistence to get deals done, even when payer timelines are slow and the first answer is no.

• Executive presence. You can run a call alone with a VP-level payer stakeholder and build trust quickly.

• Highly organized. You build systems to manage and prioritize many workstreams and relationships at once, without anything falling through the cracks.

• Healthcare services fluency. You understand, or are eager to learn quickly, how payers work, including what drives both the organization and the individual teams you work with.

More about Prosper Health

• Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.

• We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.

• Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.

• Here are a few of our favorite operating principles: Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side. Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less. Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher. Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer - Space
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Design Engineer in the Mission Engineering team, you will primarily own hardware associated with nuclear power systems in space and on the surface of the Moon and Mars. As the Responsible Engineer (RE) on space with the expectation of taking hardware from clean sheet design to build, dev test, qualification, and integration. You will be responsible for the entire life cycle of your hardware and system, interfaces to and from other systems, how your hardware fits into the larger system, sourcing, building, testing, and designing improvements for a first of a kind system. You’ll drive trades on system layout, interfaces, packaging, working closely with cross-disciplinary teams to refine configurations and close design loops. Your responsibilities will span CAD design, system analysis, leading design reviews, precise definition of thermal and mechanical interfaces, requirements ownership and decomposition, and manufacturability / scalability of your design.



Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Own a subsystem and related hardware as part of the larger space nuclear system.

 - Drive system-level layout, requirements definition/decomposition, build/test cycles, defend decisions across all phases of design, take concept through CDR and onward.

 - Own CAD models, manage configurations, produce drawings, DFMEA, etc.

 - Drive cross-discipline alignment and trade studies.

 - Coordinate closely with other teams/people (nuclear, thermal, structures, manufacturing, quality) to ensure a system architecture that satisfies mission/product requirements.

 - Develop a clean sheet design through hardware procurement and dev/qual testing.

 - Support design reviews and integration/test planning for hardware, define manufacturing plan and generate work instructions as needed.



Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related physics-based field.

 - 5+ years of experience in space system/product mechanical design, system configuration and layout.

 - Expertise with CAD (e.g., NX, CATIA) and past experience with PLM and other manufacturing planning and management systems.



Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - Master’s or PhD in mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related physics-based field.

 - Expertise in the design, analysis, and integration of nuclear or space nuclear systems.

 - Leadership experience on a project or research team.

 - Strong project management skills, cross discipline communication, and interpersonal and collaborative skills.

 - Exceptional communication skills to work effectively across teams and convey technical information to non-specialists.

 - Understanding of fundamental principles in fluid systems and solid mechanics.

 - Demonstrated track record of initiative and high impact / ROI contributions.

 - Broad knowledge of materials science and material selections, especially for nuclear applications.

 - Ability to conduct complex design trades, system sizing, and first-order engineering analyses while clearly identifying analysis limitations and associated design risks.

 - Very strong design skills and GD&T/ drawings experience; take a design into production.



Additional Requirements:

 - Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones

 - Willingness and ability to obtain and retain a security clearance



Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.





Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer I/II - Space
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Role

As a Level I or Level II Mechanical Design Engineer in the Mission Engineering team, you will support hardware design and development associated with nuclear power systems in space and on the surface of the Moon and Mars. As an engineer on the space team, you will be expected to support team members, own development tests, and component design. You will be responsible for your product or deliverable, interfaces to and from other systems, how your hardware fits into the larger system, sourcing, building, testing, and designing improvements for a first of a kind system. You’ll support trades on system layout, interfaces, packaging, working closely with cross-disciplinary teams to refine configurations and close design loops. Your responsibilities will span CAD design, system analysis, design reviews, precise definition of thermal and mechanical interfaces, requirements ownership and decomposition, and manufacturability / scalability of your design.

 
Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Own hardware or deliverable related hardware as part of the larger space nuclear system.

 - Drive requirements definition/decomposition, build/test cycles, defend decisions across all phases of design, take concept through CDR and onward.

 - Own CAD models, manage configurations, produce drawings, DFMEA, etc.

 - Support development testing, test setup, test definition, test documentation.

 - Coordinate closely with other teams/people (nuclear, thermal, structures, manufacturing, quality) to ensure a system architecture that satisfies mission/product requirements.

 - Develop a clean sheet design through hardware procurement and dev/qual testing.

 - Support design reviews and integration/test planning for hardware, define manufacturing plan and generate work instructions as needed.

 - Own or support the design of tooling/ ground support equipment and facility upgrades

 - Develop and document emerging processes.



Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related physics-based field.

 - 1-3+ years of experience in space system/product mechanical design, system configuration and layout.

 - Expertise with CAD (e.g., NX, CATIA) and past experience with PLM and other manufacturing planning and management systems.



Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - Master’s or PhD in mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related physics-based field.

 - Experience in the design, analysis, and integration of space hardware.

 - Leadership experience on a project or research team.

 - Strong project management skills, cross discipline communication, and interpersonal and collaborative skills.

 - Exceptional communication skills to work effectively across teams and convey technical information to non-specialists.

 - Understanding of fundamentals in fluid systems, solid mechanics, and heat transfer.

 - Demonstrated track record of initiative and going the extra mile.

 - Knowledge of materials science, material selection, and material compatibility.

 - Ability to conduct system sizing and first-order engineering analyses

 - Mechanical design and GD&T/ drawings experience; take a design into production.



Additional Requirements:

 - Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones

 - Ability to travel to customer and mission-relevant locations as needed.

 - Ability to obtain a Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance is preferred.

Salary Range: 

Mechanical Design Engineer I - $90,000 - $105,000

Mechanical Design Engineer II - $115,000 - $150,000

Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Global Medical Affairs Therapeutic Area Head, Rare Disease
jobs.description:
Kyowa Kirin is a global specialty pharmaceutical company backed by more than 70 years of breakthrough life science innovation, dedicated to discovering and advancing treatments for diseases in which unmet need is greatest. Based in Japan with worldwide operations, we work across the continuum from drug discovery to commercialization, guided by our commitment to patients and their families.

Our research teams, located in California and around the world, are focused on developing the next generation of antibody, cell, and gene therapies, with particular emphasis on bone and mineral disorders, hemato-oncology, and rare diseases. We accelerate development through collaborations with industry, academia, patients, and healthcare providers, and since 2018 we have introduced four new therapies serving patients with progressive illnesses often in need of new therapeutic alternatives.

Our culture is grounded in our values: Commitment to Life, Integrity, Innovation, and Teamwork/Wa, and brought to life through the Kabegoe Principles, which define the behaviors and actions that guide how we work together to deliver meaningful impact for patients.

We’re proud of the progress we’ve made and mindful of the countless individuals still waiting for their own breakthroughs. A commitment to making people smile unites our efforts. Learn more at www.kkna.kyowakirin.com.

Summary of Job:

The Global Medical Affairs Therapeutic Area Head, Rare Disease, provides strategic scientific and medical leadership for the Rare Disease portfolio within Kyowa Kirin. Reporting to the Global Head of Medical Affairs, the position is a member of the Global Medical Affairs Leadership Team and is accountable for the development and execution of global Medical Affairs strategies and plans across the therapeutic area.

This role is accountable for leading the development and delivery of the Rare Disease Global Medical Affairs Strategic Plans, including evidence generation, scientific communications, publications, external partnerships, and launch readiness, while ensuring alignment with business and franchise priorities. Success requires close collaboration across Franchise, Regional Medical, HEOR, Patient Advocacy, Market Access, Commercial, Legal and Compliance, and Regulatory Affairs, R&D functions to support integrated execution of Medical Affairs strategies.

Strategic medical input is provided to clinical development and regulatory strategies in Rare Disease, incorporating patient, physician, and payer perspectives and supporting health technology assessment (HTA) and payer strategies. The position also provides medical and scientific expertise to Business Development, Regional Medical, and Regional Business teams in the evaluation and prioritization of potential assets, including due diligence and portfolio decisions, and supports the successful execution of partnering activities.

Essential Functions:

Strategic Leadership and Medical Expertise

• Provide comprehensive subject matter expertise, scientific, medical and technical knowledge of products and disease area landscapes for marketed and development portfolio within Rare Disease Therapy Area.

• Significant contributor to Integrated Asset Plans and Integrated Evidence Generation Plans

• Develop and execute the Global Medical Affairs Strategy for the Rare Disease Therapy Area (TA) portfolio, in alignment with business and franchise priorities, and the Integrated Asset Plan

• Ensure consistency of medical affairs strategy and execution between regions (NA/EMEA/JAPAC), incorporating regional insights and supporting regional medical needs within the global medical strategy.

• Lead the development of medical communication platforms and scientific narratives for Rare Disease products across the lifecycle

• Partner with Global Development Organization to provide medical and strategic input into clinical development programs, including study design, protocol development and interpretation of results

• Provide medical and scientific input for the development of Life Cycle Management strategies

• Collaborate with the Franchise and commercial teams providing medical input into the Target Product Profile (TPP) of portfolio compounds and into Brand Plans

• Support payer/market access strategy with HEOR and Market Access colleagues.

• Conduct timely medical assessments for business development due diligence activities, as a medical and scientific expert, in partnership with the North American Medical Affairs head and North American business teams and global cross-functional teams

• Establish and chair regular global-regional medical affairs meetings and participate in Franchise and other cross-functional meetings

• Support the Global Research organization as requested with medical insights and expertise

• Participate in cross-functional leadership teams and governance committees

• Review and approve applicable medical, commercial, regulatory, quality and pharmacovigilance documents

Evidence Generation

• Develop and deliver global integrated evidence generation plans and evidence dissemination plans including specific needs for Phase 4/post-registration studies including HEOR and Real-World Evidence (claims databases, registries etc.).

• Oversee approval process and support for unsolicited investigator sponsored trial proposals

• Develop and implement post-marketing studies and/or registries, as needed in collaboration with HEOR/RWE

• Lead the development of publication strategies and medical communications plans

• Develop and implement pre-authorization Early Access Programs, as approved by enterprise governance bodies

External Engagement

• Establish and maintain strong relationships with key external experts, healthcare professionals, professional societies and patient advocacy groups

• Serve as a key medical expert and thought leader, representing Kyowa Kirin at scientific conferences, advisory boards and key stakeholder meetings

• Drive scientific exchange programs and medical education initiatives

• Collaborate with external research partners and academic institutions

Team Leadership and Development

• Build, mentor and lead a high-performing global-regional medical affairs team, in accordance with the principles of high-performing teams

• Ensure alignment in execution of medical affairs activities through Medical Directors, Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), Medical Information, Medical Communications and HEOR teams within Rare Disease

• Ensure that medical personnel at global, regional and local levels are properly trained, equipped and aligned with consistent scientific and medical messages and tools

• Foster a culture of scientific excellence and continuous learning

• Manage budget and resources effectively

jobs.title: Director of IT & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks.

As Director of IT & Infrastructure, you’ll lead the team, systems, and infrastructure that keep our employees connected and our operations moving. Your scope will span global IT support, enterprise applications, identity and access, corporate networks, and the setup of facilities for new transit service launches.

This role combines excellent people leadership with hands-on technical expertise. Balancing an entrepreneurial spirit with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, you will serve as a key stakeholder in building the reliable services our teams and partners depend on. From improving employee support through automation and AI to getting a new operational site ready for launch, you’ll turn complex requirements into well-run systems and repeatable processes.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead our global IT team. Develop and support the team, establish clear ownership and service expectations, and translate business priorities into an actionable IT roadmap. Balance daily operations with infrastructure improvements and longer-term projects.

• Own the employee IT experience. Oversee support across offices, remote teams, and operational sites. Lead the administration and continuous improvement of Freshservice, including ticketing, the service catalog, approvals, inventory, knowledge management, and automated workflows.

• Manage identity and access. Oversee Okta, SSO, application provisioning, and employee onboarding, transfers, and offboarding. Maintain reliable access approval and provisioning workflows between Freshservice, Okta, and connected applications.

• Run dependable infrastructure. Oversee corporate networks, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, remote access, and IT-managed infrastructure. Use platforms such as Cisco Meraki to monitor sites, address outages, and improve reliability. Manage relevant DNS, domain, and certificate requirements, including work with Cloudflare, AWS, GCP.

• Deliver Network TaaS launch readiness. Own facility setup and IT readiness for new launches, from sourcing telecommunications providers and infrastructure contractors to overseeing onsite installations, security cameras, and physical access control systems. Ensure access to company applications reflects each launch’s staffing and operational requirements.

• Manage the endpoint and asset lifecycle. Establish hardware standards and oversee device deployment, management, support, inventory, purchasing, logistics, replacement, and secure disposal for a

• Keep enterprise applications working together. Oversee platforms including Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, and Confluence, Freshservice, Iru and more, and partner with business owners on departmental systems. Lead implementations, migrations, and consolidation projects with clear support and administrative ownership.

• Build better workflows through automation and AI. Expand integrations across Freshservice, Okta, Slack, Confluence, and other services. Develop and maintain bots and AI agents that answer employee questions, use company knowledge, and handle service requests, with appropriate monitoring and controls.

• Support practical AI adoption. Manage the rollout and administration of tools such as Claude and Cursor, including employee access, licensing, usage allocations, spending visibility, and support.

• Manage technology spending and suppliers. Own IT budget planning and tracking, vendor relationships, commercial negotiations, renewals, and license optimization. Lead technical assessments within ZIP procurement workflows alongside Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Information Security.

• Strengthen security and operational continuity. Partner with Information Security to implement controls across IT-managed systems, support audits and access reviews, and address control gaps. Maintain recovery procedures, system documentation, and backup ownership for critical services.

Who You Are:

• An experienced IT leader with 10+ years in corporate IT or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing teams, ideally in a global technology company.

• A hands-on technical leader who can move comfortably between coaching a team, planning a deployment, troubleshooting an integration, and managing a vendor escalation.

• Experienced in identity and access management, SaaS administration, endpoint management, networking, and IT service delivery. Familiarity with Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco Meraki, and Freshservice, or comparable platforms, will help you succeed.

• Comfortable delivering technology infrastructure for new offices or operational sites, including coordinating connectivity providers, contractors, and installation schedules.

• Skilled at improving processes through APIs, integrations, and automation, with practical experience applying AI to internal support or employee workflows.

• Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, negotiating with suppliers, and improving software and hardware spending.

• A clear communicator who builds strong working relationships across Operations, Engineering, Information Security, People, Finance, and other business teams.

• Organized, resourceful, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-moving environment. You follow problems through to resolution and build processes that help prevent them from recurring.

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Head of People
jobs.description:
ABOUT LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

 At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation https://www.linkedin.com/company/intel-corporation/, Canva https://www.linkedin.com/company/canva/, the United States Department of Defense https://www.linkedin.com/company/deptofdefense/, the United States Air Force https://www.linkedin.com/company/united-states-air-force/, ASICS https://www.linkedin.com/company/asics/, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.




THE PEOPLE TEAM AT LILT

LILT’s people team has the dual mandate of cultivating and sustaining a workplace that is both healthy and high-performance. By high-performance we mean courageous, committed, and capable leaders and a talent strategy that constantly increases density. By healthy we mean that Liltonians feel challenged, stimulated, and rewarded for setting and achieving the most ambitious goals of their career.




WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This position is based in our SF Bay Area office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Boston and Indianapolis are also acceptable locations. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

 - SF Bay Area (highly preferred)

 - Others: Boston, New York, Indianapolis




ABOUT THE ROLE

With blue-chip enterprise customers and a robust pipeline of both AI and modern software innovation, LILT seeks a courageous and strategic People leader. You will report to the CEO and be a member of the Exec Ops Team.

You spike in recruiting / talent and know what good looks like in operations, compliance, and employee relations. You will be curating and developer a group of builder-coaches who build and manage AI systems.





DESIRED EXPERIENCE

 - Autodidact for markets: Our market is at the intersection of enterprise AI, AI data, and human operations. This requires highly specialized personnel that you’re able to recruit,  evaluate, and develop.

 - Proven growth-stage tech experience: This won’t be your first startup with the growth expectations of Tier 1 investors. Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business goals into actionable people strategies.

 - International leadership: 50% of our workforce is in Europe, and we have contractors in LATAM and APAC. Developing cohesive teams across very different work cultures isn’t new for you.

 - (highly preferred) Evaluating and integrating teams via acquihires and/or small acquisitions.




SKILLS

 - Talent / recruiting genius: your zone of genius is recruiting and developing niche talent. Our business requires a unique blend of operating rigor, extreme quality control, and flexibility.

 - Builder and hands-on operator: strategy is only half the job. You'll be building and running the People function with your own hands — writing the policies, driving the review cycle, and solving the day-to-day issues directly, not just setting direction for a team to execute. You're energized by doing the work, not only shaping it.

 - Strategic communicator: you know how to own and shape the narrative through the layers of leadership and down to ICs. Your written and oral communications would impress the head of PR!




KNOWLEDGE

 - Operator mindset: you know all of the roles/processes/tools in the People function and what good looks like for each.

 - Excited about in-office: we’re in-office three days a week. You’re stoked about this and have lots of ideas for building an energetic, generative in-office experience.

 - Managing workplace health and flourishing as a product: you can articulate a plan for iterating on and improving the workplace health and vitality so that we’re the most compelling place to work in our market.
   
   


QUALITIES

 - Find a way or make one: Our core virtue. You own it and solve it; nothing is somebody else's problem; you don't wait for a playbook — you build one. This is the single trait most predictive of success at LILT.

 - Uncompromising Integrity: congruence among your values, actions, and words, and you expect this from everyone around you.

 - Relationship builder: relational orientation to building trust across both the executive leadership team and with the broader team.

 - Truthseeking: demands candid truths vs. kind lies.

 - High Agency / Relentless: you can get in the mud, resolve the messy problems, and by doing so you become a trusted confidant of both executives and employees.

 - Competitive: you know that high performance begets high performance, and your whole strategy and vision are oriented around cultivating high performance and human flourishing.

 - High Business IQ: you work backward from a thorough understanding of the business and its goals to the People strategy.




EDUCATION

 - Minimum of a BA / BS.




OUR STORY

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate.  As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.



LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.



With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.




OUR TECH

What sets our platform apart:

 - Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

 - Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

 - 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

 - Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review



LILT IN THE NEWS

 - Featured in The Software Report’s https://www.thesoftwarereport.com/the-top-100-software-companies-of-2024/ Top 100 Software Companies!

 - LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List https://labs.lilt.com/lilt-listed-on-the-2024-inc-5000.

 - LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents https://patents.justia.com/inventor/john-sturdy-denero that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

 - Check out all our news on our website https://lilt.com/news.





Information collected and processed as part of your application process, including any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to LILT's Privacy Policy at https://lilt.com/legal/privacy.



At LILT, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent hiring process. As part of our recruitment efforts, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) and automated tools to assist in the evaluation of applications, including résumé screening, assessment scoring, and interview analysis. These tools are designed to support human decision-making and help us identify qualified candidates efficiently and objectively. All final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have any concerns, require accommodations, or would like to opt-out of the use of AI in our hiring process, please let us know at recruiting@lilt.com.

jobs.title: Sr. SLAM Engineer
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The GeoAI team is seeking a Senior SLAM Engineer to build fleet-scale mapping and localization technologies that power next-generation navigation, ADAS, and autonomous driving systems. This role focuses on robust SLAM, multi-route mapping, localization, sensor fusion, and map maintenance using fleet-collected camera, LiDAR, GNSS, IMU, and vehicle telemetry data.

You will play a key role in transforming large-scale fleet data into continuously improving localization maps, road graphs, and high-definition map assets used across GeoAI, Navigation, and ADAS products.

Role:

SLAM and Localization:

• Design and develop visual SLAM, LiDAR SLAM, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), multi-sensor localization, multi-session SLAM, and multi-route SLAM systems.

• Develop robust localization solutions using cameras, LiDAR, GNSS/RTK, IMU, vehicle odometry, and HD maps.

• Build loop-closure, relocalization, place-recognition, and drift-correction capabilities for long-term localization performance.

• Improve localization accuracy and availability in urban canyons, tunnels, parking structures, construction zones, and GNSS-denied environments.

Fleet-Scale Multi-Route SLAM

• Develop algorithms that jointly optimize trajectories and observations collected across repeated routes, multiple vehicles, and large geographic areas.

• Build scalable pose graph and bundle adjustment systems for globally consistent maps.

• Design place-recognition and loop-closure systems that match observations across different vehicles, lighting, seasons, weather, and roadway changes.

• Develop multi-session map fusion and collaborative mapping solutions that combine repeated drives into a unified spatial representation.

• Improve localization repeatability through long-term landmark management, route alignment, and historical fleet observations.

Map Generation & Continuous Maintenance

• Build scalable pipelines for localization map generation, HD map generation, lane-level mapping, road graph creation, and map quality validation.

• Develop map change detection, incremental update, versioning, and rollback capabilities for continuously evolving road environments.

• Create automated processes for landmark lifecycle management, fleet data aggregation, map freshness monitoring, and conflicting-observation resolution.

• Build systems that safely incorporate qualified fleet observations into production map layers while preserving traceability and map consistency.

• Define validation gates and quality metrics for map accuracy, coverage, freshness, reliability, and localization performance.

Sensor Fusion & Calibration

• Develop camera-LiDAR-GNSS-IMU fusion frameworks for localization, trajectory estimation, and map building.

• Improve temporal synchronization, coordinate-frame management, calibration robustness, and calibration monitoring at fleet scale.

• Develop localization confidence, integrity, and uncertainty metrics suitable for production ADAS applications.

• Support sensor integration and localization performance across multiple vehicle platforms and hardware configurations.

Production Deployment

• Optimize SLAM, localization, and map optimization algorithms for large-scale cloud processing and vehicle deployment.

• Build reliable distributed pipelines for processing large camera, LiDAR, GNSS, IMU, and vehicle-motion datasets.

• Develop benchmarking, regression testing, visualization, debugging, and map QA tools.

• Collaborate with Navigation, Perception, Vehicle Integration, Data Platform, and GeoAI teams to deliver production-ready mapping and localization systems.

Qualifications:

• MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Vision, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in SLAM, localization, mapping, robotics, or autonomous systems.

• Strong software engineering skills in C++ and Python.

• Deep understanding of visual SLAM, LiDAR SLAM, VIO, state estimation, sensor fusion, factor graphs, bundle adjustment, pose graph optimization, loop closure, place recognition, and multi-view geometry.

• Hands-on experience with relevant libraries and frameworks such as GTSAM, Ceres Solver, OpenCV, Eigen, and ROS/ROS2.

• Experience profiling, debugging, validating, and deploying complex robotics algorithms in production-oriented environments.

Qualifications:

• Experience building fleet-scale mapping and localization systems for autonomous driving, robotics, mobile mapping, or geospatial applications.

• Experience with multi-session SLAM, multi-route SLAM, collaborative mapping, global pose graph optimization, and large-scale bundle adjustment.

• Experience with HD maps, localization maps, map change detection, map updates, map versioning, and long-term landmark management.

• Experience processing large-scale camera, LiDAR, GNSS, IMU, and vehicle telemetry datasets using distributed infrastructure.

• Experience with production localization integrity, map quality evaluation, calibration monitoring, and system-level performance analysis.

• Publications, patents, or significant technical contributions in SLAM, localization, robotics, computer vision, or mapping systems are a plus.

What You'll Help Build

Capability

Impact

Fleet-Scale Multi-Route SLAM

Joint trajectory and map optimization across repeated drives and vehicles.

Production Localization Stack

Camera-LiDAR-GNSS-IMU localization for challenging road environments.

Collaborative Map Fusion

Unified maps built from multi-session, multi-vehicle observations.

Map Generation Pipelines

Localization maps, HD maps, lane geometry, road graphs, and landmarks.

Continuous Map Maintenance

Change detection, incremental updates, versioning, freshness, and validation.

Mapping Quality Platform

Accuracy, coverage, integrity, reliability, and regression monitoring.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on SLAM engineer with deep expertise in localization, mapping, estimation, optimization, and sensor fusion. You are excited about solving large-scale geospatial challenges and building fleet-scale multi-route SLAM systems that continuously improve map quality and localization performance across an entire vehicle fleet.

• Monitor metrics including, but not limited to: equipment utilization; underperforming assets; warranty recovery; billed mechanical hours; aged receivables and customer satisfaction.

• Conduct weekly safety meetings with all location employees.

• Ensure all branch employees have been properly trained on all equipment. Conduct and orchestrate all required training. Manage all records of completion.

• Assisting the General Manager in maintaining a safe and healthy work environment by establishing, following and enforcing standards and procedures while complying with legal regulations.

That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Physical Requirements:

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
CURIOUS HOW AI COULD RESHAPE THE WAY ACCOUNTING TEAMS WORK — AND WANT TO BE THE ONE WHO BUILDS IT?



Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for an Accounting Manager to be part of our Finance department.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn't like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That's why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we've come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we've just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.



The team:

The Finance team at Jobber is responsible for anything money-related, helping us plan, budget, and implement Jobber's best ideas.



The role:

Reporting to the Manager, Accounting, the Accounting Manager will drive the accounting projects that make the rest of the function better. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, working in focused sprints — you sit outside the day-to-day general ledger close, but you understand it deeply enough to improve it. You're known for your curiosity, your bias to action, and your ability to turn an ambiguous question into a documented, defensible answer.



The Accounting Manager will:

 - Own technical accounting expertise, serving as the go-to resource for new or complex transactions — think revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), stock compensation (ASC 718), business combinations, and capitalized software.

 - Lead our controls mapping work, connecting risks to controls, documenting how our processes run, and identifying gaps — building the internal control framework that lets us scale with confidence.

 - Bring a strong working knowledge of the month-end and year-end close, without owning it, so you can map controls and redesign processes with a real understanding of how they run.

 - Collaborate across Finance and other departments to deliver projects with cross-functional impact, and act as a resource for our Finance-owned tools.

 - Reimagine our accounting processes with AI, redesigning workflows around what Company-approved AI and automation tools make possible — building processes that are faster and better controlled, while applying professional judgement and human review to every output.



To be successful, you should have:

 - Your CPA designation, with strong knowledge of US GAAP; SEC reporting experience is strongly preferred.

 - Significant accounting experience, including time in public practice, with a track record of technical accounting research and documentation of process and controls.

 - Strong analytical skills, with the judgement to make decisions based on accurate, timely analysis.

 - Solid project management instincts — the ability to scope ambiguous work, sequence it, and drive it to the finish line on your own.

 - Coachability and adaptability, with the flexibility to thrive amid change and experimentation in a growing organization.

 - A genuine team player who collaborates widely, champions best practices, and rolls up their sleeves when it's all hands on deck.

 - Experience working with a SaaS company is an asset.

 - Previous IPO, S-1/F-1, or public company experience is a big plus.

 - Experience using NetSuite is a plus.



Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $98,300, a midpoint of $115,700, and a maximum salary of $133,100, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

jobs.title: Growth Strategy & Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

About the Role

As our Growth Strategy & Operations Lead, you'll take on Prosper's biggest growth opportunities and turn them into results, from launching new channels to solving the highest-leverage problems across marketing. You'll own each project end-to-end: strategy, creative needs, media buying, and analytics. That could mean launching major new channels like TikTok, building the system that drives our brand voice across social media platforms, or setting our AI search strategy. Ultimately, it means owning whatever our next big Growth bet is. You'll report directly to our Head of Growth Marketing, close to every major growth decision.

Prosper's work sits inside a much bigger shift. More adults are coming to understand themselves through the lens of autism and neurodivergence, and much of that is happening on social media. It's where people find the words for their experience, find each other, and decide whether to seek care. We're building the defining brand in neurodivergence, and you'll shape how it shows up where it matters most to our clients.

This role is built to grow with you. If a channel you build takes off and you love it, you can become its full-time owner. If you'd rather keep building, you become the person we hand our next big bet to. Either way, it's a fast track to strategic leadership in Growth as Prosper scales.

You'll thrive here if you're bursting with creative ideas but still an extremely structured thinker. You want to own outcomes from strategy through scrappy execution and scale, and you're chronically online and plugged into pop culture. You likely bring a mix of consulting or investment banking and high-growth startup experience, and you're excited to pair that toolkit with creative instinct, cultural fluency, and a lot of hands-on building.

Success in this role means:

• Prosper can rely on multiple channels for repeatable, scalable growth as we continue to build on the more than 3x growth we've had in the last year

• Prosper is the most trusted and most-loved voice in neurodivergence online: a brand with a real personality that people look forward to seeing in their feed and share with their friends

• Every project you take on has clear metrics, a clear owner (you), and measurable results

• The team moves faster and more effectively because of the systems and tools you build

Key Responsibilities

• Take new channels from zero to one. Find, launch, and scale Prosper's next biggest growth channels. Define the strategy and success metrics, buy media, run the tests that tell us whether a channel can scale and how, and work with our creative team to source creators and brief and make creative.

• Own our biggest growth bets. Lead the highest-leverage projects across marketing, wherever they sit: a new channel, a stuck step in the funnel, or an emerging opportunity no one owns yet. You'll scope the problem, build the plan, and drive it to results.

• Define what good looks like, then make it happen. New channels and projects don't come with an obvious scorecard, and you'll be the one who brings clarity to the ambiguity. You'll decide which metrics matter, set targets, and build the tracking to measure them. You'll design and run incrementality tests to understand what each bet truly adds, and make the call on when we should hold a channel or project to clear, direct measurement versus invest in it as longer-term brand building.

• Run a high-velocity testing engine. Turn ideas into hypotheses, launch and ship fast, read the results, and iterate until it works.

• Write the next playbook. As your projects take off, the path is yours to shape. Scale a channel you built into one you own outright, or become the person we hand each new frontier to, where no one has written the playbook yet.

About You

• 4–5 years in a combination of management consulting/investment banking and a high-growth startup. You've touched consumer-facing work before, through a job, a client engagement, or your own projects, and loved it.

• Extreme ownership. You take 100% responsibility for the business outcomes of your projects and drive them from 0-to-1 with minimal support. When something's off track, you're the first to flag it and to fix it.

• First-principles thinker. You work backward from the outcome, break it into what matters most, and iterate your way there. You bring clarity to ambiguity, including deciding what to measure when success isn't obvious.

• Highly analytical. You're fluent in Excel/Google Sheets, comfortable breaking down CAC drivers and spotting performance patterns, and you see numbers in context, never as isolated data points. You can set up tests that drive real data-driven learnings.

• Creative and culturally fluent. You can look at an ad or a post on social media and explain who it's for, what it's trying to do, and why it worked or didn't. You're energized by generating new creative concepts and angles. You have a native feel for social media platforms: what fits, what feels forced, and where trends are heading. And yes, you're on TikTok a little too often.

• You find a way. Whatever it takes to get a channel to succeed: making creative, finding creators, buying ads yourself. When you don't know how to do something, you figure it out. You treat every miss as valuable learning and keep iterating.

• Clients first. You understand how our clients and potential clients use social media to make sense of themselves, find community, and make decisions, and you come up with content that meets them there. You know where the line is: you'll pass on a trend that would get reach but trivialize what our clients go through, but you know when to lean into a joke or be silly. You seek out and amplify neurodivergent voices.

• Mission-driven. You're excited to help build the defining brand in a category that actually matters: making life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

More about Prosper Health

• Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.

• We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.

• Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.

• Here are a few of our favorite operating principles: Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side. Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less. Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher. Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.
