jobs.title: Staff Product Manager (Marketplace)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRABA



Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain.



We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships.



But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale.



We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.




THE ROLE



The product is the labor itself: the workers we match and deploy into warehouses and manufacturing facilities across the country (and eventually, the world). Every product decision impacts supply, demand, fulfillment, customer outcomes, and marketplace health.



We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to own and evolve our staffing product that sits at the center of Traba’s marketplace. You'll own the staffing product at the center of Traba's marketplace, working across both sides: the enterprise customers who run distribution centers and manufacturing lines, and the workers whose trust and reliability are what those customers are actually buying.



In addition to collaborating with software engineers, product designers, data analysts, and other product managers on the team, you’ll also work closely with our operations and field teams to design, build, and ship practical solutions into industrial facilities.

This role reports directly to our VP of Product.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Architect and steward our product strategy across critical staffing and marketplace workflows

 - Solve complex marketplace problems by balancing customer needs, operational realities, and business outcomes

 - Write detailed product requirements and partner closely with engineering teams to execute solutions

 - Build systems that improve marketplace liquidity, fulfillment, matching quality, and operational efficiency

 - Use data to uncover hidden patterns and answer critical marketplace and customer questions

 - Translate operational complexity into scalable product systems

 - Scale operations by designing smart internal tooling and technical solutions

 - Launch and iterate products across customers, regions, and operational environments

 - Visualize and communicate complex ideas from systems and workflows to operational models and product strategy

 - Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Customer-obsessed. Product judgment is downstream of customer truth, and you act like it. You spend time on-site with the people using your product, on both sides of the marketplace. When the team debates a decision, you're the one who's already talked to three customers and two workers about it.

AI-native operator. You've changed how you work because of AI, not just added it to your stack. You prototype before writing a spec. You check in code to the production repo. You build internal agents to do research and analysis that used to take days. This shows up in how you operate, not how you describe yourself.

Marketplace operator. You have deep experience building products in two-sided marketplaces where supply and demand dynamics are real and operational complexity matters. You understand marketplace liquidity, matching systems, incentives, fulfillment, trust, and the tradeoffs required to maintain marketplace health at scale.

Enterprise B2B muscle. You have built products for complex customers with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and operational rollout challenges. You are comfortable navigating environments with regional operators, warehouse leadership, procurement processes, and layered customer organizations.

First-principles thinker. You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks.

Operations systems builder. You have built operational products or internal tools that powered real businesses. You understand workflows deeply and know how to create leverage through systems that help teams operate more efficiently.

Builder mentality. Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process.

Deeply collaborative. You work seamlessly across product, design, engineering, data, operations, sales, customer teams, and leadership. You know how to align stakeholders and build trust across functions.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING



 - 7 - 10 years of experience as a Product Manager

 - Evidence of shipping products that materially moved business outcomes

 - Strong experience in two-sided marketplaces with real supply and demand dynamics

 - Experience building enterprise products with multi-stakeholder customers and complex operational environments

 - Experience building internal operational tooling or systems that supported real business execution

 - Strong technical fluency and ability to work deeply with engineering teams

 - Experience operating in startup environments where speed and ownership matter

 - Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area

 - A strong work ethic and desire to build a category-defining company

 


BENEFITS



 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 💰 Competitive Salary

 - 🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

 - 🍽️ Dinner Provided via Grubhub & stocked kitchen for NY employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🎤 Team building events

 - 🏋🏽 Gympass Benefit

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health

 


SALARY RANGE DETAILS



The compensation range for this position is set between $210,000 – $250,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long-term success and upside of the business.

 

The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high-performing team in a fast-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real-time decision-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem-solving that drives meaningful impact.





EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER



Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets.

 


OUR VALUES



Dream Big - We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Olympian’s Work Ethic - Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

Growth Mindset - We confront the toughest challenges head-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience.

jobs.title: Battery Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Battery Modeling Engineer, you’ll build the data and degradation models that tell us how our batteries age in the real world. You’ll combine software engineering, data science, and semi-empirical degradation modeling, turning telemetry from our fleet of deployed home batteries and data from cell-level testing into trusted datasets and models that predict capacity fade, resistance growth, and remaining useful life across the conditions our batteries actually see.

This is a hybrid role at the intersection of software, data science, and battery science. You’ll own degradation analytics end to end, from the pipelines and data models that make fleet and lab data trustworthy to the semi-empirical models and tools the rest of Base relies on, and you’ll help found and set up Base’s cell characterization lab. Your work will directly shape how we operate our fleet and plan for its long-term performance.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and validate semi-empirical degradation models (calendar and cycle aging, capacity fade, resistance growth) for the cells in our fleet.

 - Help found and set up Base’s cell characterization lab: define test plans, select equipment, and stand up the processes that generate reliable aging data.

 - Analyze fleet- and device-level data to understand how temperature, state of charge, and usage patterns drive degradation, and validate model predictions against real-world behavior.

 - Turn model outputs into tools and insights that engineering, fleet, and markets teams use to decide how our batteries are operated.

 - Write production-quality Python and SQL (or equivalent), with the tests, documentation, and monitoring that keep models trustworthy as the fleet grows and ages.

 - Track model history and communicate those changes effectively across the organization.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - A background in Chemistry or Battery Physics or a related field such as electrochemistry, materials science, or chemical engineering.

 - PhD in physics modeling or battery chemistry preferred.

 - A world-class ownership mindset: you own outcomes, not just tasks.

 - Hands-on experience with battery modeling, ideally semi-empirical or physics-informed degradation models for lithium-ion cells.

 - Strong software and data skills: proficiency in Python and SQL (or equivalent).

 - Familiarity with cell testing and characterization (cycling, HPPC, EIS, or similar), and excitement about building a lab from the ground up.

 - Nice to have: experience with field or fleet data from deployed energy storage, EVs, or consumer electronics.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Base’s Modeling team owns how we understand the health and performance of our battery fleet. Every battery we deploy is a long-lived asset, and how it ages determines how we operate it, how it supports the grid, and how much value it creates for our members over its life. As the fleet grows across more homes, climates, and operating conditions, that question gets harder and more valuable to answer. This team gets to build Base’s degradation modeling capability from the ground up, from a new cell characterization lab to models running on fleet-scale telemetry, so we can predict how our batteries will age and make better decisions about every battery in the field.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Video Producer (San Francisco, CA)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers: Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search, all deeply integrated.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Video is an essential distribution channel for Supabase, and we're building our video effort from the ground up. You'll support our devrel team to make short-form and longer-form video, owning each video from idea to published. You'll work in person with our short-form DevRel on street-style content, and we start without a studio, only building one if the format works. It's a chance to shape how Supabase does video and to learn the whole production process.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: 

 - Create video ideas, write scripts, project manage, shoot, book crew, and edit.

 - Work in person with the short-form DevRel on street-style content, on location.

 - Keep production on track: schedules, shoots, files, and approvals.

 - Publish across YouTube, TikTok, Reels, and X, and use what performs to shape the next ideas.


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You're a scrappy, high agency person who gets things finished and follows up without being asked.

 - You live in San Francisco or are willing to relocate.

 - You have a portfolio and real experience producing short-form or long-form video, with hands-on camera, audio, and editing skills.

 - You're organized and detail-oriented, and interested in AI coding tools and the developer world. You don't need to be technical.

 - Early-career friendly.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client.  This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion.  They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment.  Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives.  As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality.  They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels

• Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements

jobs.title: Associate Director, PD Upstream
jobs.description:
Forge Your Future with Us:

At Forge Biologics, we believe in turning bold ideas into life-changing realities. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to enable access to life-changing gene therapies and help bring them from ideas into reality. We partner with scientists, physicians, biotech and pharma innovators, and patient communities — all united by one goal: improving lives. If you’re driven by purpose and excited to make a tangible impact, this is where your journey begins.

Our team works out of The Hearth, a state-of-the-art, 200,000-square-foot cGMP facility in Columbus, Ohio. Here, you won’t just watch innovation happen — you’ll be part of it. Whether you’re scaling AAV manufacturing, collaborating on cutting-edge therapies, or supporting complex technical projects, you’ll play a key role in bringing hope to patients with genetic diseases.

What sets Forge apart is our culture of H.O.P.E. We are hardworking, showing up each day with determination and grit. We are open, creating a space where ideas flow freely, and every voice is valued. We are purpose-driven, with every task directly tied to changing lives. And we are engaged, energized by the challenges we face and the milestones we achieve together.

At Forge, your growth matters. We’re committed to helping you expand your skills, take on new challenges, and develop your career through mentorship, hands-on learning, and opportunities for advancement. Our people are our greatest investment, and we’re proud to see team members grow with us.

If you’re ready to use your talent to help deliver hope to patients around the world, join us — and be part of something bigger than yourself.

About The Role:

The Associate Director will play a pivotal role in leading scientific and operational activities to support upstream process development for viral vector production. This position will manage a team of scientists and research associates to design, execute, and optimize upstream processes, ensuring robust scalability and technology transfer into GMP manufacturing. The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence with strong leadership and collaboration skills to drive innovation and efficiency in upstream development.

Responsibilities:

• Lead day-to-day operations of upstream process development, including experimental design, execution, and data interpretation for viral vector production (AAV and LV)

• Senior-level technical expert and upstream leader responsible for complex development initiatives

• Independently manages multiple programs or initiatives to a high degree of quality, ensuring technical excellence, scientific rigor, and regulatory alignment

• Manages and provides mentorship and coaching to scientists and associates, developing technical capabilities and reinforcing a culture of quality, safety, and continuous learning

• Sets technical strategy, ensures compliance with regulatory expectations and manufacturing readiness in collaboration with MS&T, QC, and GMP Manufacturing teams, and drives innovation in upstream process design

• Authors high-impact CMC documents, supports regulatory filings, and serves as a cross-functional lead in global program teams

• Influences team culture through scientific leadership, collaboration, and clear communication

• Partners with Downstream, Analytical, and Manufacturing teams to ensure successful process integration and technology transfer

• Oversee the development of scalable upstream processes, promoting innovation and process improvements aligned with company goals, and staying within timelines and budgets while maintaining scientific rigor and data integrity

• Serve as an SME for upstream operations, providing guidance on troubleshooting and optimization

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Biology, Bioengineering, or a related field

• Proven expertise in mammalian suspension cell culture, transfection, and viral production at bench and pilot scales

• Strong understanding of DOE methodology and statistical data analysis

• Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills

• Prior experience supporting technology transfer to GMP manufacturing

• Experience managing junior team members

• Prior project management experience

Preferred Skills:

• Master’s or Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Biology, Bioengineering, or a related field

• Experience with rAAV or lentiviral production platforms

• Familiarity with cGMP principles and regulatory expectations for biologics

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate in a cross-functional matrixed environment

• Experience managing senior team members

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

This position works in both a laboratory environment and typical office environment where the physical work demands will vary depending on the specific tasks and duties required of the job. The employee will be stationary (standing/sitting) for extended periods of time. Employees regularly wear personal protective equipment based on the task being performed. Must be able to work in a confined space, such as a clean room or laboratory environment. Ability to identify small details within the field of vision, distinguish between different colors, and accurately identify objects within a specific area.

Forge Biologics is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Forge Biologics, provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We’ve Got You Covered:

At Forge Biologics, we believe our people deserve to be taken care of – in and out of the workplace. We’ve built a comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to help you thrive, grow, and feel valued every step of the way:

Health from day one

• Health, dental and vision insurance start your first day – with 90% of premiums covered for you and your family.

Time to recharge

• 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave so you can focus on family when it matters most.

Rewarding your impact

• Annual bonus opportunities for all full-time team members.

• 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future.

Your wellness, supported

Fuel for your workday

Grow with us

• Ongoing professional development resources, training, and mentorship programs to help you build your care and grow within Forge.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Dashlane

Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.

We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane, including how we work, how we hire, and the benefits of being a Dashlaner.

About the Role:

As a Customer Success Manager, you will be a pivotal player in transitioning our mid-market customer base from reactive maintenance into a disciplined, proactive retention and expansion engine. Joining an ambitious, high-performing team coming off its strongest year to date, you will take full-lifecycle ownership of accounts—from onboarding through product adoption, renewal, and upsell. You will act as a strategic advisor to our clients, ensuring they achieve maximum value from our core products (particularly the Omnix Platform) while actively elevating our internal operations through strategic account planning, AI-driven workflows, and process automation. This is a unique opportunity to challenge conventional CS processes, move upmarket, and leave a lasting footprint on how our organization operates. This role is based in our New York City office on a hybrid schedule (in-office Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

At Dashlane you will:

• Own the complete customer journey for a portfolio of mid-market accounts, guiding clients seamlessly from initial onboarding to long-term partnership.

• Lead consultative renewals and drive account expansion, proactively identifying commercial opportunities and protecting overall retention.

• Accelerate user adoption and engagement across core products like Omnix, ensuring customers realize ongoing strategic value.

• Design and execute tiered account strategies, delivering consultative executive business reviews for high-growth accounts while utilizing automation for scaled touchpoints.

• Spearhead operational initiatives and leverage modern AI workflows to streamline portfolio analysis, improve risk detection, and elevate team-wide execution.

• Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Support to champion the voice of the customer and resolve complex escalations.

Requirements:

• 3+ years of Customer Success or Account Management experience within a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.

• Proven experience managing accounts across the full customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewals

• Experience using product analytics, health metrics, or CRM platforms to assess account health, forecast risk, and plan account strategy.

• Comfortable using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) to streamline daily workflows, draft communications, and synthesize portfolio data.

We're Also Looking For:

• Prior experience within Cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management (IAM), or security-focused SaaS platforms.

• A "builder" mindset with an innate drive to optimize processes, build playbooks from scratch, and scale operational efficiency.

• High learning agility and intellectual curiosity—eager to dive deep into nuanced technical products and complex customer operating models.

What Dashlane offers you:

• Equal Parental leave - regardless of gender, up to 20 weeks fully paid leave to take care of their new baby, within the first year of birth or adoption

• Mental health services through Spring Health and well-being days

• Mentorship program - select your mentor from our internal pool and continue your learning path!

• Comprehensive health coverage, including dependents

• Unlimited PTO

• Betterment 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid holidays and sick leave

• Donation matching program - give back to the community and support actions that lead to positive social impact under the historically marginalized communities. Every donation will be matched by Dashlane, up to $500 per year

• Weekly lunch in the office and monthly happy hour

• Team buildings & seasonal social events and many more

Salary Range:

The target total compensation (OTE) for this role is $117,300 – $126,000 inclusive of base salary and variable components.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, and other opportunities at Dashlane.

Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Dashlaners.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at Dashlane to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging at Dashlane:

As a truly international company—founded in France and distributed across France, US and Portugal—Dashlane thrives off diverse perspectives. We value all aspects of diversity: gender identity, sexual orientation, ability, ethnic origin, social background, age, lifestyle, and more. We are committed to hiring a diverse community and fostering a culture where everyone is heard and belongs. See more about this here.

Your interview experience:

To know what to expect once you’ve sent your application, read about how we interview and hire at Dashlane. Feel free to browse our blog to find more information about our product and how we work.

jobs.title: VP of Communications
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The VP of Communications owns how TRM shows up in the world: the corporate narrative, the earned channels that carry it, and the voices across the company that amplify it. Criminals are scaling with AI, and TRM is building to own the AI investigations category. You'll build a dedicated communications function from responsibilities currently shared across the team, set proactive narrative strategy on how modern crime is changing and how it's best fought, so that the market, media, analysts, prospective talent, and investors look to TRM for the definitive view on how AI is changing crime, the capacity gap facing the people who fight it, and how crimefighters close it.

The impact you will have:

 - TRM is known as the company that owns the AI investigations category: one clear corporate narrative, carried consistently by our leaders in the conversations that matter, through an executive-visibility program you design and run

 - TRM's share of voice and quality of coverage grow across media, industry analysts, and our other earned channels, shaping how customers, prospective talent, and investors see the company, built on journalist and analyst relationships you own

 - Subject-matter experts from every function become recognized voices in their fields, carrying TRM's story on stages, in bylines, and across our corporate social channels, because you found them, placed them, prepared them, and gave them the guides and AI-enabled workflows to stay consistent and on-brand

 - TRM responds fast and credibly when reputation is on the line, because the monitoring, playbooks, and AI-assisted media tracking you put in place are ready before they're needed

What we're looking for:

 - 10+ years in corporate and executive communications, including owning earned media, ideally at a security, fintech, intelligence, or regulated-tech company

 - A proactive narrative strategist who has placed high-quality coverage and grown share of voice, not just shipped releases

 - Fluency in building sophisticated, credible corporate narratives about AI: what it changes, where it creates risk, and where your company stands, beyond using AI tools day to day

 - An AI-native approach: you use AI across monitoring, research, drafting, and reporting, and you build workflows others can use

 - A natural teacher and talent-spotter who can find the experts across a company, place them in the right forums, and coach them to be confident in front of press and audiences

 - Comfort building a function and its systems from the ground up, and leading cross-functionally without a large standing team

 - Exposure to a strong crisis-communications program and sound judgment under pressure; you've supported a live issue or two, but your instinct is to put TRM into the conversation, not keep it out

 - An excellent writer and editor who can distill complex, technical topics for press, executives, and the public

About the Team:

 - Reports to the Chief Brand Officer, within Brand & Communications

 - A senior leadership role that consolidates communications responsibilities currently split across several people into one dedicated function

 - Works closely with Policy, Insights, Product Marketing, Brand/Content, company Leadership, and subject-matter experts across the company

 - Manages TRM's PR agency and an APAC-based communications lead (contractor) from day one, with potential to build out a team as the function grows

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - US-based role; you'll build coverage for other time zones through your team and partners, starting with an APAC-based communications lead

 - Weekly marketing and leadership syncs; fast, async-first collaboration with executives and cross-functional partners

 - Clear communication norms and shared message guides so the company stays on-brand

Required online and collaboration hours:

 - Schedule: Core overlap across US business hours

On-Call Responsibilities:

 - Schedule: No formal on-call. Crisis-response availability is expected as issues arise.

Travel Requirements:

 - Schedule: Occasional travel for media, executive events, and team offsites

 - Frequency: Low to moderate (HM to confirm)

Onsite Requirements:

 - Schedule: Distributed; periodic in-person for key moments (HM to confirm)

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Within 30 days: ship a corporate narrative and messaging architecture, and a plan to consolidate the split comms responsibilities into one function

 - Within 60 days: land a planned earned-media moment, stand up the executive-visibility calendar, and identify the first group of subject-matter experts to develop as thought leaders

 - Within 90 days: have a tested crisis-communications playbook in place and a repeatable, AI-assisted media-monitoring and reporting workflow running




THE FOLLOWING REPRESENTS THE EXPECTED RANGE OF COMPENSATION FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $195,000-$255,000

 - Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

 - Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

jobs.title: Experienced Discretionary Macro Markets Trader
jobs.description:
We are Gelber Group -- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology.

About Gelber

We are Gelber Group -- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology.

For more than 40 years, Gelber has been one of the industry's leading proprietary trading firms, combining entrepreneurial thinking with disciplined execution. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices and remote team members throughout the United States and Europe, we have built a reputation for innovation, longevity, and consistent performance. Through regulated businesses that include a FINRA-registered broker-dealer, a self-clearing Chicago Mercantile Exchange member firm, and an AFM-licensed MiFID II investment firm, Gelber is positioned to trade across all major global financial markets.

Our business is driven by a relentless pursuit of new trading opportunities and a deep commitment to technical excellence. We trade a diverse range of asset classes and financial instruments using strategies that span the full spectrum of trading—from high-frequency and systematic approaches to longer-term discretionary trading. This diversity creates an intellectually rich environment where ideas, perspectives, and expertise from across the firm contribute to our continued evolution.

Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and meritocratic. We empower talented people to take ownership, contribute meaningfully, and make an impact early in their careers. We believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage, and we invest in their development by providing meaningful responsibility, exceptional colleagues, and the resources they need to succeed. Our flat organizational structure and focus on a true meritocracy with competitive profit splits attracts individuals with an edge which contributes to our consistent success.

The Opportunity

As an Experienced Discretionary Macro Markets Trader, you will have a real opportunity to have a huge impact on the firm. You will work side by side with other successful and talented individuals to capitalize on market opportunities. This role is for someone who flourishes in a fast-paced environment, has a strong work ethic, a competitive attitude, and a proven record of profitability in a trading position for at least 3 years. This is a senior risk-taking role that will be a key idea generator for the desk.

This position will require a strong emphasis on in-person presence in our Chicago office, located in River North right next to the Merchandise Mart and convenient to public transportation.

What you’ll do:

• Manage your own trading book with a focus on trading liquid macro futures

• Manage your own risk of a portfolio of active strategies and drive trading decisions

• Analyze market trends, order flow, and technical patterns to identify trading opportunities

• Develop, test, and refine your trading strategies using historical data and real-time market conditions

• Continuously monitor market conditions, news, and macroeconomic events

• Monitor material changes in levels of risk and variance in PnL, especially focused around deviation from your plans, and proactively communicate those changes to leadership

What we’d like to see:

• Experience trading liquid macro futures `These will commonly include equity indices and/or metals. Nice-to-have experience includes FX, crypto, options, and/or event-driven trading experience

• Proven track record independently managing a PnL, or being a senior member of the team, driving strategy in a larger environment

• Prior Proprietary Trading or Hedge Fund PM experience strongly preferred. Larger bank environment or similar experience may be considered if significant decision-making autonomy existed.

• Defined discretionary macro edge such as outcome distribution analysis, news and narrative interpretation, relative value frameworks, or portfolio construction discipline.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with competitive nature

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work both autonomously and as a team player

• Quant skills and data literacy are a plus but not required. Fully automated or black-box strategies are not the focus of this seat. Openness to feedback and willingness to adapt your trading style with changes in market conditions

• 3 years or more of verified, risk-adjusted profitability

The approximate annual base compensation range for this position in Chicago, IL is $72,000 to $150,000 + percent share of the profits you generate. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package plus benefits, will be determined by a number of factors which include but are not limited to the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities; geographic location; and internal equity. In addition to your salary, our total rewards package includes health benefits, a 401(k) plan, PTO, parental leave, professional development, tuition reimbursement and discretionary bonus, enhancing your overall total rewards package.

Benefits & Culture

Gelber offers a wide range of benefits to full-time employees in order to meet you and your covered dependents needs.  Our comprehensive benefits offering includes:

• Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement program

• Comprehensive health benefits including medical coverage provided by Blue Cross and Blue Shield (PPO and HDHP/HSA) and dental coverage

• Tuition reimbursement for Graduate courses (taken after employment begins)

• Flexible Spending Accounts for health care and dependent care; pre-tax commuter benefits for parking and transit expenses

• Life insurance and long-term disability coverage

• Brand new office in the heart of Chicago’s River North neighborhood, attached to the Merchandise Mart and “EL” stop and a short walk from both Ogilvie and Union Train Stations

• Health club membership with on-site facilities (and reciprocal memberships)

• Generous vacation time, paid holidays, and paid parental leave

• Catered lunch provided Tuesday, Wednesday, & Thursdays and stocked pantry daily and monthly continental breakfasts

• Social events including sponsored 5k races and annual company party

• Enjoyable collaborative and open work environment including a golf simulator and pool table

• Employee referral bonus program

• Charitable giving and company matching opportunities

• Casual, relaxed dress code

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read the Gelber Privacy Notice for California Employees and Applicants, linked here.

jobs.title: Risk Advisory - Senior Associate (Business Process)
jobs.description:
In today’s dynamic environment, business leaders face constantly shifting risks. Riveron helps organizations implement leading governance, risk and compliance practices by combining deep expertise with pragmatic partnership, using a hands-on approach to understand the specific needs of the organization and create tailored solutions to address key compliance risks.  

 

Our Risk Advisory services include SOX readiness, managed internal controls testing and monitoring, co-sourced/outsourced internal audit, segregation of duties and access risk review, policy and procedure development, enterprise risk management, and IT and cybersecurity risk assessment.  

 

The Senior Associate level position for Riveron’s Risk Advisory group will work collaboratively with senior team members who provide guidance, coaching, and direction. The role includes assessing the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), developing and executing remediation roadmaps, and performing ICFR risk assessments. 

Who You Are:

 - Bachelor's and/or Master’s degree in Accounting

 - Relevant certification preferred, CPA, CIA and/or CISA

 - Minimum 3 years experience, the majority of which is within external audit or risk advisory roles

 - Demonstrated knowledge of business risks, internal controls over financial reporting, SOX, the COSO framework

 - You have a passion for developing and maintaining client relationships

 - You get the job done and have fun doing it

 - You communicate skillfully with a variety of audiences and can create compelling stories from data

 - You thrive in an ever-changing, dynamic work environment

 - You readily identify problems and instinctively look for solutions

 - You enjoy participating in internal and external company initiatives such as community service, training, recruiting, and firm events

 - You are willing and able to travel as needed to meet client and business needs, as travel is an expected part of this role.
   
   

What You’ll Do:  

 - Gain an understanding of the assigned clients’ objectives as well as their regulatory and risk management environment

 - Assist projects in the areas of Sarbanes-Oxley Compliance/Internal Controls

 - Execute risk assessments in consideration of risk of misstatement and risk of fraud in financial reporting

 - Assess internal controls’ design adequacy to mitigate financial, operational, and compliance risks

 - Identify control gaps and improvement items and design controls in a greenfield environment. Design detailed remediation roadmaps to close those gaps.

 - Exhibit proficiency with creating internal controls process flows and risk/control matrices

 - Maintain the level of technical competency and professional care required for the completion of assignments in accordance with COSO, COBIT, auditing standards, and related control techniques

 - Set priorities, ensuring daily coordination among the project team, and monitor progress against schedules, budgets, project/task deliverables, and status reporting

 - Communicate extensively with clients to drive expectations and report on the status of ongoing projects.

 - Deliver oral and written presentations during and at the conclusion of projects by either recommending improvements or any operational/financial deficiencies to executive leadership

jobs.title: INFORMATION SECURITY ANALYST
jobs.description:
At Nox Group, we are dedicated to humanizing construction as one of the fastest-growing industrial enterprises in the US. Nox Group owns and operates Corbins, RMCI, Nox Innovations, and Construction Labels, and our teams set the standard as industry leaders. As we continue to expand our reach nationwide, we seek people who are passionate about personal growth and eager to make a positive impact throughout the industries and communities we serve. We prioritize our people, our partners, and our relationships. Start your journey today and join our skilled team.

The Information Security Analyst operates and maintains Nox Group's information security program under the direction of the Director of IT, who owns the program, approves all policies and standards, and makes the final decision on remediation and program changes. The Analyst monitors and responds to security events, maintains the Information Security Management System (ISMS), coordinates vulnerability remediation, maintains incident response and disaster recovery plans, governs identity and data access, and owns compliance and insurance evidence. As the day-to-day internal point of contact for security matters, this role turns findings into assigned, documented, and closed work.

Responsibilities

• Security Operations & Incident Response: Monitor, investigate, and contain security events, including phishing, suspicious sign-ins, identity risk detections, and malicious domains, whether alerts originate in Sophos MDR, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID identity protection, or Egnyte Secure & Govern. Own the employee phishing report process and take containment action on your own judgment within approved procedure.

• Incident Response Planning: Maintain and annually review the Incident Response Plan (severity model, roles, decision authority, escalation paths, communication templates, and SOPs). Facilitate tabletop exercises with IT, Finance, Legal, and leadership, run post-incident reviews, and track corrective actions to completion.

• Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity: Maintain the Disaster Recovery Plan, including recovery priorities, recovery time and recovery point objectives, and restoration runbooks, for Director of IT approval. Coordinate backup verification and restore and failover testing with the IT Systems Engineer, and support department leaders on continuity procedures.

• Governance & ISMS: Draft security policies, standards, and procedures for Director of IT approval and document them in the Nox Group Standard Works format. Keep the Risk, Exception, Compliance Obligations, CIS Control Mapping, and Vulnerability Advisory registers current, run the policy exception process, and measure program maturity against the CIS Controls and NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

• Vulnerability Management: Review platform findings and vendor advisories, confirm applicability and impact, and recommend remediation and target dates for approval. Track approved remediation to closure with evidence, coordinate patch targets with the IT Systems Engineer, and manage external assessments such as PCI ASV scanning and penetration testing.

• Identity, Access & Data Governance: Coordinate periodic access reviews of users, privileged roles, service accounts, and shared resources, and recommend MFA, passwordless, Conditional Access, and privileged access requirements. Review the joiner, mover, and leaver process, and maintain data classification, protection, retention, DLP, external sharing, and guest access requirements across file, email, and endpoint platforms.

• Vendor & Third-Party Risk: Serve as the day-to-day contact for the MDR provider, reviewing its reporting and verifying escalation contacts, response authority, and coverage across jobsite devices, subsidiaries, and cloud tenants. Perform security reviews of new software, SaaS, and vendors before adoption and document exceptions.

• Compliance & Customer Assurance: Own evidence and responses for customer, prime contractor, and cyber insurance security questionnaires, customer prequalification applications, and PCI DSS obligations. Support audits and customer security reviews, including those from data center clients.

• Security Awareness: Administer onboarding training, Sophos Phish Threat simulations, and targeted training for finance, field, and executive staff. Track completion, follow up with teams that need support, and use phishing trends to shape awareness messaging.

• Reporting & Coordination: Keep the Director of IT informed on program status, open risks, and upcoming deliverables, and produce regular reporting on incidents, vulnerabilities, access reviews, and awareness results for the Director of IT and CIO. Maintain security documentation and runbooks, partner with Legal, Accounting, People Operations, Safety, Procurement, and department leaders, evaluate security tooling for Director decision, and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Entry-level position; relevant internship, co-op, or project experience in IT, security operations, or compliance preferred.

• Working knowledge of security fundamentals, including access control, incident response, risk management, and common attack types (phishing, ransomware, business email compromise); familiarity with NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO 27001 preferred.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Office for document control and reporting.

• Exposure to Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, Sophos Central, and Egnyte Secure & Govern preferred; PowerShell and Microsoft Graph for queries and evidence a plus.

• Experience writing or maintaining policies, standard operating procedures, or training materials a plus.

• Sound analytical judgment: able to investigate ambiguous events with incomplete information, separate real threats from noise, and make containment decisions under pressure.

• Strong process discipline: follows and maintains documented procedures and keeps registers, evidence, and closure records complete; organized and self-directed with deadlines and follow-ups.

• Clear communicator who can explain risk and required actions in plain language to field crews, project teams, and executives across multiple operating companies, and who maintains confidentiality.

• Commitment to staying current with the threat landscape, Microsoft and Sophos security capabilities, and the CIS and NIST frameworks.

• Ability to walk, climb, stoop, reach, bend, and lift or move up to 50 pounds; occasional travel to job sites and branch offices.

Education & Certifications

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

• CompTIA Security+ required within 12 months of hire.

Safety Level

This is a safety sensitive position and all applicable policies including drug test and background check will apply.

It has been and continues to be the long-standing policy of any Nox Group operating company to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Nox Group and all of its subsidiaries comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

Note: This position is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in Lithuania.

About the role

As a Senior Technical Project Manager at Fluxon, you’ll lead complex products end-to-end and bring clarity to ambiguity.

We’re looking for someone who blends technical depth with sharp project instincts, thrives in dynamic environments, and brings integrity, structure, and heart to every team they’re part of.

While specific responsibilities may differ from project to project, you will:

• Coordinate cross-functionally with Product and Engineers to explore solutions, define specifications, and continuously communicate project status and needs

• Use project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) to manage documentation, workflows, and progress tracking

• Ensure project reports are accurate, up-to-date, and shared on time

• Provide clear visibility into project progress to leadership and stakeholders, supporting effective decision-making, approvals, and direction

• Organise and lead project reviews with key stakeholders to share progress, align on upcoming milestones, facilitate and support decision-making, and proactively mitigate risks. Build and maintain detailed project plans, ensuring effective management of deadlines, deliverables, and project goals

• Gain domain expertise and engage relevant subject-matter experts by asking the right questions, prioritization, and timely follow-up to ensure blockers are removed

• Leverage past experience to identify improvement opportunities and promote best practices that elevate project performance

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree

• Engineering or QA background

• Fluent in English with experience collaborating directly with Executives

• 5+ years in IT project management; 3+ years working in Agile environment

• Solid experience with Agile practices, including 1-week sprints and Program Increment planning

• Proven ability to bring structure to ambiguous environments and build strong relationships across all levels of the organisation

• Experience working with distributed/global product and engineering teams

• Strong ability to understand complex technical concepts and translate them for non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to influence without authority, drive alignment, build trust and strong stakeholder support in a matrixed environment

• Strong negotiation skills and the ability to drive outcomes through structured processes and collaborative networks

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly and concisely in both verbal and written forms, including well-structured documentation

• Self-starter: energetic, adaptable and collaborative, with a customer-focused mindset and a proactive approach to driving results.Comfortable collaborating with multiple cross-functional groups, including business, engineering, design, and QA

• Hands-on experience driving projects integrating AI capabilities into products or workflows, with the ability to translate AI requirements, risks, and constraints to stakeholders

What we offer

• Remote-first, flexible work with a budget to set up a work space that works for you

• Localized healthcare coverage to support you and your family’s wellbeing

• Flexible paid time off with a minimum of 3 weeks per year (plus holidays)

• "No internal meetings" Fridays, so you can focus on deep, uninterrupted work

• A professional growth budget for learning that matters to you – whether it’s developing your technical skills or learning a new language

• A monthly wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health

• Annual company offsites, where we gather in person to build meaningful connections

• A competitive salary that reflects your expertise, impact and experience

• Profit-sharing, so you can benefit directly from the value we build together

• A paid sabbatical program, designed for rest, renewal and fresh perspective

Kaip pardavėjas (-a)-konsultantas (-ė), atliksite pagrindinį vaidmenį nepriekaištingos klientų patirties kūrime. Jūs sutiksite klientus, padėsite orientuotis parduotuvėje ar surasti reikalingas prekes, tuo pat metu rodydami turimas prekes. Sekdami mūsų vertybes prisidėsite prie savo ir kompanijos sėkmės.

Atsakomybės:

• Dalinsitės žiniomis apie madą ir prekes su klientais, kad padėtumėte priimti gerai informuotą sprendimą.
• Bendradarbiausite su komanda, kad pateiktumėte geriausią klientų aptarnavimą kiekviename kliento kelionė žingsnyje.
• Užtikrinsite salės ir sandėlio pakankamus prekių kiekius, tvarką ir svetingą atmosferą,
• Padėsite su parduotuvės atidarymo ir uždarymo rutinomis.
• Atstovausite sau ir kompanijai bendraudami su klientais.

KOLEKTYVAS:

Mūsų parduotuvės – kompanijos širdis, nes čia klientai patiria tiesioginį sąlytį su mūsų prekės ženklu. Kaip dalis mūsų dinamiškos komandos, kiekvienas vaidmuo, nuo pardavėjo-konsultanto, skyriaus vadovo, parduotuvės vadovo, vizualistų iki grynųjų pinigų specialisto, prisideda prie įkvepiančios ir jaukios atmosferos kūrimo. Jūs taip pat bendradarbiausite ir su didesne regiono komanda, bendradarbiausite su kitomis parduotuvėmis dalindamiesi įžvalgomis ir pastebėjimais, kad ir toliau vystytumėte kompanijos, parduotuvių ir savo sėkmę. jobs.title: AMER Deal Structuring Manager
jobs.description:
About the Team & Role:

Rubrik is looking for a curious and self-motivated Deal Structuring Manager to join our AMER Deal Structuring Team. Our team operates at the critical junction of Sales, Finance, and Legal, ensuring that we structure innovative, "win-win" commercial models that drive value for both our customers and Rubrik’s long-term growth.

As a key team-member, you will act as a strategic partner to support our sales organization, navigating complex commercial landscapes by identifying commercial solutions that balance customer requirements and company objectives. We are looking for a high-energy professional who upholds the Rubrik RIVET values and proactively engages to secure revenue and maintain corporate profitability in a fast-paced environment. This role will be an individual contributor role, with potential to eventually grow into people management.

Nature of the Specialized Duties

➢ Strategic Deal Architecture and Creative Structuring (25% of time)

• Designing and implementing creative commercial structures for high-level strategic deals to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes for Rubrik and its customers.

• Architecting complex deal models that balance customer requirements with Rubrik’s revenue recognition and profitability standards.

• Leading strategic conversations with sales leadership to align commercial offerings with broad company objectives and market positioning.

• Utilizing a deep understanding of business interests to move past objections and engineer workable, high-value solutions.

➢ Commercial Contract Governance and Financial Negotiation (25% of time)

• Drafting specialized commercial language in contracts to capture unique deal terms while mitigating organizational risk.

• Applying strong financial acumen to evaluate and qualify a variety of commercial outcomes, ensuring alignment with FP&A and Accounting standards.

• Navigating complex negotiation cycles by identifying the interests behind positions and resolving commercial friction points.

• Ensuring all deals adhere to internal compliance, revenue integrity, and company-wide sales policies and ensuring detailed oversight of quoting related Governance+ Operational details

➢ Deal Velocity Management and Process Optimization (20% of time)

• Identifying, troubleshooting and resolving deal cycle bottlenecks to ensure timely closures and scale commercial exception-making.

• Driving continuous improvements for the global function by identifying process gaps and proposing tooling, automation, or intake solutions.s, or

• Leveraging CRM and CPQ systems to streamline the quote-to-cash process and improve the efficiency of deal approvals.

• Establishing and maintaining consistent intake workflows that help organization and x-functional support scale effectively within the AMER region.

➢ Analytical Synthesis and Executive Reporting (15% of time)

• Quickly digesting key deal characteristics and synthesizing them into flexible, high-impact deliverables for senior and executive management.

jobs.title: Senior Agile Delivery Analyst (5770)
jobs.description:
SMX is seeking an Agile Delivery Analyst to serve as the embedded delivery-management and workflow coordination lead for an assigned ARES value stream or delivery area. The role works closely with Government Product Managers, the ARES PMO Lead, technical leads, developers, data engineers, functional experts, and stakeholders to ensure that priorities are translated into clear, actionable work and that workload, delivery flow, risks, dependencies, and commitments are visible and manageable.

This is not solely a Scrum Master role. The successful candidate will use Agile, Kanban, and other practical delivery-management practices as appropriate, but the primary purpose of the position is to help ARES teams organize work, maintain delivery flow, coordinate across stakeholders, and provide reliable management insight to program leadership.

ARES is an enterprise data and analytics capability that delivers trusted data products, pipelines, dashboards, and decision support in support of Army financial management, audit readiness, logistics and asset reporting, enterprise resource planning modernization, and other mission needs.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Serve as the delivery-management and workflow coordination lead for an assigned ARES value stream, product area, platform function, or delivery team.

• Work with Government Product Managers, PMO personnel, technical leads, functional experts, and stakeholders to translate priorities and mission needs into structured, actionable work

• Support the full work lifecycle from intake through analysis, triage, backlog refinement, prioritization support, development, delivery, release, and follow-on sustainment

• Maintain a clear, current, and appropriately structured team backlog in Jira under the direction of the Government Product Manager and in coordination with the ARES PMO Lead.

• Ensure work items include sufficient context for the delivery team, including the requested outcome, scope, priority, users or stakeholders affected, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and relevant operational or service impacts.

• Facilitate practical team routines, including backlog refinement, Kanban or flow reviews, delivery coordination sessions, risk and dependency discussions, and action follow-up.

• Use Agile and Kanban practices pragmatically to improve visibility, predictability, and team coordination; avoid imposing ceremonies or processes that do not improve delivery or decision quality.

• Track and communicate work in progress, blocked work, backlog readiness, work-item aging, delivery forecasts, capacity constraints, operational workload, risks, and dependencies.

• Help distinguish and track new capability work, enhancements, defects, incidents, data-quality issues, access requests, routine support, and other operational work so that the program can understand how capacity is being used.

• Coordinate with technical leads and delivery personnel to capture estimates, sequencing needs, technical dependencies, release considerations, and external coordination requirements.

• Escalate material risks, blockers, cross-team dependencies, and capacity conflicts to the PMO Lead and appropriate Government or contractor leads.

• Support release readiness by coordinating work-item completion, validation needs, stakeholder awareness, release documentation, known limitations, and follow-on work.

• Maintain clear and useful Confluence documentation, including team working agreements, requirements artifacts, decision and action records, release information, and knowledge-transfer material.

• Develop concise status updates, management summaries, briefings, and Jira-based reports that accurately reflect team conditions and support leadership decision-making.

• Capture stakeholder feedback, customer-support themes, recurring issues, and lessons learned; ensure relevant information informs backlog refinement and continuous improvement.

• Participate in the VSA community of practice led by the PMO Lead to implement common ARES standards for work visibility, reporting, documentation, risk escalation, and delivery coordination.

Required Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

• Current Active Secret Clearance.

• 6+ years of experience supporting project delivery, program delivery, business analysis, product operations, technical requirements analysis, or comparable functions in a technical environment.

• 4+ years of hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage work, maintain documentation, track delivery progress, and generate reports.

• Experience supporting technical delivery teams, such as software development, data engineering, analytics, DevOps, platform operations, or enterprise IT services.

• Demonstrated experience supporting an end-to-end work lifecycle: intake, analysis, triage, refinement, prioritization support, development, delivery, release, and sustainment.

• Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous requests or stakeholder needs into clear, actionable work items, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, or functional descriptions.

• Experience facilitating backlog refinement, Kanban or workflow reviews, delivery coordination, task follow-up, and team-level risk or dependency discussions.

• Ability to analyze Jira or related work-management data to identify workload trends, bottlenecks, delivery risks, blocked work, capacity constraints, and operational demand.

• Strong organizational, written communication, verbal communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, maintain clear documentation, and collaborate productively across technical, functional, Government, and contractor teams.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Experience supporting enterprise data, analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, software, platform, or IT service-management programs.

• Experience supporting a complex Government, DoW, Army, or other Federal program.

• Experience with Kanban, Lean delivery management, Agile delivery, product operations, IT service management, or service-desk workflows.

• Experience preparing executive-ready status updates, management briefings, risk summaries, or decision-support materials.

• Certified ScrumMaster, PMI-ACP, ITIL, Kanban, CBAP, PMP, or similar credential.

• Functional familiarity with financial management, logistics, audit readiness, or related Army mission areas.

• Functional knowledge of Army Finance or Logistics is helpful but not required. ARES has established functional and technical experts within its value streams. The VSA’s primary value is organizing work, strengthening communication, improving delivery flow, and ensuring leadership has an accurate view of team capacity, commitments, risks, and progress.
