jobs.title: Linux/MacOS Systems Administrator (5766)
jobs.description:
SMX is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Linux/macOS Systems Administrator to support enterprise IT infrastructure onsite at NAS Patuxent River, MD. This position is responsible for administering, maintaining, and securing Linux and macOS systems across classified and unclassified environments.

The ideal candidate will have experience with Linux system administration, macOS endpoint management, and cybersecurity compliance. This role will leverage VMware Workspace ONE Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) to manage and secure endpoints while supporting daily operations, troubleshooting, and system maintenance.

We are looking for a self-starter who is comfortable working independently, learning new technologies, and collaborating with technical teams to support mission requirements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Install, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux and macOS operating systems across enterprise IT environments.

• Manage and secure Linux and macOS endpoints using VMware Workspace ONE Unified Endpoint Management (UEM).

• Develop, deploy, and maintain endpoint configurations, security policies, compliance profiles, and software packages.

• Implement and maintain DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) to support compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements.

• Perform vulnerability assessments, analyze findings, and coordinate remediation activities using ACAS and other approved security tools.

• Monitor system performance, availability, and security to identify and resolve operational issues.

• Perform operating system updates, security patching, software installations, and routine system maintenance.

• Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and network connectivity issues affecting Linux and macOS environments.

• Support the administration and maintenance of systems operating within classified and unclassified environments.

• Collaborate with cybersecurity, engineering, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues and implement system improvements.

• Maintain accurate system documentation, configuration records, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

• Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, security, automation, and operational efficiency.

• Provide technical support to customers and stakeholders, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests.

• Perform additional duties as assigned to support operational and mission requirements.

Required Skills & Experience

• Clearance Required: Top Secret

• Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in systems administration, IT infrastructure support, or a related technical field.

• Active CompTIA Security+ certification or equivalent DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification.

• Experience administering, configuring, and troubleshooting Linux operating systems, including RHEL, Ubuntu, or CentOS.

• Working knowledge of macOS administration, configuration, and troubleshooting.

• Experience with enterprise endpoint management, software deployment, and system maintenance.

• Understanding of DoD cybersecurity requirements, system hardening, and security compliance practices.

• Familiarity with DISA STIG implementation, vulnerability management, and remediation processes.

• Knowledge of networking fundamentals, operating system security, and troubleshooting methodologies.

• Strong technical troubleshooting, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requirements, and collaborate effectively with technical teams.

• Ability to work onsite at NAS Patuxent River, MD, and support classified and unclassified computing environments.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.

• Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.

• Familiarity with virtualization technologies, including VMware vSphere.

• Knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, including Active Directory, LDAP, and certificate-based authentication.

• Previous experience supporting DoD or federal government IT environments.

• Additional industry certifications, such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), CompTIA Linux+, or relevant Apple administration certifications.

jobs.title: Hospice RN Case Manager (Montgomery County, PA)
jobs.description:
About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Purpose:

Ennoble Care is hiring for a full-time Hospice RN Case Manager who resides within or in close proximity to Montgomery County, PA. As a member of the interdisciplinary team, the RN Case Manager works under the general direction of the Director of Nursing, the attending physician and the interdisciplinary group in providing skilled nursing assessments, planning, and care in order to maximize the comfort and health of both patients and their loved ones/caregivers.

What You'll Do:

• Manage your assigned patient caseload within your territory and be responsible for the following tasks, including but not limited to: assessing, planning, implementing, and evaluating of patients care throughout all phases of the nursing process.

• Document all notes in the EMR and submit them accurately and in a timely manner

• Communicate and partner cross-departmentally with all attending physicians, hospice staff members, and other agencies as needed to coordinate optimal care for all patients

• Educate and coach all relevant parties on the best practices regarding call levels of care for the patient including: physical, mental, emotional, etc

• Partner with clinical leadership to manage/address any issues, share professional support, and exchange feedback to enhance professional growth.

• Attend patient care conferences and facilitate discussion of issues from caseload for full staff discussion, consultation and evaluation

• Supervise and document the NAC every two weeks or as assigned

• Participate in the Hospice orientation, in-service training, and community programs as related to hospice care

• Maintain familiarity with policies of the agency and rules and regulations of State and Federal bodies which govern hospice

• Accept other assignments as appropriate

What You'll Need:

• Valid State license to practice as a Registered Nurse in the State of Pennsylvania

• 1-2+ years of work experience as a professional nurse preferably at least one of the years in hospice care

• Skilled in nursing practice, able to cope with loved ones/caregivers’ emotional stress and tolerant of individual lifestyles

• Ability to make meaningful observations, skilled assessments, and write comprehensive, accurate reports

• Must have a valid driver’s license, a good driving record, the use of a reliable vehicle, and the ability to drive year-round to locations

jobs.title: Nurse Navigator
jobs.description:
The role of the Nurse Navigator is that of consultant and educator in the implementation and coordination of the multi-disciplinary care, education and rehabilitation of the cancer patient. The Nurse Navigator is to provide support, education, coordination of care, and other assistance during the diagnosis and treatment planning stages for the pre and post-operative patient. The Nurse Navigator utilizes a multidisciplinary approach to planning and providing care, acts as liaison between oncology services and other ancillary services (surgery, genetics, medical oncology, radiation oncology, social worker, rehabilitation, and nuclear medicine support groups) to ensure that the specific needs and concerns of the cancer patient are addressed. Acts as a representative of Comprehensive Oncology Services to the patients, their caregivers and support systems, referring physician, hospital staff, local, state and federal agencies and organizations, and develops and participates in the hospital and community outreach educational programs.

Contributes to the achievement of established department goals and objectives and adheres to departmental policies, procedures, quality standards, and safety standards. Complies with governmental and accreditation regulations. Seeks opportunities to participate in developing/revising standards of practice to meet changing patient requirements.

Utilizes clinical nursing skills in observation, assessment, diagnosis and counseling. Initiates and maintains ongoing assessment considering physiological, psychological, spiritual, cultural and developmental needs of the pre and post-op cancer patient and their caregivers. Serves as resource/liaison in planning care for patients, their caregivers and multi-disciplinary health care providers.

In collaboration with the patient, caregivers and multi-disciplinary members of the patients health care team, systematically develops, updates and coordinates the patients pre and post-op plan of care, identifying abnomal findings when applicable and makes appropriate referrals and evaluates outcomes of plan of care.

Identifies health/cancer educational needs of patient and caregivers. Develops, implements and evaluates teaching program to meet the identified needs. Effectively uses and adapts a variety of teaching resources in meeting the specific needs of each individual patient and caregiver(s). Communicates educational outcomes to appropriate leadership. Presents formal education programs and provides individual guidance to staff.

Provides for emotional and psychological support of patients and caregivers during the crisis of cancer diagnosis. Models patient/family advocacy.

Establishes a collaborative relationship with multi-disciplinary medical staff and other departments. Makes referrals to appropriate community resources. Coordinates conferences associated with comprehensive specialty services. Maintains updated cancer resource materials.

Assists in the development of Comprehensive Service goals, objectives, policies and procedures. Participates in the development of health educational programs and provides health educational programs and materials in the rehabilitation setting.

Enhances growth and development and enriches person knowledge and skill through participation in educational programs and professional affililiations.

Participates in multi-disciplinary quality and service improvement teams. Provides feedback regarding participant performance in the participant and other appropriate individuals as necessary.

Participates in meeting and on committees and represents the department and hospital in community outreach efforts.

Evaluates clinical and education supplies for effectiveness and monitors appropriate utilization and cost-effectiveness.

Educates patients on clinical trials and facilitates enrollment in these trials.

Nurse Navigator communicates with all services.

Anticipates, identifies and helps patients to overcome barriers within the healthcare system to ensure prompt diagnostic and treatment resolution of an abnormal finding of cancer.

REQUIRED: Adherence to credentialing requirements of AAMC as stated in the nursing bylaws. Minimum of three years clinical nursing experience. Baccalaureate Degree in Nursing or related field with experience in health and/or oncolocy clinical coordination preferred. Computer literate. Strong assessment skills of patient needs and concerns. Able to perform duties autonomously under direction of multiple disciplines. Experience in Case Management desirable.

Pay Range

jobs.title: Risk Manager
jobs.description:
RISK MANAGER




ABOUT ATOMIC VEST

We are a fast-growing, mission-driven company powering the expansion of financial services and wealth creation globally. We build critical financial infrastructure that allows consumer-facing companies to offer engaging investing experiences to their customers in a frictionless way. We host advanced investing capabilities ranging from ESG investing to multi-currency trading across 60 global markets. We are a team of financial empowerment enthusiasts that have come together from various industries including tech, banking, finance, and law.

The company has raised $55M in funding and is positioned to rapidly scale. Come join an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Risk Manager to identify, measure, and manage risk across Atomic's growing group of regulated entities, including a FINRA-registered broker-dealer and an SEC-registered investment adviser. You'll report to [reporting line to be confirmed], work closely with leadership across finance, compliance, legal, operations, and engineering, and have direct access to the company's Risk Committee.



As our first dedicated risk hire, you'll have the opportunity to build the risk management function from the ground up: designing the framework, policies, metrics, and reporting the company will rely on as it scales, including the control framework for our planned self-clearing and alternative trading system (ATS) business lines.



Atomic is a remote-first company, and this role is fully remote; however, candidates must be based in the US or LATAM in the Americas Timezone (GMT-3 to GMT-8).




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build the risk management function as the initial hire, including an enterprise risk framework, risk appetite, and policies appropriate for a multi-entity fintech, with initial and primary focus on the broker-dealer entity.

 - Support and enhance the monitoring of broker-dealer financial risks, including net capital, liquidity, and clearing-related exposures.

 - Assess and monitor bank and counterparty risk, including banks participating in the cash sweep program, clearing firms, and key vendors, with risk ratings, KRIs, and re-review triggers.

 - Run periodic enterprise risk assessments across the broker-dealer, RIA, and technology entities, and maintain the risk register.

 - Build and maintain a risk and control matrix across all entities. Work with process owners to design practical preventive and detective controls, test them for design and operating effectiveness, and develop key risk indicators (KRIs).

 - Own a central incident and issue log: lead root-cause analysis, track remediation to validated closure, and escalate potential reportable events to Compliance, Legal, and the FinOp.

 - Review new products, entities, and markets for risk before launch and recommend appropriate controls.

 - Build controls for the planned self-clearing and ATS business lines, including reserve computations, daily net capital monitoring, possession and control, reconciliations, and Reg ATS obligations, and provide control evidence for FINRA's review.

 - Prepare risk reporting for senior management and the Risk Committee.

 - Support audits and regulatory examinations by coordinating risk-related requests and responses.

 - Maintain the business continuity plan (FINRA Rule 4370) and run tabletop exercises with Technology.

 - Partner with key stakeholders across finance, compliance, legal, operations, and engineering leadership.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2–5 years of experience in risk management, internal controls, or a related function

 - Experience in fintech, banking, brokerage, or RIA environments

 - Hands-on, builder mindset: comfortable in a small firm, and focused on fixing issues with teams rather than only documenting them

 - Working knowledge of broker-dealer financial responsibility rules (e.g., SEC net capital and customer protection rules)

 - Understanding of operational, credit/counterparty, and liquidity risk concepts

 - Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or similar tools; experience with NetSuite or another ERP is helpful

 - Advanced-level English for cross-team collaboration




NICE TO HAVE

 - External or internal audit experience, or experience at a regulatory agency (e.g., FINRA, SEC, or a banking regulator).

 - Professional certification such as FRM, CPA, CIA, or CRCM.

jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.
Overview

Validates requirements, performs analysis and design for system improvements and new applications. Represents the department by leading work and providing guidance to others.

The Unified Service Development (USD) team builds and supports the applications and reporting data that power client service and operations across the business. The team maintains web applications and services, along with a large portfolio of SQL Server databases, ETL pipelines, and reporting data feeds, and is actively modernizing these systems onto containerized platforms such as OpenShift. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention. Our programs guide members through every stage of the substance use spectrum, from unhealthy habits to active use disorders, delivering personalized treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals.

With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.

Pelago has scaled to helping hundreds of employers and health plans and has already helped more than 750,000 members better manage their substance use. If you're passionate about AI and making an impact on the health of others, join us and make it happen!

About the job

We’re seeking a Senior Product Designer to join the Product team at Pelago, the AI-led, clinician-backed behavioral health clinic for substance use, mental health, and behavioral addiction care.

Every member now starts with Sona, our voice-first clinical AI, which helps assess their needs and supports them throughout their care journey under licensed clinical supervision.

In this role, you’ll shape how members experience Sona and how AI works alongside our human care team. You’ll design thoughtful, intuitive experiences across voice, mobile, and the moments where members transition between AI-powered support and clinician-led care.

You’ll own meaningful parts of the end-to-end member journey, from initial engagement and assessment through ongoing care. This is an opportunity to apply strong product design fundamentals to an emerging technology, helping define how AI can make behavioral healthcare more accessible, personalized, and supportive.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Growth to translate complex member needs into simple, effective experiences. As Sona evolves, you’ll have the opportunity to influence the design principles and interaction patterns that shape the future of AI-supported care at Pelago.

In this role you will…

• Own end-to-end product design for key member experiences across Sona and the Pelago app, from discovery and problem definition through prototyping, launch, and iteration.

• Design intuitive, engaging experiences across conversational AI, voice, and mobile, helping members navigate assessment, care matching, and ongoing support.

• Translate complex clinical and technical workflows into clear, accessible, and human-centered experiences that build member confidence and trust.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams to design thoughtful interactions between AI and human care, including clear communication, member choice, and seamless handoffs to clinicians.

• Lead design discovery and user research, including interviews, usability testing, and rapid experimentation, to understand member needs and validate design decisions.

• Create high-quality user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs, using Figma and modern AI-assisted design tools to explore and iterate efficiently.

• Collaborate closely with engineers to bring designs to life, balancing user experience, technical feasibility, and product goals.

• Use qualitative insights, product analytics, and member feedback to evaluate experiences, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product.

• Contribute to Pelago’s design system and evolving interaction patterns, helping create consistent, accessible experiences across the platform.

• Work with Growth and Product partners to improve key member journeys, including enrollment, activation, engagement, and retention.

We’re looking for

• 6+ years of product design experience, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of digital products, from identifying user problems through delivering thoughtful, high-quality solutions.

• Strong expertise in user experience, interaction design, and visual design, with the ability to simplify complex workflows into intuitive, engaging interfaces.

• Experience designing and shipping consumer-facing digital products, ideally across mobile and web.

• A solid foundation in user-centered design and research methodologies, including discovery, prototyping, usability testing, and incorporating feedback into product decisions.

• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping, design systems, and collaboration with engineering teams.

• Familiarity with modern AI tools and an interest in using them to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and iteration.

• Strong product thinking, with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, technical considerations, and measurable outcomes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to articulate design decisions and work effectively with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional partners.

• Comfort navigating ambiguity, taking ownership, and iterating quickly in a collaborative, fast-moving product environment.

Nice to have

• Experience designing AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, voice experiences, or other emerging interaction patterns.

• Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, digital health, or another industry involving sensitive user journeys and high levels of trust.

• Experience working on products that support complex decision-making, personalized experiences, or interactions between digital services and human experts.

• Familiarity with AI prototyping tools or experience experimenting with large language models to explore product concepts and interaction patterns.

The provided range reflects our US target salary range for this full-time position, which is part of our broader total compensation package, including incentive bonus program, stock options, comprehensive benefits, and incentive pay applicable to eligible roles. Individual pay within the range will vary based on a variety of factors like role-related experience and education, internal pay equity, and other relevant business factors. At Pelago, we are committed to an equitable and fair pay philosophy and review total compensation for our employees at least twice a year.

Base Pay Range

$180,000—$195,000 USD

jobs.title: Temporary Full Time Floor Leader - Scottsdale Fashion Square Mall
jobs.description:
Position: Full Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 30-39 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

Scottsdale Fashion Square Pay

$17.60—$17.60 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

LinkedIn

jobs.title: Order Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

About the Team

The European Order Operations team owns the end-to-end quote-to-cash transaction process and serves as the main operational partner for Retail and Corporate Sales teams on order-related matters. The team connects Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, Production Control, IT, Finance, Tax, and Accounting to maintain accurate orders and enable timely deliveries. It combines hands-on daily execution with structured performance management, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. The team’s impact is visible in orderbook accuracy, delivery readiness, revenue recognition support, and a reliable experience for internal and external stakeholders.

About the Role

The Order Operations Specialist is an individual contributor role reporting to the Supervisor, Order Operations and supporting the execution of Lucid’s European order-to-delivery operations. This role ensures that customers and vehicle orders move accurately and efficiently through the transaction lifecycle, while providing Sales and Delivery teams with reliable operational support. You will take ownership of day-to-day order execution, proactively resolve transactional issues, maintain accurate data across systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure that vehicles, invoices, payments, and customer documentation are ready for delivery. Success will be demonstrated through accurate orderbook data, timely issue resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and improved operational consistency. Unlike a traditional order management position, this role provides direct exposure to the development and scaling of European automotive order operations, with opportunities to influence workflows, systems, and new purchase scenarios as the business grows.

What You Own

• Order Execution: Own the accurate processing and maintenance of customer and vehicle orders from order placement through delivery, ensuring that required changes are completed correctly and on time.

• Issue Resolution: Investigate and resolve transactional issues involving order configurations, pricing, discounts, vehicle assignments, invoices, payments, and refunds, coordinating the appropriate actions across teams and systems.

• Delivery Readiness: Partner with Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, and other operational teams to identify and resolve order-related blockers so that vehicles and customer documentation are ready for the planned handover.

• Orderbook Accuracy: Maintain accurate and consistent order, customer, vehicle, pricing, and payment data across the orderbook and connected systems, proactively addressing discrepancies that could affect fulfilment, invoicing, or reporting.

• Vehicle Allocation: Manage vehicle allocation, release, and inventory visibility to support accurate vehicle availability and ensure that orders are matched to the correct vehicles.

• Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a primary operational contact for quote- and order-related enquiries and escalations, providing clear and proactive updates on order status, fulfilment, invoicing, vehicle readiness, and delivery.

• Process Improvement: Identify and implement scalable processes, documentation, training materials, system enhancements, and automation opportunities that improve operational efficiency, consistency, and accuracy.

• Continuous Improvement: Analyze recurring errors, process gaps, system limitations, and operational risks to identify root causes, proactively raise improvement opportunities, and drive corrective actions with cross-functional stakeholders.

What You Bring

Minimum Qualifications & Skills

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in order management, sales operations, supply chain operations, fulfilment, or a similar operational role, with a strong understanding of end-to-end order-to-delivery processes and their downstream operational impact.

• A completed vocational or higher-education qualification, or equivalent relevant professional experience in business operations, supply chain, automotive operations, logistics, or a related field.

• Hands-on, proactive self-starter who can work independently, navigate ambiguity, and turn complex or undefined operational requirements into clear, structured, and actionable outcomes.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently manage priorities, drive issues to resolution, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex transactional workflows, investigate discrepancies to determine root causes, identify recurring issues, prioritize competing requirements, and maintain a high degree of accuracy across multiple systems.

• Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify trends, recurring issues, and process inefficiencies, ask the right questions, challenge the status quo, and drive improvements that enhance operational performance and customer experience.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, IT, and Finance-related functions.

• Fluent in English, other European languages a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, or evolving operational environment where processes and systems are still being developed.

• Experience in automotive order management, vehicle delivery, vehicle allocation, registration, invoicing, or a comparable mobility environment.

• Additional European language proficiency (e.g., German, French, or Norwegian) is highly desirable, with a strong preference for French and/or German.

• Working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP, Microsoft Excel, Outlook, or similar order management, ERP, CRM, and reporting systems.

Work Requirement

• This role is based in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. The expected onsite working pattern will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager, Electro Mechanical Commodities (Starlink Aviation)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOURCING MANAGER, ELECTRO MECHANICAL COMMODITIES (STARLINK AVIATION)

The SpaceX Supply Chain Department is a critical player in our operations. To capitalize on our technical and market success, our team will execute large-scale projects that will define the bottom line for the company. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics, and inventory. As SpaceX becomes the overall market leader, it will position us to maximize valuation, fuel growth and ensure achievement.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and manage the supply base to support sourcing for the Starlink satellites, satellite subsystems and ground stations

• Provide weekly team status reporting, escalate to management when necessary

• Train and mentor, working to ensure that the team is continuously improving

• Work directly with key suppliers to develop and implement sourcing and cost management strategies that support existing platforms and new product development

• Work directly with key internal stakeholders to develop and implement sourcing and cost management strategies that support capital purchases and production consumables

• Understand the technical aspects of production equipment to identify opportunities for cost, space, and process optimization and use data analytics to identify and parse process related opportunities

• Utilize negotiations to maximize value, cost savings and priority in terms of delivery for SpaceX while lowering risk; manage costs to ensure alignment with program budgets

• Build and own overall project budgets, compile funding requests, and generate capitalization plan based on project timeline focusing on TCO of the categories managed

• Conduct research, perform benchmarking, and gather market analysis for assigned categories

• Communicate overall equipment status to the management team including schedules, risks and mitigation actions and respond quickly to changes to the overall goals, schedule, and architecture

• Create sourcing strategies to reduce risk, enable continuous cost reduction and align with company strategy on payment terms, cash targets, on time delivery and cost savings

• Build genuine relationships both internally and externally and drive cross-functional teams to achieve consensus

• Present value propositions to SpaceX executives, including those related to contract award, cost reviews, cost reduction strategies and critical supply issues

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; OR 7+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:

• Engineering

• Purchasing

• Contract negotiation

• Material or production planning

• Operations or supply chain management

• Material cost control

• Master production scheduling

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience directly negotiating contracts and sourcing global suppliers

• Experience with sourcing high volume manufacturing commodities (plastic injection molding, metal stamping, die casting, CNC machining, & production tooling)

• Ability to prioritize appropriately to meet internal customer and company needs

• Effective written and verbal communications skills, with strong ability to communicate to all levels of internal personnel

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

• Ability to conduct all activities with integrity and urgency

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Able to travel for short and extended trips as needed - up to 30% work week travel may be required, including international travel

• Must be able to work flexible and extended hours as well as weekends as needed

• This position is based in Woodinville, WA and requires being onsite

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay range:

Sourcing Manager: $115,000.00 - $150,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Systems Administrator 802
jobs.description:
Freedom Technology Solutions Group is looking for a Linux System Administrator (SA) to join our team at a customer site in McLean, VA to support a mission-critical geospatial data visualization application. The Linux SA will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of enterprise Linux systems. In this role, you will operate, monitor, secure, and maintain Linux-based infrastructure across physical, virtual, and cloud-hosted environments. Your focus will be on system availability, performance, backups, security compliance, and proactive operations, using automation, monitoring, and disciplined operational practices to keep systems reliable and compliant. This is a hands-on role for an experienced Linux SA who takes ownership and operates effectively in availability- and compliance-driven production environments.

Responsibilities:

• Administer, configure, and maintain enterprise Linux servers (RHEL 8) across on-prem and cloud environments, ensuring system stability, performance, and security

• Support cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, GCP), including provisioning Linux hosts, monitoring system health and resource utilization, and optimizing compute, storage, and cost as part ofday-to-day operations.

• Perform advanced troubleshooting of system, network, and application issues, using in-depth log analysis and system diagnostics to identify root causes and resolve complex production problems.

• Perform OS maintenance activities, including system updates, patching, performance tuning, configuration management, and security hardening in accordance with operational and compliance requirements.

• Develop and maintain automation using Bash, Python, Ansible, or similar tools to streamline system administration tasks, reduce manual effort, and improve operational consistency.

• Install, configure, and support Linux-hosted software applications, virtualization platforms, and associated infrastructure components required to support mission workloads.

• Document system configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guidance, and contribute to shared knowledge bases to support team continuity and operational maturity.

• Provide tiered help desk support to system users, including issue triage, escalation, and resolution.

• Participate in operational meetings and daily task coordination, providing status updates and collaborating with team members and stakeholders to support ongoing system operations.

• Participate in an operational phone rotation to respond to time-sensitive issues outside of normal business hours.

Key Technologies

• Software: Apache Webserver, PostGres SQL/PostGIS, OMAR, OSSIM, RedHat Linux, FreeIPA, Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Internet Information Service, OGC Web. Services (WMS, WFS, WCS), Google Earth Client, Geospatial products.

• Hardware: Network Attached Storage (NAS) deployment and maintenance; firewall, switch, and router installation, deployment and maintenance; server.

Required Qualifications

• TS/SCI with Polygraph.

• Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field.

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as a Linux System Administrator or in a closely related systems administration role supporting production environments.

• Demonstrated proficiency administering Linux systems (Red Hat–based and/or Debian-based distributions), including system configuration, patching, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.

• Experience working with Elastic.

• Strong working knowledge of cloud environments, especially AWS (compute, storage, monitoring).

• Proven ability to analyze system and application logs (e.g., syslog, system journals, application logs) to diagnose issues, identify root causes, and resolve complex problems.

• Solid understanding of infrastructure fundamentals, including server hardware, storage systems, virtualization technologies, and core networking concepts.

• Experience deploying, maintaining, and patching open-source and custom applications on Linux platforms in compliance-driven or regulated environments.

• Experience supporting security and compliance requirements for Linux systems, including authentication and authorization fundamentals and support for ATO-driven operations.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, while also collaborating effectively within a technical team and communicating clearly with stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical issues and resolutions effectively in both written and verbal form.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-prem environments, including familiarity with AWS and other government or IC cloud platforms (e.g., C2S).

• Exposure to automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, as well as scripting in Bash or Python beyond basic operational tasks.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools, including Jenkins, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift.

• Experience supporting PostgreSQL.

• Familiarity with enterprise monitoring, logging, and observability tools and using metrics to improve system reliability and performance.

• Experience working with enterprise storage solutions (NFS, NAS, SAN) and backup/recovery platforms.

• Prior experience supporting mission, data-driven, or intelligence-community systems in classified or regulated environments.

• Relevant technical certifications, such as Linux (RHCSA/RHCE), AWS, Cisco, or related infrastructure certifications.

What’s in It for You?

Flexible work environment

A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

A work-life balance you can count on

Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. We provide thought leadership for complex issues through independent analysis, and we deliver practical, useful solutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. ANSER is seeking a Force Protection Planner to support enterprise-wide operational effectiveness with a focus on Force Protection within a Major Command or PACOM headquarters. In this role, you will provide oversight, planning, and advocacy for Force Protection capabilities to ensure effective protection of personnel, infrastructure, and critical assets across operational environments. This position directly supports operational forces through the development, integration, and execution of Force Protection programs. The role includes planning and implementing protection requirements within USPACOM OPLANS/CONPLANS to ensure the security of Department of Defense personnel and resources across the full spectrum of military operations in support of U.S. national interests.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities:

• Coordinate with Service Headquarters to provide Force Protection input into policy development, assessments, and service-level planning efforts

• Develop, integrate, and manage Force Protection planning requirements within USPACOM OPLANS/CONPLANS

• Support the development, staffing, and implementation of service-wide Force Protection policies, programs, and procedures

• Manage and evaluate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) supporting Detainee Operations, Identity Operations, Joint Security Operations, and PACOM Homeland Defense

• Deliver integrated protection program planning, analysis, and execution support for operational forces

• Conduct research and provide analytical support for Force Protection initiatives, including ad hoc subject matter expertise for training events and operational planning efforts

• Develop Mission Assurance, Force Protection, and security briefings, guidance, and supporting documentation

• Manage security programs, including site surveys, documentation review/approval, and compliance monitoring

• Support protection activities for forces in the PACOM Area of Responsibility, and gained forces across operational environments

• Produce required deliverables, including: Trend analysis and assessments Draft reports and documentation Briefings Meeting minutes and staff coordination materials Staff packages and Statements of Support (SOS) for specific issues Messages and official communications

Required Qualifications:

• Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility

• Bachelor’s degree

• 4+ years of experience in Force Protection, Mission Assurance, or physical security

• Demonstrated understanding of national-level security processes and programs, including Defense Critical Infrastructure (DCI), Task Critical Assets (TCA), Critical Asset Protection (CAP), and SCI standards

• Experience with clearance processing, physical security programs, and document control procedures

Preferred Qualifications:

• Background in Emergency Management related to Force Protection

• Experience with Mission Assurance Risk Management Systems (MARMS)

• Familiarity with security and compliance systems such as NIST, NISS, and DISS

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Overview

ANSER is seeking a Senior All-Source Counterterrorism Intelligence Analyst to support the Habeas Corpus Support Contract. In this role, you will provide critical intelligence analysis and classification/declassification expertise in support of legal proceedings involving individuals currently or formerly detained at Guantanamo Bay, Cuba (GTMO).

Key Responsibilities

• Review classified Department of Defense (DoD) documents, assess classification requirements, and develop recommendations for declassification in accordance with applicable DoD security classification guidance.

• Closely coordinate with intelligence professionals, legal teams, Original Classification Authorities (OCAs), and interagency stakeholders to ensure the accurate and timely handling of sensitive national security information.

• Conduct classification and declassification reviews of DoD intelligence documents, including materials associated with GTMO detainee litigation and Office of Military Commissions proceedings.

• Review classified information and prepare documents for downgrading or declassification to Unclassified/For Official Use Only (U/FOUO) or Unclassified/Public Release levels, including supporting summaries and explanations.

• Apply DoD security classification and declassification guides to evaluate the continued classification of sensitive information and develop recommendations for potential declassification.

• Prepare classified and unclassified intelligence summaries in coordination with OCAs or their designated representatives and attorneys supporting detainee litigation.

• Identify and coordinate classification and declassification equities with DoD components, military departments, combatant commands, and other national-level agencies.

• Collaborate with legal, intelligence, and interagency stakeholders to resolve classification questions and support timely document reviews.

• Produce accurate, comprehensive, and well-supported analytical products while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

• Master's degree in any field and a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience conducting all-source intelligence analysis or classification/declassification reviews; OR a bachelor's degree in any field and a minimum of 17 years of relevant experience.

• Demonstrated experience conducting all-source intelligence analysis and/or classification and declassification activities.

• Ability to independently manage complex assignments while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams and operating with moderate customer oversight.

• Proven ability to develop comprehensive, accurate, and high-quality analytical products requiring minimal revisions or editorial corrections.

• Strong analytical, research, written communication, and organizational skills.

• Ability to operate effectively in a deadline-driven environment involving sensitive national security information.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience conducting classification and declassification reviews across a broad range of intelligence and national security documents.

• Familiarity with DoD classification guidance and procedures established by DoD Component Original Classification Authorities (OCAs) or their designated representatives.

• Experience identifying classified information, determining appropriate classification levels, and applying classification guidance to support declassification recommendations.

jobs.title: Partnerships Lead, US
jobs.description:
Join Workwize as our first Partnerships Lead in the US.

We're expanding in North America and looking for a hands-on builder to own our US partner channel: MSPs, OEMs and other IT ecosystem players who refer and resell Workwize to their clients. If you know the MSP market, love building something from zero and want to carry your own ARR number, we'd love to talk.

At Workwize, we’re helping IT teams to easily equip their remote and global teams with all necessary IT equipment. Our automated SaaS platform simplifies hardware deployment, management, and retrieval with fast, reliable deliveries in 100+ countries.

With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we’re solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives.

Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide.

LinkedIn has also recognised Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands!

About the Role

As Partnerships Lead, US, you build Workwize's US partner channel from the ground up. MSPs and OEMs are the focus; VARs, EOR, HRIS and ITSM partners are important avenues too.

You own partner-sourced pipeline end to end: from the first conversation, to a signed referral or reseller agreement, to an activated partner bringing in new clients. You carry a direct ARR target.

You start as an individual contributor, take over the live US partner conversations and work closely with our EMEA Partnerships Lead, so both regions run one playbook. Outperform, and there is a clear path to Head of Partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

Build the pipeline

• Review all live US partner conversations and set a clear next step and owner for each.

• Run outreach to top targets, starting with MSPs and OEMs.

• Build and rank a larger US target list on fit: client base, lifecycle pain and appetite to refer or resell.

Sign and activate partners

• Build the business case for both sides and agree the commercial model per partner type.

• Sign referral and reseller agreements, then activate partners through enablement and first joint client conversations.

• Keep partners accountable after signature.

Report and scale

• Track qualified partner pipeline in HubSpot, with a next step on every deal.

• Report partner-sourced pipeline and ARR monthly.

• Work with Product and Engineering to scope and prioritise integrations.

• Share learnings with EMEA and build one repeatable global playbook.

Your first 90 days

• Month 1: audit of live US partner conversations done, first outreach wave live, target list built and ranked.

• Month 2: qualified partner pipeline in HubSpot, first referral or reseller agreements in legal or signed.

• Month 3: at least 3 signed US partners activated and first partner-sourced opportunities in the pipeline.

Requirements

• Direct MSP experience: you worked at an MSP, ideally working with OEMs, or at an MSP platform or ecosystem player such as NinjaOne, Pax8, Kaseya, ConnectWise or a master MSP.

• You built a partnerships or channel function from scratch at a B2B SaaS company.

• You structured and closed integration partnerships.

• You owned a pipeline or ARR target tied directly to partners, and reported on it.

• An existing network in the US MSP and OEM channel.

• A solid grasp of managed services economics, such as hardware margin and recurring per-user revenue.

• Experience with API commercialisation, rev-share models and co-sell agreements.

• Experience managing partner pipeline in a CRM, ideally HubSpot.

• You are based in or near New York and support our hybrid way of working, from our New York office and from home.

Bonus Skills

• A network with VAR, EOR, HRIS or ITSM players.

• Experience hiring and managing at least one direct report.

• Experience managing international partners.

• Experience in a high-growth scale-up.

The Right Mindset

• You execute without a full brief and come back with a recommendation, not questions.

• You qualify fast: within two meetings you know whether a partner has a real business case.

• You prioritise on commercial reality instead of treating every partner avenue equally.

• You are hands-on and enjoy doing the work yourself.

• You are a team player across regions and functions.

Workwize offers

• 25 days of paid vacation (European-style time off)

• 401(k) with competitive support to help you plan for the future Flexible work setups for better work-life balance

• Flexible hybrid work environment.

• Top-notch tools and equipment provided.

• Vibrant, entrepreneurial culture with opportunities for growth.

• The chance to shape how AI is used across an entire product, not just bolt it onto a feature.

Our Team

Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we will contribute to the change in the way of working. For us it is also important that we make an impact on our employees, that they feel challenged and ease. We consist of a rapid growing and ambitious team with all different backgrounds. OTE

jobs.title: ClickHouse Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

ClickHouse is the core piece of infrastructure at PostHog https://posthog.com/docs/how-posthog-works/clickhouse. Every product and customer relies on it to ingest, store, and query data.

We need someone to automate, manage, and maintain ClickHouse as we grow towards capturing trillions of events per year and having one of the world’s largest clusters.

This includes ClickHouse operations and scaling infrastructure, as well as node and instance-level performance optimization. We want to ensure that we have the right hardware deployed at the right time for each workload on ClickHouse.

You'll build systems and automations for the provisioning and scaling of our large ClickHouse clusters, handling over 100 PB's of data. You'll have the ability to investigate and experiment using the latest hardware that cloud providers have to offer in order to find the optimal setup for our solution. And yes, You'll have a budget to do this.

You'll be using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes to automate the dynamic provisioning of instances and work on a bleeding edge ClickHouse implementation, like open format backed tables, and not just maintenance.
We're also building a query optimizer for ClickHouse, which means you will work on query performance tooling.




YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF:

 - You bring OLAP Database Experience. This role is focussed on ClickHouse, but if you bring strong experience with other OLAP Databases, that's great. We're looking for people that went into the internals of ClickHouse and other OLAP Databases, not high level users.

 - You bring experience in automating Dynamic provisioning instances. Strong experience with utilizing Terraform, Ansible and K8s is important.

 - You bring experience with Scale and Complexity! We're building and operating high-scale complex data storage solutions, we need you to have experience with the challenges this brings.

 - You bring the Stack we need. We build using Python, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, AWS, and Zookeeper (An alternative to Zookeeper is fine) 

 - You’re ready to do the best work of your career. We have incredible distribution, a big financial cushion and an amazing team. There’s probably no better place to see how far you can go.



If this sounds like you, we should talk.

We are committed to ensuring a fair and accessible interview process. If you need any accommodations or adjustments, please let us know.

jobs.title: Manager, Manufacturing Reliability & Human Performance
jobs.description:
The field of gene therapy is growing rapidly and Genezen is here to meet the exacting needs of our clients. We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures.

WORKING AT GENEZEN

Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team.

JOB SUMMARY

Lead hands-on, cross-site improvement efforts to reduce recurring GMP deviations, prevent avoidable manufacturing failures, and improve batch success rates in gene therapy manufacturing.

Apply human performance principles, structured problem solving, standard work, and error-proofing to strengthen process reliability. Partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality, MSAT, and Engineering to implement sustainable improvements while maintaining patient safety, data integrity, and GMP compliance.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Champion a continuous improvement mindset across the organization, fostering accountability, innovation, and operational excellence.

• Lead a prioritized, multi-site portfolio of improvement projects focused on repeat deviations, preventable batch losses, and manufacturing execution reliability.

• Analyze deviation, batch outcome, and process performance data to identify recurring failure mechanisms, risk concentrations, and opportunities for prevention.

• Facilitate cross-functional root-cause and human-factors analyses, distinguishing process design weaknesses from individual actions; support Quality-led GMP investigations and CAPA without assuming Quality ownership.

• Design, pilot, and implement practical countermeasures including error-proofing, visual controls, simplified work steps, verification methods, and robust shift handoffs.

• Partner with Manufacturing and MSAT to investigate controllable causes of unsuccessful batches, including execution, process variability, material handling, equipment interfaces, and process interruptions.

• Improve critical standard work and execution practices with process owners; ensure changes to GMP procedures and records follow approved change control.

• Personally lead focused Kaizen and DMAIC-based improvement activities, from problem definition and baseline through implementation and effectiveness verification.

• Establish consistent, meaningful measures for repeat deviation rates, targeted failure modes, batch success, and sustained countermeasure effectiveness.

• Conduct shop-floor observation and process confirmation with site leaders to identify system vulnerabilities and reinforce reliable execution.

• Coach supervisors and frontline teams in problem visibility, human performance, structured problem solving, and practical prevention techniques.

• Replicate proven improvements across sites where processes and regulatory requirements are comparable.

• Communicate progress, barriers, and verified benefits to site leadership and Continuous Improvement; escalate risks promptly.

• Maintain strong collaboration with Quality, Operations, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Training, respecting functional accountability for batch disposition, investigations, and technical process ownership.

SPECIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Regular presence in GMP manufacturing environments and travel between company sites as business needs require.

• Flexibility in schedule to support critical manufacturing and improvement activities.

• Criminal background check required.

• Other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• At least 7 years of relevant experience in GMP pharmaceutical, biologics, or advanced therapy manufacturing, quality, or operational excellence.

• Demonstrated hands-on delivery of deviation reduction, process reliability, or manufacturing performance improvements.

• Experience leading cross-functional projects without direct line authority; gene therapy or cell therapy experience preferred.

• Working knowledge of cGMP, deviation investigation, CAPA, change control, and data integrity requirements.

• Practical expertise in human factors, error-proofing, standard work, process observation, and recurrence prevention.

• Strong structured problem-solving capability (e.g., DMAIC, 5 Why, cause-and-effect, risk assessment, and Kaizen).

• Ability to analyze batch and deviation trends, define defensible baselines, and verify sustained improvement.

• Manufacturing-floor credibility and ability to turn analysis into implemented countermeasures.

• Strong collaboration and influencing skills across Operations, Quality, MSAT, and Engineering.

• Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and commitment to patient safety and compliance.

• Ability to prioritize work across multiple sites and balance near-term delivery with lasting process control.

Essential

COMPENSATION RANGE:

• The anticipated annual salary range for the Manager is $130,000 - $165,000. Salary determined based on relevant experience, skills and education.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to meet the following physical demands:

Work Environment:

• Regularly sit for long periods of time

Movement:

• Frequently required to stand; sit.

• Occasionally required to walk; climb or balance; and stoop/crouch.

Vision:

• Frequently utilize close vision and the ability to adjust focus

Communication

• Frequently required to communicate by talking, hearing, using telephone and e-mail

GENEZEN'S CURES VALUE-BASED COMPETENCIES

Committed to Science
We are committed to scientific excellence, staying current with industry developments, making data-driven decisions, and pursuing innovation to advance healthcare.

Urgency in action for the patients
We operate with urgency and a commitment to delivering timely treatments to patients by accelerating our partners' programs.

Resilience & Grit in operations
We are committed to overcoming challenges, learning from failures, and persistently striving for success.

Execute with Excellence & Integrity
We are dedicated to delivering quality results and upholding ethical principals.

Solutions driven for our partners
We are committed to being a proactive, collaborative, creative and open-minded partner.

GENEZEN'S BENEFITS

• Paid vacation days, amount based on tenure

• Paid sick time

• 10 observed holidays + 2 floating holiday + 1 volunteer day

• 401(k) plan with company match up to 6% of salary

• Share Appreciation Rights

• Choice of several healthcare plans

• FSA and HSA programs

• Dental & vision care

• Employer-paid basic term life/personal accident insurance

• Voluntary disability, universal life/personal accident insurance

• Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

• Nothing in the job description for this role restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

• This position requires a criminal background check.

• Genezen is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Genezen participates in EVerify.

• Genezen is interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States; however, we are not able to sponsor visas.

Genezen has operates two locations: one in Fishers, Indiana and the second in Lexington, Massachusetts.

Fishers is a suburb of Indianapolis. Fishers was named the #1 place to live in the US by Money Magazine in 2017 for its livability, safety and entrepreneurship. Fishers is one of the fastest growing communities in Indiana and is dedicated to supporting a high quality of life for all its residents. Nearby Indianapolis is home to professional and college sports teams, the Indy 500, a growing art community and the world’s largest children’s museum--to name just a few reasons why this area is a great place to live.
