It boasts picturesque New England charm, tree-lined streets, and a vibrant community. Known for its pivotal role in the American Revolution, Lexington offers visitors and residents alike a blend of historical landmarks, modern amenities, and a strong sense of community pride.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Cobalt runs AI agents in production that test real customer applications. We’re looking for a Staff AI Engineer who has built and operated production agent systems and can help us make them more reliable, secure and cost-efficient.

You’ll set the technical direction for how we design, evaluate, ship and operate agents, and stay hands-on building the foundations our teams use. You’ll work across engineering, product, research and security, mentoring engineers and helping teams turn promising prototypes into dependable production systems.

Your primary focus will be our agent platform and production practices. You’ll also help engineering teams improve how they build software with AI coding agents.

What You’ll Do

• Set technical direction for agent systems across teams, including orchestration, tool use, context and memory management, human oversight and failure recovery.

• Design, build and operate shared foundations: evaluation frameworks, agent observability and tracing, execution controls, and model access with routing and failover where needed.

• Establish evaluation practices that measure task completion, accuracy, false positives, security and cost per successful task. Work with domain experts to build representative test cases and turn production failures into regression tests.

• Make agent workflows resilient to tool failures, timeouts, rate limits and partial execution, with clear limits on retries, runtime and spend.

• Work with security and platform teams to build in scoped permissions, customer data isolation, audit trails and safe execution of tools and code.

• Establish practical engineering standards: evals in CI, prompt and model versioning, regression testing for non-deterministic systems, cost and latency budgets, and staged rollouts with rollback paths.

• Lead model selection and cost optimization. Benchmark models against real workloads and make informed trade-offs between quality, latency and cost.

• Partner with teams on production readiness, incident investigation and improvements to agent reliability.

• Help teams use AI coding agents effectively across planning, implementation, review and testing. Measure the impact on delivery speed and software quality.

• Mentor engineers and technical leads through design reviews, pairing, internal talks and written guidance. Help teams adopt shared capabilities and improve them based on feedback.

• Work with product, research and security leaders to turn business priorities into a technical roadmap with clear outcomes.

You Must Have

• Significant software engineering experience, typically 8–10+ years, with a track record of technical leadership across teams.

• Hands-on experience building and operating LLM-based agents in production, with a clear understanding of their scale, constraints and business outcomes.

• A track record of improving agent reliability: building evaluations, investigating non-deterministic failures and improving success rates against measurable goals.

• Strong knowledge of agent architectures, including tool use, orchestration, planning, context and memory management, and the judgment to know when simpler workflows are sufficient.

• Experience running LLM workloads through managed cloud model platforms or direct provider APIs, including rate limits, failure handling and cost tracking.

• Strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency and fault tolerance.

• Experience with production observability, incident investigation and safe rollout of system changes.

• An understanding of security risks in agent systems, including prompt injection, unsafe tool execution and exposure of sensitive data.

• Evidence of impact beyond your own code: shared platforms other teams adopted, standards that improved outcomes or engineers you helped grow.

Tools and Practices You’ve Likely Used

We care more about your depth of experience and engineering judgment than experience with any specific tool.

• Agent orchestration: Framework-based or custom orchestration, tool calling and structured outputs.

• Tool integration: Model Context Protocol (MCP), APIs and permission-controlled tool execution.

• Evaluations: Automated evaluation harnesses, domain-specific test datasets and regression testing in CI.

• Observability: Distributed tracing, structured logs and metrics for multi-step agent workflows.

• Model access: Managed cloud model platforms, direct provider APIs and multi-provider gateways.

Nice To Have

• Experience with GCP, Go or Kubernetes.

• Experience building sandboxed environments for agents that execute untrusted code or interact with external systems.

• Offensive security, application security or security tooling experience.

• Experience introducing AI coding tools across engineering teams and measuring their impact.

• Public writing, talks or open-source contributions related to agent engineering.

Why You Should Join Us

• Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry

• Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities

• Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan

• Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)

• Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)

• Leverage stipends for:

• Wellness

• Work-from-home equipment & wifi

The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. jobs.title: Partner Development Representative
jobs.description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. We ship AWS modernization to production in weeks, data platforms migrated, legacy applications and databases refactored, AI agents running against real data, for mid-market and lower-enterprise companies in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, internet and software, manufacturing, and TMEGS.
Our delivery model is built around AI agents that absorb the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, schema mapping, validation, test generation, cutover rehearsal, that traditional consulting bills against human hours. Forward-deployed engineers work on top of those agents, embedded with the customer's team, owning architecture, judgment, and cutover. We commit to a fixed delivery date on a fixed fee. If we slip for reasons inside our control, the cost sits with us.
Most modernization doesn't ship. Ours does. That is the entire pitch.
You'll be the named Mactores contact for AWS sales teams across US territories. AWS account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers each carry a partner deck full of firms that all say roughly the same thing. Your job is to make them see Mactores as the agent-native firm in that mix, the one they route to when their customer needs a modernization program finished, not staffed.
What you'll sell maps directly to what AWS reps care about: we're MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and predictable on fixed-date engagements. Our founders built the agent platform we deploy, so deployment depth is a structural advantage and AWS reps make money when we win. The conversation starts on the same side of the table.
You won't run deep technical demos, a forward-deployed engineer does that. You set up the meeting, frame the customer's problem, walk through the agent-native approach in business terms, anchor everything in shipped case studies, and hand off to the FDE when the conversation reaches architecture. Then you close the loop: register the opportunity, keep the AWS rep informed, push the deal forward.
This is not a script-and-cadence BDR seat. AWS reps see hundreds of partner BDRs. The ones who get traction can hold a real conversation about the customer's modernization problem, not run through a sequence.

jobs.title: Model Partnerships - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenCreative brings together leading image and video models alongside our own audio models, so our users can make everything they need in one place. We are looking for someone to own our relationships with the model providers who make that possible, starting with video.

You will be the main point of contact for our model partners, help bring new models to ElevenCreative, and build partnerships that are good for our partners, our users, and our business. You will work closely with product, engineering, finance, marketing, and sales.

This is a green-field role. You will define how we work with model partners as the ecosystem grows.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Build and manage relationships with image and video model providers.

 - Identify and evaluate new partners and models to bring to ElevenCreative.

 - Own the commercial side of our partnerships, working closely with finance.

 - Drive marketing including joint launches, campaigns, and co-marketing.

 - Work with product and engineering to shape which models we offer and when.

 - Support enterprise sales on partnership needs for large customers.

 - Stay close to the generative video landscape and the models creators and marketers want next.


WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for someone who combines strong partnership skills with sound commercial judgment. You will thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or commercial roles at a technology company, ideally in AI or infrastructure.

 - Have deep familiarity with the generative AI model landscape.

 - Are comfortable with numbers and can connect partnership decisions to business outcomes.

 - Can manage several partner relationships at once and build trust with senior stakeholders.

 - Have worked cross-functionally with product, engineering, finance, and marketing.

 - Can operate with US and European timezone overlap, with flexibility for partners in Asia.

 - Thrive in fast-moving environments where you define the playbook rather than follow one.


BONUS

 - Experience working with AI model or API providers.

 - Familiarity with usage-based or credit-based pricing.

 - Experience running co-marketing or channel partnerships.


LOCATION

This role is remote. The team operates across US and European time zones, so the ability to maintain meaningful overlap with both is important.

jobs.title: 2027 Internship - Technology
jobs.description:
2027 – Internship, Technology

Programmes offered: Final-year internship, penultimate-year internship

Location: New York, Chicago

Programme duration: 10-week summer internship

Who qualifies: Penultimate or final-year students completing a bachelor’s or master’s degree

Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager operating across liquid asset classes and markets worldwide. Our approach to investing is scientific: we bring together data, research, technology and trading expertise to develop and run systematic strategies.

Technology is central to how QRT works. Over the years, we have built a global research and execution platform spanning geographies, asset classes and trading horizons, from ultra-low-latency systems to large-scale research, analytics and risk infrastructure. We invest heavily in engineering, automation and scalable systems because better technology allows us to test ideas faster, operate more reliably and tackle harder problems.

Our internships are designed to give students meaningful experience of that work. You’ll join a team, contribute to real projects and learn from engineers, researchers and traders working on live problems. The environment is technical, collaborative and demanding, with plenty of scope to ask questions, test ideas and take ownership. Strong performance during the internship may lead to consideration for a full-time graduate role.

Your future role at QRT

As a Technology Intern, you’ll help build the systems, platforms and tools behind QRT’s research, trading and investment activities. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, quantitative developers, researchers and traders, contributing to production technology and solving problems where performance, reliability and good engineering judgement matter.

Depending on your interests and strengths, you may join one of four Technology disciplines.

Software Engineer (New York)

Build the technology behind QRT’s trading and investment activities, from ultra-low-latency execution systems to global platforms for analytics, risk management and reporting. Our engineers connect the firm to markets, brokers and data providers, developing systems that process large volumes of data reliably.

You’ll work with experienced engineers, quantitative developers and researchers on a defined technical problem, making considered engineering choices and building something useful. Projects may include AI-powered static analysis, exchange simulator development, risk data platforms or trading interfaces.

FPGA Engineer (New York, Chicago)

Develop ultra-low-latency hardware that processes market data and executes orders. Working at the boundary between hardware and software, the FPGA team builds systems where small design decisions can have a measurable impact on latency, throughput and reliability.

You’ll use SystemVerilog, C++ and Python to help design, test and integrate FPGA systems into our trading infrastructure. Alongside experienced engineers, you’ll develop new functionality, verify system behaviour and investigate performance improvements, gaining practical experience with the hardware and development tools used in live trading.

Security Engineer (New York)

Help protect the systems, data and infrastructure behind QRT’s global research and trading activities. Our Security team works closely with Cloud, Infrastructure and Network Operations to understand system behaviour, identify weaknesses and build practical ways to prevent, detect and respond to threats.

You’ll contribute to security engineering, investigations and automation alongside experienced colleagues. Projects may include building agents to support cyber-security investigations, reproducing emerging attack techniques in isolated environments, researching vulnerabilities or developing tools that make security assurance more scalable and effective.

Infrastructure Engineer (New York)

Work on the on-premise hardware and operating systems behind QRT’s production trading environment. The Infrastructure team measures and optimises hardware performance, investigates Linux internals and tunes systems where small changes can make a meaningful difference to trading technology.

Alongside experienced engineers, you’ll develop a detailed understanding of how hardware and software interact. Your work may involve investigating performance constraints, testing system configurations and assessing improvements to reliability. You’ll learn to use evidence and careful analysis to make production systems faster, more stable and more predictable.

Your current skillset

• Eligibility: Penultimate or final-year students pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s in a STEM discipline, such as Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics or a related Engineering or Security subject, on track for a 2:1 or above from a leading institution.

• Interest in technology: You enjoy solving technical problems and are curious about how systems work. You’re interested in building things, not just studying them.

• Software engineering experience: We value hands-on experience wherever you gained it — through personal projects, open-source contributions, hobbies, internships or academic work.

• Interest in Software Engineering, Security, Infrastructure or FPGAs.

• Programming: Proficiency in C++, C# or Python, Systems Verilog

• Tools: Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or Bash, and tools and technologies including Git, SQL, GCC and Linux.

• Mindset: Curious, proactive and comfortable asking questions. You look for ways to make systems simpler, faster or more reliable and can turn those observations into practical improvements.

• Approach: Self-motivated, thoughtful and comfortable taking ownership of a problem.

Interviewing

• Application – Submit your application online. We review applications on a rolling basis, so applying early is recommended.

• Technical Assessment – Selected candidates will complete a coding challenge focused on core programming and problem-solving skills.

• Interviews – Shortlisted candidates will take part in interviews, either on-site at an assessment centre or via Microsoft Teams. We’ll explore your technical thinking, how you approach unfamiliar problems and how you work with others.

At QRT, interns join a team from day one, working on real problems alongside experienced colleagues. You’ll contribute to meaningful projects, learn by doing and have the support to ask questions, explore ideas and develop your skills throughout the programme.

The annualised base salary for these US positions is $178,000, prorated to reflect the duration of the internship. Interns also receive a signing bonus and a competitive benefits package, including healthcare coverage, access to a 401(k) plan, and breakfast and lunch. Beyond the work, there’s plenty happening in the office, from gym sessions and board game nights to team socials and opportunities to get to know colleagues across QRT.

QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

jobs.title: Director of Business Development, Enterprise Partnerships
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States of America
jobs.description:
At Liberis, our mission is to empower small and medium-sized businesses by removing finance as a friction to growth, delivering contextual, embedded financial solutions to support merchants at every stage of their business lifecycle.

The team

The Business Development team identifies and secures new enterprise partnerships that drive Liberis' growth. We work with marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, ISVs, payment providers and logistics networks to build compelling propositions, agree sustainable commercial terms and lay the foundations for successful launches.

We work closely with colleagues across Commercial, Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal and Risk to turn opportunities into commercially valuable partnerships.

The role

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to originate and close enterprise embedded finance partnerships, owning some of our largest and most complex opportunities across marketplaces, eCommerce, ISVs, payments and shipping/logistics.

You will build a strong pipeline and convert it into partnerships that deliver sustainable, profitable growth. You will draw on your existing network and track record of launching embedded lending, banking and payments programs to open doors with senior decision-makers, shape where we focus and lead complex negotiations through to signed agreement.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work closely with a Business Development Manager to manage deals from first meeting through to launch, combining strategic judgement with hands-on ownership of deals, working independently and bringing colleagues together to build compelling propositions and secure successful outcomes.

Your responsibilities

• Identify and prioritise strategic embedded finance opportunities across partner types (marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, ISVs, payment providers, shipping and logistics), verticals and markets.

• Build and manage your own pipeline, with accountability for acquisition targets and the commercial value of new agreements.

• Personally originate and lead major enterprise opportunities, from initial engagement through to signed agreement, tapping your existing network of senior contacts.

• Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and navigate complex partner organisations, including product, payments, risk, legal and finance teams.

• Shape partnership propositions for embedded lending, banking and payments that address partner priorities, meet merchant needs and create attractive economics for Liberis.

• Develop high-quality presentations, proposals and commercial models that support partner decisions.

• Lead commercial negotiations, balancing growth potential, profitability, delivery requirements and risk.

• Secure internal alignment for opportunities, present clear business cases and resolve barriers to progress.

• Maintain reliable forecasts and give senior leadership a clear view of deal progress, key decisions and risks.

• Work with implementation and partner management teams to ensure agreed commitments are achievable and partnerships are set up to deliver.

• Bring market and partner insight into decisions on product development, competitive positioning and expansion.

• Contribute to best practice across Business Development through your experience, insight and approach to complex deals.

• Represent Liberis at industry events and develop relationships that create new commercial opportunities.

What we are looking for

Experience

• 10 or more years in enterprise sales, business development or strategic partnerships, with a significant portion selling embedded lending, banking or payments solutions to enterprise platforms.

• A proven record of originating and closing embedded finance programs: signed clients or partnerships you have personally secured, with measurable commercial results.

• A strong track record of personally securing substantial B2B partnerships involving complex negotiations and multiple decision-makers.

• Experience independently managing long enterprise deal cycles, from origination through to commercial agreement and launch.

Network and market knowledge

• An established network of senior contacts across marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, ISVs, payment providers (PSPs, acquirers, processors) and/or shipping and logistics companies, with the ability to open executive-level conversations.

• A strong understanding of fintech, payments, SaaS and embedded finance, and how platforms monetise and serve small businesses.

Commercial and influencing skills

• Confidence assessing commercial models (revenue share, referral and funding economics), challenging assumptions and translating opportunities into credible business cases.

• Experience influencing senior stakeholders internally and externally, including executives at large organisations.

Nice to have

• Experience in small business lending, merchant cash advance or revenue-based financing.

• Familiarity with API and platform integrations, and with the regulatory and risk considerations of offering financial products through a partner.

And there’s plenty more! Enjoy 25 days’ PTO, competitive healthcare benefits and up to 60 days per year working from anywhere. Apply to discover the full benefits package and what life at Liberis has to offer.

Think this sounds like the right next move for you? Or if you’re not completely confident that you fit our exact criteria, apply anyway and we can arrange a call to see if the role is fit for you. Humility is a wonderful thing, and we are interested in hearing about what you can add to Liberis!

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner - AI & Agents
jobs.description:
Who is Rainforest?

Rainforest is an early stage payments-as-a-service startup that has developed a solution that makes monetizing payments for vertically focused software platforms fair and simple. 

We focus on small-to-mid sized platforms that want to add value to their small business customers through embedded payments — and want to do so without adding operational or regulatory burdens or costs. 

Led by a successful repeat fintech founder with deep knowledge of the industry, and with venture backing from a Top 10 VC firm, Rainforest is well positioned to make an impact in the payments-as-a-service space, and we're looking for new team members who want to be a part of this journey!

Who are we looking for?

Rainforest is looking for a deeply technical Product Manager for our AI & Agents team. You'll own the agentic products that help vertical SaaS platforms run and grow their payments programs.

This isn't a traditional PM role. We need someone who understands how agentic products are built from the inside: the harness around the model, the tools it calls, the memory it keeps, and the evaluations that prove it's getting better. You'll know you're the right candidate when you'd rather open a merge request with your AI coding tools than write a ticket about it, and when you have strong opinions about which model belongs on which task.

You'll also help shape how AI and agents are used across Rainforest, partnering with teams company-wide to bring agentic workflows into how we operate.


What are some of the high-impact opportunities you’ll tackle?

 - Owning the product direction for our agent harness, including the knowledge, skills, and tools that make it valuable beyond a thin wrapper on an LLM

 - Defining and building the evaluation, regression testing, and telemetry that keep our agents accurate as models and prompts change

 - Tuning agent behavior hands-on, from prompts to knowledge base to skills, in close partnership with engineering

 - Driving model selection and routing decisions across multiple LLMs, balancing capability, latency, and cost

 - Designing how our clients' own agents interoperate with Rainforest through MCP and agent-to-agent communication

 - Making product changes directly using AI coding tools and partnering with engineers to review and ship them

 - Serving as an internal thought leader on AI and agents, helping teams across Rainforest adopt agentic workflows

 - Representing our agentic products externally with clients and the broader market



This opportunity is for you if you have / are:

 - Hands-on experience building agentic products or agent harnesses, including tool use, memory, prompt assembly, and evaluation

 - Deep, current knowledge of the LLM landscape, including frontier and open-weight models and where each performs well

 - Daily fluency with AI coding tools and comfort making real code changes

 - Experience building evals or regression suites for LLM-based systems

 - Familiarity with MCP, agent-to-agent protocols, embeddings, and multi-model architectures

 - A strong technical background, whether from product, engineering, or an adjacent role

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex systems to technical and non-technical audiences

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving startup

 - Experience in payments or fintech is a plus



We offer a comprehensive health benefits package, unlimited paid time off, paid parental leave, a fun and flexible working environment, and continuously invest in our people and our culture.

If you require any accommodations throughout the pre-employment process, please contact our HR team at hr@rainforestpay.com

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

• Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.

• Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.

• Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.

• Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.

• Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.

• Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.

• Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.

• Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

• MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.

• Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.

• High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.

• Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.

• Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).

• Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.

• Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

• Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.

• Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.

• PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).

• OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.

• Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

• Openness to learn the required technologies.

• An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.

• Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

• Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need

• Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)

• Regular company events and activities

• Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits

• 401k Plan – 4% employee match

• Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss.  We know.  You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do.  Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss.  You just do that because you've always done it.  Well maybe it's time you moved up.  You want to be the boss?  Well now's your chance - Domino's is hiring bosses - more specifically General managers.  It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you.  Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math, and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible.  Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come.  You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery.  Go on, boss, show us what you've got.  Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS & DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens in your restaurant .  This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations.  You must set the example.  You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.  You will be in charge of making schedules, ordering product, training team members and hiring.  A profit share bonus is awarded to GM's based off controlling costs within goals.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's!  Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together.  At Domino's, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

- At least 18 years or older

- Preferred 1 year of restaurant management experience*

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Employee Discounts!

- Paid Training

- Perfect job for someone ready to build a career

- Earn up to 80 hours of paid time off!

- Great pay - With potential to earn more based off of our bonus program

- Benefits:  All team members are eligible for benefits (eligibility for certain benefits dependent on approximate hours worked per week)

- Profit Share

Did you know 90% of Domino's franchisees started out as Pizza Makers or Drivers?

-Paid sick leave per Oregon law

jobs.title: Behavior Therapist - Stamford
jobs.description:
At Aspire Living & Learning, we don't just talk about making an impact, we live it. For more than 40 years, we've supported neurodiverse children and adults across New England and Maryland as they discover their passions, unlock their potential, and live more independently in their communities. Our person-centered services evolve with people's needs, from education and behavioral health to residential and community-based supports. We empower people to live lives shaped by their own interests, choices, and strengths. Join our collaborative, mission-driven team and bring your skills to work that makes a real difference every day.

Aspire Living & Learning is currently seeking a Behavior Therapist to work out of one of our Approved Private Special Education Programs (ALL Academy) in Stamford, CT, providing services to children who have been outplaced to our program due to social, behavioral, and/or academic needs.

Hours: M-F 7:00a-3:00p

Location: Stamford, CT

Employees at Aspire enjoy working with a collaborative and dedicated team that values a culture of belonging and care. We take pride in offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

• 8-weeks of PTO annually, including personal time, mental health days, and school vacations

• Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance - Choose from multiple medical plans, with vision coverage included at no extra cost.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Saving Account (HSA) options - Use pre-tax dollars for medical and dependent care expenses.

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts with JOON - Monthly funds for wellness, fitness, commuting, childcare, pet care, and more.

• 403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Match - A 100% match on contributions up to 2% of your salary.

• Professional Growth Opportunities - Access to training, leadership and management courses, mentorship, and career advancement.

• Employer-Paid Life & Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Telehealth Services and more!

As a Behavior Therapist, you will work under the guidance of Special Education Teachers and Board-Certified Behavior Analysts to implement each student’s educational and behavioral programs. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with service providers, including School Psychologists, Speech and Language Pathologists and Occupational/Physical Therapists.

Our Ideal Candidate:

• High school diploma required. Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Special Education, or a related field strongly preferred.

• 2-3 years of experience providing direct support to children with disabilities.

• Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills and a collaborative approach.

Our Behavior Therapists enjoy working with a fun team of dedicated professionals to support children with a variety of needs. We believe in a healthy work/life balance, and our reputation for providing high quality, ethical services is one of our biggest assets.

Salary: $37,400 - $47,840 per year, based on education and experience

Aspire Living & Learning believes it must play an active role in creating a community of employees that is diverse, inclusive and equitable. Our work benefits greatly from the contributions of people of color, people from working class backgrounds, women, LGBTQ people, and individuals with disabilities. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

jobs.title: Domino's Delivery Driver - Newport, OR (9395)
jobs.description:
Company Description

JPC LLC is a Franchise with Domino's Pizza looking to provide opportunity to new team members who are looking for the FUN job, develop skills and grow fast within our organization.  Opportunities are limitless with Domino's!

ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers?  Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can.  What do we mean by that, you ask?  We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be.  You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area.  We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond.  Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online.  We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

- Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

- Deliver flyers and door hangers.

- Operate all equipment.

- Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

- Prepare product.

- Receive and process telephone orders.

- Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

REQUIRED SKILLS

- Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards.

- Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

- Held a valid Driver's License for at least 1 year.

- Possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain, including multi-story buildings and private homes.

- Use a personal phone for Domino’s Delivery Driver in store app.

- Criminal background check required.

We are a Franchise with Domino's Pizza looking to provide opportunity to new team members who are looking for the FUN job. Develop skills and grow fast within our organization. The opportunities are limitless with Domino's!

ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever! Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now, Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has a lot of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

Come see why other contract delivery drivers make more money with more deliveries per hour at Domino's!

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

- Deliver products by car and then to the door of the customer.

- Deliver flyers and door hangers.

- Operate all equipment.

- Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

- Prepare products.

- Receive and process telephone orders.

- Clean equipment and facilities approximately daily.

REQUIRED SKILLS

- Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards.

- Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

- Held a valid Driver's License for at least 1 year

- Submit to a criminal background check

- Possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain, including multi-story buildings and private homes.

- Use a personal phone for Domino’s Delivery Driver in store app.

- May have to drive and deliver in adverse weather conditions

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Full Time or Part time available! Or even just a day or two a week!

- Employee Discounts!

- Paid Training

- Flexible schedules!

- Perfect job for students or extra hours after another job

- Tips paid out after shift!

- Great pay - Our drivers receive a competitive hourly wage, plus tips

- Benefits:  All team members are eligible for benefits (eligibility for certain benefits dependent on approximate hours worked per week)

Did you know 90% of Domino's franchisees started out as Pizza Makers or Drivers?

Benefits:

-Health Care benefits for full time employees (30+ hours per week after waiting periods)

-Dental and Vision plans available to purchase

- 401(k) offered to employees after 1 year of employment and who are at least 21 years old.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

You were born to be the boss.  We know.  You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do.  Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss.  You just do that because you've always done it.  Well maybe it's time you moved up.  You want to be the boss?  Well now's your chance - Domino's is hiring bosses - more specifically General managers.  It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you.  Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math, and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible.  Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come.  You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery.  Go on, boss, show us what you've got.  Apply now!

You are responsible for everything that happens in your restaurant .  This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations.  You must set the example.  You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.  You will be in charge of making schedules, ordering products, training team members and hiring.  A profit share bonus is awarded to GM's based off controlling costs within goals.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's!  Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together.  At Domino's, our people come first!

jobs.title: OFICIAL PRINCIPAL DE PROGRAMAS - GESTÃO VETERINÁRIA, COMISSÃO DA CEDEAO
jobs.description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA FUNÇÃO

Sob a orientação e supervisão do Diretor Executivo, o/a Oficial Principal de Programa – Gestão Veterinária assegurará a formulação e implementação de regulamentos regionais e internacionais que promovam uma gestão veterinária eficaz, nomeadamente no controlo das doenças animais, na melhoria da formação veterinária e no reforço da investigação para o desenvolvimento dos recursos animais, contribuindo assim para a prestação eficaz e eficiente de serviços veterinários em apoio à segurança alimentar e nutricional, aos meios de subsistência, à criação de riqueza e à redução da pobreza, através da gestão eficiente da saúde animal na região da CEDEAO, em conformidade com os objetivos da Política Agrícola da CEDEAO (ECOWAP) e do Programa Abrangente de Desenvolvimento da Agricultura em África (CAADP).

Funções e Responsabilidades

• Apoiar os Estados-Membros da CEDEAO no reforço da gestão veterinária.
• Formular e assegurar a implementação de regulamentos e diretrizes veterinárias regionais e internacionais.
• Apoiar o aumento dos investimentos na infraestrutura nacional e regional de gestão veterinária, com vista a colmatar as lacunas identificadas na Análise de Lacunas da Organização Mundial da Saúde Animal (OIE) na região da CEDEAO.
• Formular, alinhar e implementar diretrizes regionais e internacionais de educação e formação veterinária na região da CEDEAO.
• Apoiar o reforço das capacidades e a formação contínua veterinária, explorando, em particular, modalidades de ensino e formação online.
• Formular e implementar quadros regulamentares e orientações regionais e internacionais em matéria de gestão da informação veterinária e de gestão de riscos para as populações.
• Apoiar e manter contactos com agências reguladoras veterinárias nos Estados-Membros da CEDEAO e outros parceiros regionais e internacionais relevantes.
• Promover e fortalecer relações de cooperação com a comunidade académica e científica regional e internacional, bem como apoiar a investigação para o desenvolvimento no setor da saúde animal.
• Promover a publicação regular, a nível regional, de documentos sobre regulamentação veterinária, formação veterinária e questões relacionadas com a investigação veterinária.
• Apoiar o estabelecimento e/ou o reforço de redes regionais de comunicação socioeconómica e de comunicação de riscos.
• Apoiar o fortalecimento da rede regional de regulamentação animal.
• Garantir o alinhamento das atividades com a implementação da Política Agrícola da CEDEAO (ECOWAP) e do Programa Abrangente de Desenvolvimento da Agricultura em África (CAADP), bem como dos projetos conexos.
• Garantir o planeamento, a formulação e a implementação adequados dos projetos, bem como a conformidade com os requisitos de financiamento dos principais parceiros multilaterais e bilaterais.
• Desempenhar outras funções que possam ser atribuídas pelo Comissário para a Agricultura, Ambiente e Recursos Naturais.

HABILITAÇÕES ACADÉMICAS E EXPERIÊNCIA

• Mestrado (ou equivalente) em Medicina Veterinária, Epidemiologia Veterinária, Saúde Pública Veterinária, Economia da Saúde Animal ou domínio afim, obtido numa universidade reconhecida.
• Dez (10) anos de experiência em negociações multilaterais e na assessoria a governos em matéria de mobilização de recursos para programas, incluindo seis (6) anos de experiência internacional relevante e cinco (5) anos em funções de supervisão.
• Conhecimento das políticas e regulamentações veterinárias relevantes que regem o desenvolvimento do setor de recursos animais.
• Experiência na formulação de projetos e no cumprimento dos requisitos de financiamento dos principais parceiros multilaterais e bilaterais.
• Capacidade técnica para desenvolver uma visão, missão e estratégia, centrando-se nas necessidades dos Estados-Membros e ajustando as estratégias em função da evolução das circunstâncias.

PRINCIPAIS COMPETÊNCIAS DA CEDEAO

• Capacidade de liderar programas e projetos atribuídos, fornecendo a perícia de gestão e operacional, necessária para o cumprimento do mandato da organização (por exemplo, estabelecer redes e referências).
• Capacidade de liderar pelo exemplo e organizar o trabalho de equipa para incentivar a cooperação para alcançar resultados esperados, defender e criar ímpeto para a mudança e trazer o afinco dos funcionários; Criar e implementar controlos internos para programas piloto para gerir potenciais barreiras à implementação.
• Excelentes habilidades de gestão pessoal, demonstrando ética e integridade, confidencialidade e o devido respeito dos controles internos de regras, delegações e transparência.
• Capacidade de reunir competências/conhecimentos complementares, avaliar contribuições individuais e reconhecer/abordar realizações e deficiências de forma a trazer sucesso contínuo à organização.
• Conhecimento de gestão de programas ao nível normalmente adquirido a partir de uma certificação em gestão de programas (por exemplo, Gestão de Programas de Sucesso (MSP) ou PgMP Profissional de Gestão de Programas).
• Capacidade de pesquisar sobre pontos de referência e tendências para trazer as melhores recomendações para a criação e melhoria de programas/projetos que melhor sirvam a comunidade/organização.
• Habilidades interpessoais e de interações bem desenvolvidas para buscar retornos de, informações e dados de uma rede de profissionais de vários países/setores/organizações e para identificar e priorizar os requisitos mais críticos da comunidade.
• Capacidade de gerir e coordenar iniciativas de gestão de clientes e fazer recomendações.
• Capacidade de desenvolver e implementar as melhores práticas nos serviços ao cliente (por exemplo, painéis, gestão de incentivos, mecanismos de retorno de informação).
• Capacidade de desenvolver e implementar planos, programas e iniciativas de gestão das partes interessadas para obter adesão a novas iniciativas, compreender melhor as opiniões divergentes, obter recursos e aumentar a perceção de sucesso.
• Capacidade de ser diplomático, tático e respeitoso com outras pessoas de diversas origens, com diferentes visões culturais, sobretudo na África Ocidental, com a capacidade de converter a diversidade em oportunidades para melhorar os resultados do programa/operacionais.
• Capacidade de criar um ambiente interativo diversificado e inclusivo que se beneficia de diversos pontos fortes reunindo práticas inovadoras.
• Capacidade de demonstrar objetividade nas apreciações, avaliações e gestão de conflitos, independentemente das diferenças culturais/posições, diferenças de género, e incentivar colaboradores a superar preconceitos e diferenças culturais e de género.
• Capacidade de servir os interesses de equipas/organizações/comunidades e povos culturalmente diversos e pessoas com deficiência sem preconceitos e diferenças ou preferências.
• Compreensão da estrutura organizacional da CEDEAO, dinâmicas conexas e expectativas necessárias para colaborar, participar, contribuir e liderar de forma eficaz.
• Conhecimento do mandato da CEDEAO, plano estratégico/prioridades, assim como da situação económica, política e social e tendências nos Estados membros, no que diz respeito à sua própria área de atividade.
• Conhecimento das melhores práticas da CEDEAO, abordagens de gestão de programas e técnicas de investigação para liderar e/ou contribuir para o desenvolvimento ou avaliação de programas, projetos ou iniciativas.
• Conhecimento profundo das regras e procedimentos da CEDEAO, a fim de interpretar e aplicar adequadamente as diretivas, fornecer conselhos técnicos, orientar os colaboradores e avaliar os desempenhos.
• Capacidade de analisar uma situação por meio de indicadores para avaliar os custos, benefícios, riscos e chances de sucesso, na tomada de decisões.
• Capacidade de reunir informações de diferentes fontes para identificar a causa dos problemas, as consequências de causas alternativas de ação, os obstáculos potenciais e as formas de evitar o problema no futuro.
• Capacidade de decompor situações/informações muito complexas em termos simples para explicar recomendações e conclusões destinadas a resolver problemas ou melhorar operações/programas/projetos.
• Capacidade de desenvolver novas perspetivas sobre situações, aplicar soluções inovadoras a problemas e conceber novos métodos de abordagem de problemas ou ruptura quando os métodos e procedimentos estabelecidos são inaplicáveis ou obsoletos.
• Proficiência em francês e inglês oral e escrito.
• Capacidade de comunicar com impacto, de forma clara, concisa, sucinta e organizada, transmitindo credibilidade e confiança ao fazer apresentações, definir expectativas e explicar questões complexas.
• Capacidade de escuta e de interpretação correta das mensagens dos outros, e de responder adequadamente.
• Habilidades e técnicas de redação (por exemplo, propostas, termos de referência, avaliações de programas, planos, processos empresariais) com boas capacidades de edição.
• Capacidade de dar opiniões francas, reconhecer, abordar as deficiências e motivar os colaboradores diretos a trabalhar com o máximo de empenho.
• Fluência em expressões orais e escritas numa das línguas oficiais da CEDEAO (inglês, francês e português).
• Habilidades de organização e de gestão de projetos/programas com experiência significativa na identificação de cronogramas, metas, custos e recursos necessários para obter resultados operacionais/programas/projetos.
• Capacidade de definir metas e objetivos eficazes para si mesmo, para os outros e para a divisão e ajustar as prioridades do trabalho ou do projeto em resposta às circunstâncias em evolução.
• Capacidade de identificar lacunas que afetam o cumprimento das expectativas do programa/projeto e de conceber e implementar planos de intervenção necessários para construir a capacidade desejada (por exemplo, formação, realinhamento estrutural, parcerias, reafetação de recursos).
• Capacidade implementar práticas rigorosas de seguimento e avaliação e para estabelecer calendários de apresentação de relatórios regulares relevantes para obter os principais resultados.
• Capacidade de planificar, organizar, controlar recursos e respeitar políticas, procedimentos e protocolos para atingir objetivos específicos.

GRAU: P5

SALÁRIO ANUAL: UC 59, 071.35/ USD 93,202.77

LIMITE DE IDADE: Ter menos de 45 anos

Método de avaliação:

A avaliação dos candidatos qualificados incluirá um exercício escrito e uma entrevista baseada em competências.

Ambiente de trabalho da CEDEAO:

A CEDEAO proporciona um ambiente de trabalho que reflete os valores da igualdade de género, da diversidade, da integridade e do equilíbrio saudável entre a vida profissional e a vida pessoal.

Estamos empenhados em garantir a paridade de género dentro da organização e, por isso, encorajamos vivamente as mulheres a candidatarem-se a cargos que correspondam às suas competências. Pessoas de grupos étnicos minoritários, populações indígenas, pessoas com deficiência e outros grupos sub-representados são também fortemente encorajadas a candidatar-se. A diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão estão no centro do pessoal da CEDEAO.

Isenção de responsabilidade:

A seleção e nomeação estarão sujeitas ao histórico de trabalho e verificações de referências e outros requisitos administrativos.

A CEDEAO não cobra quaisquer taxas pelas candidaturas, processamento, formação, entrevistas, testes relacionados com os processos de candidatura ou recrutamento e não se preocupa com a informação das contas bancárias dos candidatos.

Os documentos necessários para a candidatura incluem:

• Currículo
• Carta de apresentação
• Formulário de candidatura

O não cumprimento de qualquer um destes requisitos resultará na eliminação da candidatura.

Data limite para receção de candidaturas: 10 de maio de 2026

jobs.title: Gestor de Soluções e Valor do Cliente
Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

OpenGov is modernizing how governments operate. The infrastructure for that mission must be fast, resilient, and ready to scale. As a Sr. DevOps Engineer, you'll own the design and delivery of the cloud systems, CI/CD pipelines, and security architecture that keep our multi-tenant SaaS platform running for thousands of public sector customers. This is a high-ownership role for an engineer who moves fluidly between deep technical execution and cross-functional influence. This engineer builds AI-forward infrastructure that directly shapes how government services are delivered.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Architect and own OpenGov's multi-tenant Azure and AWS infrastructure, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery readiness at scale.

 - Lead infrastructure-as-code strategy using any IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or Crossplane), driving consistency, repeatability, and auditability across environments.

 - Design, build, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or others) that enable rapid, reliable feature delivery.

 - Drive cloud cost optimization and performance engineering across AWS and Azure services, balancing efficiency with reliability commitments.

 - Own the security posture of cloud infrastructure and partner with compliance teams on SOC2 and StateRamp adherence.

 - Establish and manage observability practices using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Azure Monitor.

 - Lead incident response and post-mortem processes with a focus on systemic improvement.

 - Serve as a cross-functional technical advisor to engineering, product, and security teams.

 - Translate business priorities into scalable infrastructure decisions.

 - Mentor and develop junior engineers, elevate technical standards, and build a culture of operational excellence.


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience with a deep focus on cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and platform engineering.

 - 3+ years running Kubernetes at scale in production on public cloud environments (Azure preferred).

 - Proven track record with AWS, Azure, or GCP infrastructure for SaaS applications.

 - Experience includes managed Kubernetes, databases, networking, and RBAC management.

 - Hands-on expertise with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or Crossplane) in production environments.

 - Strong command of CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or equivalent) and modern delivery practices.

 - Deep knowledge of cloud security practices, including encryption, RBAC, IAM, and network security architecture.

 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Go, Java, or Ruby).

 - Experience with AI-driven developer tooling, workflow automation, or agent-based systems in an engineering context.

 - Familiarity with ArgoCD or other GitOps-based deployment frameworks.

 - Experience with regulated environments and compliance frameworks such as SOC2 or StateRamp.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Head of Asset in Respiratory, Immunology Clinical Development
jobs.description:
Purpose

Manages other Medical and/or Scientific Directors and leads the direction, planning, execution, and interpretation of clinical trials or research activities of one or more clinical development programs. Participates in and may lead cross-functional teams to generate, deliver, and disseminate high-quality clinical data supporting overall product scientific and business strategy.

Responsibilities

Personally or through a direct report, leads and demonstrates ownership of the design and implementation of multiple clinical development programs (or one large, complex program) in support of the overall product development plan, based on strong medical and scientific principles, knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements, AbbVie’s customers, markets, business operations, and emerging issues. Oversees project-related education of investigators, study site personnel.

• Has overall responsibility for leading and mentoring clinical study teams, monitoring overall study integrity, and review, interpretation, and communication of accumulating data pertaining to safety and efficacy of the molecule. Along with Clinical Operations, is responsible for ensuring agreed-upon study enrollment and overall timelines for key deliverables. Responsible for assessment and reporting of serious adverse events per corporate policy and regulations for those protocols assigned.
• Has primary responsibility for and ownership of design, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of scientific content of protocols, Investigator Brochures, Clinical Study reports, regulatory submissions and responses, and other program documents.
• Manages one level of Medical and Scientific Directors (typically 2 to 4) and/or Clinical Scientists. This responsibility involves direct oversight of clinical development activities and/or management of personnel who may be working on other projects. Responsible for hiring, onboarding, mentoring, training, and supporting career development of these individuals.
• May chair Clinical Strategy Team(s), with responsibility for development of a rigorous, cross-functionally-aligned, vetted Clinical Development Plan with full consideration of contingencies and alternative approaches. In this capacity, responsibilities may include supervision of matrix team members and serving as the Clinical Research representative to lend clinical development and medical expertise to Asset Development Teams (ADTs) and ADT Leadership Boards (ALBs).
• Serves as the in-house clinical expert for one or more molecules and diseases in the therapeutic area, coordinating and leading appropriate scientific activities with internal stakeholders as they relate to ongoing projects. May participate in or lead clinical development contributions to due diligence or other business development activity. As required by program needs, contributes in partnership with Discovery colleagues to design and implementation of translational strategies.
• Acts as clinical lead and actively solicits opinion leader interactions related to the disease area(s); partners with Medical Affairs, Commercial and other functions in these activities as required, consistent with corporate policies, to ensure that broad cross-functional perspectives are incorporated into Clinical Development Plans and protocols as appropriate.
• Stays abreast of professional information and technology through conferences, medical literature, and other available training, to augment expertise in the therapeutic area. May represent AbbVie at key external meetings.
• Responsible for understanding the regulatory requirements related to the clinical studies and global drug development and accountable for complying with those requirements. Serves as a clinical representative for key regulatory discussions.
• Ensures adherence to Good Clinical Practices, pharmacovigilance standards, standard operating procedures and to all other quality standards in conducting research.

• Medical Doctor (M.D.), Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.), or non-US equivalent of M.D. degree with relevant therapeutic specialty in an academic or hospital environment required. Completion of a residency program strongly preferred. Completion of a subspecialty fellowship is desirable.
• At least 7 years (9+ years preferred) of clinical trial experience in the pharmaceutical industry, academia, or equivalent.
• Respiratory experience strongly preferred.
• Ability to run a complex clinical research program independently.
• Proven leadership skills and ability to bring out the best in others on a cross-functional global team. Must be able to lead and manage through influence.
• Demonstrated commitment to training and development of junior-level staff, using best judgment to assure that they work with an appropriate level of autonomy.
• Ability to interact externally and internally to support a global scientific and business strategy.
• Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology, regulatory and compliance requirements governing clinical trials, and experience in development of clinical strategy and the design of study protocols.
• Must possess excellent oral and written English communication skills
• Ability to exercise judgment and address complex problems and create solutions across multiple projects.

jobs.title: Game Operations Analyst, Sports (Remote - Estonia, Service Provider)
jobs.description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com.

THE ROLE:

Join the Genius team behind GeniusIQ, our live game tracking technology, and help build a brand-new Game Operations team in Estonia. You’ll help ensure our tracking and event data is accurate and on time, supporting the Game Operations team and leading a group of Operators during live football and basketball games.

A fully remote hourly paid Service Provider position in Game Operations is a great fit if you:

• Want a flexible side hustle alongside your studies or main job

• Love sports and want to get your foot in the door of sports tech

• Are happy with routine tasks and enjoy being part of the live action

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Set up and configure GeniusIQ software for live games

• Confirm correct tracking of dead balls, stoppage time and similar events

• Identify and confirm teams, lineups and players

• Stay alert during live play and report issues to your mentor

• Complete marking tasks that improve the accuracy of our system

• Lead a group of Operators on 1-2 football games per task

• Lead training for newly signed Operators

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

• Your own setup: a personal laptop or computer (not too old) with at least 512GB storage, and an internet connection of at least 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload

• Around 40-80 hours of tasks per month on average, mostly evenings, weekends and holiday periods, with fewer tasks in the summer (following the sports schedule).

• General computer literacy, particularly Excel or Google Sheets

• Football knowledge (any additional sport is a bonus)

• High attention to detail and the ability to focus in loud, distracting environments

• Extreme punctuality, as many tasks start near game start time

• Excellent communication skills, especially under pressure, to update your mentor and give feedback to Operators

• Ability to make time-sensitive judgment calls and collaborate with remote colleagues during live events

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports.

Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.
