jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Downtown - OR (7229)
jobs.description:
The following general description applies to all hourly store team members. Please read the detailed information listed below.

Job Duties: Operate all equipment

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone/internet orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training: Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills: Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions. Ability to communicate verbal with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change. Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed. Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions: EXPOSURE TO: Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks. In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas. Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside. Fumes from food odors. Exposure to cornmeal dust. Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler. Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher. Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING: Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks. Depth perception. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS: The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

Physical Demands

STANDING: Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

WALKING: Walking is generally in short distances for short durations.

SITTING: Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

LIFTING: Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck. Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3 x 1.5. Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72high.

CARRYING: Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves. Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store. Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

PUSHING: Pushing is performed to move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push. Trays may also be pulled.

CLIMBING: Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, and perform maintenance.

STOOPING/BENDING: Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

CROUCHING/SQUATTING: Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Additional Job Details

REACHING: Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward. Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

HAND TASKS: Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day. Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists. Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter. Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes. Team members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, WORK AIDS: Team members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

In addition to all of the above, the following applies to team members in driver or store management positions.

Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer. Deliver flyers and door hangers. Requires valid driver’s license with safe driving record meeting company standards. Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

Essential Skills

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area. Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Physical Demands

CARRYING: During delivery, carry pizzas, sides and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

DRIVING: Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A team member may make several deliveries per shift.

WALKING: Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer’s location.

CLIMBING: During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO: Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING: Far vision and night vision for driving.

401(k) offered to employees after 1 year of employment and who are at least 21 years old.

Elaborar relatórios internos diários e mensais de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos.

Tratar os pedidos de serviço na lista de tarefas pessoal dentro dos prazos acordados.

Cumprir o processo de integração de clientes estabelecido

Adotar princípios e tecnologias de gestão de carteiras com o objetivo de melhorar a experiência dos colaboradores e dos clientes. Orientar os colaboradores sobre os comportamentos necessários para apoiar a gestão da relação com o cliente.

Realizar uma análise da cadeia de valor do cliente para compreender melhor as suas necessidades, identificar oportunidades de vendas e implementar soluções bancárias para satisfazer essas necessidades.

Realizar uma análise da cadeia de valor para todos os clientes, a fim de compreender melhor as suas necessidades e aplicar soluções adequadas. Realizar uma análise da cadeia de valor para todos os clientes, a fim de compreender melhor as suas necessidades e aplicar soluções adequadas.

Recolher continuamente informações relevantes sobre as principais tendências e/ou mudanças nos setores em que o cliente opera, de modo a permitir a partilha proativa de informações com o cliente.

Desenvolver e implementar as melhores práticas de crescimento de receitas, em apoio à proposta de valor comercial e às expectativas do cliente.

Impulsionar os orçamentos de crescimento de receitas definidos por produto em todo o portfólio de clientes comerciais.

Promover formas integradas de trabalho e colaboração ao longo da cadeia de valor para satisfazer as necessidades do cliente. Garantir que as informações sobre os clientes sejam precisas e atualizadas.

Assegurar a implementação da proposta de valor comercial e manter-se a par das alterações à mesma.

Planear e implementar revisões de crédito anuais atempadas para os clientes comerciais atribuídos.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

Every enterprise is putting AI to work on risk and compliance. But when a regulator or board asks how the AI reached an answer, most teams can’t show it. Sayari can. Our world model maps 10.6B+ records from government sources around the world. Our agentic AI works through them like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding back to its source.

We are hiring a Strategic Account Executive to own large, complex sales into Fortune 2000 commercial and financial services accounts across North America. This is an open seat, and we want someone who can start building pipeline now. You will sell to Chief Compliance Officers, heads of financial crime, supply chain and trade risk leaders, and the technology and AI teams now involved in every one of those buying decisions.

You are joining an established scale-up with real traction. Six of the ten largest global banks rely on Sayari, and you will help shape how we take trustworthy AI to the enterprise.

Responsibilities

• Achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets

• Run complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, from first conversation through procurement, security review, and legal

• Explain how Sayari’s world model and agentic AI differ from legacy screening vendors, data providers, and generic AI tools

• Quote, negotiate, and close highly complex transactions

• Build and execute territory plans and develop net-new opportunities

• Maintain accurate Salesforce data and deliver reliable forecasts to senior leadership

• Bring competitive intelligence and customer feedback on trends, opportunities, and challenges back to Sales, Product, and Marketing

• Perform other related duties as assigned

Skills & Experience

• 5+ years in field sales with enterprise security, compliance, risk software, or data vendors

• Proven track record running complex sales processes and executing growth strategies

• Consistent top 20% performance against quota

• Credibility with AI and data buyers. You can explain agentic AI and data provenance to a compliance leader and a CTO in the same week

• Ability to tailor your message to different audiences. You know what to say and how to say it

• Experience using Salesforce

• Ability to travel up to 25%

Compensation

Base salary of up to $180,000 USD, with a 50/50 split between base and uncapped commission. Equity is included. Final offer amounts depend on location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, and internal peer equity.

Benefits

• 100% paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents

• Generous time off: all US federal holidays, a company-wide winter break (12/24-12/31), 18 PTO days, and 10 sick days

• Uncapped commission for revenue roles

• 401(k) match up to 5%

• 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage)

• Parental leave

• A collaborative culture. Your team will be as smart and driven as you

• Ongoing growth and learning opportunities

Equal Opportunity

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
This role can be based in any of our US Offices

Job Summary:

The Senior Technical Delivery Manager is a pivotal role within the Event Technology Operations team, responsible for the strategic vision of technology solutions in addition to the delivery of those solutions across multiple projects. This position combines technical expertise, project management skills, and stakeholder communication to manage internal partnerships and vendor relationships effectively. The Senior Technical Delivery Manager plays a critical role in aligning technical readiness with project milestones, driving platform adoption, providing strategic recommendations on platform configuration and ensuring the successful implementation of event technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Oversight & Delivery

• Collaborate with Senior Project Managers on strategy and scrum teams to ensure the accurate and timely delivery of event technology solutions.
• Lead platform configuration, testing, and integration across registration, exhibitor management, attendee engagement tools, and other event technology systems.
• Provide technical expertise and support for Salesforce and other key platforms, ensuring data integrity, proper configuration, and optimised workflows.
• Own and manage processes for platform governance, including user access, permissions, system roles, and process standardisation.
• Create and manages processes for Technical Delivery Managers on QA and UAT for all deliverables, ensuring high-quality execution.
• Manages integration implementation between platforms, including documentation and communication

Stakeholder & Vendor Communication

• Manage relationships between internal teams and vendors, ensuring alignment, clarity, and shared ownership of outcomes.
• Facilitate communication between technical leads, operations teams, and vendors to address risks, dependencies, and system issues proactively.
• Represent technical delivery in transformation efforts, market onboarding programs, and M&A integrations.
• Provide clear and timely updates to internal stakeholders, proactively flagging risks or dependencies.
• Provide recommendations and solutions to internal stakeholders for platform enhancements and efficiencies.

Project Management & Collaboration

• Apply Agile and SCRUM methodologies to manage scope, timelines, and deliverables across concurrent workstreams.
• Collaborate with Senior Project Manager and Senior CI Manager on the strategic vision of projects, aligning technical readiness with event milestones and onsite execution plans.
• Oversee Technical Delivery Manager's project plans and ticket queue ensuring tasks are completed by project deadlines
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of delivery playbooks, workflows, and best practices to support scalability and consistency.
• Facilitates stakeholder education by sharing platform capabilities, use cases, and insights from previous events.

Platform Administration & Innovation

• Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for event technology platforms, including Salesforce, Swapcard, Stova, ExpoPlatform, and other tools.
• Documents opportunities for platform enhancements/efficiencies and leads communication with vendors to implement improvements.
• Works directly with Technical Delivery Managers to gather data on platform performance, triage risks, and escalate systemic issues while ensuring business-as-usual (BAU) support is effective.
• Collaborate with the Senior Manager, CI & Onboarding in onboarding new technologies and creating documentation and training materials for internal teams.

Risk Management & Issue Resolution

• Identify potential risks and proactively develop resolutions to mitigate them before they impact project delivery.
• Analyse and resolve issues related to platform integrations, system bugs, and new feature requests.
• Act as the liaison between users and platform vendors, focusing on system bugs and new feature requests.

Essential Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
• Minimum 5 years of experience in platform administration, technical delivery, or system development.
• Strong understanding of API integrations
• Hands-on experience with event technology platforms such as Swapcard, Stova, ExpoPlatform, and top-tier registration vendors.
• Strong understanding of Agile/SCRUM methodologies and project management principles.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously with attention to detail and effective prioritisation.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
• Preferred Attributes:
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Visio, and platform documentation tools.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and recommendation skills.
• CSS and HTML coding experience preferred
• High attention to detail with the ability to handle sensitive access roles and system-level permissions professionally.
• Comfortable working in matrixed environments and managing technical teams.
• Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 4-6 times per year) to support onsite execution.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at an Informa event – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

We work hard to make sure Life at Informa is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. Here’s some of what you can expect when you join us. But don’t just take our word for it – see what our colleagues have to say at LifeAt.Informa.com

• Great community: a welcoming culture with in-person and online social events, our fantastic Walk the World charity day and active colleague groups and networks promoting a positive, supportive, and collaborative work environment
• Broader impact: take up to four days per year to volunteer, with charity match funding available too

• Competitive benefits, including a 401k match, health, vision and dental insurance, parental leave and an ESPP offering company shares at a minimum 15% discount
• Strong wellbeing support through EAP assistance, mental health first aiders, free access to a wellness app and more
• Recognition for great work, with global awards and kudos programs
• As an international company, the chance to collaborate with teams around the world

The salary range for this role is $65,000- $80,000 based on experience.

This role will be unpublished on 12th December, 2026

- Operate all equipment.

- Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

- Prepare products.

- Receive and process telephone orders.

- Clean equipment and facilities daily.

- Employee Discounts!

- Paid Training

- Flexible schedules!

- Perfect job for students or extra hours after another job

- Tips paid out after shift!

- Benefits:  All team members are eligible for benefits (eligibility for certain benefits dependent on approximate hours worked per week)

Qualifications

- Must be 18 years of age.

- Held a valid Driver's License for at least 1 year.

- A safe driving record meeting company standards. (no more than 2 traffic violations within the last 3 years)

- Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

- Submit to a criminal background check

- Possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain, including multi-story buildings and private homes.

jobs.description:
Your Role as a Data Entry Specialist:

As a Data Entry Specialist, you will enter information from a variety of sources into our systems, helping ensure our clients receive reliable, high-quality data. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and enjoys working in a fast-paced environment.

A Day in the Life of a Data Entry Specialist:

In this role, you will analyze and process information from filings and other digital sources, accurately entering data into our systems while following established standards and procedures. You will review records for completeness and accuracy, identify and correct discrepancies, and ensure data integrity before submission.

You’ll work independently while collaborating with teammates to meet production goals and quality standards. Throughout the day, you may also track corrections, identify trends or recurring issues, and contribute to process improvements that enhance data quality and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

• Enter data accurately and efficiently into internal systems following established formatting and classification standards.
• Review records for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
• Identify and correct omissions, formatting issues, and logical inconsistencies.
• Track edits, corrections, and exceptions to support auditing and continuous process improvement efforts.
• Meet productivity and quality expectations in a high-volume environment.
• Collaborate with team members to ensure timely completion of work.

What You'll Need:

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Comfortable managing repetitive tasks in a high-volume production environment.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows.
• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.

Nice to Have:

• Previous data entry, records processing, administrative, or production-based experience.
• Experience working with databases or document management systems.
• Familiarity with quality control or data validation processes.
• Experience working in a metrics-driven environment.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Assistant Recruitment Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ACTAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As Assistant Recruitment Manager , you will own ActAI's global technical recruiting function and be accountable for building the engineering and AI teams required to scale the company.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Own technical hiring across ActAI, including AI/ML, backend, infrastructure, web, mobile and engineering leadership.

 - Build the technical recruiting strategy, team structure, hiring priorities and operating cadence required to meet company hiring goals.

 - Personally lead searches for critical and senior hires, from market mapping and headhunting through assessment, offer negotiation and closing.

 - Set the standard for candidate quality, ensuring recruiters evaluate actual technical contribution, complexity and relevance rather than relying on titles, companies or keywords.

 - Partner directly with engineering and company leadership to define hiring bars, target profiles, interview processes and final hiring decisions.

 - Build and coach a high-performing technical recruiting team, reviewing pipelines and raising the quality of sourcing, assessment and candidate management.

 - Use recruiting data and market intelligence to identify bottlenecks, challenge ineffective searches and continuously improve hiring quality, speed and conversion.

 - Build scalable recruiting processes and talent networks across the US, Europe and Asia without allowing process to replace judgement or execution.

 


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - 10+ years of recruiting experience with deep experience hiring software engineering, AI/ML or other highly technical talent.

 - Proven track record building and leading technical recruiting for a high-growth technology company while remaining hands-on with critical searches.

 - Strong understanding of engineering and AI talent markets, with the ability to assess the substance and relevance of highly technical profiles.

 - Demonstrated success hiring senior engineers, technical leaders and other scarce talent through proactive headhunting.

 - Experience building, managing and raising the performance of technical recruiting teams.

 - Ability to work directly with founders and engineering leaders, challenge assumptions and translate company priorities into executable hiring plans.

 - Strong judgement on talent, high execution speed and clear accountability for hiring outcomes.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience leading technical recruiting at an AI company, AI-native startup or high-growth technology company.

 - Direct experience recruiting AI researchers, ML engineers, applied AI engineers and senior engineering leaders.

 - Strong existing networks across global AI and engineering communities.

 - Experience building technical teams across multiple markets, particularly the US, Europe and Asia.

jobs.description:

ROLE

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

 


FOCUS

 - Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

 - Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

 - Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

 - Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

 - Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality.

 - Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data.

 - Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines.

 - Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback.

 


TECH STACK

 - Python

 - PyTorch / JAX

 - Embeddings, vector search and ranking models

 - Production ML systems and inference pipelines

 


IDEAL EXPERIENCE

 - Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

 - Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production.

 - Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization.

 - Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics.

 - Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets.

 - Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability.

 - Strong ownership, problem-solving skills

 


OUTCOMES

 - ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets.

 - Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality.

 - Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases.

 - Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable.

 - Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results.

jobs.title: Container Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. More than 9 million developers and 250,000+ customers now build on Supabase, and the majority of new databases on the platform are created by AI app builders — so the systems underneath have to stay reliable while they grow fast.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Container Engineering (ConEng) owns the internal container platform that runs Supabase's multi-tenant, multi-region services — the managed Kubernetes platform that other engineering teams build and deploy on top of. We own cluster lifecycle and cluster classes, multi-cluster and multi-region topology, capacity, scheduling, isolation and runtime safety, the higher-level platform APIs, the Kubernetes deployment contract and Argo semantics, rollout primitives, and runtime configuration and secret injection.

 

Your job is to make the platform itself trustworthy, observable, and cheap to operate at scale — and to raise the reliability bar for everyone who depends on it. This is not a gatekeeper role. You'll make the reliable path the easy path: building the automation and platform APIs that let product teams run safely by default, instrumenting what we operate, and making sure that when something breaks we detect it and recover fast.

 

The work spans three strength areas:

Tooling & ecosystem — deep knowledge of the container and orchestration landscape (Kubernetes, containerd/OCI, the CNCF ecosystem) and a clear point of view on how to compose it.

Software engineering — designing and building the platform's automation, controllers, and internal tooling as production code, including solutions that don't come pre-shaped by an existing tool.

Operational / SRE practice — the discipline (SLOs, error budgets, incident response, ORRs) that runs the platform at scale as a predictable one.

We expect you to be genuinely deep in at least one of these, and many of our strongest candidates are deep in two (usually leaning toward one). Bringing real strength across all three is rare and exceptional — and even then, no one is equally strong in all three at once, so you'd focus where you're most needed at any given time. Different profiles are welcome here; tell us which of these is your center of gravity.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Regardless of the skill set, all team members carry a share of the team's on-call rota, responding to platform incidents and driving them to resolution and follow-up.

Platform reliability & operations

 - Define SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for the container platform itself, and build error-budget policies that actually gate platform changes.

 - Own the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process for new platform capabilities and major changes.

 - Design and track metrics for platform uptime, and increase observability into the platform by capturing the right metrics, logs, and traces across the platform layers.

 - Drive the incident-to-improvement pipeline: facilitate blameless postmortems, connect findings to readiness gaps, spot repeat failure patterns, and push through systemic fixes.

Software engineering

 - Build and maintain the platform's automation, controllers, operators, and internal tooling — writing production code and shipping it, not just wiring together existing tools.

 - Design and implement the platform-side CI/CD and rollout primitives that speed up platform deployments while working within proper change and release management.

 - Implement and maintain security automation for the platform: intrusion detection, automated remediation, and patch management.

 - Identify and quantify operational toil, and build the automation that removes it rather than just documenting it.

 - Contribute to the platform's continual testing automation — the test suites and pipelines that validate platform releases are fit for purpose before they reach tenants.

Tooling, ecosystem & architecture

 - Act as a platform reliability and architecture expert — contribute to failure-mode analysis, dependency mapping, and resilience design for multi-tenant container workloads.

 - Evaluate and evolve the platform's tooling ecosystem (orchestration, runtime, networking, isolation, and observability stack) with a clear, opinionated view on trade-offs.

 - Improve system architecture to reduce infrastructure cost while balancing security, reliability, and performance across tenants.

 - Guide teams building on the platform to design sustainable on-call practices for their own services: alert quality, escalation paths, runbook coverage, and noise reduction.

 


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years in platform engineering, container/Kubernetes platform operations, SRE, or production infrastructure, and have operated production systems at scale and carried on-call for them.

 - Are genuinely deep in at least one — ideally two — of the three strength areas below (and tell us which is your center of gravity):

 - Tooling & ecosystem — know the container/orchestration landscape well: Kubernetes, containerd and the OCI/CRI standards, and the surrounding CNCF ecosystem (e.g. Argo CD/Argo Rollouts for GitOps and progressive delivery; Cilium/eBPF networking and the Gateway API; Karpenter/KEDA-style autoscaling; and workload-isolation runtimes such as gVisor or Kata Containers). You reason about trade-offs rather than reaching for defaults.

 - Software engineering — write real production code (Go and/or a comparable systems language) and can build controllers, operators, and platform APIs — stepping back to the underlying problem and building the right solution when no off-the-shelf tool fits.

 - Operational / SRE practice — are fluent in SLOs, error budgets, and operational KPIs; have led incident response and blameless postmortems; and have driven down MTTD/MTTR for systems you operated.

 - Have worked with large-scale multi-tenant systems and understand isolation as a spectrum — from namespaces, RBAC, network policies, and resource quotas through to stronger primitives such as virtual clusters (e.g. vCluster) or VM-class runtimes.

 - Operate confidently on AWS (multiple accounts, IAM, VPC) and are comfortable with infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi preferred; Terraform/CDK also fine) and Kubernetes.

 - Script and automate to eliminate toil rather than absorb it.

 - Communicate clearly with both infrastructure specialists and product engineers, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and iterating toward better systems over time.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building and operating a multi-tenant Kubernetes platform that internal teams deploy onto.

 - Familiarity with policy engines (Kyverno, or OPA/Gatekeeper) and cost-attribution tooling (OpenCost/Kubecost) for per-tenant chargeback/showback.

 - Experience with managed database platforms or Postgres.

 - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, or similar observability tooling.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.description:

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Automation Engineer, Provisioning & Onboarding, you will be tasked with building and maintaining the workflows, scripts, and system integrations that set up customers' product access automatically. This role is the bridge between the daily technical workflows of the Provisioning Operations team and the provisioning automation roadmap, where you will scope revenue-impacting initiatives, drive cross-functional progress with IT, and close operational gaps before they become incidents.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Ensure that SentinelOne is portrayed in a positive, authentic way as an ethical provider of reliable, effective, and scalable security solutions.

• Expand provisioning automation coverage to free the team to focus on high-touch operational needs.

• Partner with Product and GTM so provisioning workflows are built and tested ahead of new product rollouts, preventing gaps; identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks and process gaps before they cause high-stakes incidents.

• Connect Salesforce, licensing and entitlement platforms, and product consoles so a closed order triggers provisioning actions downstream without manual steps.

• Scope initiatives, write requirements, and drive progress with IT and Engineering partners on integrations, access, and tooling.

• Size and prioritize initiatives by revenue, SLA, and customer impact, and keep the roadmap tied to month- and quarter-end needs.

• Support the Provisioning Operations team's automated tools, scripts, and runbooks, and resolve technical blockers in daily workflows.

• Test automated pipelines for defects, monitor them, handle exception and approval routing for non-standard requests, and keep entitlement and compliance controls intact.

• Build reverse and conversion workflows that migrate customers and revoke access, reclaim licenses, and close instances when a term ends.

• Document workflows and exceptions, and report automation coverage, time saved, and error rates to leadership.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 5 or more years of provisioning automation experience.

• Experience with provisioning or workflow tooling and platforms, as well as Python, Workato, Make, and other automation tools.

• Experience with provisioning, entitlement or licensing, order management, sales operations, or customer support operations.

• Ability to turn manual, multi-step processes into documented, testable, automated workflows.

• Strong project scoping and prioritization skills, with the ability to connect technical work to revenue and SLA impact.

• Ability to meet tight deadlines while being extremely organized and detail-oriented, and to collaborate effectively with a strong sense of urgency and timeliness in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly and effectively, and to be enthusiastic, driven, and confident in clearly and persuasively articulating the company's mission, product, and business opportunity.

• Experience with Salesforce, including automation, flows, or integrations is preferred.

• Experience in the IT or Cybersecurity industry and prior experience in a SaaS provisioning or onboarding role are preferred.

• Embodying the core values of SentinelOne (Trust, Accountability, OneSentinel, Relentlessness, Ingenuity, and Community) is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - EHR
jobs.description:
ABOUT NABLA

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

Product development at Nabla is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads. As Senior Product Manager for EHR Integrations, you will own how Nabla lives inside the systems clinicians actually work in.

The EHR is where a clinician’s day already lives, and a large part of the Nabla experience happens inside it. Providers launch Nabla from the chart, and everything Nabla produces (notes, orders, visit diagnoses, codes) has to land in the right place, in the right format, at the right moment. When that fits naturally into how a clinician already works, Nabla becomes something they reach for dozens of times a day. When it doesn’t, even the best AI goes unused. This role owns that part of the workflow, and with it a decisive share of the experience our providers have with Nabla.

It is a rare mix of UX craft and technical depth. You will design workflows that feel effortless to a clinician mid-encounter, while reasoning about SMART on FHIR launches, embedded contexts, API surfaces and rate limits, data mapping, versioning, and the very different constraints each EHR imposes. You need to understand the technicality of each integration well enough to know what is genuinely possible, what is expensive, and what is a dead end.

It is also a deeply human role. You will go onsite with our clients, in clinics, EDs, and on inpatient floors, to see how providers really navigate their EHR and where Nabla fits into their day. Deep user understanding, empathy, and genuine curiosity about clinical workflows are the foundation of everything else.

You will work in a cross-functional squad of backend, and full-stack engineers, and partner constantly beyond it: with the other product squads whose features reach clinicians through your integrations, with Customer Success to deepen our understanding of clients and users, with the Technical Implementation team, and directly with Enterprise clients as you guide them through demanding change management.

If you thrive where regulatory, technical, and UX complexity meet, and you would rather solve the unglamorous problem that unlocks everything downstream, this role is for you.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Nabla’s EHR integrations across existing and new platforms as we expand.

 - Design the end-to-end clinical workflow from launching Nabla inside the EHR to exporting notes, orders, and visit diagnoses back into the chart, so it feels seamless to a clinician working under time pressure.

 - Go onsite with clients to observe how providers navigate their EHR and use Nabla in real encounters, and turn what you see into product decisions and strategic insight.

 - Build deep technical fluency in each EHR’s capabilities and constraints: APIs, FHIR resources, launch contexts, data models, release and validation cycles, so you can make sound trade-offs alongside your engineers.

 - Partner with Design to turn hard integration constraints into simple, trustworthy interfaces that clinicians adopt without training.

 - Collaborate across squads whose capabilities reach clinicians through your integrations, anticipating dependencies and sequencing work accordingly.

 - Bring Enterprise clients live, working with Customer Success and Technical Implementation to guide health systems through demanding change management, rollout, and adoption.

 - Define and track the metrics that matter: adoption across encounters, successful export rates, time spent in the chart, integration reliability, and support burden. Let them drive prioritization.

 - Prioritize ruthlessly across a roadmap that spans new EHR platforms, deepening existing integrations, and the reliability, testability, and documentation work that keeps all of them running.

 - Create alignment across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Go-to-Market, and leadership on priorities, progress, risks, and product decisions.


QUALIFICATIONS

Requirements:

 - 6–10 years of product management experience, including time spent in healthtech or another regulated, safety-critical industry.

 - A track record shipping products built on complex integrations (APIs, developer platforms, or third-party systems), including ownership of versioning, documentation, and partner-facing workflows.

 - Strong systems thinking: you can hold a complex architecture in your head, anticipate dependencies, and make sound technical trade-offs with engineers.

 - Excellent UX judgment, with a demonstrated ability to turn technical constraints into simple, intuitive workflows for non-technical users.

 - Deep user empathy and genuine interest in clinician workflows, and the willingness to travel and spend real time onsite with clients.

 - Exceptional collaboration and communication skills: you are equally comfortable debating a data model with an engineer and walking a health system executive through a rollout plan, and you create alignment across squads and functions.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information, competing priorities, and high ownership.

 - Location: based in our Brooklyn, NY office. This is an in-office-first role (not fully remote), with regular travel to client sites across the US. Full professional fluency in English is required.

Nice to have:

 - Hands-on experience with Epic or the Epic ecosystem (Vendor Services, Hyperspace, Haiku/Canto), or with Oracle Health (Cerner), athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, or MEDITECH.

 - Experience with clinical documentation, orders, coding, or revenue cycle workflows.

 - Prior software engineering experience, or the ability to write scripts and reason about system logs, API schemas, and data models.

 - Experience guiding Enterprise health systems through change management, go-lives, and multi-site rollouts.

 - Experience building products powered by ML/AI.

 - Working proficiency in French is a plus, but not a requirement. Much of our Engineering and Product organization is based in Paris, all work communication happens in English.


LIFE AT NABLA

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. 

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.




OUR VALUES AT NABLA

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.




DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.




AVOID RECRUITMENT SCAMS: STAY SAFE AND INFORMED

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com http://nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager (Strategic Initiatives)
jobs.description:
About ActAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

 - Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

 - Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

 - Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

 - Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

 - Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

 - Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

 - Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

 - Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

 - Comfortable working across different business functions.

 - Strong ownership and execution skills.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 - Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 - Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.title: Backend .NET Software Engineer - Payments
jobs.description:
About the Role

Are you an experienced Backend Software Engineer ready for your next challenge? The Payments Engineering Area is hiring! Payments Engineering is responsible for building the best payment customer experience from payment pages perspective and improving the offering of different payment options across global brands and markets that we operate within. We are an international team with some of the best people in the industry! If you are passionate about the latest technologies and can handle company-critical responsibilities, then this is the role for you!

What You’ll Work On

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable server-side applications using the .NET framework and related technologies.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, product managers, and designers, to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

• Develop and implement efficient and secure RESTful APIs and microservices to support client applications and integrations.

• Perform thorough testing and debugging of backend applications to ensure high quality and reliability.

• Optimise application performance and scalability through code optimisations, caching strategies, and database optimisations.

• Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to architectural guidelines, and best practices.

What You Bring

• Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS).

• Strong background in backend development, with experience in languages such as C#/.Net

• Knowledge of NoSQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server databases.

• Experience in design and implementation of distributed systems that comprise of multiple domain-oriented services.

• Understanding of front-end development technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• Familiarity with version control systems, preferably Git.

• Familiarity with containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

• Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.

• Proficiency in SQL databases both in writing queries and optimising performance

• Effective communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in backend development and actively contribute to improving development processes and efficiency.

Nice to Have

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• We don’t expect you to be an expert in all these technologies but would anticipate experience with some combined with a curiosity for others: etcd, Consul, Redis, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, gRPC, Orleans.

Benefits

• Hybrid working model

• Private health insurance

• Life insurance

• Wellness allowance

• Home office set-up allowance

• 24 days annual holiday leave + additional days for public holidays falling on weekends

• Flexible compensation benefits

• Remote working from abroad options

Who We Are

Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta.

We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands.

You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers!

Product Development at Betsson Group

Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 6 Tech Hubs – Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn, Malaga and Athens. With around 1,000 strong professionals, the Product Development organisation is spear-headed by our CTO-CPO with all our talented Area Teams working together.

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your next step, please submit your CV in English.

By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Compliance Coordinator - Syria Aleppo or Idleb
jobs.description:
Established in 1977, GOAL is an international humanitarian and development agency, committed to working with communities to achieve sustainable and innovative early response in crises, and lasting solutions to poverty and vulnerability. GOAL has worked in over 60 countries and has responded to almost every major humanitarian disaster. We are currently operational in 18 countries.

GOAL began operations in Syria in 2013 responding to the acute needs of conflict-affected communities. GOAL's areas of operations include but not limited to Aleppo, Idleb and Damascus Programmes focus on Food and Nutrition Security, WASH, Shelter, Livelihoods/ERMS and Emergency Response with an emphasis on cash and voucher modalities. GOAL Syria implements its programmes directly, with staff based in Syria, and through Syrian NGO partners. GOAL's programme works at the household and community levels to improve community resilience and household coping strategies

Job purpose:

The Compliance Coordinator “CC” will oversee the Compliance Department, ensuring annual compliance plans are developed/followed and are appropriate to the context and management requirements. CC will manage the Compliance team who work across all departments, including programs, finance, procurement, logistics, and human resources, providing timely advice on donor regulations and feedback on the effectiveness of the internal controls in place in ensuring adherence to those regulations.

Provide leadership and oversight of the GOAL Syria Compliance Department ensuring that all responsibilities of the Compliance Department are fulfilled in a timely and effective manner, making best use of GOAL’s resources and ultimately ensuring compliance with donor and GOAL procedures and policies

Duties, objectives and competencies:

• Lead and manage the Compliance Department, including staff supervision, planning, and performance management.

• Develop and implement annual compliance plans and monitor compliance across all functions.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks, ensuring timely escalation of significant issues.

• Provide guidance on donor regulations, organizational policies, contracts, partnerships, and grant management.

• Deliver compliance training and build staff and partner capacity.

• Oversee compliance reviews, audits, reporting, and follow-up on corrective actions.

• Ensure donor compliance, due diligence, sanctions screening, and regulatory requirements are effectively implemented.

• Support and monitor implementing partners to strengthen compliance systems and accountability.

• Coordinate donor audits, compliance investigations, and reviews, while escalating fraud, misconduct, or other significant breaches.

Requirements (essential):

• Bachelor’s degree in relevant subjects (such as Business Administration, Law, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, international trade, or a related field).

• At least 3 years’ experience in leading compliance, audit, risk management, governance, or donor compliance within NGOs or Business Sector.

• At least 6 years professional experience in INGOs or NGOs in related fields.

• At least 5 years’ previous experience in team management.

• Proven ability to develop staff and provide training on systems and procedures.

• Any previous experience in implementing organizational internal control, SOPs and donor policies.

• Strong knowledge of donor regulations, internal controls, and risk management practices.

• Experience in compliance monitoring, risk assessment, audit follow-up, and corrective-action tracking.

• Ability to manage and priorities a varied workload in a rapidly changing work environment.

• Previous Experience in reviewing donor agreements, partnership agreements, procurement processes, waivers, exceptions, and organizational procedures.

• Willingness and ability to undertake some travel for work purposes, as required.

• Ability to work under pressure to pursue multiple tasks simultaneously to successful conclusions.

• Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Trustworthy and honest.

• Fluency in Arabic and English

Requirements (desired):

• At least two years previous work experience as head of department.

• Diplomacy and negotiation skills.

• Master’s degree in related field.

• Previous experience in Anti-Terrorist Sanctions check systems.

• Previous experience in the U.S.G Vetting System "PVS".

• Data Analysis skills, including knowledge of Power BI and advanced Microsoft Excel

Interested? Then apply for this position via clicking on the "apply now" button and fill out the application form. All applicants must send a Cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages). Both must be in English.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

GOAL has the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with GOAL at the same grade level and with similar job descriptions, experience, and educational requirements.

Qualified female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

The application deadline is 09 Nov 2026 however, you are encouraged to apply immediately as we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis, therefore we may withdraw the position before the advertisement’s closing date if a suitable candidate/s is identified.

Please note that GOAL does not charge a fee of any kind or any other financial obligation at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training, induction) or other fees, or request information on applicants’ bank accounts. GOAL does not work with intermediary institutions and individuals or employment agencies during the recruitment process. If any fee or payment is requested from you at the application or any stage of the recruitment process, please do not respond.

GOAL does not accept any responsibility for the accuracy, errors or omissions of any of the information contained in translated advertisements by an independent party on other sites or through other channels.

General terms and conditions

Safeguarding

Children and vulnerable adults must be safeguarded to the maximum possible extent from deliberate or inadvertent actions and failings that place them at risk of abuse, sexual exploitation, injury and any other harm. One of the ways that GOAL shows this on-going commitment to safeguarding is to include rigorous background and reference checks in the selection process for all candidates.

Safeguarding Statement
GOAL has zero tolerance for safeguarding violations. All staff are expected to adhere to GOAL’s Code of Conduct and Safeguarding policies, including the prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (PSEAH). Recruitment is subject to safeguarding checks, including reference verification

Accountability within GOAL

Alongside our safeguarding policy, GOAL is an equal opportunities employer and has a set of integrity policies. Any candidate offered a job with GOAL will be expected to adhere to the following key areas of accountability:

• Comply with GOAL’s policies and procedures with respect to safeguarding, Code of Conduct, health and safety, data protection and confidentiality, do no harm principles and unacceptable behavior protocols.

• Report any concerns about the welfare of a child or vulnerable adult or any wrongdoings within our programming area.

• Report any concerns about inappropriate behavior of a GOAL staff or partner.

This Job Description only serves as a guide for the position available. GOAL reserves the right to change this document. Any published closing dates are estimated.  Due to the nature of GOAL’s work we aim to fill vacancies as quickly as possible.  This means that we will close adverts as soon as we have found the right candidate and this may be before the published closing date.  We would therefore advise interested applicants to submit an application as early as possible.

Thank you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, DevOps
jobs.description:
About Eko Health
Eko builds AI and digital tools to enable every healthcare provider to more accurately detect heart and lung disease – the leading causes of death globally. Our FDA cleared, industry leading products are used by hundreds of thousands of clinicians on millions of patients around the world. With Eko, clinicians can detect cardiac and pulmonary disease with higher accuracy, diagnose with more confidence, manage treatment effectively, and ultimately give their patients the best care possible.
We have strong venture capital backing from investors like Artis Ventures, Questa Capital, Highland Capital, and Mayo Clinic Ventures.
Recognized by TIME magazine in 2025 as one of the world’s top healthcare technology companies, Eko is one of the fastest growing digital health companies with products used around the world at some of the most prestigious health systems.
We have more than 8 FDA clearances including novel AI algorithms, and we invest heavily in quality clinical research and R&D to build and validate exceptional products for patients we care deeply about.
We’ve built a mission driven, high performing, talented, and diverse team of engineers, physicians, PhD’s, creatives, and technologists. We are committed to investing in each other and our mission to ensure all patients have access to high quality care.
We are headquartered in Emeryville, California and privately-held with world class investors and partners.


About The Role
Eko Health is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to maintain and evolve the infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment systems that support our cloud services and mobile applications. The role also carries meaningful SRE and SecOps responsibilities.

Today, AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines are handled by the engineering team itself. You would become the person the team turns to for deployments and for keeping servers running. You will help define processes, build security and reliability into our AWS infrastructure and delivery pipelines, and act as one of the first lines of defense when critical events and issues arise.

The work centers on backend infrastructure and DevOps, mostly with Terraform. You will stay closely connected to backend application development, databases, and APIs. That work supports Eko's hardware, software, and AI products in human and veterinary health.
Early Projects & Initiatives
Mature and upgrade the deployment pipeline.
Make sure cloud infrastructure continues to goes through the appropriate security processes.
Because the team has shared infrastructure work until now, a valuable first step is turning that shared knowledge into documented, codified practices, including runbooks and system design decisions.
About The Team
You will join a team of 5 engineers that report to a team lead. The others on the team are full stack engineers, with some focusing on backend and others in frontend engineering. The team has shared AWS, CI, and CD responsibilities. This hire will take on that ownership and work with the engineers who currently handle it.

Essential Functions
Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, cloud security posture, and observability monitors/alerts using infrastructure-as-code frameworks and best practices
Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines to build, test, artifact and deploy continuously merged code
Build self-service tooling and paved paths to enable downstream engineers to ship without infrastructure expertise
Upgrade security and vulnerability scanning into our CI/CD layer and help coordinate the triaging of deficiencies
Help harden the software supply chain with artifact signing, SBOM generation, and properly configured build runners

Expected Travel is less than 10%

jobs.title: Senior Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ACTAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Define how ActAI is seen by the world.

You'll create the visual identity behind our brand across product launches, website, recruiting, social media, presentations, merchandise, and marketing. You'll play a key role in building a global AI brand from the ground up.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Develop and evolve ActAI's visual identity.

 - Design launch materials, marketing assets, presentations, and social content.

 - Design graphics for our website, recruiting, events, and merchandise.

 - Create and maintain brand guidelines and design templates.

 - Ensure consistency across all visual communications.

 


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - Strong portfolio in visual or brand design.

 - Excellent typography, layout, and visual communication skills.

 - High attention to detail.

 - Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

 - Ability to turn ideas into polished visual assets.

 


HOW WE WORK

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design challenge.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Duty Management Intern
jobs.description:
Let your passion shine as Duty Management Trainee

Belong in a place where you can be yourself and love what you do. Join our hotel community/ us and we will support you to realise your potential. You will be part of a team where everyone’s contribution is valued. We will empower you to bring ideas to elevate our services, creating personalised experiences for guests. Help them to feel special and we will do the same for you.

A career that lets your passion shine

During this internship you will have the opportunity to assist in the work of a Duty Manager in an international, luxury five-star hotel.

Our Duty Managers are responsible for the operations of the hotel and represent the management team in their absence. Their challenge is to find the right balance between regular work and ad hoc situations. They have the responsibility to make quick and adequate decisions that affect the well-being of guests and other employees.

Another would describe them as an involved manager who oversees everything from a 'strategic' position, who watches and listens carefully and responds quickly to developments and offers solutions where necessary, while at the same time coaching and monitoring colleagues with the aim of providing consistent service and therefore guest satisfaction.

What we offer

Our team is young and full with passion and motivation. The Grand highly values personal and professional growth, therefore, we have a full time trainings manager who contributes do your development. Not only during, but also after your internship, we see possibilities and career opportunities. You also have the possibility to do various cross trainings in different departments to broaden your hotel knowledge. As part of your internship experience, you'll get the opportunity to take part in an operational shift once a month, giving you valuable hands-on insight into our daily operations.

The internship allowance is €750 gross per month, based on 38 hours per week. Besides this, you also have the possibility to receive travel allowance. Every day you can enjoy a meal (for free) in our staff canteen.

Do you like to go out for dinner and drinks? Good! You will get up to 50% F&B discount in selected bars and restaurants in 4- and 5 star hotels in Amsterdam.

What you will bring to the role

• You are studying hospitality management at HBO level
• You are available for at least 10 months
• You speak English fluently. Every other language is a plus.
• You are flexible (available 24/7), serious and attentive and stand firmly in your shoes

What we offer

Our team is young, dynamic, and passionate about hospitality. The Grand highly values personal and professional development, which is why we have a dedicated Training Manager who actively supports your growth throughout your internship journey.

In addition to your operational learning experience, you will have the opportunity to:

• Participate in various cross-trainings across different hotel departments
• Gain exposure to quality management and operational coordination projects
• Take part in an operational management shift once per month, providing valuable insight into daily hotel operations and decision-making
• Explore future career opportunities within Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam and the wider Accor network

The internship allowance is €750 gross per month based on 38 hours per week. In addition, you may be eligible for a travel allowance.

Every day, you can enjoy a complimentary meal in our staff canteen.

Love dining out? As part of the Accor family, you can enjoy discounts of up to 50% at selected restaurants and bars within participating 4- and 5-star hotels in Amsterdam.

Please note that only candidates who already have the legal right to work in the Netherlands will be considered. Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam does not provide visa or work permit sponsorship.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:

• Become part of an international, young, dynamic & welcoming team.
