jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser (Палма Мол Тетово)
jobs.description:
ШТО ЌЕ ПРАВИТЕ

Како визуелен комерцијалист, ќе играте клучна улога во создавањето инспиративно и конзистентно искуство на клиентите со имплементирање на визуелни стандарди и поттикнување на комерцијална извонредност. Постапувајќи во согласност со нашите вредности, ќе придонесете за вашиот успех и успехот на компанијата.

Вие ќе:

• Извршите визуелно, комерцијално и стајлинг курирање во согласност со упатствата и календарите на продавниците за да го подобрите искуството на клиентите и да ја зголемите продажбата во вашата продавница.
• Анализирате перформанси на продажба, одржувате нивоа на залихи, обезбедите грижа за облеката и идентификувате и давате приоритет на визуелните и комерцијалните можности во соработка со Менаџментот на продавницата.
• Ги користите вашите трендови и сознанија за конкурентите за да го обучите и развиете тимот на продавницата, опремувајќи ги да испорачаат одлично искуство за клиентите.
• Се претставувате себеси и брендот позитивно за време на сите интеракции со клиентите.
• Го поддржите продажниот пазар со проекти за проширување на продавниците.

СО КОЈ ЌЕ РАБОТИТЕ

Нашите продавници се срцето на нашата компанија, каде што клиентите го доживуваат нашиот бренд од прва рака. Како дел од динамичниот тим на продавницата, секоја улога - од советници за продажба, менаџери на одделенија, менаџери на продавници и визуелни трговци до одговорни за благајна - придонесува за создавање инспиративна и добредојдена средина. Ќе се поврзете и со поширокиот тим на Ареа, соработувајќи низ продавници за да споделувате увиди и заедно да постигнете успех. Заедно со вашиот тим, ќе играте витална улога во помагањето на клиентите да се чувствуваат сигурни и да ја изразат својата индивидуалност со најновите трендови и безвременски стилови. Со градење значајни врски со клиентите во нашите продавници, ја правиме модата достапна и одржлива за сите..

​

КОЈ СИ ТИ

Ние бараме луѓе со…​

• ​ Силна визуелна комерцијалност и комерцијално искуство во динамично опкружување, со начин на размислување ориентиран кон решенија.
• Познавање како да управувате, анализирате и постапувате по извештаите за продажба и равенката за продажба.

И луѓе кои се…​

• Страстни за модата и обезбедување на исклучително искуство во продавницата.
• Мотивирани да создаваат извонредни искуства за клиентите додека промовираат и поттикнуваат продажба.
• Креативен, љубопитен и проактивен.
• Вешти комуникатори кои можат да ги водат и инспирираат тимовите на продавниците да постигнат заеднички резултати.
• Флексибилни и ориентирани кон акција.

​

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ​

H&M Group е глобална компанија на силни модни брендови и вложувања. Нашата цел е да докажеме дека нема компромис помеѓу исклучителен дизајн, пристапни цени и одржливи решенија. Сакаме да ја ослободиме модата за многумина, а нашите клиенти се во срцето на секоја одлука што ја носиме.

Ние сме составени од илјадници страсни и талентирани колеги обединети со нашата заедничка култура и вредности. Заедно, сакаме да ја искористиме нашата моќ, нашата скала и нашето знаење, за да ја поттикнеме модната индустрија кон поинклузивна и одржлива иднина. ​

​

ЗОШТО ЌЕ САКАТЕ ДА РАБОТИТЕ ТУКА

Во H&M Group, ние сме горди што сме енергична и гостопримлива компанија. На нашите вработени им нудиме атрактивни придобивки со широки можности за развој низ целиот свет. ​

• 25% Попуст за персоналот на сите наши брендови на H&M Group, и во продавниците и на интернет
• Приватно здравствено осигурување
• HIP - Incentive program. Дознајте повеќе за програмата тука
• Награда за долгогодишна служба на 10, 15 и 20-годишнина
• Награда при пензионирање
• Подарок-картичка за новороденче
• Отсуство за татковство
• Надоместок за транспорт
• Божиќен/Новогодишен подарок за децата на вработените
• Бонус за препорака на пријател

ПРИДРУЖИ НИ СЕ

Нашата уникатност доаѓа од комбинација на многу нешта - нашата инклузивна и колаборативна култура, нашите силни вредности и можности за раст. Но, најмногу од сè, нашите луѓе нè прават она што сме.​

Аплицирајте со испраќање на вашето CV што е можно поскоро, но не подоцна од 15.11.2026. Поради политиките за податоци, ние прифаќаме апликации само преку страницата за кариера.

jobs.title: Sales Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Us

Beamup builds AI agents for supply chain and operations at scale. Our agents find and fix failures inside large supply chain and operations businesses: retailers, marketplaces, fulfillment operators and manufacturers. They cut through the noise in the fifteen to twenty systems our customers already run, find the failures that matter, prove what they cost, and fix the cause autonomously so it stops repeating, before the end customer ever finds out.

We are deployed in more than twenty countries, hold eleven granted AI patents, and count Fortune-100 customers.

Our Mission

To close the gap between what every customer-facing team hears and what every operations team sees. So delivery promises hold, customer loyalty compounds, and nobody starts from zero the next time the same failure comes back.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Account Executive to join our sales organization. This role requires a seasoned sales professional with 5+ years of enterprise software sales experience and a deep understanding of supply chain challenges within retail, manufacturing, or 3PL/logistics. The ideal candidate is a solution-selling expert with a robust network, capable of sourcing and closing end-to-end deals that fuel our growth. The Account Executive will report to the VP Sales, playing a critical role in driving strategic revenue initiatives. The job requires balancing USA and European Hours.

Key Responsibilities

• Sales Strategy & Leadership:

• Execute with Enterprise Sales Strategy to drive revenue growth in targeted sectors.

• Participate in a high-performing sales team to meet and exceed sales targets.

• Collaborate with executive leadership to refine the company’s market positioning and value proposition.

• Pitch directly to the prospect’s C-Suite

• Identify, prospect, and engage with potential enterprise clients within the designated supply chain sectors.

• Leverage an existing robust Rolodex to expand the company’s network and drive new business opportunities.

• Own the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals, ensuring a seamless, consultative solution-selling approach.

• Responsible for self-sourcing leads

• Customer Relationship Management:

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, understanding their business challenges and aligning our software solutions to meet their needs.

• Market Analysis & Relevancy:

• Monitor market trends and competitive activity to inform strategic decisions.

• Provide regular sales forecasts and performance reports to the executive team.

• Utilize Salesforce and continue to optimize the sales processes.

Qualifications

• Experience:

• Minimum of 5+ years in enterprise software sales with a focus on supply chain solutions.

• Proven track record in solution selling and closing complex deals end-to-end.

• Industry Expertise:

• Deep understanding of supply chain dynamics within retail, pharma, manufacturing, or 3PL/logistics.

• Skills & Attributes:

• Demonstrated ability to execute Solution-Based Selling and operate within an MEDDPIC framework

• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

• Strong organizational skills and internal prep. This is a must

Why Join Beamup?

• Opportunity to shape the sales strategy of a high-growth, innovative company.

• Collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment.

• Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

• Career growth opportunities as we expand our footprint in the enterprise software market

Beamup is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

You can read more about us at:

https://www.beamup.ai/

And we were also chosen to be one of the 50 most promising Israeli startups of 2023:

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager, K4B
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK for Business (K4B) is KAYAK's corporate travel platform — built to help companies manage business travel through a modern online booking experience, AI-powered features, and a connected network of travel management partners. This Senior Account Manager role sits at the heart of our client relationships: you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of US-based corporate clients, helping them get real value from the platform, stay on track with their travel programs, and grow with us over time. You'll work closely with a collaborative account management team and partner regularly with colleagues across Product, Support, Finance, and Implementation to deliver for your clients.

This position is based in our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 times per week

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own a portfolio of assigned corporate accounts and serve as their primary day-to-day contact for platform adoption, account health, and ongoing support.

 - Build trusted, long-term relationships with client travel teams and program managers, with a focus on retention and satisfaction.

 - Lead regular account reviews, quarterly business reviews, and strategic performance reviews — often in coordination with travel management company (TMC) partners.

 - Monitor account health across your portfolio, identify risks early, and develop clear action plans to address them.

 - Drive adoption of platform capabilities — including AI-assisted booking, group travel features, direct content, and international expansion — by helping clients understand the value and supporting successful rollouts.

 - Coordinate with internal teams including Product, Support, Finance, and Implementation to resolve issues, close open items, and deliver on commitments made to clients.

 - Manage contract renewals and amendments; contribute to pricing discussions and identify opportunities for account growth.

 - Keep account records, action logs, and renewal timelines accurate and up to date.

 - Contribute to team-wide improvements — including playbooks, templates, and scalable processes — that help the whole team work more effectively.

 - Represent the voice of your clients internally, sharing feedback and patterns that help the broader team and product organization make better decisions.




PLEASE APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience in account management, client success, customer relationship management, or a related client-facing role — we value what you've accomplished and the skills you've built, not a specific number of years or a particular job title

 - A track record of managing multiple client relationships at the same time, with strong follow-through and attention to detail

 - Clear, confident communication skills — written and verbal — and comfort working with people at different levels of an organization, from day-to-day contacts to senior decision-makers

 - The ability to use data to track account performance, spot trends, and inform your conversations with clients

 - A collaborative, organized approach to work, including the ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and external partners to get things done

 - Equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills from adjacent fields (such as hospitality, operations, consulting, or customer success) are genuinely considered


YOU'LL STAND OUT IF YOU ALSO HAVE:

 - Experience in corporate travel, B2B technology, or SaaS

 - Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, project management platforms, or business intelligence dashboards

 - Experience working alongside or coordinating with travel management companies or other third-party service partners

 - Experience supporting clients through product launches, market expansions, or change management

 


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

 - Focus on mental health and well-being:
   
   - Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
   
   - Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
   
   - Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

 - No meeting Fridays

 - Paid parental leave

 - Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

 - Paid volunteer time

 - Focus on your career growth:
   
   - Development Dollars
   
   - Leadership development
   
   - Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

 - Travel Discounts

 - Employee Resource Groups

 - Competitive retirement and health plans

 - Free lunch 2 days per week

 - Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $115,000-$140,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

 


INCLUSION

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

#LI-AS1

jobs.title: Department Manager (Big Fashion Kragujevac)
jobs.description:
ŠTA ĆEŠ RADITI

Kao menadžer odeljenja, bićeš lider u pružanju podrške i podsticanju celog svog tima. Negujući inkluzivnu kulturu koja promoviše saradnju i preduzetnički duh, stvaraćeš okruženje u kome svako može da napreduje. Postupajući u skladu sa našim vrednostima, doprinosićeš i svom, kao i kompanijskom uspehu.

Takođe ćeš:

• Voditi svoj tim ka postizanju izvanrednog iskustva kupaca, obezbeđujući odlične operativne i vizuelne standarde, dok aktivno promovišeš prodaju naših artikala.
• Preuzeti odgovornost za prednosti svog odeljenja i prodavnice, analizirati prodajne performanse, prepoznavati komercijalne mogućnosti, postavljati ciljeve i praviti planove za poboljšanje rezultata, profita i nivoa zaliha.
• Upravljati planiranjem tima i rasporeda i obezbeđivati neometane rutine zatvaranja i otvaranja prodavnice.
• Zapošljavati, obezbeđivati obuku i razvoj svog tima, negujući inkluzivnu kulturu punu saradnje koja promoviše razvoj i inovaciju.
• Biti u toku sa modnim trendovima, preferencama kupaca, kao i ponudom konkurentnih brendova, kako bi se održala konkurentska prednost.
• Predstavljati sebe i brend na pozitivan način tokom svake interakcije sa kupcima.
• Obezbeđivati ukupno OMNI iskustvo kupaca, promovišući aktivno naš program lojalnosti.

​

SA KIM ĆEŠ RADITI

Naše prodavnice su srce naše kompanije, gde naši kupci imaju direktan dodir sa našim brendom. Kao deo dinamičnog tima u prodavnici, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savetnika, menadžera odeljenja, menadžera prodavnice i aranžera, do glavnog blagajnika — doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog okruženja punog dobrodošlice.  Takođe ćeš sarađivati sa širim timom područja, kao i između prodavnica, kako biste delili iskustva i podsticali uspeh zajedno. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imaćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju pomoći kupcima da se osećaju samouvereno i ističu svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Gradeći značajne veze sa kupcima u našim prodavnicama, mi modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

KO SI TI

Tražimo osobe sa…

• Iskustvom u prodajnom menadžmentu i operativnosti.
• Ekspertizom u planiranju prodaje, analiziranju i praćenju, koristeći alate orijentisane prema kupcima i izveštavanje.

I osobe koje su…

• Snažni i samouvereni lideri, koji inspirišu, podučavaju i razvijaju svoj tim, dok ilustruju kompanijske vrednosti i kulturu.
• Uživaju u saradljivim i dinamičnim okolnostima, sa načinom razmišljanja koji je orijentisan prema pronalaženju rešenja.
• Motivisani da stvaraju odlično iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišu i prodaju naše artikle.
• Istinski zainteresovani za modne trendove, komercijalnost i uvide u konkurente radi podsticanja prodaje.
• Efikasni u komunikaciji, kreativni i znatiželjni.
• Fleksibilni, analitični i orijentisani ka postignućima, sa umećem da upravljaju statistikom i rade sa brojevima.

​

KO SMO MI

H&M Grupa je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i poduhvata. Naš cilj je da dokažemo da ne postoji kompromis između odličnog dizajna, pristupačnih cena i održivih rešenja. Želimo da oslobodimo modu za sve, a naši kupci su srce svake odluke koju donosimo.

​

Naš tim čine hiljade posvećenih i talentovanih kolega, koje su ujedinjene našom kulturom i vrednostima. Zajedno, želimo da koristimo našu moć, našu veličinu i znanje da usmerimo modnu industriju kao inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ OBOŽAVATI DA RADIŠ OVDE

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična kompanija puna dobrodošlice. Našim zaposlenima nudimo atraktivne benefite i beskrajne mogućnosti za razvoj širom sveta.

• 10% popusta za zaposlene u svim brendovima H&M grupe, u prodavnicama i onlajn
• H&M Incentive Program (podsticajni proram) – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovde.
• Poklon kartica za bebu
• Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
• Poklon za odlazak u penziju
• Bonus za preporuku prijatelja protivvrednosti
• Naknada za prevoz
• Naknada za dugogodišnji rad u kompaniji nakon 10, 15 i 20 godina
• Božićni/Novogodišnji poklon za decu zaposlenih

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE

Naša jedinstvenost potiče iz kombinacije mnogo stvari – naše kulture pune inkluzije i saradnje, naših snažnih vrednosti i mogućnosti za razvoj; ali najviše iz ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.

Neka tvoj sledeći korak u karijeri bude sa nama. Putovanje počinje ovde.

​*Posvećeni smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, zasnovan na jednakosti i kompetencijama. Zbog toga te molimo da u svojoj prijavi ne šalješ motivaciono pismo.

jobs.title: Knowledge Base Team Lead
jobs.description:
Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in Cyprus.

Who We Are.

Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.

Let's talk about the cool stuff you'll do at Axi!

As Knowledge Base Team Leader, you'll lead the development, quality, and performance of Axi's knowledge base, helping clients and Customer Service teams find accurate answers quickly and consistently. You'll combine content expertise, analytics, and people leadership to understand why knowledge isn't working as expected and turn those insights into measurable improvements.

You'll play an important role in strengthening our chatbot and self-service experience, improving knowledge governance, and ensuring our content supports both human agents and AI-powered tools.

Your EDGE Assignment / You Will

• Own knowledge base management and governance: Oversee content creation, taxonomy, metadata, quality assurance, review cycles, and governance to keep articles and SOPs accurate, consistent, and up to date.

• Improve chatbot deflection: Drive performance towards Axi's internal 95% query-deflection target by optimising knowledge content and identifying opportunities to improve self-service resolution.

• Investigate deflection failures: Analyse chatbot conversations, search failures, retrieval issues, and escalation patterns to identify root causes and prioritise corrective actions.

• Use analytics to drive improvements: Monitor article performance, resolution rates, repeat contacts, escalations, and customer satisfaction signals to guide the knowledge improvement roadmap.

• Maintain high content standards: Ensure information is clear, complete, easy to find, and consistent across chatbot, self-service, and agent-facing channels.

• Lead and develop the team: Establish performance expectations, coach team members, monitor quality and productivity, and manage competing priorities effectively.

• Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Customer Service, Operations, and technical stakeholders to identify recurring issues, close knowledge gaps, and keep content aligned with evolving products and processes.

• Drive continuous improvement: Challenge ineffective processes, identify opportunities to improve knowledge management, and implement practical solutions that deliver measurable results.

• Undertake additional duties and projects as reasonably assigned to support evolving business and operational requirements.

Are You the One?

We're looking for someone who combines strong knowledge management expertise with analytical thinking, a hands-on approach, and the ability to lead a team, ability to work 07:00am to 16:00 Cyprus time (1 hour break included).

You'll ideally bring:

• Knowledge management leadership: 1–2+ years of experience leading a knowledge base, content operations, or self-service function, with direct accountability for content quality and team performance.

• Knowledge lifecycle expertise: Practical experience managing content creation, taxonomy, metadata, quality assurance, governance, and structured review cycles.

• Chatbot and self-service optimisation: Experience analysing chatbot interactions and knowledge performance to identify gaps and improve resolution.

• Root-cause analysis: The ability to distinguish between missing content, poor article quality, tagging issues, search relevance problems, and chatbot retrieval failures.

• Data-driven decision-making: Experience using search analytics, escalation rates, repeat-contact data, and customer feedback to prioritise improvements and measure impact.

• Knowledge management platforms: Familiarity with tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow, or Confluence. Experience with DevRev is a strong advantage.

• AI and automation awareness: Exposure to conversational AI, knowledge retrieval, LLM-powered self-service, or knowledge automation is advantageous.

• Team leadership and performance management: The ability to set clear standards, coach team members, manage workloads, and improve performance through regular, evidence-based feedback.

• Stakeholder management: Confidence collaborating with technical teams, subject matter experts, and Customer Service stakeholders, including constructively challenging existing approaches when the evidence supports a change.

• Prioritisation and ownership: A structured, proactive approach to managing competing demands and turning insights into practical improvements.

Axi's Bag of Delights

• Competitive total rewards package.

• Extensive learning opportunities, including professional certifications and continuous development.

• 21 days of annual leave per year.

• Public holidays as declared by the local government.

• Comprehensive health insurance coverage.

Axi's Interview Journey

Our selection process includes:

• Talent Acquisition Interview – 60 minutes

• Take-Home Test – 60 minutes

• Hiring Manager Interview – 60 minutes

• Final Interview – 60 minutes

Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.

At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

jobs.title: Culinary Director
jobs.description:
Hawar Resort by Mantis is seeking an experienced and dynamic Culinary Director to lead and oversee all culinary operations across the resort. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining the highest standards of food quality, consistency, innovation, guest satisfaction, and operational excellence across all dining venues. The Culinary Director will play a key role in menu development, talent management, cost control, and culinary innovation while ensuring that all food offerings align with the resort's luxury positioning and guest expectations.

What is in it for you:

• Unleash the excitement: enticing rewards and unbeatable benefits are waiting for you!
• Ignite your skills with our cutting-edge Academies for rapid professional growth.
• Cultivate your talents and watch your career flourish, locally and globally.
• Drive change through impactful Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
• Immerse yourself in a vibrant work environment with extraordinary colleagues.
• Join us on a direct path to success as we skyrocket to new heights!

• Oversee all culinary operations across the resort, ensuring alignment with brand standards and operational excellence.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Why work for Accor? We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

About Mantis Collection: Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco-tourism in a poverty-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.

jobs.title: Premium Cash Assistant
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year on year. And, we’re still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people’s everyday lives.

The Premium Cash Assistant plays a crucial role in our liquidity operations, serving our customers and rebalancing our mobile money agents with cash or e-float.

In this role, you'll;

• Control access to the safe/cash house, including managing cash in and cash-outs between the safe and the PAA accounts.

• Hold the end-of-day bill counting and maintain daily reconciliation of premium agent outlets.

• Ensure that all cash management transactions are correctly recorded in the treasury system.

• Promptly request sufficient funds from the head office to ensure no service disruptions and delays at the outlet while serving our customers and agents.

• Be responsible for the receipt and dispatch of cash through the Cash In Transit (CIT) team.

• Ensure all cash management policies and guidelines are adhered to.

• Responsible for the escalation and follow-up of all issues that impede the well-functioning of the premium outlet.

• Encourage proximity agents to be liquid through frequent tracking, monitoring, and issue resolution.

• Support agent/customer needs to provide immediate support on Wave's offer information, opening accounts, system, application, and physical cards.

• Ensure that all cash management transactions are correctly recorded in the treasury system.

Key details

• Location: You'll work from our office in Lilongwe, Malawi, and may travel to other field locations.

• Work authorization in Malawi is required.

• This is a permanent position.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space.

Requirements

• Strong proficiency in English and other local languages in Malawi, preferably.

• 3+ years of experience as a cashier in cash management, reconciliation & liquidity management, cash handling, delivery, or a similar position.

• A bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, banking, or any related discipline.

You might be a good fit if you

• Are exceptionally organized and able to follow through on tasks independently.

• Have a strong sense of prioritization.

• Are exceptionally customer-obsessed.

• Demonstrate tenacity and a willingness to go the extra distance to get something done.

• Are detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.

• Are a clear and proactive communicator, both written and verbal.

• Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets.

• Always seek to improve yourself through honest self-reflection.

• Enjoy teamwork, but also know how to work well independently.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT TESSERA LABS

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world-class founding team, we build multi-agent AI systems that automate complex business workflows across platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, MuleSoft, and more.

Our mission is to bring real AI automation to the enterprise—delivering speed, precision, and measurable impact. We operate with extreme ownership, move quickly, and build at the frontier of applied AI.

We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Foundation Capital, and built by leaders from Meta AI, Google Research, Microsoft AI, SAP, Oracle, and Salesforce. We move fast, operate with extreme ownership, and build at the frontier of applied AI. Our ethos in one line: enterprise serious, AI forward.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Platform Engineer to build the software that connects enterprise systems and makes their data usable across applications, analytics, and AI.

You’ll work at the intersection of backend engineering and data systems, building reusable capabilities for connecting to, querying, moving, and processing data.

This role is open to remote candidates, with a preference for those based in the Bay Area.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - At least 4+ years of experience as a Data Platform Engineer

 - Build core data platform capabilities. Develop services and APIs for data access, query execution, ingestion, and synchronization.

 - Make integrations reusable. Build connector frameworks and abstractions that support different systems and access patterns without requiring bespoke implementations.

 - Improve performance and resource efficiency. Identify bottlenecks in querying and data movement; apply partitioning, parallelism, and effective memory and storage management.

 - Own execution reliability. Build orchestration, retries, checkpointing, and observability so workloads recover predictably from failures and maintain data correctness.

 - Take capabilities from design to production. Work with product and engineering teams to define interfaces, make architectural tradeoffs, and operate what you build.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong Python and SQL, with experience building maintainable, tested production software.

 - Experience developing backend services, data infrastructure, or data platform components, beyond configuring pipelines.

 - A solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, data formats, and the tradeoffs between querying data in place and materializing it elsewhere.

 - Experience with concurrent or distributed workloads, including failure handling, resource management, and performance debugging.

 - The ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and turn complex requirements into clear, practical designs.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with analytical query engines, lakehouse technologies, workflow orchestration, enterprise-system integrations, or containerized infrastructure.

 - Experience building connector libraries, developer-facing APIs, or shared platforms used by other engineering teams is especially relevant.

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including networking, storage, identity and access management (IAM), and infrastructure as code.


WHY TESSERA LABS

 - Build AI products that solve complex, real-world enterprise problems

 - Work at the intersection of AI, ERP systems, and automation

 - High ownership, high impact, and direct influence on product direction

 - Collaborate with a deeply technical and customer-focused team

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.

About the Job:

The Postharvest Technician will be responsible for leading teams of associates in all processes in the Post Harvest Department. They will prepare harvests through processes that prepare cannabis for flower sales and oil extraction. The Postharvest Technician will also be responsible for equipment/room sanitization and sterilization as well as maintaining facilities cleanliness.

Duties include the following.  Other duties may be assigned.

• Strong time management skills and multi-tasking in a busy office environment

• Monitor the weights and accuracy of recorded post-harvest materials, throughout all Post Harvest processes

• Tag flower and trim for compliance

• Maintain a neat and organized work area allowing for the proper segregation of materials and processes

• Leading a team to precisely trim flower that will be sold for flower sales

• Responsible for facility and equipment cleaning in a clean room manufacturing environment to maintain required standards

• Responsible for organizing work areas and performing daily tasks such as washing and sanitizing equipment and racking systems

• Fill out logs related to postharvest (daily, weekly, monthly)

• Sanitization and sterilization of post-harvest processing equipment and rooms such as stainless-steel racks and shelve

• Strong emphasis on documentation according to state regulations and internal tracking.

• Other duties as assigned, or any reasonable request from any member of management

• Assist manager/supervisor in conducting audits

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

General

• Regulations require that incumbent be at least 21 years of age and able to obtain and maintain medical marijuana work credentials – applicable marijuana licensing regulations may disqualify individuals with certain criminal convictions.

Education/Experience:

• High school diploma or equivalent is required

• Cannabis experience preferred

• 2+ years skilled manufacturing work experience

Required Knowledge and Skills:

• Familiarity with weights and measures

• Ability to accurately fill out documentation

• Must be able to clearly communicate with team members

• Ability to understand and follow processes to produce products that meet quality standards

• Effective verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to comply with established safety standards for the proper use, safe handling and disposal of harmful chemicals, substances, and hazardous wastes.

• Must be able to work in a challenging fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to details

ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Warehouse environment with artificial lighting and ventilation

• Potential for mold exposure.

• Potential for allergic reaction or hypersensitivity to the marijuana plants

• Carbon dioxide (CO2) may be encountered. CO2 can displace oxygen at high concentrations. CO2 exposure can cause symptoms such as headache, dizziness, rapid breathing, and increased heart rate; in extreme cases, unconsciousness and death can result.

• The warehouse is properly ventilated, however, marijuana cultivation produces ozone from the chemical reaction of nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds, such as terpenes that are given off from the marijuana plant. Terpenes and nitric oxides can be associated with eye, skin and mucous irritation. In some people, ozone can cause decreased lung function and/or exacerbate pre-existing health effects, especially in workers with asthma or other respiratory complications. PPE in the form of respiratory protection may be recommended in certain parts of the warehouse.

• Confined Spaces

PHYSICAL CONDITIONS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly required to perform grasping, lifting, walking, standing, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Ability to tolerate moderate to loud exposure to noise level. Exposure to long periods of bright lights. Long periods of prolonged use of office equipment including computers and phones.

jobs.title: Senior Roboticist
jobs.description:
ABOUT ASTERA

Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at  https://astera.org/visionastera.org/vision http://astera.org/vision.



ABOUT THE ROBOTICS LAB

We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action.

Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence.

Building on our existing research results and working robotic systems, we are seeking a few senior roboticists to advance our robotics capabilities and lead technical execution.



POSITION SUMMARY

You will contribute to the robotics research and engineering effort within a multidisciplinary team spanning robotics, AI, and computational neuroscience. Your focus will be advancing robot capabilities, coordinating execution across the robotics stack, and translating research into reliable performance on physical systems.

Working closely with the lab’s leadership, you will turn scientific priorities into concrete robotics programs, recruit and mentor robotics researchers and engineers, and establish rigorous technical standards. You will bring deep robotics expertise and the ability to collaborate with colleagues in AI and neuroscience, connecting their contributions to functioning robotic systems.

This is a hands-on leadership role on research and/or engineering. You should be comfortable evaluating a learning architecture, reviewing a control or perception pipeline, designing a decisive experiment, and working directly with the team to resolve difficult technical bottlenecks.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Advance useful robotic capabilities. Expand the range of skills robots can perform reliably, with clear improvements in task success, generalization, learning efficiency, adaptation, and recovery from failure.

 - Help design and execute the robotics roadmap. Work with the lab’s leadership to translate scientific priorities into coordinated projects across perception, learning, simulation, control, hardware integration, and deployment. Help define milestones, coordinate technical efforts, and resolve dependencies to deliver reliable robotic capabilities.

 - Connect research to physical systems. Guide work from algorithm development and simulation through real-world deployment. Establish effective cycles of data collection, training, evaluation, failure analysis, and improvement.

 - Recruit and develop robotics talent. Help recruit for robotics research and engineering roles, including candidate sourcing, technical evaluation, and onboarding. Mentor team members and develop their technical judgment and leadership.

 - Solve critical technical problems. Contribute directly to experimental design, algorithms, software, and system architecture. Investigate failures and help the team overcome challenges that span multiple components of the robot.

 - Establish rigorous evaluation. Develop reproducible benchmarks and testing practices that measure performance across repeated trials, varied environments, and changing operating conditions. Use results to guide development priorities.

 - Collaborate across AI and neuroscience. Work with specialists to implement and test learning methods and neural circuit models on robots. Design experiments that assess both practical capability and the computational mechanisms underlying behavior.

 - Guide robotics hardware and resource decisions. Recommend robotic hardware, compute, and tooling investments based on technical needs and expected impact. Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to the lab’s leadership.
   


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Research and leadership experience. Typically 10+ years of relevant robotics research and engineering experience, including 5+ years leading technical teams or substantial robotics programs. Exceptional accomplishments may substitute for a specific number of years.

 - Technical contributions. A record of original work and successful delivery on physical robotic systems, supported by research publications, deployed capabilities, or substantial engineering achievements.

 - Robotics depth and breadth. Deep expertise in one or more areas of robotics, with broad working knowledge across perception, robot learning, simulation, motion planning, control, and deployment.

 - Systems judgment. Demonstrated ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, reproducible robotic capabilities and diagnose failures across software, models, sensing, and hardware.

 - Team development. Experience recruiting and mentoring strong researchers and engineers, setting technical standards, and coordinating work across specialties.

 - Cross-disciplinary collaboration. Strong grounding in modern AI and an interest in understanding and evaluating ideas from computational neuroscience. Prior neuroscience specialization is welcome but is not required.

 - Education or equivalent accomplishments. A PhD in robotics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent research and technical leadership accomplishments.
   


WHY JOIN US?

This is a rare opportunity to build robust, useful robots that reliably perform real-world tasks while pursuing a deeper question: how can we give them a brain that learns, remembers, and adapts through interaction with the world?

You will work alongside neuroscientists and AI researchers to translate insights from biological neural circuits and AI systems into computational architectures, then test them on physical robots. Our ambition is to build a broad repertoire of robust, task-oriented behaviors and use these capabilities to investigate how skills accumulate, how experience informs decisions, and how online learning enables robots to adapt to unfamiliar tasks.

Building on our existing results and robotic systems, you will help bring these ideas into the real world. Success means both robots that perform useful tasks reliably and scientific advances in how intelligent behavior can emerge from brain-inspired computation.

Lead revenue strategy for a 252-room hotel, optimising occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue per Available Room (RevPAR), market share and hotel profitability through pricing, forecasting, commercial analysis and cross-department coordination.

DAILY | REVENUE & OPERATIONS

•  Performance monitoring. Review occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, room nights and room revenue against forecast, budget and prior year; analyse pickup, cancellations, OTB, segments, booking channels and room types. Correct anomalies and data-quality issues.

•  Competitive and demand insight. Use STR, Lighthouse and other intelligence to assess competitor rates, market share and indexes; track Perth events and other demand drivers, identifying peak and low-demand periods.

•  Forecasting and communication. Maintain day-to-day forecasts and monitor the current and following two months; flag occupancy changes, commercial opportunities and operational risks to the General Manager and department heads.

•  Groups and corporate business. Price enquiries, complete displacement and net-contribution analysis (including accommodation, F&B, meeting revenue and costs), manage group options and review corporate production with Sales and Reservations.

•  Forecasts and commercial review. Maintain segment-based rolling forecasts, a daily three-month forecast and three-month financial projections; assess revenue risks, booking pace and the forward 12-month demand outlook.

•  Distribution and marketing. Evaluate OTA/direct booking mix, distribution costs, commissions, campaign returns and net revenue; support invoice checks and review contracted corporate rates/potential package revenue generators with the DOSM.

ANNUAL  |  BUDGET & DEVELOPMENT

KEY SYSTEMS

Opera Cloud  •  IDeaS G3 RMS  •  Lighthouse  •  STR  •  Fornova  •  Accor reservation/distribution systems  •  OTA extranets          •  Advanced Microsoft Excel  •  Microsoft Office  •   Distribution networks  •  TrustYou review software

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

You'll join the team that owns the Software Factory: the development environments, build systems, CI/CD, and engineering automation that set the ceiling on how fast every other engineer at Brain Co. can ship high-quality software.

This is a force-multiplier role: your work compounds as we add teams, services, and customers. You'll shape how engineers develop, test, review, and ship software, combining developer tooling, reliable infrastructure, and AI-assisted workflows to improve speed and quality across Brain Co.

Your job is to discover, measure, and remove developer friction. You should be comfortable going from “this workflow is slow or confusing” to instrumented evidence, a shipped improvement, and clear before/after impact.

Own developer environments and build infrastructure

Own the local development experience, monorepo, build systems, and shared tooling. Make it easy for engineers to set up, develop, and test software, with fast and reliable workflows as the company scales.

Build delivery workflows and engineering automation

Own CI/CD, PR workflows, code-review automation, and shared tooling for product quality assurance. Integrate AI-assisted development and coding agents where they improve speed and quality, supporting delivery across cloud, regulated, and air-gapped environments.

Measure and improve developer experience

Discover, measure, and remove friction across the development lifecycle. Combine developer feedback with instrumentation to shorten feedback loops, improve reliability, and demonstrate clear before/after impact.

Drive onboarding, enablement, and adoption

Help engineers become productive quickly through intuitive tooling, documentation, and practical support. Guide teams through new workflows and migrations, and drive adoption through quality, not mandates.

Operate the developer platform as a product

Own the full lifecycle: architecture, implementation, rollout, reliability, and iteration based on internal user feedback. Partner closely with engineering, Infrastructure, and Security to build a platform teams trust and want to use.




YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU…

We're looking for engineers who treat developer experience as a product — engineers who reach for users, not just specs.

Developer Platform & Build Systems

 - Have 3+ years building developer-facing infrastructure: monorepo platforms, build systems, CI/CD, or internal tooling.

 - Have hands-on depth with at least one modern monorepo tool (Nx, Bazel, Pants, Buck, Turborepo) and the willingness to go deeper.

 - Have strong fluency with CI/CD systems at scale (GitHub Actions, Buildkite, CircleCI, or similar): matrix design, caching strategies, secret flow, parallelism.

 - Are fluent in at least two of: Go, Python, TypeScript, Rust, Bash.

 - Have experience building automated testing or code-quality workflows that engineers trust.

Platform & Product Mindset

 - Have shipped developer platforms that real engineers adopted.

 - Have measured developer friction and shown clear before/after impact from tooling, CI, build, release, or workflow improvements.

 - Have strong intuition for developer experience, paved paths, and long-term maintainability.

 - Are comfortable owning the full lifecycle: design doc, MVP, hardening, adoption.

 - Can help teams adopt new tools and migrate existing workflows through clear documentation and practical support.

Production & Reliability

 - Have owned developer-facing systems with real uptime and operational responsibility.

 - Are familiar with observability tooling and incident response.

 - Bring strong fundamentals in retries, idempotency, queueing, and failure modes for reliable build and automation systems.


WAYS YOU MIGHT STAND OUT

 - Built or integrated coding agents, automated code review, or AI-assisted testing into engineering workflows, with measurable improvements in speed or quality.

 - Experience with sandboxed code execution, credential scoping, or security controls for development agents.

 - Built or significantly contributed to a remote build cache, custom build system, or hermetic build pipeline (Bazel, Nix, etc.).

 - Open-source contributions to Nx plugins, GitHub Actions, coding-agent tooling, or related developer platforms.

 - Exposure to multi-tenant, regulated, or air-gapped deployment environments.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

You'll set the ceiling on how fast every other engineer at Brain Co. can ship. As we grow from a handful of teams to dozens — building AI systems for governments and regulated industries — the platform that lets us move quickly without breaking what matters becomes one of the highest-leverage systems in the company.

jobs.title: Director of Finance & Business Operations
jobs.description:
Overview

Infinite Machine is hiring a Director of Finance & Business Operations to own finance, accounting, HR, legal, facilities, and reporting. This is a senior, hands-on role reporting to the CEO. 

Responsibilities

 - Own financial planning and analysis, including the annual budget, rolling forecasts, and the company's long-range cash flow model.

 - Manage cash, runway, and working capital, with close attention to supplier payment terms, landed cost, and duties and tariffs.

 - Partner with vehicle operations on inventory planning, purchasing, and cost tracking, owning the financial view of stock, landed cost, and supplier terms.

 - Oversee accounting and the monthly close, whether in-house or through an outside firm, and own audit, tax, and sales tax compliance.

 - Support equity and debt fundraising by building models, preparing investor materials, maintaining the data room, and running diligence.

 - Manage the cap table, 409A valuations, option grants, and board and investor reporting.

 - Run HR operations, including payroll, benefits, onboarding and offboarding, compensation planning, and employment compliance across the states where we operate.

 - Manage legal work with outside counsel, including supplier, dealer, and commercial agreements, corporate governance, IP, and regulatory matters.

 - Oversee facilities, including leases, insurance, vendors, and workplace safety, in partnership with vehicle operations.

 - Build the company's reporting on sales, inventory, unit economics, and operating metrics, with dashboards the team uses to make decisions.

 - Partner with the CEO on special projects, board preparation, priorities, and operating cadence.

 - Put systems and processes in place that hold up as we grow, without adding overhead the company doesn't need.

Qualifications

 - 5+ years of experience in finance, business operations, or strategy, including time at an early-stage, venture-backed company.

 - Experience in hardware, consumer products, automotive, or another business with physical inventory and overseas manufacturing.

 - Strong financial modeling skills and a working command of accounting, including GAAP, the monthly close, and audit.

 - Direct experience on an equity or debt raise, from model to diligence to close.

 - Comfort managing outside counsel, accountants, and advisors, and judgment about when to bring them in.

 - Working knowledge of HR operations, payroll, and benefits at a small company.

 - Clear writing and the ability to explain numbers to people outside finance.

 - Comfortable taking ownership, making decisions, and solving problems independently in a fast-moving environment.

 - Properly AI-pilled 






ABOUT INFINITE MACHINE

Our mission at Infinite Machine https://www.infinitemachine.com/?lp_location=wf is to build the best non-cars on earth. We design and manufacture premium electric vehicles that blend design with breakthrough hardware and software.

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

jobs.title: Power Systems Engineer, Launch Pad (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

POWER SYSTEMS ENGINEER, LAUNCH PAD (STARSHIP)

As a member of the Starship Launch Engineering team, you design and build the electrical systems that enable a Starship launch. At Starbase, you own power distribution and supporting electrical systems for the launch mount, tower, propellant farm, power generation and storage, and ground equipment, from design through field commissioning, partnering with mechanical, controls, and fluids engineers. Your work scales high-capacity electrical infrastructure, ensuring the world’s most powerful rocket has reliable power exactly when the pad and mission need it. The position is based at Starbase, TX, with potential travel to other SpaceX facilities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead electrical design for Starship launch pad and Starbase power systems, including power distribution, motor control, microgrids, and supporting infrastructure

• Perform detailed design across the full power system: one-lines, three-lines, control and relaying schematics, wiring diagrams, SCADA, conduit and cable routing, grounding, and construction documentation

• Design control panels, power distribution, and hazardous-area systems to NEC, NFPA 79, UL 508A, NFPA 70/70E, NESC, and IEEE standards

• Develop protective relay settings and schemes, and perform load, short-circuit, and arc-flash studies

• Own sitewide power budgets, monitoring, and metering, and coordinate with utilities so mission-critical pad equipment has reliable power.

• Scale launch and grid infrastructure, including standardized designs, to Starship production-rate targets

• Integrate electrical systems with high-power equipment, motion systems, and instrumentation, and support construction, activation, testing, and operations in the field

• Manage subcontractors and design documentation so installations match design intent and safety requirements

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or another engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience in power systems design, analysis, and build, with a focus on high-power, high-voltage systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES

• 3+ years of professional experience in a similar role

• Professional Engineering license or intention to actively seeking PE license

• Experience with power systems analysis software and tools: ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, PowerWorld, Matlab, PSCAD, PSEE, Simulink, etc

• Experience performing basic load flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, coordination, and transient stability studies

• Familiarity with industrial power systems up to 345 kV, including switchgear, transformers, BESS, VFDs, motors, distribution systems, UPS/emergency backups, power generation, relaying, metering, protective devices, and networking

• Familiarity with industrial communications protocols and networking: Modbus, IEEE C37.115, IEEE C37.111, DNP3, etc

• Experience with CAD software: Revit, AutoCAD, NX, etc

• Demonstrated initiative, creative problem-solving, and strong analytical/engineering fundamentals

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Proven ability to lead teams, work independently, and thrive in dynamic, high-stress environments with tight deadlines

• Strong organizational skills to prioritize, schedule, and implement solutions with minimal operational impact

• Ability to quickly troubleshoot issues and support technicians hands-on

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights

• Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support launch operations

• Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE

• Lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Technical Business Consultant (Global Trade Compliance)
jobs.description:
Technical Business Consultant — Global Trade Compliance

Pre-Sales Solutions Engineering | North America Territory

We are looking for a senior Global Trade Compliance Technical Business Consultant (TBC) who will serve as the domain and solutions expert embedded alongside our Global Trade Compliance Sales Executive. This is a North American pre-sales role — not a post-sale implementation role — requiring someone who can translate complex compliance requirements into compelling product demonstrations, proof-of-concept exercises, and executive-level presentations that win business.

The ideal candidate is a rare combination: a genuine Global Trade Compliance subject matter expert who also possesses the technical depth to configure and showcase GTC software solutions — and the executive presence to deliver those demonstrations credibly to Customs Directors, Chief Compliance Officers, VPs of Trade, and C-suite stakeholders.

You will own the technical dimension of every sales cycle — from discovery and requirements mapping through customized demos, RFP/RFI responses, and technical objection handling — while maintaining the trust and credibility of a true compliance practitioner in the room. You understand FTZ grantees, operators, and users. You speak CBP fluently. You know what keeps an Importer of Record up at night, and you can show — live, on screen — how our solutions solve those problems. You also understand how AI is redefining classification, screening, and document processing, and you can make that case confidently to skeptical enterprise compliance buyers.

• 6–8+ years of hands-on experience in global trade compliance — either as a practitioner (customs broker, trade compliance analyst, FTZ administrator, import/export manager) or in a technical pre-sales / solutions consulting role for a GTC software vendor.
• Deep technical proficiency with at least one major GTC platform — such as Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE, Descartes, E2open/Amber Road, SAP GTS, Oracle GTM, QAD GTC, MIC, or CargoWise — with demonstrated ability to configure and demonstrate solutions.
• Comprehensive domain fluency across: Foreign Trade Zones (FTZ) including grantee, operator, and user structures; Customs & Border Protection (CBP) compliance; Importer of Record (IOR) obligations; HTS/HS product classification; denied party and sanctioned entity screening (OFAC, BIS, ITAR); Free Trade Agreement (FTA) qualification and rules of origin; duty drawback; and export controls (EAR/ITAR).
• North America territory coverage with knowledge of vertical market dynamics in manufacturing, aerospace & defense, automotive, life sciences, retail/e-commerce, and high-tech.
• Executive presence and polished communication skills — equally effective presenting live software demos, technical architecture overviews, or business case ROI narratives to audiences ranging from IT and compliance teams to CFOs and COOs.
• Solid foundation in AI and how it applies to trade compliance — classification automation, denied party screening accuracy, intelligent document processing, duty optimization, and regulatory change monitoring.
• Collaborative operating style: works in lockstep with the Sales Executive, aligns on account strategy, and knows when to lead the room and when to enable the AE.
• Comfortable building and delivering custom demo environments tailored to a specific prospect vertical, pain point, or compliance scenario.

Core Competencies

• Deep global trade compliance domain expertise: FTZ (grantee, operator, user), CBP, IOR, HTS/HS classification, denied party screening, CTPAT, FTA qualification, duty drawback, export controls (EAR/ITAR/OFAC)
• Technical platform fluency: able to configure, demonstrate, and troubleshoot at least one enterprise GTC solution with confidence
• Requirements mapping and solution design: translates complex compliance workflows
• and regulatory requirements into structured product demonstrations and solution architectures
• Executive presence and polished presentation delivery — credible to technical, compliance, and C-suite audiences simultaneously
• AI fluency and the ability to articulate AI value to risk-averse compliance buyers in terms of accuracy, auditability, and regulatory defensibility
• Collaborative sales partnership: operates as a true co-pilot to the Sales Executive — aligned on strategy, clear on role boundaries, and always reinforcing the commercial narrative
• Curiosity and continuous learning — stays current on CBP regulatory changes, tariff policy shifts, trade agreement developments, and evolving GTC software capabilities
• Strong written communication: builds compelling technical proposals, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept documentation
• Experienced with modern sales tech: Gong, Outreach, Vidyard, and AI tools actively used to increase personal productivity
• Bias to preparation — over-prepares for every prospect interaction, researches the account deeply, and customizes every demo to the specific vertical and pain profile

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst
Sturtevant, WI | Plant-based hybrid role: 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
Get closer to the business. Make a bigger impact.
Are you a commercially minded finance professional who wants more than reporting deadlines and spreadsheet handovers?
Daniels Health is looking for a Financial Analyst to help shape decisions at the heart of our Sturtevant plant operation. You will partner directly with Operations, Sales, Transport and Customer Service—using data to uncover opportunities, improve profitability and help teams make smarter decisions every day.
This is a high-visibility role for someone who is curious, resilient and ready to get into the detail. You will see how the business runs, understand what is driving performance and turn analysis into action.
Why this role stands out
You will not be sitting on the sidelines.
You will be a key finance partner to our Sturtevant plant and wider Midwest business. Your work will influence customer profitability, pricing, service models, transport efficiency, operational performance and growth opportunities.
One day you could be assessing whether a major customer is delivering the right margin. The next, you may be helping optimize truck capacity, building a business case, preparing an RFP analysis or identifying the reason behind an unexpected cost trend.
You will work closely with the people making decisions—and your insights will help them make better ones. This is a practical, candid and fast-moving environment, so you will be comfortable navigating competing views, asking thoughtful questions and keeping perspective when priorities shift.
What you’ll make happen
Turn operational and commercial data into clear, practical recommendations.
Support profitability analysis across customers, pricing, service arrangements and cost-to-serve.
Help evaluate RFPs, contract renewals and new-business opportunities, ensuring growth is commercially sound.
Partner with Operations and Transport to improve capacity utilization, service frequency and cost efficiency.
Support plant leaders with performance reporting, KPIs, dashboards and insight they can act on.
Contribute to monthly close, including P&L review, expense analysis, variance commentary and business-unit reporting.
Support budgeting, forecasting, modelling, scenario planning and business cases.
Investigate data issues, identify bottlenecks and help improve processes across the operation.
Build stronger reporting tools and improve the quality, consistency and usefulness of business data.
What you’ll bring
Whether you began your career in public accounting or industry, you will bring strong analytical foundations and the drive to apply them in a practical, commercial setting.
2+ years’ experience in public accounting, commercial finance, FP&A, corporate finance, business partnering or a related analytical finance role.
A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large, complex or imperfect datasets.
Experience with financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and variance analysis.
Exposure to an ERP system; SAP, Enwis/Tegos or similar experience is beneficial.
Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau or another BI/reporting tool is an advantage.
A sharp commercial mindset—you look beyond the numbers to identify the risk, opportunity and action required.
The confidence to build relationships and explain finance clearly to operational and non-finance stakeholders.
A calm, adaptable and resilient approach; you can work through ambiguity, welcome constructive challenge and maintain a positive, good-humored outlook when the pace picks up.
The judgment to know when to push for answers, when to listen and how to build credibility with a broad range of stakeholders.
Why Daniels Health
Daniels Health delivers essential healthcare waste-management solutions that protect people and support safer healthcare environments. Our work is practical, purpose-led and important—and we need finance professionals who want to be equally close to the action.
In this role, you will gain broad exposure across plant operations, sales, transportation, customer profitability and financial planning. You will join a collaborative team, work with approachable leaders and have genuine scope to build your capability and take on more responsibility over time.
If you are ready to turn financial analysis into commercial impact, apply now.
