jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

The Product Management team defines guiding hypotheses for what our thermal energy storage product must achieve, for whom, by when, and why. Through market research and techno-economic analysis, we define product requirements for Engineering, develop specifications for Business Development, and guide product development, ensuring Antora builds the right product to advance its mission.

The Product Manager will perform market research, techno-economic analysis, and trade studies that inform these hypotheses, communicate the findings across the company, and own the process that verifies and validates them with engineering, business development, and analytics. Over time, the role grows into an embedded partner to engineering, business development, and analytics, helping Antora make the many trade-offs that shape Gen2 into a product that helps to solve climate change at a global scale.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Guide analytical product design work. Scope, structure and run analyses ranging from trade-off & techno-economic studies to codes & compliance development with engineering, deliver clear recommendations, and own the process of confirming each requirement is verified and validated through the design process

• Serve as the internal source of truth on product information. Align stakeholders on the product’s specs and capabilities, product development roadmap, and follow-up with the necessary experts and stakeholders when certain specs and capabilities are still developing

• Support the development of Antora’s long-term product strategy, including grid modeling, power systems analytics, and industrials market research

• Lead special projects engagements for the product. Structure and solve the most important questions related to the product that don’t yet have an owner first by collecting inbound product questions from engineering, commercial, and executive leadership, assembling the right internal and external experts, and leading workstreams towards a point of completion or handoff.

• Lead engagements with key external Antora stakeholders, including customers, financiers, regulators, electric utilities, project developers, independent engineers and codes & standards organizations, to gather market intelligence, inform product strategy, and write technical reviews & third-party reports

• Enable our policy, marketing, legal, communications teams with the right information and collateral to effectively advocate for the product. This is a range of initiatives including: identifying where regulatory constructs constrain our product, designing marketing collateral that clearly communicates our value proposition, and developing memos and messaging for investors, regulator, and legislators that highlight our product and it’s strengths.

• Understand our customers by collecting market intelligence. Build the information systems that disseminate the highest priority market insights across technical and commercial teams to help them better understand our customers’ needs and help drive product development in the right direction.

Key Qualifications

• Bachelors degree in engineering, physics, or other technical field related to Antora’s product

• Experience performing quantitative techno economic or financial analysis and knows how to structure a trade study and reason about trade offs. Can build and defend a project-economics case (NPV, IRR, cost of capital as working fluency).

• Collaborative across very different backgrounds. Communicates clearly and proactively up, down, and sideways.

• Operates independently in ambiguity. Identifies problems and scopes resolution, finds the right people, drives to a solution, prioritizes work effectively, and knows when to escalate.

• Curious, first principles thinker who wants to learn the technology, markets, and regulations deeply.

• Knows how to turn ambiguous, multi-stakeholder discussions into plans

• Questions requirements and constraints, has intuition (product sense) to question biggest constraints and drivers to constantly reassess/determine what is important for product success.

• Has personally solved an ambiguous problem through building a defensible, narrative-led economic case and motivating stakeholders to act on it; demonstrated ability to solve hard, more ambiguous, and more complex problems than typically seen at their current level

• A demonstrated willingness to push the limits of what AI can do in their role

• Motivated by impact beyond self-interest, believes in the mission, team and mission first, humility and openness, sticks through hard stretches

Additional Qualifications Desired

• Electrical engineering experience or coursework

• Energy markets or power systems economics experience or coursework

• Hardware startup or first of a kind deployment experience

• Experience developing and using software based product analysis tools

• Python proficiency

• Experience working with or for EPC firms

• Familiarity with industrial controls/SCADA integration and operational-technology (OT) cybersecurity

• Experience working on projects in international markets (particular preference for EU and Australia)

• Familiarity with European and/or Australian codes and standards

• Direct experience with microgrid or utility scale power generation projects

Work Location:  Hybrid Onsite - San Jose, CA

Salary Range:  $142,000 USD - $170,000 USD

Salary Basis:  Annual

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

When it comes to stopping climate change, we need everyone. We believe that having a diversity of backgrounds and experiences strengthens all of us, and we strive to create an environment where every one of us is empowered to create meaningful change.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist (OT)- Home Health Visits
jobs.description:
BAYADA Home Health Care is currently seeking an experienced Occupational Therapist, OT, for a per diem or part-time opportunity performing home health visits.  This office services adult and geriatric patients on a per visit basis in homes throughout Columbia County.

As a home care Occupational Therapist, you will be an integral member of a multi-disciplinary health care team that provides rehabilitative care and skilled nursing to clients, affording them the opportunity to receive the medical care required to remain at home.

Occupational Therapist, OT Responsibilities:

• Make home visits to clients in designated geographic territories.

• Perform thorough evaluations of patients’ functional status, including muscle function, endurance, visual coordination, written and verbal communication skills, and ADL and IADL performance.

• Assess cognitive, psychological and motor aspects of performance and develop individualized intervention plans to achieve favorable outcomes.

• Evaluate home environment for hazards or barriers to more independent living.

• Identify equipment needs and environmental adaptations resulting in enhanced outcomes for clients.

• Continually assess and revise the occupational therapy care plan, and participate with nursing in the multidisciplinary care plan, as appropriate.

• Educate and instruct patients, family members, or other patient representatives, in rehabilitative care and activities necessary to promote the client's health, safety and independent living.

• Accurately document observations, interventions, and evaluations pertaining to patient care management and services provided, utilizing a state-of-the-art touch pad tablet.

Occupational Therapist, OT Qualifications:

• A current Pennsylvania Occupational Therapist license.

• Prior home care experience preferred, but not required

• A minimum of one year of recent work experience as an Occupational Therapist.

• Graduation from an occupational therapy program accredited jointly by the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation of the AMA and the AOTA, as indicated by school transcript or diploma.

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

• Strong interpersonal skills, organizational skills, and problem solving skills.

• Solid computer skills; prior experience with electronic medical records (EMR) preferred.

BAYADA believes that our employees are our greatest asset:

• Enjoy being part of a team that cares and a company that believes in leading with our values.

• Develop your skills with training and scholarship opportunities.

• Advance your career with specially designed career tracks.

• Be recognized and rewarded for your compassion, excellence, and reliability.

• Benefits may include mileage reimbursement; weekly pay and direct deposit; scholarship opportunities; one-on-one training; recognition programs; referral bonuses; 401(k) with company match; and opportunities for career advancement.

BAYADA believes that our clients and their families deserve home health care delivered with compassion, excellence, and reliability.  Be part of a caring, professional team that is instrumental in providing the highest quality care while developing your career with an industry leader.  Apply now for immediate consideration.

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Relief) - San Diego, CA (Otay Ranch)
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation: pay range is $27-$56 and based on a leveling system and experience

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

Who You Are

• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work

• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $17.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Nurse (Full-Time) - Williamsburg, NYC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

VEG is a rapidly growing emergency company with hospital locations across the United States. Our mission is helping people and their pets when they need it most. We are revolutionizing emergency medicine with a “customer first” mentality and a true, employee-centric work environment.

TALENT + CULTURE AT VEG

At VEG, we want people and their pets to feel safe, secure, and valued; we want our employees to feel the same way. What we’re aiming to achieve on the customer side is equivalent in nature to what we want for our employees: to have the best experience possible. With the highest NPS score in our industry, we’re ready to ensure that VEG remains the place where the best and brightest in the emergency world not only want to work, but stay and grow. For our customers and their pets, we strive to find a way to say, “yes.” We do the same and more for our teams. In fact, VEG is one of this year’s nominees for INC Magazine’s Best Places to Work!

FOCUS

To apply a patient-centered approach while performing treatments, making patient assessments, and all other aspects of patient care. This role will promote learning and growth as an emergency veterinary technician, providing opportunities for advancement towards a Veterinary Technician Specialist certification and participating in the coordination of care. Veterinary technicians autonomously function using critical thinking and leadership to carry out patient treatment plans in coordination with the veterinary team.

WHO WE NEED

You are a credentialed veterinary technician. You are passionate and motivated. You value learning and are a team player that is honest and respectful to your peers. You love what you do. You love working with animals and people. You are comfortable adapting to new scenarios, willing to learn new techniques, and think outside the box. You have excellent interpersonal capabilities across a diverse group. You’re happy to pitch in wherever and whenever you are needed, with a positive attitude. You demonstrate the ability to accomplish assigned tasks for all areas involved, knowing when to ask for assistance. You display excellent communication skills with your peers, customers, and team.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO

All clinical team members:

• Treat each patient and customer with the highest level of compassion and care.

• Perform basic to intermediate nursing care tasks, patient monitoring, and treatments.

• Use understanding of common diseases and conditions, physical assessment, and monitoring parameters to accurately triage incoming patients.

• Administer subcutaneous, intramuscular, and intravenous medications and understand potential adverse effects of medications.

• Set-up, monitor, and administer intravenous fluid therapy including constant rate infusions and blood transfusion therapy.

• Contribute to incoming outpatient care and ongoing inpatient care.

• Participate in giving and receiving patient rounds to ensure continuity of care.

• Be trained to properly perform all aspects of CPR as a RECOVER Certified Rescuer.

• Collect samples and perform diagnostic tests including in-house and point-of-care tests and diagnostic imaging.

• Perform nursing care tasks such as placing and/or maintaining urinary catheters, nasoenteral tubes, nasal oxygen tubes, chest and abdominal tubes.

• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot oxygen cages and other oxygen administration techniques.

Veterinary technicians additionally perform:

• Administer, monitor, and maintain patients under general anesthesia with or without mechanical ventilation for patients with varied levels of risk.

• Perform advanced vascular access techniques including jugular catheter placement, sampling line placement, central line placement, intraosseous catheterization, and arterial catheterization.

• Perform advanced diagnostic techniques including ultrasonography and paracentesis,

• Participate in formulating treatment, anesthetic, and nursing care plans.

• Conduct treatments using clinical decision-making skills according to protocolized plans.

• Aid in managing patient care workload to ensure the patients are receiving uncompromised care.

• Coach and guide veterinary assistants and credentialed veterinary technicians to perform clinical tasks to maintain standards of care and encourage growth.

• Collaborate and share knowledge with teammates to ensure optimal patient care.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as VTS certification, trainer role, coordination of care, community outreach, and leadership.

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the location of the VEG practice.

• Veterinary technician specialist (VTS) certification will receive additional considerations in practice role and compensation.

• Basic computer skills to use practice management, electronic medical record, and collaboration software.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role. Experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred.

• Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and electronic) with the team and with customers

• Fine motor skills adequate for utilizing hospital equipment necessary daily such as syringes, electric clippers, computers, surgery instruments, monitors, diagnostic equipment, etc.

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance.

WHY YOU SHOULD CHOOSE US

Because emergency is all we do, so we do it best! We also offer:

• Industry-leading‌ ‌compensation‌ ($28.00 - $50.00/hr)

• Something new every day - you’ll never be bored in emergency medicine

• We build our hospitals from scratch. You’ll be using all of the latest equipment and technology.

• Generous employee pet discount

• Referral rewards - tell your friends why they should come work for VEG too!

• Health‌, Vision, and Dental ‌Insurance‌ ‌ ‌

• 401K‌ ‌w/‌ ‌company‌ ‌match‌

• Paid‌ ‌parental‌ ‌leave‌ ‌-‌ ‌10‌ ‌weeks‌ ‌of‌ ‌paid‌ ‌leave‌ ‌at‌ ‌100%‌ ‌of‌ ‌regular‌ ‌salary‌ ‌

• Unlimited‌ ‌Continuing Education opportunities - we want to help you grow in your career!

• Flexible‌ ‌work‌ ‌schedules‌ ‌for‌ ‌a‌ ‌true‌ ‌work-life‌ ‌balance‌ ‌ ‌

• Growth‌ and relocation ‌potential‌ ‌ ‌

• Groceries‌ sent‌ ‌to the hospitals weekly for the staff to enjoy,‌ ‌monthly‌ ‌and‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌contests,‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌hospital‌ ‌outings,‌ company-wide retreats,‌ ‌etc!‌ ‌

• Lastly, because while our work is serious, we believe that it should also be fun!

VEG celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. You've found the equal opportunity employer you are looking for. We can't wait to meet you!

WHAT YOU NEED

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.

• Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.

• CAM Software (Mastercam, NX, Fusion 360)

• ERP/MRP Manufacturing Systems

• Ability to lift up to 35 pounds.

THE JOB

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match: pay range is $25-$51 per hour, and is based on a leveling system and experience

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. jobs.title: Senior Director, Developer Relations
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Director of Developer Relations.

About the job

We’re hiring a Sr Director of Developer Relations to lead the global team building the strategies and programs that inspire and equip developers to win with Twilio. You’ll lead a unique, world-class org of hybrid engineer-marketers as you evolve the GTM motion that Twilio pioneered. This is a high-visibility, high-agency role reporting into Marketing, while working lockstep with Product and Go-To-Market.

The DevRel team at Twilio exists to make heroes of developers in their own organizations. You'll ensure we do this by showing up where developers live, both online and offline, while being humble, authentic and acting as a servant leader in the community. You are strategic yet deeply plugged into the Dev ecosystem, turning community engagement, technical contributions, and developer awareness into a steady drumb

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Serve as a figurehead, influencer, and key speaker on the global DevRel circuit, setting a high standard for how Twilio engages with builders online and offline.

• Define the long-term global narrative for developer marketing. Build consensus and influence at the executive level to ensure cross-functional alignment with Product, Marketing, and GTM teams.

• Recruit, mentor, and cultivate a unique global organization of Developer Evangelists, Advocates, and community specialists. Foster a culture of technical excellence that blends engineering rigor with world-class marketing storytelling.

• Guide and scale Twilio's global Startups Program, help the team shape the strategic frameworks, partnerships, and early-stage developer initiatives that establish Twilio as the foundational tech stack for the next generation of high-growth companies.

• Oversee a comprehensive technical content program (covering video, newsletters, and YouTube) to showcase the “art of the possible” with Twilio. Partner closely with the PR team to fuel our creator and influencer engine, leveraging both internal advocates and external partners to amplify developer-first storytelling.

• Evolve our community and forums strategy into a modern, high-engagement motion. Build robust User-Generated Content (UGC) and ambassador programs that turn developers into long-term advocates across modern developer surfaces.

• Spearhead Twilio’s Builder event strategy, ensuring our team is on the ground at major developer gatherings & meetups by showing, not just telling. Build strategic relationships with adjacent ecosystem partners to unlock high-impact co-marketing and launch activations.

• Act as the ultimate steward of the developer experience. Navigate and facilitate complex, sensitive public community situations with high empathy, tact, and professional media coordination, while synthesizing community signals to directly inform the product roadmap.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

• 7+ years of leadership experience managing developer relations, technical evangelism, or community advocacy programs (and 10+ years total working in this technical field).

• Proven track record of building, training, and scaling outstanding technical global teams to support local and global stakeholders.

• Deep technical baseline with an understanding of software developer personas and workflows (e.g., former full-time developer or hands-on software development experience).

• Strong data-driven execution skills with a demonstrated understanding of marketing motions and user growth metrics.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships with C-level executives, journalists, bloggers, and industry analysts.

Desired:

• Experience leading a developer relations team that directly supports a bottom-up, Product-Led Growth (PLG) self-service GTM motion.

• Firsthand experience contributing to or directing prominent open-source software communities or public engineering forums.

• An established professional network spanning a diverse set of technical communities, platform ecosystems, and developer networks.

Location

This role will be remote and based in the USA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with developers, customers, and each other. For this role, approximately 30% travel is anticipated.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

• Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $275,840 - $344,800.

• Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $292,080 - $365,100.

• Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $324,480 - $405,600.

• This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Recruiter to join our Rexel USA team in Dallas, TX!

Summary:

The Recruiter will play a vital role in shaping the talent landscape of our organization. This role will be responsible for sourcing, researching, and implementing effective recruiting strategies to attract qualified candidates across various disciplines and locations. Collaborating closely with hiring managers and organizational leaders, the Recruiter will ensure that Rexel fills open positions in a timely manner with candidates who align with our values and contribute to our success.

What You'll Do:

• Specialty, Corporate, Military and College Recruiting: Lead full-cycle recruitment for Rexel’s specialty businesses and corporate functional roles, including Human Resources, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Information Technology. Develop and execute strategic recruiting plans in partnership with hiring managers, using data-driven sourcing strategies and recruitment KPIs to measure pipeline strength, candidate quality, timeliness, and overall effectiveness. Lead college recruiting efforts to identify interns and candidates for the early-career rotational program, ACE, by building and maintaining strong relationships with universities and candidates; effectively utilizing Handshake; attending college career fairs and other campus events; and developing sustainable talent pipelines. Continuously evaluate and improve university recruiting strategies while providing hiring managers with qualified candidates and actionable market insights.
• Recruitment Lifecycle Management: Manage the recruitment process from start to finish, including conducting hiring manager intake calls, sourcing candidates, reviewing applications, conducting phone screens, providing feedback to candidates, and extending offers for various positions across multiple disciplines and locations. Execute all recruiting activities with a strong sense of urgency to meet business and hiring needs. Develop and implement a clear hiring strategy for each assigned requisition in partnership with the hiring manager.
• Workforce Planning and Analysis: Collaborate with business leaders to understand staffing needs and projections. Utilize effective workforce planning strategies, including operational analysis and research, to provide insights and recommendations that enhance the candidate pipeline and align with organizational goals.
• Networking and Candidate Sourcing: Build and maintain a strong network of contacts to identify and source qualified candidates. Leverage industry connections, job boards, and social media. Participate in career fairs, conferences, and community job fairs to engage with potential candidates and evaluate the effectiveness of these events. Use proactive and innovative sourcing techniques to identify passive candidates, expand diverse talent pools, and consistently present highly qualified candidates to hiring managers.
• Efficiency and Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements that support the achievement of recruiting goals and key performance indicators (KPIs) around time, cost, and complexity for hiring managers and the Talent Acquisition Team. Manage requisitions and candidate activity with a sense of urgency, promptly addressing barriers and ensuring timely movement through each stage of the recruitment lifecycle. Ensure a smooth transition from job opening to candidate onboarding while adhering to TA processes, policies, and legal requirements.
• Recruitment Marketing and Branding: Use creative and proactive recruitment marketing approaches to strengthen talent pipelines, increase candidate engagement, and support hiring strategies for difficult-to-fill roles.
• Performance Tracking and Reporting: Adhere to established recruitment KPIs. Track recruitment metrics to assess the effectiveness of sourcing strategies and make timely data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement. Provide regular updates to leadership on recruitment progress, challenges, and successes.
• Relationship Building: Serve as a proactive talent advisor by developing hiring strategies, setting clear expectations, providing timely updates, and partnering with hiring managers to understand their needs and build and maintain effective pipelines of qualified talent.
• Other Duties as Assigned: Perform other duties as assigned while demonstrating responsiveness, accountability, creativity, and a consistent sense of urgency in support of organizational and Talent Acquisition objectives.

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Relief) - Pleasant Hill, CA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation: pay range is $27-$56 and based on a leveling system and experience

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

• Identifies and secures strategic resource needs, ranging from next-gen LLM API integrations and specialized 3rd-party toolsets to specialized hardware and talent investments.
• Builds, inspires, and scales a world-class team of AI talent through intentional recruiting, technical mentorship, coaching, and performance management.

• 8+ years of progressive experience in machine learning, advanced data science, and AI development—with a strong recent emphasis on deploying Generative AI, LLMs, or agentic systems to production—OR an Advanced Degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a quantitative STEM field with 6+ years of relevant experience.

jobs.title: Lead Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Lead Maintenance Technician

Tuesday - Friday, 3:00AM - 11:30 AM | Saturday 7:00AM – 3:30PM

(Schedule subject to change according to business needs.)

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Lead Maintenance Technician to serve as the single point of technical leadership for our maintenance team at a high-volume pharmacy automation facility. This is a hybrid technician role — roughly half hands-on technical work and half administrative leadership — making it ideal for an experienced tech who’s ready to step into a leadership position without leaving the tools behind.

As the only Lead Tech on the team, you’ll own the full picture: diagnosing and resolving quick-fix issues on the floor, training and developing technicians, tracking equipment downtime, assigning troubleshooting tasks, and driving continuous improvement across maintenance operations. You’ll also be responsible for creating and maintaining SOPs and STPs, managing parts inventory, and representing the maintenance team in weekly cross-site meetings with colleagues. If you thrive in a role where no two days look the same — one moment you’re elbow-deep in a PLC fault, the next you’re coaching a junior tech through a repair — this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Administrative & Leadership (~50%)

• Serve as the primary technical lead for the maintenance team, acting as the bridge between technicians and site supervision
• Own quick-fix issue resolution — triage, prioritize, and either resolve directly or assign to the appropriate technician
• Track and report equipment downtime; analyze trends and assign troubleshooting tasks to drive resolution
• Train, mentor, and develop maintenance technicians; lead skill-building sessions and provide hands-on coaching
• Create, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Standard Test Procedures (STPs) for maintenance operations
• Maintain and track parts inventory; coordinate ordering and ensure critical spares are stocked
• Attend and actively participate in weekly joint calls and meetings to share updates, discuss events, and align with colleagues across sites
• Develop and maintain an overall preventive maintenance schedule based on the requirements of each device

Hands-On Technical Work (~50%)

Electrical Troubleshooting & Repair

• Measure voltage and current accurately and safely; use data to troubleshoot circuits across 460V, 220V, 120V AC and 24V DC systems
• Read electrical schematics and evaluate equipment operations based on those schematics
• Read ladder logic, download/upload PLC programs, and troubleshoot PLC functions
• Work with control circuits using photoeyes, solenoid valves, limit switches, indicating lights, and safety switches
• Troubleshoot motor starting circuits and power distribution circuits

Mechanical Troubleshooting & Repair

• Align bearings, shafts, and drives; adjust tension of belts and chains
• Identify worn or damaged parts and replace them
• Work with pneumatic circuits involving cylinders and solenoid valves
• Lubricate, oil, and clean devices as specified in their maintenance manuals
• Maintain printers and peripheral mechanical devices
• Computer & Network Systems
• Analyze cards and chips and replace if necessary
• Troubleshoot network (Ethernet) systems, cabling, and I/O devices
• Configure and troubleshoot Windows computers
• Set up and analyze RS232/RS422 communications between computers and peripheral devices
• Facilities & General Maintenance
• Perform general maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational upkeep for all facility equipment, including pharmacy automation systems, office equipment, and computer systems
• Support light construction, electrical projects, and facility infrastructure improvements
• Coordinate with outside contractors and vendors on facilities an

Continuous Improvement & Culture

• Improve quality and efficiency on the production floor
• Understand and promote McKesson’s I2CARE principles: Integrity, Inclusion, Customer-First, Accountability, Respect, Excellence
• Communicate effectively at all levels within the organization

WHAT YOU BRING

Minimum Requirements

Typically, minimum 0-2 years of relevant experience. May have degree or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

Education & Experience

• High school diploma or equivalent
• 3+ years of facilities engineering or industrial maintenance experience, with demonstrated progression into leadership or senior technical responsibilities
• Prior experience in a lead, senior, or supervisory maintenance role preferred
• Experience creating SOPs, STPs, or similar technical documentation

Technical Skills

• Working knowledge of electrical systems: 460V/220V/120V AC and 24V DC circuits, motor starters, power distribution, PLC programming (ladder logic), and control circuit devices
• Mechanical aptitude: bearing/shaft/drive alignment, belt and chain tensioning, pneumatic systems, and preventive maintenance scheduling
• Computer proficiency: Windows OS troubleshooting, Ethernet networking, RS232/RS422 serial communications, and hardware-level diagnostics (cards, chips, I/O devices)
• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics

Leadership & Core Competencies

• Proven ability to train, mentor, and develop technical staff
• Strong organizational skills with experience tracking equipment downtime, parts inventory, and maintenance schedules
• Discretionary, decisive, and organized thinking regarding best practices
• Self-motivated and self-directed with extreme attention to detail
• Flexible to meet changing business demands and situations
• Excellent oral and written communication skills; experience interfacing with customers, employees, McKesson network, and suppliers
• Comfortable presenting in meetings and collaborating cross-functionally across multiple sites

WORKING CONDITIONS

• Environment: Production/warehouse environment with closely monitored and legally compliant regulations
• Physical Requirements: 100% standing, bending, lifting, and climbing throughout shift
• Schedule: Tuesday – Saturday (subject to change per business needs)

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Expected Base Pay Range: $32.00 $34.00 hour/+ shift differential

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Relief) - New Dorp/Staten Island, NYC
jobs.location: Staten Island, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a per diem Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($21.00 - $45.00/hr)

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Associate Producer (Motion-Based Games)
jobs.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

Important Notice: ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Remote / Hybrid (Los Angeles-based preferred)
Annual salary: USD 85,000 - 115,000 per year (Final base salary within this range will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.)
Type: Full-time
Reports to: Senior Game Producer

About the Role

As an Associate Producer, you will support the end-to-end development of motion-based games — from concept through launch — ensuring projects stay on track, teams stay aligned, and our player experience remains magical, intuitive, and family-friendly.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, art, QA, and external partners to coordinate deliverables, manage schedules, and maintain clear communication across stakeholders.

This is an ideal role for someone who loves games, thrives in fast-moving environments, and cares deeply about creating meaningful experiences for kids and families.

What You’ll Do

Production & Execution

• Maintain production schedules, and milestone tracking

• Participate in and help run stand-ups and cross-functional sync meetings

• Track dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams

• Ensure builds and deliverables are on time and aligned with scope

• Prepare milestone reports and stakeholder updates

Motion-Based Gameplay Support

• Coordinate implementation of camera-based motion gameplay systems

• Support playtesting with kids and families; synthesize feedback into actionable insights

• Track motion calibration, usability improvements, and accessibility features

• Ensure experiences are intuitive for a wide age range and skill levels

• Evaluate milestones, write build notes and help compile stakeholder feedback.

Kids & Family Focus

• Advocate for age-appropriate design and safety considerations

• Support external brand or IP collaboration workflows when applicable

• Keep fun, accessibility, and inclusivity at the center of development

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the communication bridge between creative, technical, and business teams

• Partner with QA to prioritize and track bug resolution

• Support publishing needs (build delivery, feature documentation, gameplay capture coordination)

• Help coordinate external development partners when needed

What We’re Looking For

Required

• 3+ years experience in game production or project management

• Experience working on shipped game titles (mobile, console, or interactive platform)

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum workflows

• Experience with tools such as GitHub, Notion, Slack, Asana, or equivalent

• Passion for kids, family entertainment, and active play

• Flexibility to collaborate across global time zones, including Asia (particularly Hong Kong), with the understanding that recurring meetings and coordination will be required outside standard U.S. business hours.

Bonus Points

• Experience with motion-based, camera-based, or fitness-style games

• Experience working with licensed IP or external partners

• Background in consumer hardware or platform-based products

• Experience conducting or coordinating playtests with children

Who You Are

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Proactive problem solver

• Comfortable operating in a fast-growing startup environment

• Collaborative and low-ego

• Energized by building products that get kids moving and families playing together

• Comfortable with ambiguity

• Able to take initiative in a fast-paced environment

Why Join Nex Playground?

• Build category-defining motion gaming experiences

• Help shape a growing platform at an exciting stage

• Work with a passionate team focused on joy, movement, and meaningful play

• Make a real impact on how families experience games together

We Offer

• Competitive compensation package.

• Flexible working hours and vacation policy.

• Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.

• Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong. Learn more about us at https://www.nexplayground.com/about.

jobs.title: MRO Business Development Manager - Austin, TX
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Impact In This Role

The MRO Business Development Manager is responsible for identifying, developing, and expanding maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) opportunities across targeted accounts, with a focus on industrial manufacturing and automation customers. This role drives growth of MISUMI Americas Factory Automation product offerings by building strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding site-level maintenance needs, and delivering a high level of customer support. The manager partners closely with internal teams to develop account strategies, support demand forecasting, and help introduce new products, services, and solutions that improve uptime and standardize procurement for customers.

This role directly grows revenue and share of wallet within key manufacturing accounts, with a strong focus on working closely with the Spares team. The position partners with customer maintenance, engineering, and procurement teams to identify opportunities involving mechanical components and automation applications. An engineering background is a plus for building technical credibility, understanding customer requirements, diagnosing reliability and uptime challenges, and recommending the right MISUMI Americas solutions.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Develop and maintain relationships with maintenance, operations, procurement, and engineering teams across assigned accounts

• Identify and grow opportunities by understanding site-level maintenance needs, spend, and reliability challenges

• Apply engineering and technical knowledge to evaluate customer applications, review component requirements and specifications, and recommend the right solutions

• Promote MISUMI Americas Factory Automation solutions to improve uptime, reduce total cost, and increase overall share

• Provide customer feedback to internal teams to support MRO product, service, and inventory program development

• Create and deliver presentations, proposals, and account plans for customer stakeholders and internal leadership

• Apply consultative selling strategies to expand MRO revenue

• Support sales forecasting, pipeline management, and KPI tracking

• Lead negotiations and manage implementation of programs and agreements

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support account execution and ongoing customer needs

• Support on-site account development and relationship building

• All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS

Desired Traits

Required:

• 1–3 years of experience in MRO, industrial sales, business development, or application engineering within a manufacturing or industrial environment

• Technical aptitude to understand mechanical components, automation equipment, and engineering drawings or specifications, and to discuss them credibly with maintenance and engineering teams

• Strong consultative selling and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify maintenance, reliability, and operational improvement opportunities

• Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and relationship-management skills across maintenance, operations, procurement, and leadership teams

• Results-driven mindset with demonstrated success growing accounts, expanding share of wallet, and developing long-term customer programs

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present value-based solutions and business cases
